sum: This article introduces the Cascadia Region Earthquake Science Center (CRESCENT), established to address the significant seismic, tsunami, and cascading hazard risks in the Pacific Northwest. CRESCENT aims to overcome challenges such as a less mature regional earthquake culture and workforce gaps in community representation and technical training. By integrating scientific research, fostering collaboration, and leveraging new technologies, the center seeks to improve hazard assessment and resilience. The paper outlines a novel regional framework that connects science to practice, promoting equitable workforce development, societal preparedness, and an academic-regional partnership model applicable to other seismically active regions.
本文介绍了新成立的卡斯卡迪亚地区地震科学中心（CRESCENT）。该中心旨在应对美国太平洋西北地区面临的地震、海啸及连锁灾害风险。针对该地区“地震文化”不够成熟以及专业人才储备不足等挑战，CRESCENT通过整合科学研究、促进多方合作并利用新技术，致力于提升灾害评估与防灾韧性。文章阐述了该中心“科学……

t: An academic-regional partnership and co-designed research framework integrating scientific studies, education, and community engagement to translate science into resilience practices.
整合科学研究、教育与社区参与的学术-区域合作与共同设计研究框架。
Synthesized regional hazard assessments, workforce demographics, and community preparedness metrics for the Cascadia subduction zone.
综合卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带的区域灾害评估、劳动力人口统计及社区防灾指标。
Establishment of a structured regional framework (CRESCENT) to improve hazard assessment, societal preparedness, and inclusive workforce development in the Pacific Northwest.
建立了CRESCENT区域框架，以提升太平洋西北地区的灾害评估、社会防灾准备与人才培养。
The paper describes an organizational and strategic framework rather than presenting specific quantitative physical models or new observational datasets.
本文阐述的是组织与战略框架，而非具体的定量物理模型或新观测数据集。
A novel regional science-to-practice framework and academic-regional partnership model tailored for subduction zone earthquake resilience.
针对俯冲带地震韧性定制的新型区域“科学到实践”框架与学术-地方合作模式。

kc: Introduces the organizational structure and mission of the newly established Cascadia Region Earthquake Science Center (CRESCENT).
Proposes a novel academic-regional partnership model to bridge the gap between scientific research and community resilience practices.
Outlines strategies for equitable and inclusive workforce development and societal preparedness in the Pacific Northwest.
介绍了新成立的卡斯卡迪亚地区地震科学中心（CRESCENT）的组织架构与使命。
提出了一种新型学术-区域合作模式，以弥合科学研究与社区防灾实践之间的鸿沟。
概述了在太平洋西北地区开展公平、包容性人才培养与社会防灾准备的战略。
me: Co-designed research framework integrating geoscience, social science, and community engagement.
Science-to-practice translation methodologies for seismic hazard and risk mitigation.
整合地球科学、社会科学与社区参与的共同设计研究框架。
用于地震灾害与风险减轻的“科学到实践”转化方法学。
de: Analysis of regional seismic risk, community preparedness gaps, and workforce representation in the Pacific Northwest.
对美国太平洋西北地区区域地震风险、社区防灾差距及人才队伍代表性的分析。
li: As an introductory overview of a newly established center, the paper focuses on frameworks and plans rather than presenting new observational data or specific modeling results.
作为新成立中心的介绍性概述，本文侧重于框架与规划，未提供新的观测数据或具体的模拟结果。

tm.why: The paper introduces CRESCENT, a center focused on improving seismic hazard assessment, tsunami risks, and resilience in the Cascadia subduction zone.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the published abstract and metadata of the SRL paper, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates coseismic and 12-year post-seismic changes in nonlinear site response associated with the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake using surface-to-borehole spectral ratios (SBSR) at six KiK-net stations. By applying a moving-window short-time Fourier transform (STFT) during the mainshock/aftershocks and full-waveform spectral ratios for pre- and post-seismic records, the authors continuously track the predominant frequency (pf) and maximum amplification factor (Amax). During peak shaking, pf and Amax drop by 18.8–46.1% and 55.7–75.8%, respectively. Post-seismically, normalized multi-station curves show that pf undergoes a two-stage log-linear recovery: a rapid 138.1 s first stage restoring 58% of the drop, followed by a ~16.6-year slow dynamics recovery. Conversely, Amax exhibits a single-stage log-linear recovery, fully returning to pre-seismic levels within ~229.1 s. This stark contrast suggests pf and Amax are governed by different physical mechanisms (wave velocity vs. structural stress gradients).
本研究利用6个KiK-net台站的地表-井下谱比（SBSR），研究了2011年Mw 9.0日本东北大地震同震及震后12年的非线性场地响应变化。通过滑动窗短时傅里叶变换（STFT）和全波形谱比法，连续追踪了卓越频率（pf）和最大放大系数（Amax）。强震期间，pf和Amax分别下降18.8–46.1%……

t: Applies short-time Fourier transform (STFT) sliding-window surface-to-borehole spectral ratios (10.24 s window, 1 s step, 1.5 Hz Parzen smoothing) averaged over 18 horizontal directions to track predominant frequency and maximum amplification continuously.
采用10.24秒滑动窗短时傅里叶变换计算18个方向平均的地表-井下谱比，连续追踪卓越频率与最大放大系数。

Uses surface and downhole strong-motion accelerograms from six KiK-net stations in northern Honshu spanning pre-seismic events, the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki mainshock (PGA > 470 cm/s²), aftershocks, and 12 years of post-seismic earthquakes.
使用日本本州北部6个KiK-net台站的震前、2011年Mw 9.0主震、余震及震后12年强震记录。

Mainshock shaking reduces predominant frequency by 18.8–46.1% and maximum amplification by 55.7–75.8%. Normalized predominant frequency recovers in two log-linear stages (138.1 s and 16.6 years), whereas amplification fully recovers in one stage within 229.1 s.
同震卓越频率和最大放大系数分别下降18.8–46.1%和55.7–75.8%；前者呈138.1秒和16.6年两阶段恢复，…
Station FKSH09 showed an unexplained anomalous drop in maximum amplification between 10^5 and 10^7 seconds and had to be excluded from normalization; 53 of 59 high-PGA stations were also excluded.
59个高PGA台站中仅6个可用，且FKSH09台站在10^5–10^7秒出现不明放大系数下降而被剔除。

Unifies coseismic and 12-year post-seismic spectral ratio tracking to define exact recovery end times, revealing that maximum amplification recovers within minutes while predominant frequency takes over a decade.
首次统一连续追踪同震至震后12年谱比并确定恢复终点，揭示最大放大系数与卓越频率恢复机制的截然不同。

kc: Continuous 12-year monitoring (2011–2023) bridging coseismic and long-term post-seismic site response evolution for the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake.

Discovery of a stark divergence in recovery behavior: predominant frequency follows a two-stage log-linear recovery (~138.1 s rapid stage, ~16.6 years slow stage), whereas maximum amplification fully recovers in a single rapid stage (~229.1 s).
Demonstration that site amplification factor is governed by fast-recovering structural attributes (e.g., in-situ stress and modulus gradients) rather than slow-dynamics material wave velocity.
对2011年Mw 9.0日本东北大地震进行了长达12年（2011–2023年）的连续监测，贯通了同震与长期震后场地响应演化过程。
发现了恢复行为的显著差异：卓越频率遵循两阶段对数线性恢复（约138.1秒快速阶段和约16.6年缓慢阶段），而最大放大系数仅通过单阶段快速恢复（约229.1秒）即回到震前水平。
证明了场地放大系数受快速恢复的结构属性（如原位应力和模量梯度）控制，而非受慢动力学控制的介质波速。
me: Surface-to-borehole spectral ratio (SBSR) calculated via Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) with a 10.24 s moving window and 1 s step for mainshock and aftershock records.
Full-waveform SBSR for pre-seismic and long-term post-seismic weak-motion records, smoothed with a 1.5 Hz Parzen window.
Rotational synthesis across 18 horizontal azimuths (averaging EW and NS components) to eliminate site anisotropy and obtain isotropic site response.
Logarithmic-time binning (0.5 log10(s) intervals), multi-station normalization, and piecewise log-linear regression to quantify recovery timescales.
针对主震和余震记录，采用10.24秒滑动窗和1秒步长的短时傅里叶变换（STFT）计算地表-井下谱比（SBSR）。
针对震前和震后长期弱震记录采用全波形SBSR，并使用1.5 Hz带宽的Parzen窗进行平滑。
合成18个水平方位角的地震动记录并取平均，以消除场地各向异性影响并获得各向同性场地响应。
在对数时间轴上按0.5间隔分箱平均、多台站归一化及分段对数线性回归，量化恢复时间尺度。
de: Three-component surface and downhole strong-motion acceleration records from 6 selected KiK-net stations (FKSH09, FKSH10, IBRH11, IBRH12, IBRH15, TCGH12) in northern Honshu, Japan.
Dataset spans 608–843 pre-seismic records, the 2011 Mw 9.0 mainshock (PGA > 470 cm/s² at all 6 stations), 10–12 immediate aftershocks, and 1,827–1,967 post-seismic events up to 2023 (10^8.5 s).
日本本州北部6个精选KiK-net台站（FKSH09、FKSH10、IBRH11、IBRH12、IBRH15、TCGH12）的地表和井下三分量强震加速度记录。
数据集涵盖每个台站608–843条震前记录、2011年Mw 9.0主震记录（PGA均大于470 cm/s²）、10–12条早期余震，以及截至2023年（10^8.5秒）的1,827–1,967条震后事件记录。
li: Only 6 out of 59 high-PGA (>200 cm/s²) KiK-net stations could be used due to borehole depth issues, station updates, influence from other large earthquakes, or lack of a clear predominant frequency peak.
Station FKSH09 exhibited an unexplained anomalous drop in maximum amplification factor between 10^5 and 10^7 seconds and had to be excluded from the final amplification normalization.
A wide 1.5 Hz Parzen smoothing bandwidth was required to stabilize sliding-window spectra, trading off spectral frequency resolution.
在59个高PGA（>200 cm/s²）KiK-net台站中，受钻孔深度、台站更新、其他强震干扰或缺乏清晰卓越频率峰值限制，仅能筛选出6个台站。
FKSH09台站在震后10^5至10^7秒期间出现原因不明的最大放大系数显著下降，最终在放大系数归一化计算中被剔除。
为保证滑动窗谱比结果的稳定性，采用了较宽的1.5 Hz Parzen平滑带宽，牺牲了一定的频率分辨率。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates nonlinear site response and ground-motion amplification using strong-motion borehole records from the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake.

The paper tracks temporal changes in shallow material properties and site empirical transfer functions over time, closely paralleling seismic interferometry approaches for monitoring near-surface healing.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 16-page accepted manuscript PDF including all text sections, equations/regressions, 6 figures, and 2 tables.

sum: Understanding the age and origin of chemical heterogeneities in the Earth's mantle is a fundamental challenge in geodynamics and geochemistry. This study presents ultra-high-precision neodymium isotope measurements (3.1 ppm 2 s.d. long-term reproducibility) using a five-line multi-dynamic TIMS method on young submarine lavas from Fani Maoré in the Comoros archipelago. The authors discover a statistically significant positive μ142Nd anomaly (+3.2 ± 0.9 ppm), indicating a mantle source formed within the first 100 Myr of Earth's history. Combined with laser-heated diamond anvil cell experiments measuring Sm and Nd partitioning between bridgmanite and melt at 53–97 GPa, isotopic evolution modeling shows that the anomaly is best explained by incorporating ~9–11% Hadean bridgmanite crystallized from a deep magma ocean, plus ~0.4% recycled sediment, into ordinary mantle. This demonstrates incomplete mantle mixing over 4.3 billion years.
本研究利用新型五线多动态热电离质谱（TIMS）方法（长期外部精度达3.1 ppm），测量了科摩罗群岛Fani Maoré海底火山熔岩的钕同位素，并结合53–97 GPa激光加热金刚石压腔（DAC）实验测定了布里奇曼石-熔体的Sm、Nd分配系数。结果显示Fani Maoré熔岩具有显著的正μ142Nd……

t: Used a five-line multi-dynamic TIMS method for high-precision Nd isotopes, laser-heated DAC experiments (53–97 GPa) for bridgmanite-melt Sm/Nd partitioning, and isotopic mixing models.
采用五线多动态TIMS测定高精度Nd同位素，结合53–97 GPa激光加热DAC实验与同位素混合模型。
Analysed 13 basanites from the submarine Fani Maoré volcano and 8 basanites and phonolites from the flank of Mayotte, plus synthetic pyrolite glass in DAC experiments.
分析了Fani Maoré海底火山13个碧玄岩、Mayotte侧翼8个样品及DAC合成地幔岩玻璃。

Fani Maoré basanites yield a mean μ142Nd of +3.2 ± 0.9 ppm (2 s.e.) and DAC experiments yield Dliq-brid(Nd) = 0.24 ± 0.12 and Dliq-brid(Sm) = 0.45 ± 0.10, requiring 9–11% Hadean bridgmanite in the source.
Fani Maoré的μ142Nd均值为+3.2±0.9 ppm，测定了深部Sm/Nd分配系数，证明源区含9–11%冥古…
The crystallization timescale and exact age of the terrestrial magma ocean are poorly constrained, requiring an assumed crystallization age of 4.46 ± 0.05 Ga.
地球岩浆洋的确切结晶年龄和时间尺度受限，需假设4.46±0.05 Ga的年龄。
First identification of Hadean bridgmanite remnants in modern ocean island lavas enabled by unprecedented 3.1 ppm long-term TIMS precision and direct 53–97 GPa partitioning measurements.
依托3.1 ppm长期精度与超高压分配实验，首次在现代洋岛熔岩中识别出冥古宙布里奇曼石残余。

kc: Achieved a 2-year long-term reproducibility of 3.1 ppm (2 s.d.) on 142Nd/144Nd using a five-line multi-dynamic TIMS method.
Detected a statistically significant positive μ142Nd anomaly (+3.2 ± 0.9 ppm, 2 s.e.) in modern basanites from the Fani Maoré submarine volcano.
Measured Sm and Nd partition coefficients between bridgmanite and melt at deep-mantle conditions (53–97 GPa) using a laser-heated diamond anvil cell.
Demonstrated via ternary isotopic mixing models that ~9–11% Hadean bridgmanite and ~0.4% recycled sediment in ordinary mantle explain both 142Nd and 143Nd signatures.
采用五线多动态TIMS方法，实现了142Nd/144Nd比值3.1 ppm（2 s.d.）的两年长期重现性。
在Fani Maoré海底火山的现代碧玄岩中检测出显著的正μ142Nd异常（+3.2 ± 0.9 ppm, 2 s.e.）。
利用激光加热金刚石压腔测定了深部地幔条件下（53–97 GPa）布里奇曼石与熔体间的Sm和Nd分配系数。
通过三元同位素混合模型证明，普通地幔中混入约9–11%的冥古宙布里奇曼石和约0.4%的再循环沉积物可同时解释142Nd和143Nd特征。
me: Five-line multi-dynamic thermal ionization mass spectrometry (TIMS) for ultra-high-precision Nd isotope ratio measurements.
Four-step chemical separation procedure to isolate Nd and eliminate Sm and Ce isobaric interferences.
Laser-heated diamond anvil cell (DAC) fractional crystallization experiments at 53–97 GPa and 3,200–3,700 K with STEM-EDXS chemical mapping.
Two-step isotopic evolution and ternary mass-balance mixing modeling of magma ocean solidification products, ordinary mantle, and subducted sediments.
用于超高精度Nd同位素比值测量的五线多动态热电离质谱法（TIMS）。
分离Nd并消除Sm和Ce同量异位素干扰的四步化学分离流程。
在53–97 GPa和3,200–3,700 K下进行的激光加热金刚石压腔（DAC）分步结晶实验及STEM-EDXS化学成像。
岩浆洋凝固产物、普通地幔和俯冲沉积物的两步同位素演化与三元质量平衡混合模拟。
de: 13 basanite samples dredged from the submarine Fani Maoré volcano (2018–2021 MAYOBS cruises) and 8 basanite/phonolite samples from Petite-Terre, Mayotte.
Repeated analyses of JNdi-1 and AMES Rennes Nd pure solution standards over two analytical sessions spanning 2 years.
High-pressure, high-temperature DAC experiments on synthetic pyrolitic glass doped with 3,000 ppm Sm and Nd.
从Fani Maoré海底火山采集的13个碧玄岩样品（2018–2021年MAYOBS航次）以及Mayotte岛Petite-Terre的8个碧玄岩/响岩样品。
在跨越两年的两个分析时段内对JNdi-1和AMES Rennes Nd纯溶液标准物质进行的重复测试。
对掺杂3,000 ppm Sm和Nd的合成地幔岩（pyrolite）玻璃进行的高温高压DAC实验。
li: The exact timing and crystallization timescale of the terrestrial magma ocean are uncertain, requiring an assumed age of 4.46 ± 0.05 Ga.
Lack of convergence in the magnitude of the nuclear field shift (NFS) effect across isotopes prevented mathematical correction of one affected sample (DR1802-1).
Fractional crystallization modeling used a constant-D batch equation approximation rather than iterative integration, though the difference is negligible.
地球岩浆洋的确切形成时间和结晶时间尺度存在不确定性，模型需假设4.46 ± 0.05 Ga的年龄。
由于核场位移（NFS）效应在不同同位素间的幅度缺乏收敛性，无法对受影响样品（DR1802-1）进行数学修正。
分步结晶模拟使用了恒定分配系数D的批处理方程近似而非迭代积分，尽管两者差异可忽略不计。

tm.why: The paper investigates deep mantle chemical heterogeneities, Hadean magma ocean solidification, and long-term survival of bridgmanite in the convecting mantle.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 23-page Nature PDF including main text, figures, Methods, and Extended Data.

sum: Simulation-based ultrasonic non-destructive testing methods like reverse time migration (RTM) and full-waveform inversion (FWI) require accurate excitation source characterization, especially when transducer apertures are comparable to acoustic wavelengths. This paper introduces an adjoint-based distributed source inversion (DSI) strategy to reconstruct an effective spatio-temporal transducer model directly from experimental waveforms without explicit piezoelectric modeling. Using spectral-element elastic wave simulations in Salvus and L-BFGS optimization with analytical step lengths, the method calibrates a collection of point sources across the transducer aperture. Validated on directivity measurements from an aluminum half-cylinder with a 1 MHz transducer, DSI with amplitude-compensating receiver weighting accurately reproduces waveforms and directivity patterns up to ±80°. Subsequent synthetic RTM and FWI benchmarks on a three-hole aluminum block demonstrate that capturing heterogeneous spatio-temporal source characteristics at high aperture angles is essential for FWI to resolve deep defects (achieving an F1-score of 0.6203 versus 0.1832 for uniform sources).
针对大孔径超声换能器非均匀激发导致波场模拟失真的问题，本文提出一种基于伴随状态的分布式震源反演（DSI）方法。该方法利用谱元法（Salvus）进行二维弹性波正演，结合L-BFGS算法和解析最优步长，直接从铝半圆柱体的17个接收器实验波形中反演换能器孔径上离散点源的独立时空子波。结果表明，采用振幅补偿……

t: An adjoint-based distributed source inversion represents an ultrasonic transducer as 20 independent point sources across its aperture, updating spatio-temporal wavelets via steepest descent and L-BFGS with analytical step lengths and amplitude-compensating receiver weights.
基于伴随法的分布式震源反演将换能器表示为20个独立点源，结合L-BFGS、解析步长和振幅补偿权重反演时空子波。
Experimental P-wave directivity dataset on a 0.3 m diameter aluminum half-cylinder excited by a 1 MHz, 12.7 mm aperture transducer, recorded by 17 receivers spaced every 10° from -80° to +80°.
在直径0.3米铝半圆柱体上采集1 MHz、12.7毫米孔径换能器激发的P波实验数据，由-80°至+80°间隔10°的17…

Amplitude-compensated DSI (DSI 2) accurately reproduces waveforms across all ±80° angles with >=4 points per wavelength, and boosts synthetic FWI defect reconstruction F1-score to 0.6203 compared to 0.1832 for a uniform source.
振幅补偿DSI准确恢复全角度波形，并在合成铝块FWI中将三孔缺陷重构的F1分数提升至0.6203（均匀源仅为0.1832…
Uses a 2D non-dissipative isotropic model that omits 3D spreading and attenuation, and yields setup-specific effective sources that may not directly transfer across different coupling conditions.
采用二维无耗散模型忽略了三维扩散与衰减，且反演源包含特定耦合条件，限制了跨实验直接迁移。

Reconstructs a fully heterogeneous spatio-temporal ultrasound transducer model via adjoint inversion without assuming spatial wavelet uniformity or requiring explicit piezoelectric finite-element modeling.
无需均匀子波假设或压电显式建模，直接通过伴随反演重构出时空异质的超声换能器有效模型。

kc: Developed an adjoint-based distributed source inversion (DSI) framework using L-BFGS and analytical optimal step lengths to estimate spatio-temporal transducer signatures.
Validated DSI experimentally on an aluminum half-cylinder dataset, showing that amplitude-compensating weighting (1/sqrt(A_r)) accurately recovers waveforms and directivity across all angles.
Established sampling guidelines showing that 4 source points per P-wavelength and 20-degree receiver spacing suffice for robust source reconstruction.
Demonstrated via synthetic RTM and FWI studies that heterogeneous spatio-temporal source modeling is vital for FWI to resolve deep defects using long-offset data.
开发了结合L-BFGS与解析最优步长的伴随分布式震源反演（DSI）框架，用于估计完整的时空换能器特征。
在铝半圆柱体实验数据集上进行了验证，证明振幅补偿加权（1/sqrt(A_r)）能在所有孔径角下准确恢复波形和方向性。
确立了采样准则，表明每个P波波长至少4个源点及20°接收器间距即可实现稳健的震源重构。
通过合成RTM和FWI研究证明，精确的异质时空震源建模对于FWI利用长偏移距数据分辨深部缺陷至关重要。
me: 2D linear isotropic elastic wave modeling using the spectral element method (SEM) in Salvus with central difference time integration.
Adjoint-state gradient computation (first optimize, then discretize) for a spatially and temporally parameterized point-source collection.
Two-stage optimization combining 10 steepest-descent iterations and 40 L-BFGS iterations with exact linear-problem optimal step lengths.
Amplitude-compensating receiver weighting (1/sqrt(A_r)) in the L2 misfit functional to balance low- and high-aperture angle contributions.
使用Salvus中的谱元法（SEM）和中心差分时间积分进行二维线性各向同性弹性波模拟。
针对时空参数化的点源集合，采用先优化后离散（OTD）的伴随状态法计算梯度。
采用两阶段优化策略，结合10次最速下降迭代和40次L-BFGS迭代，并利用线性性质计算解析最优步长。
在L2误差泛函中引入振幅补偿接收器加权（1/sqrt(A_r)），以平衡低孔径角和高孔径角的信号贡献。
de: Experimental ultrasonic measurements on a 0.3 m diameter aluminum half-cylinder with one 1 MHz source transducer (12.7 mm diameter) and 17 receivers spaced at 10 degrees.
Sensitivity tests varying the number of distributed source points (N_s = 5 to 160) and receiver count (N_r = 3 to 17).
Synthetic 2D ultrasonic RTM and FWI benchmarks on a 380 mm x 90 mm aluminum block with three vertically aligned circular holes (diameters 3, 4, and 6 mm).
在直径0.3米的铝半圆柱体上进行超声实验测量，使用1个1 MHz源换能器（直径12.7毫米）和17个间隔10°的接收器。
改变分布式点源数量（N_s = 5至160）和接收器数量（N_r = 3至17）的参数敏感性测试。
在含三个垂直排列圆孔（直径3、4、6毫米）的380 mm × 90 mm铝块上进行二维合成超声RTM和FWI基准测试。
li: Relies on a 2D non-dissipative elastic approximation, neglecting 3D geometric spreading, out-of-plane radiation, material attenuation, and anisotropy.
Reconstructed effective source models absorb setup-specific coupling conditions, limiting direct transferability to other specimens without recalibration.
Receiver uncertainties such as positioning errors and directional sensitivity are not explicitly modeled.
依赖二维无耗散弹性近似，忽略了三维几何扩散、面外能量辐射、介质衰减和各向异性。
重构的有效震源模型包含了特定实验装置的耦合条件，限制了其在不重新校准情况下向其他试件的直接迁移。
未显式建模接收器的位置误差和方向敏感性等不确定性。

tm.why: The paper develops an adjoint-based distributed source inversion method and demonstrates its critical impact on ultrasonic reverse time migration (RTM) and full-waveform inversion (FWI).
The core methodology formulates and solves a spatio-temporal distributed source inverse problem using continuous adjoint equations, L-BFGS optimization, and analytic optimal step lengths.
Wavefield simulations are performed using the spectral element method (SEM) implemented in the GPU-accelerated solver Salvus to model elastic wave propagation.

ev.notes: All metadata, equations, experimental configurations, numerical parameters, and quantitative results (including Table 1 and Figs. 1-12) were extracted directly from the full 13-page PDF.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution 3-D isotropic shear-wave velocity (Vs) model of the Dabie Orogenic Belt (DOB) and southern Tan-Lu Fault (F4) in east-central China. Using ambient-noise cross-correlations from 176 dense short-period temporary stations (~10 km spacing) supplemented by 32 broadband stations, the authors extracted 3,333 Rayleigh-wave phase-velocity dispersion curves (1–19.8 s) and inverted them directly for 3-D Vs structure via DSurfTomo. Resolution tests and Monte Carlo diagnostics confirm robust imaging in the upper to middle crust (up to ~25 km). The model delineates low-velocity zones beneath the Hefei Basin, the F4 fault-basin corridor, and a localized middle-crustal lens in the Changpu-Wumiao region, contrasted with high-velocity zones beneath mapped ultrahigh-pressure metamorphic (UHPM), crystalline, and intrusive domains. Compared to regional models, this dense-array study resolves localized crustal segmentation shaped jointly by collisional inheritance, basin development, and fault reactivation.

t: Direct 3-D surface-wave tomography (DSurfTomo) inverts Rayleigh-wave phase-velocity dispersion measurements directly for 3-D isotropic Vs structure using fast marching ray tracing and wavelet-based sparsity constraints.
采用DSurfTomo三维面波直接成像方法，结合快速行进法射线追踪与小波稀疏约束直接反演三维Vs结构。

Reliability decreases with depth (robust above 15 km, broad trends at 15–25 km), and the ray-based isotropic inversion neglects finite-frequency effects and crustal radial/azimuthal anisotropy.

First dense-array (~10 km spacing) 3-D Vs model across the Dabie Orogen and southern Tan-Lu Fault that separates localized fault-corridor and metamorphic anomalies merged in prior regional models.
首次利用~10 km间距密集台阵精细分离了此前区域模型中被平滑合并的郯庐断裂走廊与大别变质带局域异常。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution 3-D upper-to-middle crustal Vs model of the Dabie Orogen and southern Tan-Lu Fault using a 176-station dense short-period array combined with 32 broadband stations.
Resolved fine-scale separation between low-velocity fault/basin corridors (Hefei Basin, Tan-Lu Fault) and high-velocity metamorphic/intrusive blocks (Tongcheng, Shangcheng-Jinzhai, Qichun).
Identified a localized middle-crustal low-velocity lens in the Changpu-Wumiao region spatially associated with fault corridors and hydrothermal activity.
Demonstrated that local upper-crustal seismicity clusters along fault systems, basin margins, and velocity gradients controlled by inherited structural weaknesses.
联合176个密集短周期台站与32个宽频带台站，构建了大别造山带及郯庐断裂南段的高分辨率中上地壳三维Vs模型。
精细区分了低速盆地/断裂走廊（合肥盆地、郯庐断裂）与高速变质/侵入岩块体（桐城、商城-金寨、蕲春）。
识别出菖蒲-五庙地区受构造控制的局域中地壳低速透镜体，与断裂带及地热流体活动空间相关。
揭示了研究区浅部地震活动主要沿断裂系、盆地边缘及高低速梯度带展布，受控于先存构造薄弱带。
me: Vertical-vertical (ZZ) ambient-noise cross-correlation and empirical Green's function (EGF) retrieval.

Fundamental-mode Rayleigh-wave phase-velocity dispersion picking via image analysis with three-stage quality control (SNR >= 5, far-field criterion, sliding-window outlier removal, and neighboring-path clustering).
Direct 3-D surface-wave tomography (DSurfTomo) using fast marching ray tracing and wavelet-based sparsity-constrained iteratively reweighted least-squares inversion.

Model appraisal using 1-D depth-sensitivity kernels, ray-path hit counts, checkerboard resolution tests (0.2° and 0.5°), L-curve regularization analysis, and 50-realization Monte Carlo noise propagation.
垂直分量（ZZ）背景噪声互相关计算与经验格林函数（EGF）提取。
基于图像分析法的基阶瑞利波相速度频散提取及三级质量控制（信噪比≥5、远场条件、滑动窗口滤波与邻近路径聚类剔除）。
基于快速行进法射线追踪和小波域稀疏约束迭代重加权最小二乘的三维面波直接成像（DSurfTomo）。
综合一维深度敏感核、射线密度、检测板测试（0.2°和0.5°）、L曲线正则化分析及50次蒙特卡洛误差传播评估模型可靠性。
de: Continuous vertical-component ambient noise recorded by 176 EPS-QS10 short-period stations deployed from June to August 2022 (~10 km spacing, down-sampled to 10 Hz).
Supplemental dispersion measurements from 32 broadband stations in the study area from a prior deployment (Luo et al., 2019).
3,333 quality-controlled path-dependent Rayleigh-wave phase-velocity dispersion curves spanning periods of 1.0 to 19.8 s.
Catalogued local earthquake epicenters (M >= 2.0, 1917–2024) compiled from ISC, ANSS, and CENC catalogues for seismotectonic comparison.
2022年6月至8月布设的176个EPS-QS10短周期台站连续垂直分量背景噪声数据（台间距约10 km，降采样至10 Hz）。
研究区内已有的32个宽频带台站补充频散测量数据（Luo et al., 2019）。
经质控筛选后的3333条路径依赖瑞利波相速度频散曲线，周期范围1.0至19.8 s。
整合自ISC、ANSS和中国地震台网中心的本地地震目录（1917–2024年，M ≥ 2.0）用于地震构造对比。
li: Model reliability decreases significantly below ~25 km depth due to reduced long-period measurements, lower ray-path density, and broader sensitivity kernels.
Both inversion and checkerboard tests rely on the ray-theoretical approximation, neglecting finite-frequency effects, scattering, and wavefront healing.
Only ZZ cross-correlations were inverted for an effective isotropic Vs model, leaving radial and azimuthal crustal anisotropy unmodeled.
Isotropic Vs anomalies alone cannot uniquely distinguish between competing UHPM exhumation mechanisms (vertical extrusion vs. lateral underplating vs. channel flow) or unique lithologies.
受长周期数据减少、射线密度降低和敏感核变宽限制，25 km以深模型的可靠性显著下降。
反演和检测板测试基于射线理论近似，未显式考虑有限频效应、散射和波前愈合。
仅使用ZZ互相关反演等效各向同性Vs模型，未解析地壳径向和方位各向异性。
单一Vs异常无法唯一区分超高压变质岩折返机制（垂向挤出、侧向底垫或通道流）及唯一岩性成因。

tm.why: The study constructs a 3-D shear-wave velocity model using Rayleigh-wave phase-velocity measurements from dense-array ambient-noise cross-correlations.
It applies direct 3-D surface-wave tomography (DSurfTomo) to invert path-dependent Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves for crustal shear-wave velocity.
The paper investigates the upper to middle crustal architecture, ultrahigh-pressure metamorphic terranes, and post-collisional tectonic evolution of the Dabie Orogenic Belt.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 15-page published PDF (Tectonophysics 936, 2026, 231309), including full text, equations, Table 1, and Figures 1–11.

sum: What controls giant earthquake occurrence remains a central question in seismology. Analyzing global and regional centroid moment tensor catalogs (GCMT and NIED F-net) alongside regional stress datasets (Japan inland stress map and World Stress Map), this study reveals a robust relationship between earthquake size distribution (Gutenberg-Richter b value) and fault dip in subduction zones. Shallow thrust earthquakes on ultralow-angle faults (<15° dip) exhibit an exceptionally low b value of ~0.65 compared to ~1.1 for dips >30°, indicating a much higher probability of self-similar rupture growth into giant earthquakes. Through three case studies—inland Japan seismicity, global strike-slip faults, and mid-ocean ridge normal faults—the authors demonstrate that b values minimize when fault geometry aligns with the regional stress field under low effective friction (μ ≈ 0.2). In subduction zones, a seaward-dipping maximum principal stress axis rotates toward ~20° before megathrust events, rendering ~15° faults optimal for catastrophic rupture.
巨型地震的控制机制是地震学的核心问题。本研究结合全球（GCMT）和日本（NIED F-net）震源机制目录及区域应力场数据（日本内陆应力图和世界应力图），揭示了俯冲带地震震级-频度关系（Gutenberg-Richter b值）与断层倾角之间的显著关联。倾角小于15°的超低角度浅源逆冲断层表现出极低……

t: The authors bin shallow earthquake focal mechanisms by dip angle, fault instability index (I), and azimuthal stress misalignment (Δϕ), estimating Gutenberg-Richter b values via the maximum-likelihood method and relating them to Coulomb failure mechanics.
按断层倾角、不稳定性指数和应力方位角差对浅源震源机制分组，利用最大似然法估计b值并结合库仑破裂准则分析。

They analyze the 1976–2024 Global CMT catalog (subduction thrust, global strike-slip, mid-ocean ridge normal faults), the 1997–2024 NIED F-net CMT catalog in Japan, the Japanese inland stress map, and the World Stress Map.
使用1976–2024年GCMT目录、1997–2024年日本F-net目录、日本内陆应力图及世界应力图数据。

Subduction thrust b values drop from ~1.1 for dips >30° to ~0.65 for dips <15° (SE ~0.05). Across all regimes, b values minimize on planes optimally oriented to the regional stress field with effective friction μ ≈ 0.2.
俯冲逆冲地震b值从倾角>30°时的~1.1降至<15°时的~0.65；最优应力取向且有效摩擦μ≈0.2时b值最小。
Stress maps in Japan and WSM are derived from focal mechanisms and thus not independent of the earthquake catalogs; furthermore, the proposed stress-alignment explanation is not necessarily unique.
应力图反演自震源机制，与地震目录非完全独立；且所提出的应力取向解释并非唯一。

Reveals a previously overlooked dependence of subduction earthquake b values on fault dip and links ultralow-angle megaearthquakes to optimal alignment with a seaward-dipping, time-varying principal stress axis.
首次揭示俯冲带b值对断层倾角的强烈依赖性，将超低角度巨型地震归因于向海倾斜主应力轴的震前旋转与最优匹配。

kc: Discovered that shallow subduction-zone thrust earthquakes on ultralow-angle faults (<15° dip) have extremely low b values (~0.65) compared to steeper faults (~1.1 for >30° dip).

Demonstrated across three tectonic settings (inland Japan, global strike-slip, mid-ocean ridges) that b values decrease systematically when focal mechanisms align optimally with the background stress field.
Inferred a low effective coefficient of friction (μ ≈ 0.2) along plate boundaries from the angular offset of minimum b values relative to principal stress axes.

Proposed a cyclic stress-rotation model in subduction zones where tectonic loading decreases the plunge of the seaward-dipping σ1 axis to ~20°, making ~15° ultralow-angle faults optimal for giant rupture growth.
发现俯冲带超低角度（倾角<15°）浅源逆冲地震具有极低的b值（约0.65），而倾角>30°时b值约为1.1。
通过三个构造背景案例（日本内陆、全球走滑断层、洋中脊正断层）证实，当震源机制与背景应力场一致（处于最优破裂方向）时b值显著降低。
根据最小b值相对于主应力轴的角度偏移，推断出板块边界的有效摩擦系数较低（μ ≈ 0.2）。
提出了俯冲带应力循环旋转模型：长期构造加载使向海倾斜的σ1轴倾伏角减小至约20°，从而使约15°的超低角度断层处于最优破裂方向，促进巨型地震生长。
me: Maximum-likelihood estimation of Gutenberg-Richter b values and standard errors across binned fault dip angles and stress alignment metrics.
Modified Vavryčuk fault instability index (I) calculation using deviatoric stress tensors and NIED F-net focal mechanisms on normalized Mohr circles.
Azimuthal angle difference (Δϕ) analysis between focal mechanism P-axes and World Stress Map maximum horizontal compressive stress (SHmax) directions.
Analytical derivation relating σ1 plunge angle (δ), differential stress (Δσ), vertical stress, pore pressure, and friction coefficient under Coulomb failure criteria.
采用最大似然法计算不同断层倾角分组及应力一致性指标分组下的Gutenberg-Richter b值及其标准误差。
利用偏应力张量和NIED F-net震源机制，在归一化莫尔圆上计算改进的Vavryčuk断层不稳定性指数（I）。
分析全球走滑地震震源机制P轴与世界应力图最大水平主压应力（SHmax）方向之间的水平方位角差（Δϕ）。
基于库仑破裂准则推导主压应力σ1倾伏角（δ）、差应力（Δσ）、垂向应力、孔隙压力与摩擦系数之间的解析关系。
de: Global CMT (GCMT) catalog (1976–2024) for shallow (<30 km) subduction-zone reverse faults (within 200 km of PB2002 trenches), global strike-slip faults (dip >60°), and mid-ocean ridge normal faults (within 100 km of ridge axes).
NIED F-net CMT catalog (1997–2024, depth <30 km, Mw ≥ 4.2) paired with the 0.2° gridded shallow inland stress map of Japan.
World Stress Map (WSM) smoothed SHmax dataset on a 0.2° grid (variable search radius 100 to 1000 km).
1976–2024年全球CMT（GCMT）目录，提取俯冲带浅源（<30 km）逆冲地震（PB2002海沟陆侧200 km内）、全球走滑地震（倾角>60°）及洋中脊正断层地震（洋脊轴100 km内）。
1997–2024年日本NIED F-net震源机制目录（深度<30 km，Mw ≥ 4.2），结合0.2°网格的日本内陆浅部应力场模型。
世界应力图（WSM）0.2°网格平滑最大水平主压应力（SHmax）数据集（搜索半径100至1000 km）。
li: The Japanese inland stress map and World Stress Map are primarily derived from earthquake focal mechanisms, meaning the background stress estimates are not strictly independent of the seismic catalogs.
The proposed optimal stress-alignment mechanism under high differential stress is not necessarily unique and does not exclude other physical interpretations for giant earthquake growth.
日本内陆应力图和世界应力图主要反演自地震震源机制，因此背景应力场估计与所分析的地震目录并非完全独立。
所提出的大差应力下断层最优应力方向机制并非唯一解释，不能排除控制巨型地震破裂增长的其他物理机制。

tm.why: The study investigates the probability of earthquake rupture growth into giant earthquakes based on Gutenberg-Richter b values, fault dip angles, and regional stress fields.
It applies Anderson's theory, Coulomb failure criteria, fault instability indices, and frictional mechanics to explain how stress orientation and fault geometry govern megathrust rupture.
The findings link ultralow-angle fault geometry and temporal variations in stress orientation and b values directly to forecasting future megaearthquakes and seismic hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 7-page Science Advances PDF, including all main text sections, equations, and Figures 1–4.

sum: Conventional joint full-waveform inversion (FWI) of distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) and ocean-bottom node (OBN) data converts measured strain to particle velocity, introducing noise and spectral distortion. This paper presents a 2-D time-domain elastic multi-parameter (Vp, Vs, density) FWI framework based on a velocity-stress-strain (VSS) formulation. The VSS solver tracks strain as a passive companion to the velocity-stress system, directly outputting pressure, particle velocity, and gauge-length-averaged DAS axial strain from one forward simulation. Residuals from all sensor types are injected additively into a single adjoint simulation, making computational cost independent of the active sensor subset. Benchmarked on synthetic cross-talk and elastic Marmousi models, pairing seabed two-component geophones with a deviated borehole DAS cable achieves the highest Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) across all parameters and best suppresses inter-parameter cross-talk through complementary depth aperture and distinct radiation patterns. The Devito- and Dask-based Python package is released as xFWI.
传统分布式声学传感（DAS）与海底节点（OBN）联合全波形反演需将应变转换为质点速度，易引入噪声与频谱畸变。本文提出基于速度-应力-应变（VSS）方程的二维时域弹性多参数（Vp、Vs、密度）全波形反演框架。该方法在单次正演中直接输出压力、质点速度和标距平均DAS轴向应变，并将多类型数据残差叠加注入单……

t: A 2-D time-domain velocity-stress-strain (VSS) elastic FWI formulation evolves strain passively alongside velocity and stress, directly modeling pressure, particle velocity, and gauge-averaged DAS strain and injecting all residuals additively into one adjoint solve.
采用二维时域速度-应力-应变（VSS）弹性FWI公式，单次正伴随模拟直接处理压力、质点速度与标距平均DAS应变。

Noise-free 2-D synthetic datasets on a cross-talk anomaly model (with and without a deep reflector) and the elastic Marmousi model, comparing six subsets of OBN pressure, 2C geophones, seabed DAS, and deviated borehole DAS.
在有无深部反射层的串扰模型和弹性Marmousi模型上生成二维无噪合成数据，对比六种OBN与DAS组合。

Joint geophone-borehole DAS inversion achieves the highest SSIM across all benchmarks: 0.961, 0.989, and 0.951 for Vp, Vs, and density on the no-reflector cross-talk model, and 0.793, 0.871, and 0.788 on Marmousi.
检波器与斜井DAS联合反演精度最高，无反射串扰模型SSIM达0.961/0.989/0.951，Marmousi达0.7…

The experiments simultaneously varied depth aperture and physical observable for the borehole cable without an aperture-matched control experiment, and used dense co-located noise-free 2-D synthetic arrays.
仅使用二维无噪合成数据且OBN密集共址，未通过对照实验分离孔径与物理量的独立贡献。

Eliminates noisy strain-to-velocity conversion in multi-parameter, multi-component elastic FWI while keeping per-iteration wave-propagation cost independent of the active sensor combination via a single forward-adjoint pair.
无需应变-速度转换即可实现多参数多分量原生应变同化，且单次迭代波场计算成本与传感器组合无关。

kc: Formulates a time-domain velocity-stress-strain (VSS) elastic wave equation that outputs pressure, particle velocity, and gauge-length-averaged DAS strain in a single forward solve without strain-to-velocity conversion.
Derives a discrete joint adjoint system where pressure, velocity, and gauge-spread DAS strain residuals are injected additively into a single backward simulation.
Enforces physical admissibility, CFL stability ceilings, and bulk-modulus positivity via bound-constrained L-BFGS-B optimization in velocity parameterization.

Demonstrates on cross-talk and Marmousi benchmarks that pairing seabed 2C geophones with a deviated borehole DAS cable best recovers Vp, Vs, and density by providing complementary aperture and distinct observables.
Releases xFWI, an open-source Python package built on Devito and Dask for scalable shot-parallel multi-deployment FWI.
建立了时域速度-应力-应变（VSS）弹性波方程，无需应变到速度转换即可在单次正演中直接输出压力、质点速度和标距平均DAS应变。
推导了离散联合伴随系统，将压力、速度和标距展布DAS应变残差以加性方式注入单次逆时伴随模拟中。
在速度参数化下结合有界约束L-BFGS-B优化器，严格执行物理容许范围、CFL稳定性上限与体积模量正定约束。
在串扰和Marmousi基准模型上证明，海底双分量检波器与斜井DAS光缆结合提供了互补孔径和不同物理观测量，最准确地恢复了Vp、Vs和密度。
发布了基于Devito和Dask构建的开源Python软件包xFWI，支持可扩展的炮并行多观测系统联合反演。
me: 2-D isotropic elastic velocity-stress-strain (VSS) finite-difference forward modeling on a staggered Yee-type grid (8th-order spatial Holberg stencils, 2nd-order leapfrog time integration, CPML boundaries).
Exact self-adjoint boxcar window averaging over the DAS cable gauge length L along local cable tangent vectors.
Joint discrete adjoint state method injecting point-receiver residuals and gauge-spread strain-adjoint accumulators into one backward solve.
Multiscale frequency-band (2, 5, 10, 20 Hz) bound-constrained L-BFGS-B inversion in (Vp, Vs, density) parameterization with receiver-Green's-function energy preconditioning.
基于交错Yee网格的二维各向同性弹性速度-应力-应变（VSS）有限差分正演模拟（空间8阶Holberg算子、时间2阶蛙跳积分与CPML吸收边界）。

联合离散伴随状态法，将点接收器残差和标距展布应变伴随累加器注入单次反向求解。

Systematic comparison of six recording subsets: pressure p, 2C geophone [vx, vz], seabed DAS [exx], borehole DAS [enn], all-DAS [exx, enn], and joint geophone-borehole [vx, vz, enn].

tm.why: The paper develops a joint multi-parameter elastic full-waveform inversion framework with a single adjoint simulation for multi-component geophone and DAS data.
The method directly models and assimilates gauge-length-averaged DAS axial strain alongside ocean-bottom node data without converting strain to particle velocity.
It introduces a velocity-stress-strain (VSS) staggered-grid finite-difference formulation in Devito and scales shot-parallel FWI on CPU/GPU clusters using Dask.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 13-page manuscript PDF, including mathematical derivations in §II, Algorithm 1, Tables I–II, and Figures 1–8.

sum: Seismic monitoring in Haiti relies heavily on citizen-hosted RaspberryShake seismometers, which suffer from high urban noise that limits event detection. This study evaluates the deep learning algorithm DeepDenoiser alongside STA/LTA, PhaseNet, and template matching across two years of continuous data (2021–2022). While DeepDenoiser increases the average signal-to-noise ratio by 4.7 dB, it introduces impulsive artifacts that cause high false-positive rates in STA/LTA and PhaseNet workflows. Conversely, combining DeepDenoiser with band-pass filtering and template matching maximizes true detections while suppressing false alarms. Applying this combined workflow with HypoDD relocation yields a high-resolution catalog of 11,752 relocated earthquakes—roughly triple the original Ayiti-seismes catalog. The novel catalog clearly resolves the segmented northeast-dipping reverse and near-vertical strike-slip faults of the 2021 Mw 7.2 Nippes sequence, discovers fluid-diffusion-driven offshore swarms in the Jérémie basin, and identifies active seismicity beneath Lake Enriquillo.
海地地震监测主要依赖公民部署的RaspberryShake地震仪，但高城市噪声限制了检测能力。本研究利用2021至2022年连续波形，评估了深度学习算法DeepDenoiser与STA/LTA、PhaseNet及模板匹配的结合效果。DeepDenoiser将平均信噪比提高了4.7 dB，但产生的脉冲……

t: The authors combine the pretrained DeepDenoiser CNN with band-pass filtering (2–16 Hz), GPU-based network template matching (2,065 templates), and HypoDD double-difference relocation using cross-correlation differential travel times.
结合预训练DeepDenoiser去噪、2–16 Hz带通滤波、GPU网络模板匹配及HypoDD双差重定位构建高精度地震…

Two years of continuous waveforms (January 2021–December 2022) from citizen-hosted RaspberryShake sensors (HY network), 12 temporary broadband stations (Z2), and regional permanent stations across Hispaniola.
2021至2022年海地公民部署的RaspberryShake台网（HY）、12个临时宽频带台站（Z2）及区域固定台站连…

DeepDenoiser boosts average SNR by 4.7 dB. Combined with template matching and HypoDD, it yields 13,877 detections and 11,752 relocated events (reducing relative location uncertainty from 20 m to 14 m), tripling the original catalog.
去噪使平均信噪比提升4.7 dB；检测13,877个事件并精定位11,752个（误差降至14 m），规模达原目录三倍。

DeepDenoiser introduces impulsive artifacts that yield >60% false detections in STA/LTA and PhaseNet, and template matching biases the catalog toward known sources rather than isolated background seismicity.
去噪产生脉冲伪影导致STA/LTA与PhaseNet超60%误报，且模板匹配偏向已有震源而难以改善孤立背景地震检测。

First quantitative evaluation of deep learning denoising combined with STA/LTA, PhaseNet, and template matching on citizen-science RaspberryShake networks, producing Haiti's most comprehensive relocated catalog to date.
首次在公民科学地震台网定量评估深度学习去噪与多检测器组合，构建了海地最完整的高分辨率震源目录。

kc: Demonstrated that DeepDenoiser increases waveform SNR by 4.7 dB on average (4.3 dB on RaspberryShake stations), outperforming locally retrained models in signal distortion ratio.

Showed that DeepDenoiser creates impulsive artifacts that degrade STA/LTA and PhaseNet performance, whereas combining it with band-pass filtering and template matching maximizes true detections and minimizes false positives.
Compiled a 2-year high-resolution catalog for Haiti (13,877 detected and 11,752 relocated events), tripling the existing Ayiti-seismes catalog and lowering Mc from 2.8 to 1.8.

Illuminated the 5-plane segmented geometry of the 2021 Mw 7.2 Nippes rupture, fluid-driven migrating swarms (diffusivity 0.02–0.14 m²/s) in the Jérémie basin, and seismic bursts beneath Lake Enriquillo.
证明DeepDenoiser可将波形平均信噪比提高4.7 dB（RaspberryShake台站提高4.3 dB），在信号失真比上优于本地重新训练的模型。
发现DeepDenoiser产生的脉冲伪影会降低STA/LTA和PhaseNet的性能，但与带通滤波和模板匹配结合能最大化真实检测并最小化误报。
编制了海地2年期高分辨率地震目录（13,877个检测事件，11,752个重定位事件），规模达原目录三倍，完备震级从2.8降至1.8。
揭示了2021年Mw 7.2 Nippes破裂的五平面分段几何结构、Jérémie盆地流体驱动的迁移震群（扩散率0.02–0.14 m²/s）以及Enriquillo湖下的地震丛集。
me: Waveform denoising in the time-frequency domain using the pretrained convolutional neural network DeepDenoiser and evaluation of transfer learning via SNR and Signal Distortion Ratio (SDR).

Comparative evaluation of single-station detectors (STA/LTA, PhaseNet with REAL association) versus network-based GPU fast matched filtering (FMF) across raw, filtered, and denoised continuous waveforms.
Double-difference earthquake relocation using HypoDD with cross-correlation differential travel times computed on denoised, band-pass-filtered (2–16 Hz) waveforms.
Spatiotemporal fault plane fitting and fluid pressure diffusion modeling (R = sqrt(4*pi*D*t)) for earthquake swarms.

在原始、滤波和去噪连续波形上对比评估单台检测器（STA/LTA、结合REAL关联的PhaseNet）与基于网络的GPU快速匹配滤波（FMF）。
利用去噪并带通滤波（2–16 Hz）波形计算互相关走时差，使用HypoDD进行双差地震重定位。
对余震和震群进行时空断层平面拟合以及流体压力扩散建模（R = sqrt(4*pi*D*t)）。

Transfer learning experiments on DeepDenoiser using 4,957 earthquake waveforms (SNR > 10 dB) and 5,976 noise waveforms from the Ayiti-seismes catalog.
Visual inspection and benchmarking of real versus false detections during two test periods: 1–26 August 2021 and 6–7 November 2021.
Template matching search over 2021–2022 using 2,065 catalog templates with at least four P-picks within 120 km and SNR > 5.
伊斯帕尼奥拉岛2021年1月至2022年12月连续两年的地震波形，涵盖公民部署的RaspberryShake（HY台网）、临时宽频带台站（Z2台网）和区域固定台网。
使用Ayiti-seismes目录中4,957条地震波形（SNR > 10 dB）和5,976条噪声波形对DeepDenoiser进行迁移学习实验。
在2021年8月1–26日和11月6–7日两个测试期内，通过人工目视检查对真实检测和错误检测进行基准对比。
使用2,065个模板（120 km内至少4个P波拾取且SNR > 5）在2021–2022年连续数据中进行模板匹配搜索。
li: DeepDenoiser generates impulsive artifacts and zeros pure noise segments, causing high false detection rates and early P-picks that make it unsuitable for real-time STA/LTA or PhaseNet monitoring.
Template matching and double-difference relocation bias the catalog toward sources near existing templates, limiting detection improvements for isolated or background seismicity.
Small event magnitudes and limited azimuthal station coverage preclude focal mechanism determinations for the Lake Enriquillo seismicity.
DeepDenoiser会产生脉冲伪影并将纯噪声段归零，导致高误报率和P波早拾取，不适合直接用于实时STA/LTA或PhaseNet监测。
模板匹配和双差重定位使地震目录偏向于已有模板附近的震源，限制了对孤立地震或背景地震活动的检测改进。
记录到的地震震级较小且台站方位角覆盖有限，无法确定Enriquillo湖地震活动的震源机制解。

tm.why: The paper builds a 2-year high-resolution earthquake catalog for Haiti containing 13,877 detected and 11,752 relocated events using template matching and HypoDD.
The authors evaluate the DeepDenoiser convolutional neural network and PhaseNet deep learning picker on noisy citizen-hosted RaspberryShake and broadband waveforms.
The high-resolution catalog delineates segmented fault structures of the 2021 Mw 7.2 Nippes rupture and reveals fluid-driven seismic swarms in the Jérémie basin.

sum: This study investigates the seismogenic mechanism of the 2024 Feidong earthquake swarm (maximum magnitude M 4.7) in the Hefei segment of the Tanlu fault zone (TLFZ) using 3D magnetotelluric imaging. The imaging reveals a large-scale, Tanlu high-resistivity belt (TLRB) along the fault. The southern segment of this belt acts as a giant, rigid barrier inhibiting dextral strike-slip motion. The earthquake swarm occurred in a structurally weak zone on the western flank of the central TLRB. A local barrier effectively impeded northeastward rupture propagation. Although this barrier shares geometric similarities with seismogenic asperities of stronger earthquakes, low regional tectonic stress and seismic energy release suggest a low risk of strong earthquakes in the near future.
本研究利用三维大地电磁成像技术，探讨了郯庐断裂带合肥段2024年肥东震群（最大震级M 4.7）的孕震机制。成像结果揭示了沿断裂带分布的大规模郯庐高阻带（TLRB）。该高阻带南段作为巨大的刚性屏障，抑制了断裂带的右旋走滑运动。肥东震群发生于高阻带中部西侧的结构薄弱带内，局部屏障体有效阻止了破裂向东北方……

t: 3D magnetotelluric imaging was used to reconstruct the deep crustal resistivity structure of the Tanlu fault zone.
利用三维大地电磁成像技术重建了郯庐断裂带深部地壳电阻率结构。
Magnetotelluric sounding data acquired across the Hefei segment of the Tanlu fault zone.
在郯庐断裂带合肥段采集的大地电磁测深数据。
Discovery of a large-scale high-resistivity belt (TLRB) and a local barrier that impeded the northeastward rupture of the Feidong swarm.
发现大规模高阻带（TLRB）及限制肥东震群向东北方向破裂的局部屏障体。
Low regional tectonic stress currently prevents overcoming the local barrier, but long-term stress accumulation remains unquantified.
当前区域构造应力较低，无法克服局部屏障，但长期应力积累仍未量化。
First 3D electrical resistivity characterization of the seismogenic barriers controlling the 2024 Feidong earthquake swarm.
首次通过三维电阻率成像揭示了控制2024年肥东震群的孕震屏障体。

Identified a large-scale high-resistivity belt (TLRB) acting as a rigid barrier to fault motion.
Revealed that the 2024 Feidong earthquake swarm was constrained by a local high-resistivity barrier.
获取了郯庐断裂带合肥段的三维地壳电阻率结构。

tm.why: The paper investigates the seismogenic mechanism and barrier-controlled rupture propagation of the 2024 Feidong earthquake swarm.
It uses 3D magnetotelluric imaging to map the crustal resistivity structure of the Tanlu fault zone.

sum: This study investigates the tectonic interaction between the Tethyan and Paleo-Pacific subduction domains in Southeast Asia by comparing the crustal evolution of Hainan Island and Borneo. Using new and compiled detrital zircon U-Pb geochronology, Lu-Hf isotopes, and trace element Eu/Eu* crustal thickness proxies from Carboniferous to Cretaceous sandstones, the authors reconstruct magmatic and crustal thickness histories from 450 to 100 Ma. Results demonstrate broadly synchronous magmatic flare-ups and crustal thinning intervals at 440–410 Ma, 370–350 Ma, 270–220 Ma, and 160–140 Ma, accompanied by predominantly negative εHf(t) values through the Paleozoic–Triassic. This indicates shared geodynamic evolution driven by Paleo-Pacific subduction and slab rollback. However, during the Jurassic–Cretaceous, Borneo zircons shift to mostly positive εHf(t) while Hainan remains negative, providing novel geochemical evidence for an inward-dipping Tethyan–Paleo-Pacific double-subduction system beneath Sundaland that added juvenile mantle material to Borneo.
本研究通过对比海南岛和婆罗洲的地壳演化，探讨东南亚特提斯与古太平洋俯冲域的构造相互作用。利用石炭纪至白垩纪砂岩的新测试及汇编碎屑锆石U-Pb年代学、Lu-Hf同位素和Eu/Eu*地壳厚度代用指标，重建了450至100 Ma的岩浆活动与地壳厚度历史。结果显示两地在440–410、370–350、270……

t: LA-ICP-MS U-Pb dating, MC-ICP-MS Lu-Hf isotope analysis, and trace element Eu/Eu* proxy calculations on detrital zircons were used to evaluate provenance, magma sources, and paleo-crustal thickness.
利用碎屑锆石U-Pb定年、Lu-Hf同位素及Eu/Eu*微量元素指标评估物源与古地壳厚度。
Seven Carboniferous–Cretaceous sandstones from Hainan Island and five Triassic–Eocene sandstones from Borneo were analyzed and combined with compiled regional U-Pb-Hf datasets across Southeast Asia.
分析了海南岛7个和婆罗洲5个砂岩样品，并结合了东南亚区域U-Pb-Hf汇编数据集。
Detrital zircon ages cluster at 440–410, 370–350, 270–220, and 160–140 Ma, coinciding with crustal thinning; Jurassic–Cretaceous εHf(t) becomes positive in Borneo but stays negative in Hainan.
440–410、370–350、270–220和160–140 Ma岩浆爆发伴随地壳减薄；侏罗-白垩纪婆罗洲εHf(t)…
Early Jurassic detrital zircons and magmatic rocks are scarce across Hainan Island, South China, and Borneo, and compiled Paleozoic magmatic zircon data from South China are relatively limited.
早侏罗世碎屑锆石和岩浆岩在研究区稀缺，且华南古生代岩浆锆石汇编数据相对有限。

Establishes the Paleozoic–Triassic crustal co-evolution of Hainan and Borneo under Paleo-Pacific subduction and links their Jurassic–Cretaceous divergence to a Tethyan–Paleo-Pacific double-subduction system.
确立了两地古生代-三叠纪地壳共演化，并将侏罗-白垩纪分异归因于双俯冲系统。

提供了海南岛和婆罗洲石炭纪至白垩纪砂岩的新碎屑锆石U-Pb年龄、Lu-Hf同位素和微量元素数据。

发现了侏罗纪-白垩纪的同位素分异：受特提斯-古太平洋双俯冲影响，婆罗洲转为正εHf(t)，而海南岛保持负εHf(t)。

Crustal thickness reconstruction using the detrital zircon Eu/Eu* proxy and auxiliary whole-rock Sr/Y and (La/Yb)N proxies.

Sandstone samples from West Sarawak, Borneo (Triassic Kuching Formation, Jurassic-Cretaceous Serabang Formation, Upper Cretaceous-Eocene Kayan Group).
Regional compilation of published Paleozoic–Mesozoic magmatic and detrital zircon U-Pb-Hf data from South China, Hainan, Borneo, Indochina, Malay Peninsula, and Sumatra.

华南、海南、婆罗洲、印支、马来半岛和苏门答腊已发表古生代-中生代岩浆与碎屑锆石U-Pb-Hf数据的区域汇编。

tm.why: The paper evaluates crustal evolution, relative crustal-thickness variations, and subduction geodynamics in Hainan Island and Borneo from the Paleozoic to the Cretaceous.
