sum: Understanding source scaling of volcano-tectonic (VT) earthquakes is difficult due to strong path heterogeneity and small magnitudes. This study analyzes 3,116 shallow VT events (Md 0–3) occurring on a ring-fault system beneath Piton de la Fournaise volcano from 2014 to 2023 across 36 eruptions. Using 3-component broadband waveforms from 6 summit stations (3–5.5 km distance), the authors invert narrow-band coda amplitude envelopes in a two-step procedure to isolate frequency-dependent coda decay rates, site terms, and source spectra. Fitting Brune's model to multi-pair coda spectral ratios yields corner frequencies and calibrated seismic moments for over 1,500 events—one of the largest volcanic source datasets to date. Results demonstrate standard self-similar scaling (fc ∝ M0^-1/3) and average stress drops around 2–10 MPa, resembling regular tectonic earthquakes. Temporally stable coda decay and invariant stress drops indicate repeated reactivation of pre-existing faults rather than progressive edifice damage.
本研究利用尾波包络谱比法，分析了2014至2023年间富尔奈斯火山36次喷发前的3116次浅源火山构造（VT）地震。基于距山顶3-5.5公里的6个宽频带台站数据，通过窄带滤波尾波包络两步反演提取衰减率、场地响应与震源项，并拟合Brune模型获得了超1500个事件的地震矩和拐角频率，构建了最大规模的火……

t: A two-step coda-envelope inversion extracts frequency-dependent decay rates and site terms from 25 reference events, then isolates source spectra for thousands of events to fit Brune's model to multi-pair spectral ratios.
利用25个参考事件两步反演尾波衰减率与场地项，提取数千事件震源谱并拟合多事件对Brune谱比模型。

3,116 quality-selected shallow volcano-tectonic earthquakes (Md 0–3, 2014–2023) associated with 36 eruptions at Piton de la Fournaise, recorded by 6 three-component broadband stations within 3–5.5 km of the summit ring fault.
2014-2023年富尔奈斯火山36次喷发相关的3116个浅源VT地震及6个山顶台站三分量波形。

Shallow VT earthquakes follow self-similar scaling (fc ∝ M0^-1/3) with source radii of 17–200 m and average stress drops of 2–10 MPa, showing no significant spatial or temporal variations before eruptions.
浅源VT地震遵循自相似标度律，震源半径17-200米，平均应力降2-10 MPa且无显著时空变化。
The 100 Hz sampling rate limits the Nyquist frequency to 50 Hz, preventing robust corner frequency resolution for most Mw < 1 events and causing one-order-of-magnitude stress-drop uncertainties.
50 Hz奈奎斯特频率限制了Mw<1微震的拐角频率解析，导致应力降存在数量级不确定性。

Applies a multi-pair coda spectral ratio method to build one of the largest VT source datasets (>1,500 events) across 36 eruptions, proving long-term mechanical stability of a frequently erupting volcano.
首次对超1500个火山地震应用多事件对尾波谱比法，揭示高频喷发火山锥体的长期力学稳定性。

kc: Constructed one of the largest volcanic earthquake source parameter datasets (>1,500 events) using a two-step narrow-band coda spectral ratio inversion.
Demonstrated that shallow volcano-tectonic earthquakes at Piton de la Fournaise follow standard self-similar cubic scaling (fc ∝ M0^-1/3) with an average stress drop of ~10 MPa.
Showed that coda decay rates and stress drops remain invariant over 10 years and 36 eruptions, indicating brittle reactivation of pre-existing ring faults without progressive edifice weakening.
利用两步窄带尾波包络谱比反演方法，构建了迄今最大规模之一的火山地震震源参数数据集（超过1500个事件）。
证实富尔奈斯火山浅源火山构造地震遵循标准的自相似立方标度律（fc ∝ M0^-1/3），平均应力降约为10 MPa。
发现尾波衰减率和应力降在10年36次喷发期间无显著时空变化，表明地震主要由先存环状断层的脆性重新激活引起，火山锥体未发生累积损伤弱化。
me: Narrow-band fourth-order Butterworth filtering and 2-s moving window smoothing to extract 3-component coda amplitude envelopes.

Two-step linear least-squares inversion of logarithmic coda envelopes: first fixing coda decay slope and station terms using 25 large reference events (Md > 2.3), then solving for decoupled source spectra terms in 3-s windows.
Multi-pair spectral ratio fitting using Brune's source model via non-linear least squares in overlapping 400-event groups, followed by relative moment calibration against OVPF duration magnitudes.
采用窄带四阶Butterworth滤波和2秒滑动窗口平滑技术，提取三分量尾波振幅包络。
对数尾波包络两步线性最小二乘反演：首先利用25个较大参考事件（Md > 2.3）确定频率相关的尾波衰减率和台站项，随后在3秒短窗内解耦求解所有事件的震源项。
在重叠的400事件分组内，利用非线性最小二乘法将多事件对谱比拟合至Brune模型，并通过火山观测台持续时间震级标定绝对地震矩。
de: 3,356 initial (3,116 quality-controlled) shallow VT earthquakes (Md ~0 to 3, depth < 1 km relative to sea level) from the OVPF catalog (Jan 2014 – Aug 2023) spanning 36 eruptions.
3-component broadband waveforms (100 Hz sampling rate) from 6 summit stations (FRE, HIM, GPN, CSS, PRA, VIL) at epicentral distances of 3–5.5 km.
来自OVPF目录（2014年1月至2023年8月，涵盖36次喷发）的3356个初始（质控后3116个）浅源VT地震事件（震级Md 0~3，海拔深度小于1公里）。
震中距3至5.5公里范围内6个山顶宽频带台站（FRE, HIM, GPN, CSS, PRA, VIL）记录的三分量波形数据（采样率100 Hz）。
li: The 100 Hz sampling rate yields a 50 Hz Nyquist frequency, which is lower than the corner frequencies of most small earthquakes (Mw < 1) and leaves only ~10% of the catalog in the strict robust subset.
Individual stress-drop estimates carry uncertainties of at least one order of magnitude due to cubic dependence on corner frequency.
High event rates (>10 events/minute) during short-term pre-eruptive swarms cause coda contamination and reduce the detection of small, low-stress-drop events.
100 Hz采样率对应的50 Hz奈奎斯特频率低于大多数小震（Mw < 1）的拐角频率，导致严格质控子集仅保留约10%的目录事件。
由于应力降与拐角频率呈立方依赖关系，单个事件的应力降估计存在至少一个数量级的不确定性。
临喷发短期震群期间极高的发震率（>10次/分钟）导致尾波相互干扰，降低了小震级、低应力降事件的检测率。

tm.why: The paper investigates the source scaling and stress drops of over 3,000 shallow volcano-tectonic earthquakes beneath Piton de la Fournaise volcano across 36 eruptions.
The core objective is estimating seismic moments, corner frequencies, and stress drops to test self-similar source scaling laws.
The methodology relies on inverting narrow-band coda wave amplitude envelopes to extract frequency-dependent coda decay rates, site terms, and source spectra.

ev.notes: Full 20-page JGR: Solid Earth article PDF (HAL manuscript hal-05722037v1, 21 pages including HAL cover) was read and analyzed, including all equations, 9 figures, and 1 table.

sum: Detecting small-scale structural discontinuities on volcanoes is critical for assessing flank stability and hazards. This study analyzes moderate- to high-resolution InSAR data spanning 30 magma intrusions at Piton de la Fournaise volcano between October 2010 and July 2023. By applying a 20–500 m Gaussian band-pass filter in the frequency domain to east-west and vertical displacement components, the authors isolate 1–3 cm differential motions and map 151 active fault structures. About 87% are tensile fractures along the main NE-SE rift zone, outlining 200–300 m wide graben-like subsidence zones triggered by intrusion-induced normal stress decreases averaging −0.8 MPa down to 400–600 m depth. On the northwestern flank, nested circular faults reveal buried paleo-pit craters. Joint interpretation with self-potential, 3D electrical resistivity tomography, and magnetic data demonstrates that these faults channel meteoric water and hydrothermal fluids, promoting rock alteration and mechanical weakening of the volcanic edifice.
本研究分析了2010年10月至2023年7月富尔奈斯火山30次岩浆侵入期间的InSAR数据。通过对东西向和垂向位移分量应用20–500米空间波长的高斯带通滤波，分离出1–3厘米的局部差异运动，识别出151条活动断层结构。其中87%为沿主NE-SE裂谷带分布的张性裂缝，勾勒出宽200–300米的地堑状……

t: Multi-geometry InSAR interferograms are inverted for East-West and Up-Down displacements, then band-pass filtered in the frequency domain between 20 and 500 m wavelengths to isolate small-scale fault motions and horizontal gradients.
反演多视角InSAR获取东西与垂向位移，经20–500米频域高斯带通滤波及梯度计算分离小断层运动。

Moderate- (5 m) to high-resolution (1.5–2.5 m) InSAR data across 30 magma intrusions (2010–2023) at Piton de la Fournaise, supplemented by Self-Potential, 3D Electrical Resistivity Tomography, and magnetic surveys.
2010–2023年30次侵入的中高分辨率InSAR数据，结合自然电位、三维电阻率层析成像和磁测数据。

Identified 151 faults (87% tensile fractures along the NE-SE rift zone) showing 1–3 cm differential motions, outlining 150–300 m wide grabens and buried nested ring-faults activated by ~−0.8 MPa normal stress changes.
识别出151条断层（87%为张裂缝），勾勒出宽150–300米地堑及隐伏环状断层，受约−0.8 MPa法向应力变化触发。
InSAR viewing geometry cannot resolve north-south horizontal displacements, which reduces sensitivity to potential east-west striking tensile faults on the eastern and western flanks.
InSAR观测几何无法解析南北向水平位移，降低了对东西走向潜在张性断层的检测灵敏度。

Systematically maps meter-scale volcanic faults and buried paleo-craters across 30 intrusions using band-pass filtered InSAR, linking stress-triggered fracturing with electrical/magnetic signatures of hydrothermal weakening.
首次对30次侵入开展滤波InSAR系统测绘，将断层应力激活机制与热液蚀变弱化的电磁特征直接关联。

kc: Mapped 151 small-scale active faults and graben structures on the summit cone of Piton de la Fournaise by band-pass filtering InSAR displacement fields across 30 intrusions.
Discovered four nested circular ring-faults on the northwestern flank representing buried paleo-pit craters, alongside tilted collapsing blocks at the Petit Plateau.
Demonstrated via 3D stress modeling that fault opening is driven by intrusion-induced normal stress decreases averaging −0.8 MPa down to 400–600 m depth.
Integrated self-potential, 3D electrical resistivity, and magnetic anomalies to show that faults and grabens guide hydrothermal circulation and rock alteration, weakening the edifice.
通过对30次岩浆侵入的InSAR位移场进行带通滤波，在富尔奈斯火山顶峰锥体上测绘出151条小尺度活动断层和地堑构造。
在西北侧翼发现了4个代表隐伏古陷落坑的嵌套环状断层，并在Petit Plateau发现了向火山口倾斜垮塌的断块。
通过三维应力模拟证实，断层张开受控于岩浆侵入引起的法向应力减小（平均−0.8 MPa，深度达400–600米）。
综合自然电位、三维电阻率和磁异常数据，揭示断层和地堑充当热液循环通道并引发岩石蚀变，从而削弱山体稳定性。
me: Two-pass InSAR processing (DIAPASON and iterative SNAPHU unwrapping) and inversion of multi-geometry interferograms for East-West and Up-Down displacement components.
Frequency-domain Gaussian band-pass filtering (retaining 20–500 m spatial wavelengths) and horizontal gradient magnitude calculation to isolate centimeter-scale fault displacements.
3D elastic normal stress change modeling along observed fault traces and radial planes based on inverted magma intrusion source geometries.
Multi-geophysical correlation combining Self-Potential (SP), 3D Electrical Resistivity Tomography (3D ERT), and reduced-to-the-pole (RTP) magnetic anomaly data.
双轨法InSAR处理（DIAPASON与迭代SNAPHU解缠）及多几何视角干涉图反演，获取东西向和垂向位移分量。
频域高斯带通滤波（保留20–500米空间波长）与水平梯度模量计算，分离厘米级断层差异位移。
基于反演的岩浆侵入源几何形态，计算观测断层迹线及径向平面上的三维弹性法向应力变化。
结合自然电位（SP）、三维电阻率层析成像（3D ERT）和化极磁异常（RTP）数据进行多地球物理联合分析。
de: Moderate- (5 m) to high-resolution (1.5–2.5 m, PAZ and COSMO-SkyMed) InSAR data covering 30 magmatic intrusions between October 2010 and July 2023.
5-m resolution LiDAR Digital Elevation Model (DEM) acquired in 2008 for topographic phase removal and artefact testing.
Summit-scale and repeated high-resolution (1-m and 5-m spacing, 2017–2022) Self-Potential and ground/UAV magnetic profiles, plus a 30x30x30 m resolution 3D ERT model from May 2023.
涵盖2010年10月至2023年7月共30次岩浆侵入的中等（5米）至高分辨率（1.5–2.5米，PAZ和COSMO-SkyMed卫星）InSAR数据。
2008年获取的5米分辨率LiDAR数字高程模型（DEM），用于地形相位去除和伪影检验。
顶峰尺度及重复测量的高分辨率（1米和5米间距，2017–2022年）自然电位与地面/无人机磁测剖面，以及2023年5月获取的30×30×30米分辨率三维电阻率模型。
li: InSAR viewing geometry lacks sensitivity to North-South displacements, potentially limiting the detection of East-West striking tensile faults.
High-resolution (1–2.5 m) SAR imagery was only available for 9 out of the 30 analyzed intrusive events.
Fault traces were manually delineated after excluding high-gradient features near eruptive fissures, recent lava flows, and scoria cones.
InSAR观测几何对南北向位移不敏感，可能限制了对东西走向张性断层的识别能力。
在分析的30次侵入事件中，仅有9次事件拥有高分辨率（1–2.5米）SAR影像数据。
断层迹线依赖人工勾绘，需主观剔除喷发裂隙附近非弹性形变、新熔岩流沉降及火山渣锥等高梯度特征。

tm.why: The study investigates small-scale active faults, graben structures, and buried paleo-pit craters on the flanks of Piton de la Fournaise volcano during 30 magma intrusions.
The paper analyzes fault activation mechanisms, tensile fracturing, and normal stress changes (−0.8 MPa) induced by magma intrusions along volcanic rift zones.

ev.notes: Full 19-page research article PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§6), and all 9 figures.

sum: This study investigates the recurrent seismicity along the Vuache Fault in the French western Alps following the 1996 M5.3 Annecy earthquake. By analyzing post-1996 seismicity and calculating local seismic velocity variations, the authors demonstrate that while the mainshock was tectonic, subsequent seismicity is driven by fluid pressurization in a deep, fractured sedimentary aquifer. The aftershock sequence exhibited a two-phase behavior: an initial random spatial distribution followed by a clear migration phase indicating fluid diffusion. The hydraulic diffusivity of the aquifer was estimated at approximately 2 m²/s from both aftershock migration and the correlation between velocity variations and rainfall. This high diffusivity suggests a highly permeable, confined reservoir within the regional flat-and-ramp structure.
本研究调查了1996年法国安纳西M5.3地震后，阿尔卑斯西部Vuache断层沿线的复发性地震活动。通过分析1996年以来的地震活动并计算局部地震波速度变化，作者表明虽然主震具有构造起源，但随后的地震活动是由深部裂隙沉积含水层中的流体加压驱动的。余震序列表现出两阶段特征：初始的随机空间分布和随后的流体……

t: Analysis of seismic velocity variations at local permanent stations combined with spatial-temporal earthquake migration modeling to estimate hydraulic diffusivity.
结合地方固定台站的地震波速变化分析与时空地震迁移建模，来估算水力扩散率。
Seismic catalogs and waveform data from local permanent stations following the 1996 M5.3 Annecy earthquake, integrated with spring flow and rainfall records.
1996年安纳西M5.3地震后的本地台站地震目录和波形数据，以及泉水流量和降雨记录。
The hydraulic diffusivity of the deep fractured aquifer was estimated at approximately 2 m²/s, indicating a highly permeable, pressurized reservoir.
深部裂隙含水层的水力扩散率估算约为2 m²/s，表明存在高渗透性的承压储层。
The findings are highly specific to the sedimentary formations and flat-and-ramp geometry of the Vuache Fault zone.
研究结果高度受限于Vuache断层带的沉积地层和平缓-陡倾几何结构。
Quantifying high hydraulic diffusivity (2 m²/s) in a natural tectonic fault zone, comparable to values observed during artificial fluid injections.
在自然构造断裂带中量化了极高的水力扩散率，该值与人工注水诱发的值接近。

kc: Demonstrated that post-1996 seismicity along the Vuache Fault is sustained by fluid pressurization in a deep sedimentary aquifer.
Identified a two-phase aftershock sequence consisting of an initial stationary phase and a subsequent fluid-diffusion migration phase.
Estimated a high hydraulic diffusivity of approximately 2 m²/s using both aftershock migration and seismic velocity-rainfall correlations.
证实了Vuache断层沿线1996年后的地震活动是由深部沉积含水层中的流体加压维持的。
识别出余震序列的两阶段特征，包括初始的静止阶段和随后的流体扩散迁移阶段。
利用余震迁移和地震波速与降雨的关联，估算出约2 m²/s的高水力扩散率。
me: Seismic velocity variation (dv/v) monitoring at local permanent stations.
Analysis of earthquake catalogs, including Omori decay, swarm identification, and spatial-temporal migration.
Hydraulic diffusivity modeling based on fluid diffusion equations and correlation with rainfall data.
利用地方固定台站进行地震波速度变化（dv/v）监测。
地震目录分析，包括大森定律衰减、震群识别以及时空迁移分析。
基于流体扩散方程以及与降雨数据相关性的水力扩散率建模。
de: Seismic waveform data from local permanent stations in the Annecy Molasse Basin from 1996 onwards.
Rainfall measurements and spring flow variation data in the French western Alps region.
1996年起法国安纳西糖蜜盆地地方固定台站的地震波形数据。
法国阿尔卑斯西部地区的降雨量测量和泉水流量变化数据。
li: The study is geographically focused on a specific flat-and-ramp structure, and the high diffusivity values may not represent all strike-slip fault systems.
该研究在地理上集中于特定的平缓-陡倾结构，高扩散率值可能不代表所有走滑断层系统。

tm.why: The paper investigates hydro-mechanical coupling, fluid diffusion, and seismicity along the Vuache Fault.
The study calculates seismic velocity variations at local permanent stations, typically done via ambient noise interferology, to link them to rainfall and fluid processes.
The paper analyzes aftershock sequences, migration, and repeated swarms following the 1996 M5.3 earthquake.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from GJI, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar.

sum: This study introduces an integrated monitoring framework combining Shannon and Tsallis entropy measures from a 25-year AFAD seismic catalog (45,568 events, Mw ≥ 2.0) with GRACE-FO Equivalent Water Height (EWH) anomalies to investigate the 2023 Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş earthquake doublet along the East Anatolian Fault System. Using maximum likelihood estimation on a 0.25° grid, the authors obtain a Gutenberg-Richter b-value of 0.83 ± 0.04 and a non-extensive Tsallis index q = 1.70 ± 0.02. Pre-rupture results show rising seismic entropy alongside decreasing EWH anomalies, interpreted as fault network fragmentation, long-range correlations, and poroelastic fluid migration approaching criticality. Co-seismically, entropy jumps sharply while EWH drops abruptly. Elevated entropy and negative EWH anomalies persist for up to 2.5 years post-rupture, reflecting sustained non-equilibrium driven by aftershocks, fault damage, and viscoelastic relaxation. The novelty lies in fusing non-extensive information theory with satellite gravimetry and providing reproducible algorithmic pseudocodes.
本研究提出了一种融合25年AFAD地震目录（45,568个Mw≥2.0事件）香农熵、察里斯熵与GRACE-FO等效水高（EWH）异常的综合框架，用于研究2023年土耳其Mw 7.8双震。作者在0.25°网格上通过最大似然估计得出b值为0.83±0.04，非广延指数q=1.70±0.02。震前熵值升高……

t: Computes spatial-temporal Shannon and non-extensive Tsallis entropies on a 0.25° grid from magnitude histograms, linking Gutenberg-Richter b-value to Tsallis index q via maximum likelihood estimation alongside GRACE-FO EWH anomaly tracking.
在0.25°网格上计算香农熵和察里斯熵，通过最大似然估计关联b值与q指数，并追踪GRACE-FO等效水高异常。
Uses a 25-year declustered AFAD earthquake catalog (45,568 events, Mw ≥ 2.0, 2000–2025) and CSR GRACE/GRACE-FO RL06.3 monthly mascon Equivalent Water Height solutions on a 1° × 1° grid.
采用25年AFAD去丛集地震目录（45,568个Mw≥2.0事件）及1°×1°网格GRACE-FO RL06.3月度水高…
Finds Mc = 2.5, b = 0.83 ± 0.04, and Tsallis index q = 1.70 ± 0.02; pre-seismic entropy rises while EWH decreases 1–4 months prior, followed by co-seismic jumps and 2.5-year post-seismic persistence.
求得Mc=2.5，b=0.83±0.04，q=1.70±0.02；震前熵增伴随水高下降，同震突变且震后2.5年持续非平衡…
GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon solutions have a coarse ~300 km inherent spatial resolution and suffer from degraded GRACE-FO-C2 accelerometer data quality after August 2016.
GRACE-FO固有空间分辨率较粗（约300公里），且2016年8月后依赖移植加速度计导致数据质量有所下降。
First joint integration of non-extensive Tsallis and Shannon seismic entropies with satellite gravimetric EWH anomalies to track pre-, co-, and post-rupture phases of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş doublet.
首次将非广延察里斯/香农地震熵与卫星重力水高异常联合，监测2023土耳其双震震前、同震和震后演化。

kc: Developed a joint analytical framework integrating seismic Shannon and Tsallis entropy with GRACE-FO Equivalent Water Height (EWH) anomalies.
Quantified non-extensive seismicity parameters for the East Anatolian Fault Zone (Mc = 2.5, b = 0.83 ± 0.04, q = 1.70 ± 0.02).
Identified coordinated pre-seismic entropy increases and negative EWH anomalies prior to the 2023 Kahramanmaraş doublet, followed by persistent post-seismic non-equilibrium.
Provided two structured computational workflows (Algorithms 1 and 2) in pseudocode for reproducible spatial-temporal entropy and b-q estimation.
开发了融合地震目录香农熵、察里斯熵与GRACE-FO等效水高（EWH）异常的联合分析框架。
量化了东安纳托利亚断裂带的非广延地震活动性参数（Mc = 2.5, b = 0.83 ± 0.04, q = 1.70 ± 0.02）。
识别出2023年卡赫拉曼马拉什双震前协同的熵增与负EWH异常，以及震后持续的非平衡状态。
提供了两个结构化计算工作流伪代码（算法1和算法2），用于可复现的时空熵和b-q关系估计。
me: Histogram-based spatial and temporal Shannon entropy and non-extensive Tsallis entropy estimation on a 0.25° uniform grid.
Catalog declustering using the Gardner-Knopoff algorithm to remove foreshock and aftershock clusters.
Maximum curvature (MAXC) and maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) of Mc and Gutenberg-Richter b-value, analytically mapped to Tsallis entropic index q.
Spatiotemporal tracking of GRACE-FO RL06.3 mascon Equivalent Water Height (EWH) anomalies with GIA, geocenter, and SLR C20/C30 corrections.
基于直方图方法在0.25°均匀网格上计算时空香农熵与非广延察里斯熵。
使用Gardner-Knopoff算法对地震目录进行去丛集处理以分离主震与前震、余震序列。
采用最大曲率法（MAXC）和最大似然估计（MLE）计算完备震级Mc和G-R关系b值，并解析映射至察里斯熵指数q。
对经过GIA、地心运动及SLR C20/C30改正的GRACE-FO RL06.3 mascon等效水高（EWH）异常进行时空演化追踪。
de: AFAD regional earthquake catalog spanning 25 years (January 13, 2000 to October 7, 2025) containing 45,568 events complete for Mw ≥ 2.0.
GRACE and GRACE-FO Release 06 Level-3 monthly mass concentration (mascon) solutions (RL06.3) from CSR on a 1° × 1° grid, focusing on a 4-month window before and after February 2023.
土耳其灾害与应急管理局（AFAD）跨越25年（2000年1月13日至2025年10月7日）的区域地震目录，包含45,568个事件（完备震级Mw ≥ 2.0）。
德克萨斯大学空间研究中心（CSR）发布的1°×1°网格GRACE/GRACE-FO RL06.3月度质量浓度（mascon）解，重点分析2023年2月震前和震后4个月窗口的数据。
li: Inherent spatial resolution of GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon signals is coarse (~300 km) despite the 1° × 1° grid representation.
Documented decline in data quality after August 2016 for GRACE and the GRACE-FO-C2 instrument due to reliance on transplanted accelerometer data.
Calculated seismic entropy parameters are sensitive to arbitrary choices of spatial grid sizing and temporal window smoothing.
尽管采用1°×1°网格表示，GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon信号的固有空间分辨率依然较粗（约300公里）。
2016年8月之后GRACE及GRACE-FO-C2仪器因依赖移植加速度计数据而存在已知的数据质量下降问题。
地震熵参数的计算稳定性与分辨率对空间网格尺寸和时间窗口平滑参数的选择较为敏感。

tm.why: The paper investigates pre-, co-, and post-seismic fault system evolution, criticality, poroelastic contraction, fluid migration, and viscoelastic relaxation along the East Anatolian Fault System.
The study relies on statistical and entropy-theoretic analyses of a 25-year declustered regional earthquake catalog (45,568 events) and Gutenberg-Richter b-value estimation.
The joint entropy and gravimetric monitoring framework is explicitly framed to detect critical transitions and contribute to physics-based seismic hazard and risk assessment.

ev.notes: Full 24-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, mathematical derivations of Shannon and Tsallis entropy, Algorithms 1 and 2 pseudocodes, Table 1, and Figures 1-4.

sum: This study investigates the sensitivity of the Beibei well-aquifer system to the coupling effect between volumetric and shear strain using high-quality coseismic water-level records from four earthquakes with different azimuths. The authors invert elastic parameters from seismic waves along different azimuths, revealing significant differences that are attributed to crack and damage anisotropy within the fault zone. Notably, the rock damage degree derived from body waves is significantly higher than that from surface waves, indicating more substantial damage along the near-vertical propagation path of body waves. These findings elucidate how fault-zone anisotropy governs hydroseismic responses and offer new insights into the coupled mechanical-hydraulic behavior of aquifer systems under dynamic strain.
本研究利用四个不同方位角地震的高质量同震水位记录，探讨了北碚井-含水层系统对体应变与剪切应变耦合效应的敏感性。结果表明，沿不同方位角地震波反演的弹性参数存在显著差异，这归因于断裂带内的裂隙与损伤各向异性。体波推导的岩石损伤程度显著高于面波，表明沿近垂直传播路径的体波方向损伤更严重。该研究阐明了断裂带……

t: Inversion of azimuth-dependent elastic parameters from coseismic water-level responses to coupled volumetric and shear strains.
利用同震水位对体应变和剪切应变耦合响应的方位角相关性，反演弹性参数。
High-quality coseismic water-level records from the Beibei well-aquifer system corresponding to four earthquakes with different azimuths.
北碚井-含水层系统记录到的四个不同方位角地震的高质量同震水位数据。
Significant differences in elastic parameters along different azimuths reveal fault-zone damage anisotropy, with body waves showing higher damage than surface waves.
不同方位角反演的弹性参数差异显著，且体波推导的损伤程度高于面波，揭示了各向异性。
The analysis is focused on a single well-aquifer system, and further validation across diverse tectonic environments is required.
研究局限于单一井-含水层系统，其普适性仍需在更多不同构造区域进行验证。
Incorporating shear strain coupling and azimuth-dependent analysis to decipher fault-zone damage anisotropy from hydroseismic responses.
引入剪切应变耦合效应，通过水震响应方位角差异定量表征断裂带损伤各向异性。

kc: Demonstrated the sensitivity of well-aquifer systems to the coupling of volumetric and shear strains.
Inverted azimuth-dependent elastic parameters to reveal crack and damage anisotropy within the fault zone.
Discovered that rock damage derived from body waves is higher than that from surface waves, indicating path-dependent damage characteristics.
证明了井-含水层系统对体应变和剪切应变耦合作用的敏感性。
反演了方位角相关的弹性参数，揭示了断裂带内的裂隙与损伤各向异性。
发现体波推导的岩石损伤程度高于面波，表明存在路径相关的损伤特征。
me: Analysis of coseismic water-level response to dynamic strain from distant earthquakes.
Inversion of elastic parameters from seismic waves along different azimuths.
Modeling of coupled mechanical-hydraulic behavior under volumetric and shear strain.
分析远震动态应变引起的同震水位响应。
利用不同方位角的地震波反演弹性参数。
模拟体应变与剪切应变耦合作用下的力学-水文行为。
de: High-quality coseismic water-level records from the Beibei well-aquifer system.
Seismic waveform data from four earthquakes with different azimuths.
来自北碚井-含水层系统的高质量同震水位记录。
来自四个不同方位角地震的地震波形数据。
li: The study is based on a single well-aquifer system (Beibei), which may limit the immediate generalizability to other tectonic settings.
该研究基于单一井-含水层系统（北碚），这可能会限制其直接推广到其他构造背景的能力。

tm.why: The paper investigates crack and damage anisotropy within a fault zone using dynamic strain responses.
It explores fault-zone damage and coupled mechanical-hydraulic behavior under dynamic strain.
It analyzes hydroseismic responses and well-aquifer systems, which fall under environmental/hydro-seismology.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from OpenAlex, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates crustal stress distribution, fault clustering, and seismic hazard across the Zagros Orogenic Belt using a homogenized, declustered IRSC earthquake catalog (2006–2024; 40,731 events; Mc = 2.60). The authors compute and spatially interpolate the Gutenberg–Richter b-value, correlation fractal dimension (Dc), and empirical differential stress (sigma1 - sigma3) on a 0.25-degree grid and along four depth cross-sections. The catalog-wide b-value is 0.81 +/- 0.01, continuing a multi-decadal decline indicative of accelerating tectonic loading. Low b-values (0.4–0.7), high Dc-values (>=1.5), and high differential stresses (>=520 MPa) consistently co-locate within the upper 10–15 km along major faults (Mountain Front, High Zagros, and Main Zagros Reverse faults). At 10–20 km depth, localized decreases in Dc mark seismicity focusing onto discrete fault planes. Integrating these results with prior seismic tomography defines northern/central 'locked' and southern 'decoupled' regimes governed by a mid-crustal felsic low-velocity channel.
本研究利用均一化并去丛集的伊朗地震中心（IRSC）目录（2006–2024年，40,731个事件，完备震级Mc=2.60），分析了扎格罗斯造山带的b值、相关分形维数（Dc）及差应力（σ1-σ3）的平面与深度剖面分布。全区b值为0.81±0.01，延续了数十年的下降趋势，反映构造加载增强。低b值（0.……

t: The authors estimate completeness magnitude via Maximum Curvature, b-values via Maximum Likelihood, fractal dimension via the correlation integral, and differential stress via Scholz's empirical relation, interpolating all parameters onto a 0.25-degree grid using ordinary Kriging.
利用最大曲率法求Mc，最大似然法求b值，关联积分求分形维数Dc，Scholz经验公式求差应力，并用克里金法进行0.25°…

The study uses 40,731 earthquakes (M >= 1.5) from the Iranian Seismological Center (IRSC) catalog from January 2006 to October 2024, homogenized to moment magnitude (Mw) and declustered using the Gardner and Knopoff algorithm.
采用伊朗地震中心（IRSC）2006至2024年40,731个M≥1.5地震事件，统一转换为矩震级（Mw）并去丛集。

The regional b-value is 0.81 +/- 0.01 (Mc = 2.60). Low b-values (0.4–0.7), high Dc-values (>=1.5), and high differential stress (>=520 MPa) co-locate in the upper 10–15 km along major Zagros thrust faults.
Differential stress is directly computed as a function of b-value using an empirical constant rather than derived from independent focal mechanism stress inversions.
差应力直接由b值通过经验公式计算得出，缺乏震源机制反演等独立应力测量数据的验证。

Integrates 2D and depth cross-sectional analyses of b-value, fractal dimension, and differential stress across the entire Zagros belt using recent instrumental data (2006–2024) and correlates them with crustal velocity structure.
利用最新目录对整个扎格罗斯带开展b值、分形维数与差应力的平面及深度剖面综合分析，并与地壳波速结构关联。

kc: Constructed a homogenized (Mw) and declustered earthquake catalog of 40,731 events (2006–2024) for the Zagros Orogenic Belt with Mc = 2.60 and an overall b-value of 0.81 +/- 0.01.

Mapped 2D spatial and depth cross-sectional variations of b-value, fractal dimension (Dc), and differential stress, identifying shallow (<10–15 km) high-stress locked asperities along the MFF, HZF, and MZRF.

Linked statistical seismicity parameters with prior seismic velocity tomography to propose two seismotectonic regimes controlled by a mid-to-lower crustal felsic low-velocity zone: a northern/central locked regime and a southern decoupled regime.
构建了扎格罗斯造山带2006–2024年间包含40,731个事件的均一化（Mw）去丛集地震目录，确定完备震级Mc=2.60，全区b值为0.81±0.01。
绘制了b值、分形维数（Dc）和差应力的二维平面与深度剖面分布，识别出沿MFF、HZF和MZRF展布的浅部（<10–15 km）高应力闭锁凹凸体。
将地震活动性统计参数与前人地震波速层析成像结合，提出受中下地壳长英质低速带控制的两类地震构造模式：北/中部“闭锁”模式与南部“解耦”模式。
me: Catalog homogenization from local magnitude (MN) to moment magnitude (Mw) using empirical relations (Karimiparidari et al., 2013) and declustering via the Gardner and Knopoff (1974) algorithm.
Completeness magnitude (Mc) estimation via Maximum Curvature (MAXC) and b-value calculation using Aki's (1965) maximum likelihood estimation with Shi and Bolt (1982) uncertainties.

Correlation integral method (Grassberger and Procaccia, 1983) for fractal dimension (Dc) and Scholz's (2015) empirical scaling relation for differential stress, interpolated onto a 0.25-degree grid via ordinary Kriging.
利用经验关系（Karimiparidari et al., 2013）将地方震级（MN）转换为矩震级（Mw），并采用Gardner和Knopoff（1974）算法进行地震目录去丛集。
采用最大曲率法（MAXC）估计完备震级（Mc），利用Aki（1965）最大似然法计算b值，并用Shi和Bolt（1982）公式计算标准差。
采用关联积分法计算分形维数（Dc），利用Scholz（2015）经验关系估算差应力，并通过普通克里金法在0.25°均匀网格上进行空间插值。
de: Iranian Seismological Center (IRSC) instrumental earthquake catalog spanning January 1, 2006 to October 31, 2024, containing 40,731 events with M >= 1.5 and depths up to 45 km.
Four regional depth cross-sectional profiles (A1–B1 to A4–B4) intersecting major fault zones from NW to SE across the Zagros Mountains.
伊朗地震中心（IRSC）2006年1月1日至2024年10月31日的仪器地震目录，包含40,731个震级M≥1.5、深度达45 km的地震事件。
从西北向东南横跨扎格罗斯山脉主要断层带的四条区域深度剖面（A1–B1至A4–B4）。
li: Differential stress is not measured independently but derived directly from b-values via Scholz's (2015) empirical formula, making the inverse correlation between b-value and differential stress mathematically predetermined.
Spatial and depth cross-sections rely on catalog hypocenters without waveform relocation and smooth 0.25-degree Kriging interpolation, which may blur sharp fault-zone boundaries.
差应力并非独立测量，而是直接通过Scholz（2015）经验公式由b值换算得出，因此差应力与b值的负相关性在数学上是预设的。
平面和深度剖面依赖于未经波形重定位的目录震源位置及0.25°克里金平滑插值，可能会模糊断层带的精细边界。

tm.why: The paper evaluates regional earthquake hazard potential across the Zagros Orogenic Belt by mapping critically stressed fault segments using statistical seismicity parameters.
It links crustal stress distribution, brittle-ductile transitions, and seismicity clustering to tectonic convergence and a mid-to-lower crustal felsic channel in the Zagros collision zone.
The study investigates fault locking, asperities, differential shear stress, and fracture scaling along major active thrust and strike-slip fault systems.

ev.notes: Full 35-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including all 6 sections, 10 figures, and 1 table.

sum: Discriminating underground nuclear explosions from earthquakes and collapses is critical for nuclear test monitoring. This study compiles an expanded catalog of 1,405 full seismic moment tensors (1,196 western US earthquakes, 160 nuclear and chemical explosions, and 49 global collapses) and maps them onto the 5D hypersphere. The authors demonstrate that all three source populations are anisotropically distributed around their mean directions and are best represented by elliptical scaled von Mises-Fisher (SvMF) probability distributions rather than isotropic ones. Applying a Bayesian classification scheme with equal priors yields a 98.4% overall success rate, outperforming eigenvalue-only lune projections by retaining all six moment tensor elements. Furthermore, adjusting prior probabilities allows seamless tuning between missed explosions and false alarms. Finally, tangent-space principal component analysis reveals subtle sub-population separations, achieving preliminary discrimination between nuclear and chemical explosions (92% and 82% accuracy) and between Geysers geothermal and tectonic earthquakes.
本研究收集了1405个全矩张量解（含1196个地震、160个核爆与化爆、49个塌陷事件），将其映射至五维超球面进行震源分类。研究表明三类震源均呈各向异性分布，适合用椭圆对称的缩放von Mises-Fisher（SvMF）概率分布描述。结合贝叶斯分类器，在等先验概率下总体分类准确率达98.4%，且可……

t: Normalized full moment tensors are mapped onto the 5D hypersphere, fitted with anisotropic scaled von Mises-Fisher (SvMF) probability distributions via tangent-normal decomposition, and classified into source categories using a Bayesian formulation with tunable priors.
将归一化全矩张量映射至五维超球面，拟合各向异性SvMF分布，并利用可调先验的贝叶斯公式进行多源分类。

An expanded catalog of 1405 full moment tensors comprising 1196 western US earthquakes (123 from Geysers), 160 explosions (143 nuclear, 17 chemical), and 49 global collapses (44 mining, 5 post-nuclear).
包含1405个全矩张量的扩展目录：1196个美西地震、160个核爆与化爆及49个全球塌陷事件。

Under equal priors, the Bayesian classifier correctly assigns 1382 of 1405 events (98.4% success rate). Sub-group classification achieves 92% and 82% accuracy for nuclear and chemical explosions, and 86% and 84% for non-Geysers and Geysers earthquakes.
等先验下总体分类准确率达98.4%（1382/1405）；核爆与化爆区分准确率为92%和82%。

Small sample sizes for sub-events prevent isolating fundamental source physics from secondary factors like yield, depth-of-burial, rock properties, and inversion settings; earthquakes are restricted to the western US.
亚群样本量小，难以分离震源物理机制与埋深、当量等次要因素；地震样本仅限美西。

Progresses from bipolar screening metrics to generalized multi-source Bayesian identification (including collapses) on the 5D hypersphere, and reveals hypersphere sub-groupings separating nuclear from chemical explosions.
从二元筛查扩展至包含塌陷的多源贝叶斯分类，并发现超球面上核爆与化爆的亚群分离。

kc: Assembled an expanded catalog of 1405 full moment tensor solutions comprising 1196 earthquakes, 160 nuclear and chemical explosions, and 49 collapses.

Demonstrated that collapse moment tensor populations, like explosions and earthquakes, are anisotropically distributed on the 5D hypersphere and well-modeled by scaled von Mises-Fisher (SvMF) distributions.
Achieved 98.4% classification accuracy across the three source types using a Bayesian classifier, showing that prior probabilities can be tuned to balance false alarms against missed explosions.

Identified subtle sub-groupings on the hypersphere that enable preliminary discrimination between nuclear and chemical explosions (92% and 82% success rates) and between Geysers geothermal and non-Geysers earthquakes.
汇编了包含1405个全矩张量解的扩展目录，涵盖1196个地震、160个核爆炸与化学爆炸以及49个塌陷事件。
证明了塌陷事件的矩张量群体与爆炸和地震一样，在五维超球面上呈各向异性分布，且可用缩放von Mises-Fisher（SvMF）分布准确建模。
利用贝叶斯分类器在三类震源间实现了98.4%的分类准确率，并展示了如何通过调整先验概率来平衡误报与漏报。
发现了超球面上的细微亚群特征，初步实现了核爆炸与化学爆炸（准确率92%和82%）以及Geysers地热区地震与普通地震的区分。
me: Mapping normalized symmetric 3x3 moment tensors to 6-element unit vectors on the 5D hypersphere using Silver & Jordan's norm-preserving isomorphism.
Tangent-normal decomposition and principal component analysis (PCA) of sample dispersion matrices to quantify directional mean and orthogonal axes of variance.
Iterative fitting of anisotropic scaled von Mises-Fisher (SvMF) probability density functions to each event population.
Multi-class Bayesian event classification with variable prior probability weighting.
利用Silver和Jordan的保范同构，将归一化对称3x3矩张量映射为五维超球面上的六维单位向量。
采用切向-法向分解与样本离散矩阵的主成分分析（PCA），量化群体平均方向及正交方差轴。
对各类事件群体迭代拟合各向异性的缩放von Mises-Fisher（SvMF）概率密度函数。
采用具有可变先验概率权重的多类别贝叶斯事件分类方法。
de: Catalog of 1405 full moment tensor solutions: 1196 western US earthquakes (including 123 from the Geysers geothermal area, Mw 2.14–7.01), 143 nuclear explosions (NNSS, Lop Nur, North Korea, Mw 3.49–5.80), 17 chemical explosions (Mw 0.40–4.18), and 49 global collapses (44 mining, 5 post-nuclear, Mw 3.28–5.45).
Synthetic generation of 10,000 moment tensors per source class comparing isotropic vMF and anisotropic SvMF fits on the fundamental lune.
Prior probability sweep experiment varying earthquake prior from 1 to 10^-7 to evaluate misclassification trade-offs.
Sub-population discrimination tests comparing nuclear vs. chemical explosions and Geysers vs. non-Geysers earthquakes.
1405个全矩张量解目录：1196个美国西部地震（含123个Geysers地热区地震，Mw 2.14–7.01）、143个核爆炸（Mw 3.49–5.80）、17个化学爆炸（Mw 0.40–4.18）和49个全球塌陷事件（Mw 3.28–5.45）。
每类震源生成10,000个合成矩张量，在基本月牙图（lune）上对比各向同性vMF和各向异性SvMF的拟合效果。
先验概率扫描实验，将地震先验概率从1变化至10^-7以评估误分类权衡。
对比核爆炸与化学爆炸、Geysers地热区与非地热区地震的亚群区分测试。
li: Small sample sizes for specific sub-populations (e.g., only 17 chemical explosions and 5 nuclear-related collapses) limit rigorous statistical testing and robust parameter constraints.

Inability to definitively isolate whether nuclear vs. chemical explosion differences are caused by intrinsic source physics or secondary dataset differences (e.g., yield, depth-of-burial, rock lithology, frequency passbands).
Earthquake catalog is geographically restricted to the western United States, lacking diverse global tectonic settings.
特定亚群样本量过小（如仅17个化爆和5个核试验塌陷），限制了严格的统计检验和稳健的参数约束。
无法确切分离核爆与化爆的差异是源于内在震源物理机制还是次要数据集差异（如当量、埋深、岩性、滤波频带）。
地震目录在地理上局限于美国西部，缺乏全球不同构造背景的地震样本。

tm.why: The paper characterizes seismic source deformation mechanisms (explosions, earthquakes, collapses) using full six-element seismic moment tensor solutions.
It fits anisotropic probability density functions (scaled von Mises-Fisher distributions) on the 5D hypersphere and uses a Bayesian classifier with tunable priors to identify event types.
It compiles an expanded catalog of 1405 full moment tensors and develops a generalized screening and event classification framework for nuclear monitoring.

ev.notes: Full 27-page manuscript PDF (Seismological Research Letters revised manuscript, LLNL-JRNL-2011064) including all text, equations, 1 table, and 8 figures was read and analyzed.

sum: This study investigates earthquake scaling relations in the Southern Andes region from 2015 to 2017. Under conditions of small strain and steady seismic moment release rates, the author derives and evaluates empirical scaling equations. The work contributes to understanding how local tectonic stress and strain rates control the scaling behavior of seismicity in active subduction and mountain-building environments, providing key parameters for regional seismic hazard assessment.
本研究探讨了2015至2017年间安第斯南部地区的地震定标关系。在小应变和稳定地震矩释放率条件下，推导并评估了经验定标方程。该工作有助于理解局部构造应力和应变率如何控制活动俯冲带与造山环境中的地震活动定标特征，为区域地震危险性评估提供了关键参数。

t: Empirical and theoretical derivation of earthquake scaling equations under small strain and steady seismic moment release-rate conditions.
在小应变和稳定地震矩释放率条件下，对地震定标方程进行经验与理论推导。
Seismic catalog and event data from the Southern Andes region recorded between 2015 and 2017.
2015至2017年间记录的安第斯南部地区地震目录及事件数据。
Establishment of localized scaling relations that describe earthquake source parameters under steady-state tectonic deformation.
建立了描述稳态构造变形下地震源参数的局部定标关系。
The scaling relations are constrained by a relatively short observational period (2015-2017) in a specific tectonic setting.
定标关系受限于特定构造背景下较短的观测时期（2015-2017年）。
Formulating earthquake scaling specifically under the combined physical constraints of small strain and steady-state moment release.
首次在小应变和稳态矩释放的双重物理约束下构建地震定标关系。

kc: Derived earthquake scaling equations tailored for small strain conditions in the Southern Andes.
Analyzed seismicity from 2015 to 2017 to characterize steady moment release-rate behaviors.
Provided empirical constraints on tectonic stress and strain relationships in active subduction zones.
推导了适用于安第斯南部小应变条件的地震定标方程。
分析了2015至2017年间的地震活动，以表征稳定的矩释放率行为。
为活动俯冲带的构造应力与应变关系提供了经验约束。
me: Empirical scaling analysis of seismic catalog data.
Modeling of seismic moment release rates under small strain approximations.
地震目录数据的经验定标分析。
小应变近似下的地震矩释放率建模。
de: Seismicity catalog and waveform data from the Southern Andes region spanning 2015 to 2017.
2015至2017年间安第斯南部地区的地震活动性目录及波形数据。
li: The study is limited to a short temporal window (2015-2017) and a specific geographic region of the Southern Andes.
研究局限于较短的时间窗口（2015-2017年）以及安第斯南部的特定地理区域。

tm.why: The paper focuses on earthquake scaling equations and moment release-rate conditions in the Southern Andes.
It investigates earthquake scaling under small strain and steady moment release-rate conditions, which relates to fault mechanics.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the metadata, title, and public registry information from ESS Open Archive and Crossref.

sum: This paper presents a comprehensive comparison of five thermodynamic melt-vapor equilibrium tools (D-Compress, VolFe, EVo, Sulfur_X, and MAGEC) for H-O-C-S systems in basaltic magmas (MORB, Kīlauea, Fuego, and Fogo). The authors evaluate how differences in model implementation, such as fO2 buffer equations and sulfur solubility approaches, lead to divergent outputs in gas compositions, melt S and Fe speciation, and fO2. Comparing these with S-free models (MagmaSat, VolatileCalc, Iacono-Marziano) via VESIcal, they find that adding sulfur has minimal impact on vapor saturation pressure, which is instead dominated by the underlying H2O-CO2 calibration datasets. The study highlights the critical need for code transparency, interoperability, and targeted high-pressure/temperature experiments.
本文对比了五种用于玄武质岩浆体系的H-O-C-S熔体-蒸汽平衡热力学模拟工具（D-Compress、VolFe、EVo、Sulfur_X和MAGEC）。研究表明，各模型在氧逸度（fO2）缓冲方程和硫溶解度处理方法上的差异，会导致模拟的气体组分、熔体中硫和铁的赋存状态及氧逸度产生显著偏差。与无硫模型对……

t: Thermodynamic modeling of H-O-C-S melt-vapor equilibrium using five distinct computational tools (D-Compress, VolFe, EVo, Sulfur_X, MAGEC) and comparison with S-free models via VESIcal.
利用五种不同的计算工具对H-O-C-S熔体-蒸汽平衡进行热力学模拟，并通过VESIcal与无硫模型进行对比。
Simulated degassing scenarios using geochemical compositions of basaltic magmas from Mid-Ocean Ridge Basalts (MORB), Kīlauea, Fuego, and Fogo.
使用洋中脊玄武岩（MORB）、基拉韦厄、富埃戈和福戈玄武质岩浆的地球化学成分进行模拟脱气情景分析。

Model implementation differences lead to divergent gas compositions and Fe/S speciation, while adding S has negligible effect on vapor saturation pressure compared to H2O-CO2 calibration dataset controls.
模型实现差异导致气体组分和铁/硫赋存状态不同，而加入硫对蒸汽饱和压力的影响远小于H2O-CO2校准数据集的控制作用。
Model accuracy is highly limited by the underlying calibration datasets, particularly for less-studied magma compositions, and by a general lack of code interoperability.
模型准确性受底层校准数据集限制，特别是在研究较少的岩浆成分中，且代码缺乏互操作性。
First comprehensive, multi-model benchmarking of H-O-C-S melt-vapor equilibrium tools, highlighting the critical role of fO2 assumptions and calibration datasets over sulfur addition.
首次对H-O-C-S熔体-蒸汽平衡工具进行全面的多模型基准对比，突出了氧逸度假设和校准数据集的关键作用。

kc: Comprehensive comparison and benchmarking of five major H-O-C-S melt-vapor equilibrium modeling tools.
Identification of fO2 buffer equations and fO2-Fe3+/ΣFe relationships as major sources of model divergence.
Demonstration that the addition of sulfur has negligible effect on vapor saturation pressure calculations compared to H2O-CO2 calibration datasets.
对五种主要的H-O-C-S熔体-蒸汽平衡模拟工具进行了全面的对比与基准测试。
指出氧逸度（fO2）缓冲方程和fO2-Fe3+/ΣFe关系是导致模型输出偏差的主要原因。
证实了与H2O-CO2校准数据集相比，加入硫对蒸汽饱和压力计算的影响微乎其微。
me: Thermodynamic modeling of melt-vapor (±mineral) equilibria.
Comparative analysis of degassing scenarios for MORB, Kīlauea, Fuego, and Fogo basaltic compositions.
Model coupling and comparison using the VESIcal framework.
熔体-蒸汽（±矿物）平衡的热力学模拟。
对洋中脊玄武岩（MORB）、基拉韦厄、富埃戈和福戈玄武质成分脱气情景的对比分析。
利用VESIcal框架进行模型耦合与对比。
de: Synthetic degassing scenarios based on representative basaltic compositions from MORB, Kīlauea, Fuego, and Fogo.
Model outputs of gas compositions, melt S and Fe speciation, fO2, and vapor saturation pressures.
基于洋中脊玄武岩（MORB）、基拉韦厄、富埃戈和福戈典型玄武质成分的合成脱气情景模拟。
气体组分、熔体硫和铁赋存状态、氧逸度及蒸汽饱和压力的模型输出数据。
li: Lack of experimental calibration data for H2O-CO2-S solubility in compositions less represented in the literature (e.g., Fuego and Fogo).
Lack of interoperability and standardized code usability among existing thermodynamic tools.
在文献中代表性较少的成分（如富埃戈和福戈）中，缺乏H2O-CO2-S溶解度的实验校准数据。
现有热力学工具之间缺乏互操作性和标准化的代码易用性。

tm.why: The paper evaluates thermodynamic models of volcanic volatiles (H2O, CO2, S) used to interpret melt inclusions and volcanic gases, which is central to volcanology.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the comprehensive abstract and metadata available from EarthArXiv and Crossref, as no PDF was provided.

sum: High-speed railways (HSRs) excite repeatable seismic wavefields characterized by two key frequency eigenquantities: train frequency (from carriage repetition) and bridge frequency (from sequential pier excitation). This study systematizes theoretical wavefield expressions, compares template-based frequency-domain correlation with direct cepstral analysis for train-frequency estimation, and derives a novel velocity-independent bridge-frequency estimator by combining approaching and receding Doppler-shifted spectral peaks within high-SNR harmonic bands. Validated on synthetic spectra and one hour of dense (0.8 m spacing, 500 traces) Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data along the Beijing–Guangzhou HSR viaduct, results show that fourth-harmonic bridge-frequency estimates achieve significantly lower uncertainty (SD ~0.01 Hz) than train-frequency estimates (SD ~0.04 Hz). Spatial Fourier analysis reveals periodicity matching the 32 m pier spacing. Multi-train analyses accurately recover train speeds, carriage lengths, and apparent wave velocities (~2200 m/s), establishing a quantitative source-characterization basis for DAS railway monitoring.
本研究针对高铁（HSR）地震波场中的列车频率和桥梁频率两类特征量建立集成测量框架。方法上对比了频域相关与倒谱法在列车频率估计中的性能，并利用车前与车后配对多普勒频移谐波峰推导出与波速无关的桥梁频率估计器。基于京广高铁高架段500道密集分布式声学传感（DAS）数据的单车、多道及多车验证表明，桥梁频率测……

t: Compares frequency-domain template correlation and quefrency-domain cepstral peak picking for train frequency, and combines pre-arrival and post-departure Doppler-shifted harmonic peaks to estimate intrinsic bridge frequency independent of wave velocity.
对比频域相关与倒谱法估计列车频率，并配对车前车后多普勒频移谐波峰以消除波速依赖来估计本征桥梁频率。
Evaluated using synthetic spectra and a 1-hour field DAS dataset (500 Hz sampling, 0.8 m spacing, 1.6 m gauge length, 500 channels across piers 114–127) along the Beijing–Guangzhou HSR viaduct.
采用合成频谱及京广高铁高架段1小时实测DAS数据（500 Hz采样，0.8 m道距，500道覆盖114–127号墩）。

Across 8 trains and 500 traces, bridge frequency shows much lower uncertainty than train frequency (mean SD 0.0129 Hz vs 0.0640 Hz), yielding consistent speeds, carriage lengths (~25.75–26.35 m), and apparent wave velocities (~2200 m/s).
8列次500道测试中桥梁频率比列车频率更稳定（均值标准差0.0129对0.0640 Hz），反演表观波速约2200 m/…

Relies on a homogeneous-medium assumption, lacks independent train-set labels and true site P-wave velocity calibration, and exhibits ~200 m/s trace-to-trace scatter in apparent wave velocity due to multi-phase interference.
采用均匀介质近似，缺乏独立车型标签与真实场地波速标定，且多震相干扰导致表观波速有约200 m/s道间散差。

Formulates a velocity-independent bridge-frequency estimator from paired Doppler-shifted harmonics and systematically benchmarks correlation versus cepstral train-frequency estimators with trace-level uncertainty across dense HSR DAS arrays.
推导出不依赖波速的多普勒配对桥梁频率估计公式，并在密集DAS阵列上系统评估了相关法与倒谱法的道级不确定度。

kc: Systematized theoretical expressions for train frequency and bridge frequency in HSR-induced seismic wavefields under a unified notation.
Compared frequency-domain spectral correlation and cepstral analysis for train-frequency estimation across synthetic and 500-trace field DAS datasets.
Derived and validated a velocity-independent intrinsic bridge-frequency estimator using reciprocal combinations of paired approaching and receding Doppler-shifted harmonic peaks.
Demonstrated that bridge frequency exhibits ~4x lower measurement variance than train frequency and accurately yields train speed, carriage length, and ~2200 m/s apparent wave velocity.
在统一符号体系下系统化梳理了高铁地震波场中列车频率与桥梁频率的理论物理表达式。
在合成数据与500道实测DAS数据上系统对比了频域谱相关法与倒谱法对列车频率的估计性能。
利用车前与车后配对多普勒频移谐波峰的倒数代数组合，推导并验证了与介质波速无关的本征桥梁频率估计器。
证实桥梁频率测量方差显著低于列车频率（标准差约低4倍），并能稳定估算列车速度、车厢长度和约2200 m/s的表观波速。
me: Frequency-domain normalized cross-correlation between observed spectra and theoretical carriage/wheelset modulation reference spectra.
Cepstral analysis (Fourier transform of log-spectrum) to directly identify spectral line spacing in the quefrency domain without template searching.
Velocity-independent bridge-frequency estimation via harmonic-matched pre-arrival and post-departure Doppler-shifted spectral peaks (2/f_p = 1/f_2 + 1/f_1).
Spatial Fourier transform of multi-trace frequency estimates and statistical uncertainty quantification (Wilcoxon signed-rank and paired t-tests).
计算实测频谱与基于车厢/轮对调制理论参考谱之间的频域归一化互相关系数搜索列车频率。
采用倒谱分析（对数谱的傅里叶变换）在倒频域直接识别等间距谱线周期，无需模板搜索。
在相同高信噪比谐波频带（2次和4次谐波）内配对列车到达前后的多普勒频移峰值，通过公式 2/f_p = 1/f_2 + 1/f_1 消除波速依赖以估计本征桥梁频率。
对多道频率测量结果进行空间傅里叶变换分析空间周期性，并采用配对t检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验量化测量不确定度。
de: Synthetic HSR source spectrum simulations (v = 80 m/s, L = 25.0 m, 16 carriages, 4 wheelsets per carriage, theoretical f_c = 3.2 Hz).
Field DAS deployment along an elevated viaduct of the Beijing–Guangzhou HSR (Baoding, Hebei) using a HiFi-DAS unit (500 Hz sampling, 0.8 m channel spacing, 1.6 m gauge length).
One-hour continuous DAS dataset (23 November 2024, channels 501–1000 spanning piers No. 114 to No. 127) containing ~20 train passages and 8 isolated multi-train events.
高铁震源频谱合成数据模拟实验（车速80 m/s，车厢长25.0 m，16节车厢，每车4组轮对，理论列车频率3.2 Hz）。
河北保定京广高铁高架桥段浅沟敷设约2.5 km光缆的现场DAS观测实验（HiFi-DAS系统，采样率500 Hz，道间距0.8 m，标距1.6 m）。
2024年11月23日1小时连续DAS记录（第501–1000道，覆盖114至127号桥墩），包含约20次列车通行及精选的无干扰8列次多车事件。
li: Assumes a homogeneous scalar effective-velocity medium as a first-order approximation, neglecting complex lateral heterogeneity, scattering, and mode conversions.
Lack of independent ground-truth train-set identification labels (exact train model/speed) and controlled-source true site P-wave velocity for absolute calibration.
Fundamental bridge frequency (~2.5 Hz) is weak in field DAS records, requiring reliance on 2nd (~5 Hz) and 4th (~10 Hz) harmonics, and wave velocity estimates show ~200 m/s trace-to-trace scatter.
理论推导采用均匀标量等效波速介质的一阶近似，未在正演模型中直接包含复杂的横向非均匀性、散射和波型转换。
缺乏独立的列车车次/车型真实标签以及可控震源实测场地真实P波速度数据来进行绝对标定。
实测DAS记录中桥梁基频（约2.5 Hz）能量较弱，需依赖2次和4次谐波提取，且表观波速估计存在约200 m/s的道间散差。

tm.why: The paper develops and applies frequency measurement methods to dense Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data recorded along a high-speed railway viaduct.
It characterizes anthropogenic seismic wavefields generated by moving high-speed trains and viaduct bridge piers for railway and near-surface vibration analysis.

ev.notes: Full 21-page PDF analyzed, including equations (1)-(15), synthetic tests, field DAS setup in Hebei Province, statistical tests in Section 5.4, and all 12 figures.

sum: This study investigates Middle Triassic felsic volcanic rocks along the Periadriatic Fault System and Mid-Hungarian Shear Zone. Using petrology, mineral chemistry, and U-Pb zircon geochronology, the authors show that ignimbritic rhyolites from Margečan experienced high-pressure, low-temperature blueschist-facies metamorphism (~1.1-1.2 GPa, ~300 °C) during the Cretaceous Eoalpine subduction. In contrast, nearby Kjumberk volcanics show no overprint, retaining their Southern Alpine affinity. This metamorphic contrast redefines the tectonic boundary in this sector, implying that the Margečan units belong to the Austroalpine domain and underwent large-scale eastward lateral extrusion into the Carpathian embayment along major strike-slip faults.
本研究对阿尔卑斯边缘中三叠世长英质火山岩进行了岩石学、矿物化学和锆石U-Pb年代学分析。结果表明，Margečan地区的流纹质凝灰岩经历了白片岩/蓝片岩相高压低温变质作用（~1.1-1.2 GPa, ~300 °C），属于早阿尔卑斯俯冲变质产物；而邻近的Kjumberk火山岩未受变质影响。这一发现重……

t: Mineral chemistry of phengitic muscovite combined with whole-rock geochemistry, Nd isotopes, and U-Pb zircon geochronology.
结合全岩地球化学、Nd同位素和锆石U-Pb年代学，对多硅白云母进行矿物化学分析。
Middle Triassic felsic volcanic rocks (ignimbrites) from Margečan and Kjumberk areas along the Periadriatic Fault System.
采集自沿周阿尔卑斯断裂带分布的Margečan和Kjumberk地区的中三叠世长英质火山岩。
Discovery of blueschist-facies metamorphism (~1.1-1.2 GPa, ~300 °C) in Margečan ignimbrites, contrasting with the unmetamorphosed Kjumberk volcanics.
在Margečan流纹岩中发现蓝片岩相变质作用（~1.1-1.2 GPa, ~300 °C），而Kjumberk火山岩未…
The study relies on regional tectonic correlations to link the metamorphic overprint to Cretaceous Eoalpine subduction.
变质超覆与白垩纪早阿尔卑斯俯冲的关联主要依赖于区域构造对比。
First identification of high-pressure, low-temperature Eoalpine metamorphic overprint in Triassic felsic volcanic rocks of this region.
首次在该地区三叠纪长英质火山岩中识别出高压低温早阿尔卑斯变质超覆作用。

kc: Discovered the first evidence of high-pressure, low-temperature blueschist-facies metamorphic overprint in the Margečan ignimbrites.
Constrained the peak metamorphic conditions to ~1.1-1.2 GPa and ~300 °C using phengitic muscovite compositions.
Delineated a first-order tectonic boundary between the metamorphic Austroalpine-derived Margečan units and the unmetamorphosed Southern Alpine Kjumberk units.
Proposed a geodynamic model of large-scale eastward lateral extrusion of Adria-derived units accommodated by right-lateral strike-slip faults.
首次在Margečan流纹质凝灰岩中发现了高压低温蓝片岩相变质作用的证据。
利用多硅白云母成分确定了峰期变质条件为~1.1-1.2 GPa和~300 °C。
划分了经历变质的奥地利阿尔卑斯源Margečan单元与未变质的南阿尔卑斯Kjumberk单元之间的一级构造边界。
提出了阿德里亚源区地体在右旋走滑断裂作用下向东大规模侧向挤出的地球动力学模型。
me: Mineral chemistry analysis of phengitic muscovite to estimate metamorphic pressure and temperature.
U-Pb zircon geochronology to constrain the depositional age of the felsic volcanism.
Whole-rock geochemistry and Nd isotope analysis to determine magma source characteristics.
利用多硅白云母进行矿物化学分析，以估算变质压力和温度。
利用锆石U-Pb年代学约束长英质火山作用的沉积时代。
利用全岩地球化学和Nd同位素分析确定岩浆源区特征。
de: Felsic volcanic rock samples collected from the Margečan and Kjumberk areas along the Periadriatic Fault System and Mid-Hungarian Shear Zone.
U-Pb zircon ages ranging from ~246 to 240 Ma (Anisian-early Ladinian).
采集自沿阿尔卑斯周缘断裂带和中匈牙利剪切带分布的Margečan和Kjumberk地区的长英质火山岩样品。
获得介于~246至240 Ma（安尼期至早拉丁期）之间的锆石U-Pb年龄数据。
li: The precise timing of the Cretaceous Eoalpine metamorphic overprint is inferred from regional correlations rather than direct geochronological dating of the metamorphic minerals.
白垩纪早阿尔卑斯期变质超覆的精确时代主要基于区域对比，而非直接对变质矿物进行放射性测年。

tm.why: The paper investigates the tectonic evolution, metamorphic overprint, and large-scale lateral extrusion of crustal units along the Periadriatic Fault System and Mid-Hungarian Shear Zone.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from Crossref, as no PDF was available.

sum: Mapping active faults from remote sensing data is vital for surface rupture hazard assessment, yet tectonic landforms are often ambiguous. This study evaluates how mapper experience, data resolution, and geologic maps impact fault mapping quality through a controlled experiment with 23 participants (undergraduates to senior professionals). Using a standardized desktop workflow on pre-earthquake topography and imagery across four earthquakes (Borah Peak, El Mayor-Cucapah, Fukushima-Hamadori, Ridgecrest), participants mapped fault traces that were then compared to coseismic surface ruptures using 15, 50, and 150 m buffers. While experienced geologists better filtered out non-tectonic fluvial features, trained graduate students produced maps of comparable quality to professionals, and all groups missed subtle or anthropogenically altered rupture zones. High-resolution lidar/SfM data improved detail, whereas pre-existing geologic maps mainly validated interpretations. The novelty lies in empirically quantifying inter-mapper epistemic uncertainty in fault location (55–117 m) across career stages.
基于遥感数据绘制活动断层对地表破裂危险性评估至关重要。本研究组织23名不同经验参与者（本科生至资深专家），利用震前地形与影像数据对4次地震开展标准化桌面重复填图实验，并与同震地表破裂对比。结果显示，专家更善于排除河流冲沟等非构造地貌，但受训研究生的填图质量与专业人员相当，且所有群体均遗漏了微弱或受人……

t: Participants used a standardized desktop GIS workflow to map tectonic landforms and pre-rupture fault traces, which were evaluated against coseismic ruptures using 15, 50, and 150 m buffers and a 15° trend threshold.
参与者使用标准化GIS流程绘制震前断层迹线，并通过15、50、150米缓冲区及15°走向阈值与同震破裂对比。

Twenty-three participants (undergraduates, graduate students, postdocs, and professionals) mapped pre-earthquake remote sensing topography and imagery across four surface-rupturing earthquakes, plus multi-resolution (30 m to 0.1 m) and geologic map test sites.
23名不同经验参与者对4次地表破裂地震的震前遥感数据，以及多分辨率（30至0.1米）和地质图测试区进行填图。

Graduate students mapped with quality similar to professionals, though professionals better avoided fluvial scarps. Inter-mapper epistemic uncertainty in fault location around tectonic landforms is 55–117 m (2σ).
研究生与专家的填图质量相当，但专家更少将河流陡坎误判为断层；构造地貌附近断层位置的认知不确定性为55–117米。

Evaluating mapping accuracy against a single subsequent earthquake conflates unruptured active faults (aleatory variability) with mapping errors, and small sample sizes limit statistical generalization.
以单次后续地震破裂评估精度会将未破裂的活动断层（偶然变异性）与填图误差混淆，且样本量较小。

First controlled repeat-mapping experiment across 23 mappers from undergraduate to senior professional levels that empirically isolates inter-mapper epistemic uncertainty against actual subsequent coseismic ruptures.
首次开展跨本科生至资深专家23人的受控重复填图实验，结合实际同震破裂经验性地分离出填图者间认知不确定性。

kc: Quantified inter-mapper epistemic uncertainty in fault trace location around tectonic landforms to be between 55 and 117 m (2σ).
Demonstrated that targeted training allows graduate students to produce geomorphic fault maps comparable in quality to senior professionals.
Evaluated the impact of topographic/imagery resolution (30 m SRTM to 0.1 m SfM) and prior geologic maps on fault mapping confidence and detail.
量化了构造地貌附近断层迹线位置的填图者间认知不确定性（2σ为55至117米）。
证明经过针对性培训的研究生能够绘制出质量与资深专业人员相当的地貌断层图。
评估了地形/影像分辨率（30米SRTM至0.1米SfM）及已有地质图对断层填图置信度和细节的影响。
me: Standardized 5-step desktop geomorphic fault mapping workflow in GIS (morphologic mapping, tectonic landforms, fault traces, and confidence ranking).
Spatial buffer analysis (15, 50, and 150 m widths with a 15° local trend threshold) comparing 1-m resampled pre-rupture mapped faults to actual coseismic ruptures.
Perpendicular swath profile analysis across key tectonic landforms to quantify the 2σ spatial spread (epistemic uncertainty) of participant-mapped traces.
GIS中标准化的五步桌面地貌断层填图流程（地貌填图、构造地貌识别、断层迹线绘制及置信度评级）。
空间缓冲区分析（15、50和150米宽度及15°走向阈值），将1米重采样的震前填图断层与实际同震破裂进行对比。
跨越关键构造地貌的垂直剖面分析，以量化参与者所绘断层迹线的2σ空间分布（认知不确定性）。
de: Repeat Mapping Project: 23 participants mapped 2-km sections of pre-earthquake datasets for 1983 Borah Peak, 2010 El Mayor-Cucapah, 2011 Fukushima-Hamadori, and 2019 Ridgecrest earthquakes.

Data Type and Resolution Project: Sequential mapping using 30 m SRTM, 1 m NAPP airphotos, 1 m satellite imagery, 1 m lidar, and 0.1 m Structure-from-Motion (SfM) DEMs along the Southern San Andreas, Wasatch, and Hope faults.
Adding a Geologic Map Project: Pre-rupture mapping before and after consulting published 1:10,000 and 1:100,000 geologic maps for El Mayor-Cucapah and 2014 South Napa earthquakes.
重复填图实验：23名参与者对1983年Borah Peak、2010年El Mayor-Cucapah、2011年福岛浜通和2019年Ridgecrest地震的2公里震前数据区进行填图。
数据类型与分辨率实验：沿南圣安德烈斯、Wasatch和Hope断层，依次使用30米SRTM、1米航片、1米卫片、1米激光雷达和0.1米SfM数据进行填图。
叠加地质图实验：在参考已发表的1:10,000和1:100,000地质图前后，对El Mayor-Cucapah和2014年南纳帕地震区进行震前断层填图对比。
li: Mapping accuracy is operationally evaluated against a single subsequent coseismic rupture realization, which conflates unruptured valid faults (aleatory variability) with overmapping errors.
Small sample size of 23 participants (only 6 professionals) and 2-km rectangular mapping boxes that may have subtly biased expected fault orientations.
填图精度仅以单次后续同震破裂作为参考标准进行评估，这会将未破裂的真实断层（偶然变异性）与过度填图误差混为一谈。
参与者样本量较小（共23人，仅6名专业人员），且2公里长的矩形填图框可能对预期的断层走向产生微妙的暗示偏差。

tm.why: The paper evaluates pre-rupture active fault mapping accuracy and epistemic uncertainty to improve probabilistic fault displacement hazard assessment and critical infrastructure protection.
The study compares pre-earthquake geomorphic fault maps directly against coseismic surface rupture traces from four major historical earthquakes.
A primary contribution of the paper is quantifying inter-mapper epistemic uncertainty (55–117 m) versus aleatory variability in fault trace locations.

ev.notes: Full PDF text, figures, and tables (pages 1–25) were analyzed.

sum: Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) captures complex wave propagation along fiber-optic arrays, where conventional CNNs and static GNNs struggle with shifting spatial footprints and low SNR. This paper introduces the Spectro-Spatial Dynamic Graph Neural Network (S2-DyGNN) for DAS acoustic event classification. First, an asymmetrical 2D frequency-time CNN extracts localized spectro-temporal embeddings per channel from STFT spectrograms while preserving exact temporal resolution. Next, a dual-matrix GNN combines a static physical distance matrix with a frame-by-frame multi-head self-attention adjacency matrix (with ReLU sparsification) to dynamically aggregate correlated spatial channels while suppressing background noise. Evaluated on a skewed nine-class field DAS dataset (1663 channels, 20 kHz) and a secondary six-class dataset, S2-DyGNN achieves 94.0% accuracy and 86.6% macro-F1 (and 97.4% accuracy on the secondary dataset), substantially improving minority transient event detection with real-time computational efficiency (RTF < 0.005).
针对分布式声学传感（DAS）中复杂波传播与背景噪声干扰，本文提出光谱-空间动态图神经网络（S2-DyGNN）。方法首先利用非对称2D时频CNN从单通道STFT语谱图中提取保留时间分辨率的局部特征，随后通过双矩阵图神经网络将静态物理距离先验与基于多头自注意力的逐帧动态邻接矩阵融合。在高度不平衡的9类校……

t: S2-DyGNN converts 1D DAS signals to STFT spectrograms, extracts temporal-preserving node embeddings via an asymmetrical 2D frequency-time CNN, and aggregates spatial neighborhoods using a GCN over a convex combination of multi-head attention and static physical distance matrices.
将DAS信号转为STFT语谱图，经非对称2D时频CNN提取保时序特征，再通过融合多头注意力与静态距离矩阵的GCN聚合空间…

Evaluated on a large-scale 9-class Φ-OTDR dataset (1663 channels at 1.02 m spacing, 20 kHz sampling, >324,000 windows of 8192 samples) and a secondary 6-class 12-channel Φ-OTDR dataset (15,612 samples).
采用1663通道、20kHz采样的9类校园Φ-OTDR实地数据集（>32.4万窗口）及6类12通道公开数据集（15,61…

S2-DyGNN achieved 94.0% accuracy and 86.6% macro-F1 on the primary 9-class dataset (improving minority 'openclose' F1 to 55.7% with RTF of 0.00415), and 97.4% accuracy (97.3% macro-F1) on the secondary dataset.
在主数据集上达94.0%准确率和86.6%宏F1（开关井盖类F1达55.7%，RTF为0.00415），在次数据集上达9…
Expanding the spatial window beyond 17 sensors degrades performance due to spatial oversmoothing and blurred event epicenters, and overlapping multisource interference is not yet disentangled.
空间窗口超过17通道会导致空间过度平滑与震中模糊，且尚未解决多源重叠干扰信号的解耦问题。
Couples an unbroken temporal-preserving 2D spectrogram CNN front-end with a ReLU-sparsified dynamic attention graph regularized by a static physical distance prior.
将保时序2D语谱图CNN前端与受静态物理距离先验正则化的ReLU稀疏动态注意力图网络相耦合。

kc: Independent intra-channel feature extraction using an asymmetrical 2D frequency-time CNN that compresses spectral dimensions while strictly preserving frame-by-frame temporal alignment.
Event-driven dynamic spatial aggregation via a dual-matrix GNN that blends multi-head attention spectral similarity edges with a static physical distance penalty (alpha = 0.15).

Structural resistance to signal washout via ReLU attention sparsification, boosting the minority 'openclose' class F1-score to 55.7% vs. 48.0% for static graphs and maintaining real-time execution (RTF < 0.005).
采用非对称2D时频CNN进行通道独立特征提取，在压缩频率维度的同时严格保持逐帧时间对齐。
提出事件驱动的双矩阵动态空间聚合GNN，将多头注意力光谱相似性动态图与静态物理距离惩罚项（α=0.15）相融合。
通过ReLU注意力稀疏化抑制纯噪声节点，抗信号淹没能力强，将稀有“开关井盖”类F1提升至55.7%，且满足实时运行（RTF<0.005）。
me: Short-time Fourier transform (STFT, window 1024, hop 256) converting 8192-sample 1D DAS phase streams into 2D time-frequency spectrograms.
Asymmetrical 3-layer 2D frequency-time CNN (kernel 3x5, stride 1x2) followed by frequency-axis adaptive average pooling to produce 64-D temporal feature sequences per sensor.
Two-head self-attention dynamic graph generator with ReLU sparsification and softmax normalization, combined convexly with a static inter-sensor physical distance matrix.
Two stacked Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) layers with batch normalization, ReLU, dropout, and residual skip connections.
短时傅里叶变换（STFT，窗长1024，步长256）将8192采样点的一维DAS相位信号转换为二维时频语谱图。
三层非对称2D时频CNN（卷积核3×5，步长1×2）结合频率维自适应平均池化，生成每个传感器64维时间特征序列。
含ReLU稀疏化与Softmax归一化的双头自注意力动态图生成器，与静态传感器物理距离矩阵进行凸组合融合。
两层堆叠图卷积网络（GCN），包含批归一化、ReLU激活、Dropout及残差跳跃连接。
de: Primary dataset: Publicly available 9-class Φ-OTDR campus field dataset (buried 1 m, 1663 channels at 1.02 m spacing, 20 kHz pulse repetition rate, 324,000+ windows across car, construction, climbing, longboard, manipulation, openclose, regular, running, walking).
Secondary dataset: Publicly available 6-class armored-fiber Φ-OTDR dataset with 15,612 samples across 12 fixed spatial channels (background noise, digging, knocking, watering, shaking, walking).

Benchmark comparisons against 1D CNN, CNN-LSTM, GAT, and GCN, plus ablation studies on graph topology, CNN front-end (1D FT, 2D NT, 2D FT), spatial window size (9 to 21 channels), attention heads (1, 2, 4), and blending hyperparameter alpha (0.1 to 0.3).
主数据集：公开的9类校园埋地Φ-OTDR实地数据集（埋深1米，1663通道，间距1.02米，采样率20 kHz，超32.4万个样本窗口）。
次数据集：公开的6类铠装光缆Φ-OTDR数据集，包含12个固定空间通道共15,612个样本（背景噪声、挖掘、敲击、浇水、摇晃、行走）。
与CNN、CNN-LSTM、GAT和GCN进行基准对比，并针对图拓扑、CNN前端、空间窗口大小（9至21通道）、注意力头数及混合超参数α开展了消融实验。
li: Expanding the spatial context window beyond 17 sensors (e.g., 21 sensors) blurs the physical epicenter and causes spatial oversmoothing from distant uncorrelated ambient noise.
Minority sparse transient classes like 'openclose' remain challenging under severe class imbalance, reaching a ceiling of 55.7% F1-score.
Disentangling overlapping acoustic signatures under extreme multisource interference remains unaddressed and is left for future work.
空间上下文窗口超过17个传感器（如21个）会模糊事件物理震中，并引入远距离不相关环境噪声导致空间过度平滑。
在严重类别不平衡下，诸如“开关井盖”等极稀疏瞬态事件的F1分数上限仍仅为55.7%。
尚未解决强多源干扰环境下重叠声学信号特征的解耦问题。

tm.why: The paper develops an acoustic event classification framework specifically designed for phase-sensitive OTDR distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) arrays.
It introduces S2-DyGNN, coupling a 2D frequency-time convolutional neural network with a dynamic dual-matrix graph neural network to classify surface and anthropogenic vibrations.

ev.notes: Full 24-page PDF analyzed, including architecture equations, experimental setups on two public Φ-OTDR datasets, 9 tables, and 7 figures.

sum: Deep marine sediments host vast microbial populations persisting in dormancy for millions of years, creating an evolutionary paradox: how are deep-burial adaptations maintained if reproduction ceases after shallow burial? This study proposes and tests whether subduction-zone tectonic pumping provides the physical return pathway to close this evolutionary loop. Using 2D Fourier-domain poroelastic models constrained by observational benchmarks across global subduction margins, the authors demonstrate that megathrust slip drives transient fluid circulation exceeding 10^6 Gt/Myr globally, capable of transporting 10^26–10^30 cells/Myr back to the seafloor, predominantly focused through permeable fault zones and cold seeps. Furthermore, empirical analysis of 16S rRNA datasets and USGS earthquake catalogs across the Costa Rica forearc reveals significant positive correlations between cumulative seismic energy and both microbial alpha diversity and subsurface-associated phyla abundance. This burial-reemergence cycle establishes a geological selection filter favoring extreme microbial longevity.
深海沉积物中存在大量休眠数百万年的微生物，形成了演化悖论：若浅埋后繁殖停止，深埋适应性特征如何维持？本文提出并检验了俯冲带构造泵送是否提供物理返回路径以闭合该演化循环。利用受全球俯冲边缘观测约束的二维傅里叶域孔隙弹性模型，研究表明大逆冲断层滑动驱动的全球瞬态流体通量超过10^6 Gt/Myr，每百万……

t: The authors model slip-driven fluid transport in subduction-zone outer wedges using a 2D poroelastic framework linking megathrust slip to pore-pressure perturbations, extrapolating transient drainage with stretched-exponential functions scaled by plate convergence rates.
利用二维孔隙弹性模型关联逆冲滑动与孔隙压力扰动，结合拉伸指数拟合与板块汇聚速率外推全球流体与微生物通量。

The study combines poroelastic models across global subduction margins constrained by geophysical and geochemical benchmarks with published 16S rRNA microbial datasets from 14 Costa Rica forearc seeps and USGS ComCat earthquake catalogs.
整合全球9个俯冲带数值模型与通量观测基准，以及哥斯达黎加前弧14个冷泉的16S rRNA数据与USGS地震目录。

Global subduction outer-wedge fluid discharge reaches 10^6–10^8 Gt/Myr, transporting 10^26–10^30 cells/Myr; in Costa Rica, cumulative seismic forcing significantly correlates with microbial Shannon diversity (R = 0.64, p = 0.0136) and subsurface phyla.
全球俯冲外楔排水达10^6–10^8 Gt/Myr，运移10^26–10^30个细胞/Myr；地震能量与微生物多样性显著…

Direct sampling kilometers beneath the seafloor is technically challenging, seep-specific permeability architectures lack constraints for site-level flux prediction, and co-varying environmental or geochemical stimulation cannot be fully excluded.
深部原位采样困难，特定冷泉渗透率结构缺乏约束，且无法完全排除共变地球化学刺激因素的影响。

Identifies subduction-zone tectonic pumping as a global physical return mechanism that closes the natural selection loop for long-buried dormant subseafloor microbes, explaining widespread extreme longevity adaptations.
首次提出俯冲带构造泵送作为深埋休眠微生物重返海底的物理机制，闭合了偏好极端寿命的自然选择演化循环。

kc: Developed a 2D poroelastic modeling framework to quantify slip-driven fluid discharge and microbial transport across global subduction-zone outer wedges.
Estimated global tectonic pumping fluxes at 10^6–10^8 Gt/Myr, sufficient to recycle 10^26–10^30 microbial cells per Myr from kilometer-scale depths to the seafloor.
Demonstrated empirical positive correlations between distance-weighted cumulative seismic energy and microbial diversity/subsurface clades in Costa Rica forearc cold seeps.
开发了二维孔隙弹性建模框架，用于量化全球俯冲带外楔中由断层滑动驱动的流体排放和微生物运移。
估算全球构造泵送通量为10^6–10^8 Gt/Myr，足以每百万年将10^26–10^30个微生物细胞从数公里深处循环回海底。
证实了哥斯达黎加前弧冷泉中距离加权累积地震能量与微生物多样性及深部相关菌群之间存在显著正相关。
me: 2D in-plane strain Fourier-domain Green's function and poroelastic solver coupled with Darcy's law and Runge-Kutta time integration.
Stretched-exponential (Kohlrausch–Williams–Watts) fitting to extrapolate transient post-seismic fluid drainage over long-term seismic cycles.
Pearson and Spearman correlation analysis between USGS ComCat distance-weighted seismic energy metrics and 16S rRNA microbial community diversity.
耦合达西定律与Runge-Kutta时间积分的二维平面应变傅里叶域格林函数及孔隙弹性求解器。
利用拉伸指数（KWW）函数拟合外推震后瞬态流体排泄在长期地震周期中的累积通量。
对USGS地震目录距离加权地震能量指标与16S rRNA微生物群落多样性进行Pearson和Spearman相关性分析。
de: Numerical poroelastic simulations across nine global subduction margins (Japan Trench, Sumatra, Cascadia, Aleutian, Costa Rica, Lesser Antilles, Nankai, Colombian, Peru-Chile).
Observational fluid flux benchmarks from mass balance, geochemical, biogeochemical, thermal budgets, and CORK/flow-meter measurements.
Published 16S rRNA gene sequencing data from 14 Costa Rica forearc seep sites paired with regional USGS ComCat seismicity (1990–2026, M >= 2.5).
针对全球九个俯冲边缘（日本海沟、苏门答腊、卡斯卡迪亚、阿留申、哥斯达黎加、小安的列斯、南海海槽、哥伦比亚、秘鲁-智利）的孔隙弹性数值模拟。
来自质量平衡、地球化学、生物地球化学、热通量收支及CORK/流量计观测的流体通量基准数据。
来自哥斯达黎加前弧14个冷泉站点的已发表16S rRNA基因测序数据，结合USGS区域地震目录（1990–2026年，M >= 2.5）。
li: Direct in situ sampling of microbial communities several kilometers beneath the seafloor remains technically challenging, requiring reliance on surface-expressed forearc seeps.
Seep-specific permeability architectures and local sediment-thickness variations at Costa Rica sampling sites are not sufficiently constrained for site-specific flux prediction.
Broader microbial community restructuring driven by co-varying environmental or geochemical stimulation factors cannot be fully excluded.
海底以下数公里处微生物群落的原位直接采样在技术上仍具挑战性，需依赖地表出露的前弧冷泉窗口。
哥斯达黎加采样站点的特定冷泉渗透率结构及局部沉积物厚度变化缺乏足够约束，无法进行站点特定的通量预测。
无法完全排除由共变环境因素或地球化学刺激因素驱动的更广泛的微生物群落重构。

tm.why: The study models poroelastic fluid circulation driven by megathrust earthquakes, slow-slip events, tremor, and aseismic creep in subduction-zone accretionary wedges.
The paper links cumulative seismic forcing from earthquake catalogs to subseafloor microbial community diversity and biogeochemical transport in forearc cold seeps.
It quantifies global fluid fluxes across subduction-zone outer wedges scaled by long-term plate convergence rates and wedge structural geometries.

ev.notes: Full preprint PDF (17 main pages + 12 supplementary pages provided in extract) was used to verify methods, equations, flux estimates, statistical correlations, and figure contents.

sum: This Nature news/review article highlights four emerging deep-sea technologies transforming ocean-bottom research and hazard monitoring. These include deep-sea drilling ships, advanced sea-floor sensors, and repurposed submarine telecommunication cables (such as SMART cables and DAS). By leveraging acoustic waves and fiber-optic networks, these technologies aim to significantly improve early warning times for deadly earthquakes and tsunamis, providing critical hours of evacuation time for coastal communities.
这篇《自然》新闻综述重点介绍了四种正在改变深海研究与灾害监测的新兴技术，包括深海钻探船、先进海底传感器以及重构的商业海底光缆（如SMART光缆和分布式光纤声学传感DAS）。通过利用水中声波和光纤网络，这些技术旨在显著提高破坏性地震和海啸的预警时效，为沿海地区争取宝贵的避险时间。

t: Review of deep-sea instrumentation, including SMART cables, DAS, and seafloor acoustic sensors for real-time hazard monitoring.
综述了包括SMART光缆、DAS和海底声学传感器在内的实时灾害监测深海仪器技术。
Synthesis of observational capabilities from global submarine cable networks and deep-sea sensor deployments.
综合了全球海底光缆网络和深海传感器部署的观测能力与应用案例。
Acoustic-based detection can potentially predict tsunami landfall locations and damage hours in advance by utilizing fast-propagating ocean waves.
利用水中快速传播的声波，声学检测技术能够提前数小时预测海啸登陆位置和破坏范围。
The practical challenges of scaling up instrumentation globally due to high costs and commercial cable access restrictions.
由于高昂的成本和商业光缆准入限制，在全球范围内推广这些设备面临挑战。
Synthesizes the integration of commercial telecom infrastructure (SMART cables) with traditional geophysics for global-scale hazard mitigation.
系统总结了将商业通信基础设施（如SMART光缆）与传统地球物理学结合的最新进展。

kc: Identifies and reviews four key deep-sea technologies for hazard mitigation.
Highlights the potential of repurposing commercial submarine telecommunication cables for seismic monitoring.
Discusses how acoustic wave propagation in water can accelerate tsunami early warning systems.
梳理并评估了用于防灾减灾的四种关键深海技术。
强调了将商业海底通信光缆重构用于地震监测的巨大潜力。
探讨了利用水中声波传播加速海啸早期预警系统的可行性。
me: Review and synthesis of recent technological developments in marine geophysics.
Analysis of submarine fiber-optic sensing (DAS and SMART cables) for seismic detection.
Evaluation of acoustic-based tsunami early warning methods.
对海洋地球物理学最新技术进展进行综述与系统梳理。
分析海底光纤传感（DAS和SMART光缆）在地震检测中的应用。
评估基于声学波的海啸早期预警方法。
de: Based on literature review and reports of active deep-sea monitoring initiatives and pilot projects.
基于文献综述以及现有的深海监测计划和试点项目的公开报告。
li: High deployment and maintenance costs of deep-sea instrumentation.
Geopolitical and commercial challenges in accessing global submarine telecommunication networks.
深海仪器部署和维护的成本极高。
获取全球海底商业通信网络数据面临地缘政治和商业准入挑战。

tm.why: The paper reviews deep-sea technologies, sea-floor sensors, and repurposed cables for detecting earthquakes and tsunamis.
It discusses repurposed Internet cables and deep-sea technologies for seismic and tsunami monitoring.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on Nature publication metadata, crossref records, and public science news summaries detailing the four deep-sea technologies.

sum: This study uses numerical simulations to investigate the formation of dilational bands and the distribution of non-ice materials on Europa's surface. By conducting a parametric study of lateral tectonic extension, the authors demonstrate that dilational bands form under high extensional strain rates, with their specific morphology governed by lithospheric thickness and strength. Furthermore, the models show how extension drives the upward transport of crustal non-ice materials (such as salts) from the subsurface ocean to the surface. The resulting surface composition and spatial distribution of these materials reflect the initial vertical profile of the ice shell, explaining the localized salt concentrations observed by the Galileo mission.
本研究采用数值模拟方法探讨了木卫二表面扩张带的形成及非冰物质的分布。通过对侧向构造拉张进行参数化研究，作者发现扩张带在高速率拉张应变下形成，其具体形态受控于冰壳岩石圈的厚度与强度。此外，模拟表明拉张作用驱动了地壳非冰物质（如盐分）从内部海洋向表面的运移。最终的表面成分和空间分布反映了冰壳初始的垂直剖……

t: Numerical simulations and parametric analysis of lateral tectonic extension and lithospheric deformation in an icy planetary shell.
对冰卫星外壳侧向构造拉张与岩石圈变形进行数值模拟和参数化分析。
Synthetic models of Europa's ice shell under varying extensional strain rates, lithospheric thicknesses, and strengths.
在不同拉张应变速率、岩石圈厚度和强度下木卫二冰壳的合成数值模型。
Dilational bands form at high strain rates, with morphology controlled by lithosphere properties, driving upward transport of non-ice materials.
高应变率下形成扩张带，其形态受岩石圈性质控制，并驱动非冰物质向上运移。
Simplified representation of ice shell vertical profiles and transport dynamics of non-ice materials.
对冰壳初始垂直剖面及非冰物质运移动力学的简化表示。
Coupling tectonic extension modeling with the transport and spatial distribution of subsurface non-ice materials to the surface.
将构造拉张模拟与地下非冰物质向表面的运移及空间分布特征相结合。

kc: Identified that high extensional strain rates are required for the formation of dilational bands on Europa.
Determined that lithospheric thickness and strength govern the specific morphological types of dilational bands.
Modeled the transport mechanism of crustal non-ice materials (CNIM) from the subsurface ocean to the surface during extension.
确定了高拉张应变速率是木卫二上形成扩张带的必要条件。
阐明了岩石圈的厚度和强度决定了扩张带的具体形态类型。
模拟了拉张过程中地壳非冰物质（如盐分）从地下海洋向表面的运移机制。
me: Numerical geodynamical modeling of lithospheric extension and deformation.
Parametric analysis of strain rates, lithospheric thickness, and material strength.

sum: This study investigates the complex stress state within the Copiapó double seismic zone in north-central Chile, a region characterized by seismic swarms and slow-slip events. Using a high-resolution seismic catalog and focal mechanisms for earthquakes (M 2.0-4.6), the researchers performed stress inversions to determine principal stress directions. The results show distinct depth-dependent stress variations: compressional stress near the interplate boundary, extensional regimes in the upper lithospheric mantle, and a novel subhorizontal compressive stress between 80-100 km depth, potentially linked to the subduction of the Copiapó ridge or slab geometry changes. Below 100 km, slab-pull re-establishes an extensional regime. These findings enhance understanding of intraslab seismicity, subducting bathymetric features, and subduction dynamics, identifying potential nucleation zones for future large earthquakes.

sum: Recent studies inferred 1–2 km of global-equivalent liquid water in Mars' mid-crust (11.5–20 km depth) using a single rock-physics model and averaged seismic parameters. This paper conducts a comprehensive Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) inversion spanning eight rock-physics configurations (Berryman's Self-Consistent Model, Hashin–Shtrikman, Differential Effective Medium, Kuster–Toksöz, and Voigt–Reuss–Hill, paired with Voigt or Hill fluid mixing) and three InSight-derived seismic velocity sets. Propagating full joint posterior distributions of porosity and saturation reveals that inferred water thickness varies from ~0 to ~3.2 km depending on theoretical and seismic choices. Furthermore, substituting marginal modes into the thickness product biases estimates high due to hyperbolic area distortion in the porosity–saturation plane. The most parsimonious model–data combination (Hashin–Shtrikman with Hill mixing at Vp = 4.7 km/s) yields a median thickness of ~0.35 km, demonstrating that current observations do not uniquely require abundant mid-crustal liquid water.

Inferred water thickness spans ~0 to ~3.2 km across 24 combinations. Most posterior modes lie near zero; the most parsimonious model (HS + Hill at Vp = 4.7 km/s) gives 0.35 km median thickness and P_wet = 0.16.

Models assume seismic-scale isotropic homogeneity, constraints rely on a single InSight landing site, and results depend on the assumed basalt-consistent prior bounds.

Reveals that mid-crustal Martian water inference is highly non-unique across rock-physics theories and exposes a hyperbolic area bias when using marginal modes instead of full joint posteriors.
