kc: Expanded Bayesian rock-physics inversion of Mars' mid-crust to 24 combinations across 8 rock-physics configurations and 3 InSight seismic velocity sets.

Demonstrated that full joint posterior propagation of porosity and water saturation yields modes near zero for most models, whereas multiplying marginal modes artificially inflates water thickness due to hyperbolic area geometry.

Showed that inferred water thickness is governed by the Vp/Vs ratio and unconstrained crack aspect ratios rather than Vp alone, with largest cross-theory disagreement (CoV = 65%) at intermediate Vp = 4.1 km/s.

Identified the most parsimonious combination—Hashin–Shtrikman bounds with Hill mixing and the 17-marsquake velocity model (Vp = 4.7, Vs = 2.7 km/s)—which places 67% of posterior probability below 0.5 km water thickness (median 0.35 km).

Performed binary (fully wet vs. fully dry) Bayesian evidence analyses, confirming that P_wet = 0.16 for the most parsimonious case and that wet/dry probabilities alone cannot establish a thick water layer.

证明完整传播孔隙度与水饱和度联合后验分布时大多数模型众数接近零，而将边缘众数直接相乘会因双曲线面积几何效应人为高估水层厚度。

sum: This study investigates the formation mechanism and motion dynamics of the Hongtupo landslide in Wudu District, China, triggered by the 1879 Ms 8.0 Wudu earthquake. Combining field surveys with a 2D Particle Flow Code (PFC2D) discrete element model calibrated via numerical biaxial tests and driven by 2008 Wenchuan earthquake ground motions, the authors reconstruct the complete failure process. Results show a 120 s duration, a maximum particle velocity of 25 m/s at the upper surface, a maximum horizontal runout of 561 m, and a peak kinetic energy of 5.34 × 10^8 J. Topographic amplification causes crest velocity to triple that at the toe. The landslide exhibits a four-stage push-type mechanism (initiation, acceleration, deceleration, stabilization) dominated by collisional and frictional energy dissipation, ultimately blocking the Beiyu River. The novelty lies in coupling micro-parameter calibration with dynamic energy-evolution tracking for this historical coseismic landslide.

Field geological surveys, UAV imagery, and a 32,125-particle 2D slope model (1025 m × 465 m) driven by filtered EW and UD ground-motion records from the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake (Wolong station).

The simulated landslide lasted 120 s, reaching a peak velocity of 25 m/s, maximum horizontal displacement of 561 m, peak kinetic energy of 5.34 × 10^8 J, and a 3x crest-to-toe seismic velocity amplification.

The parallel bond model oversimplifies irregular grain cementation as a uniform disc, and its micro-parameters cannot be directly measured in laboratory tests, requiring empirical back-calculation.

li: The parallel bond model idealizes interparticle cementation as a uniform disc, ignoring irregular geometry, micro-cracks, and voids under complex stress paths.
Micro-parameters such as normal and shear stiffness cannot be directly measured in laboratory tests and rely on back-calculation from regional empirical data.
Actual ground-motion records from the 1879 Wudu earthquake are unavailable, requiring substitute records from the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake.
平行粘结模型将颗粒间胶结理想化为圆盘，未能反映真实胶结的不规则几何形态及微裂隙。
法向与切向刚度等细观参数无法通过室内试验直接测定，需依赖宏观响应反演标定。
缺乏1879年武都地震的实测强震记录，只能采用2008年汶川地震记录作为近似替代。

tm.why: The paper investigates the dynamic movement and seismic triggering of the Hongtupo landslide using discrete element modeling.
The study analyzes topographic seismic wave amplification and applies strong ground motion records from the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake to simulate coseismic landslide hazards.

ev.notes: Full 23-page manuscript PDF (Scientific Reports Article in Press) including all text, 13 figures, and 1 table used as primary evidence.

sum: Characterizing active crustal faults in the northern Cascadia forearc is challenging due to dense vegetation and glacial scouring. This study investigates the 80-km-long San Juan fault (SJF) on southern Vancouver Island using airborne and drone lidar, Monte Carlo scarp slip analysis, Schmidt hammer rock hardness testing, and electrical resistivity tomography (ERT). The authors map over 80 discrete scarps, including 2–150 m high north-facing bedrock scarps and subtle uphill-facing scarps in colluvium, alongside right-laterally deflected channels. Schmidt hammer measurements novelly demonstrate that rocks on the lowered northern side are significantly harder (mean R-value 54) than on the uplifted southern side (mean R-value 36), ruling out differential glacial erosion and confirming tectonic south-side-up motion. ERT profiles across an uphill-facing scarp reveal a ~1.4 m subsurface offset in colluvium. These findings indicate Quaternary dextral-reverse reactivation capable of Mw ~7.2 earthquakes, motivating paleoseismic trenching.
受植被覆盖和冰川侵蚀影响，卡斯卡迪亚前弧活动地壳断层的识别极具挑战。本文综合机载与无人机激光雷达（Lidar）、蒙特卡洛断层陡坎滑动分析、施密特回弹仪岩石硬度测试及高密度电阻率层析成像（ERT），研究了温哥华岛南部80公里长的圣胡安断层（SJF）。研究测绘了80余处断层陡坎（高2-150米）及右旋偏……

t: The authors combined 0.5–1 m lidar geomorphic mapping, Monte Carlo scarp slip estimation, in-situ Schmidt hammer rock hardness testing, and 2D dipole-dipole electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) to evaluate fault activity.
结合0.5-1米激光雷达地貌测绘、蒙特卡洛陡坎滑动估算、施密特回弹仪测试及二维电阻率层析成像。

Data comprise >1,000 km2 of airborne lidar, four drone lidar surveys, 405 Schmidt hammer measurements at 81 bedrock sites across five geologic units, and two co-located ERT profiles (120 m and 40.5 m long).
逾1000平方公里机载与4处无人机激光雷达、81个露头405次回弹测量及两条重合ERT剖面。

Rocks north of the fault are harder (mean R=54) than uplifted southern rocks (mean R=36), refuting glacial erosion. Scarp profiles show ~30–36 m cumulative dip-slip, while ERT reveals a ~1.4 m subsurface offset.
北盘岩石（R=54）比南盘（R=36）更硬，排除冰川侵蚀；累积倾滑约30-36米，浅表错断约1.4米。
No laterally extensive post-glacial landforms or piercing points cross the fault to constrain Holocene slip rates, and glacial scouring plus high precipitation obscure sharp lateral offsets.
缺乏冰期后穿刺点以约束全新世滑动速率，冰川冲刷与强降水掩盖了清晰的水平位错。
First application of Schmidt hammer rock strength testing in Cascadia to rule out differential glacial scouring across a cryptic forearc fault scarp, combined with drone lidar and ERT.
首次在卡斯卡迪亚应用施密特回弹仪测试排除冰川差异侵蚀，结合无人机激光雷达与ERT识别隐伏断层。

kc: Mapped >80 discrete fault scarps and lineaments along the 80-km San Juan fault using 1 m airborne and 0.5 m drone lidar DTMs.
Applied Schmidt hammer rock hardness testing across the fault, ruling out differential glacial erosion by showing harder rocks occupy the lowered northern side (mean R=54 vs R=36).
Imaged a ~1.4 m vertical offset in shallow colluvium and weathered bedrock beneath an uphill-facing scarp using electrical resistivity tomography (ERT).
Proposed Quaternary dextral-reverse reactivation of the Eocene sinistral San Juan fault, capable of hosting Mw ~7.2 earthquakes.
利用1米分辨率机载和0.5米分辨率无人机激光雷达数字地形模型，沿80公里长的圣胡安断层测绘了80余处断层陡坎和线性构造。
跨断层开展施密特回弹仪岩石硬度测试，证实下降北盘岩石比抬升南盘更坚硬（平均R值54对比36），排除了冰川差异侵蚀假说。
利用电阻率层析成像（ERT）在逆坡向陡坎下方成像了浅表坡积物与风化基岩中约1.4米的垂直位错。
提出始新世左旋圣胡安断层在第四纪发生右旋逆冲复活，可引发约Mw 7.2级地震。
me: Geomorphic mapping and scarp profiling using airborne (1 m resolution) and drone (0.5 m resolution) lidar digital terrain models.
Monte Carlo dip-slip estimation along fault-perpendicular topographic profiles using the Monte Carlo Slip Statistics Toolkit (MCSST).
In-situ rock compressive strength testing via N-type Schmidt hammer rebound measurements across different lithologies.
2D dipole-dipole electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) inversions across an uphill-facing scarp.
基于机载（1米分辨率）与无人机（0.5米分辨率）激光雷达数字地形模型的构造地貌测绘与陡坎剖面分析。
使用蒙特卡洛滑动统计工具包（MCSST）对垂直断层地形剖面进行倾滑量及不确定性估算。
利用N型施密特回弹仪对断层两侧不同岩性露头进行原位抗压强度（回弹值R）测量。
跨逆坡向陡坎开展二维偶极-偶极装置高密度电阻率层析成像（ERT）及阻尼最小二乘反演。
de: Over 1,000 km2 of collated airborne lidar (~5 pts/m2) and four targeted drone lidar surveys (~15 pts/m2) along the San Juan fault.
405 individual Schmidt hammer rebound measurements collected across 81 bedrock outcrop sites spanning five geological units.
Two co-located ERT profiles (3 m electrode spacing over 120 m length, and 1.5 m spacing over 40.5 m length) plus a 0.5 m test pit at the UPSCARP site.
沿圣胡安断层收集的超过1,000平方公里机载激光雷达数据（约5点/平方米）及4个重点区域的无人机激光雷达测绘数据（约15点/平方米）。
在5个地质单元共81个基岩露头点采集的405次施密特回弹仪硬度测量数据。
在UPSCARP站点布设的两条重合ERT测线（3米极距120米长、1.5米极距40.5米长）及一个0.5米深的探槽。
li: Lack of laterally extensive post-glacial depositional landforms or dateable piercing points prevents quantifying a precise Holocene slip rate.
Dense vegetation, high precipitation, and Quaternary glacial scouring obscure unequivocal surface rupture indicators and sharp channel offsets.
缺乏横向连续的冰期后沉积地貌或可定年的穿刺点，无法精确量化全新世断层滑动速率。
茂密植被、高降水量及第四纪冰川冲刷掩盖了确凿的地表破裂标志与清晰的河道错动。

tm.why: The paper investigates neotectonic fault reactivation, kinematics, and forearc deformation of the San Juan fault in the northern Cascadia subduction zone.
The study assesses late Quaternary surface rupture potential along an 80-km crustal fault capable of Mw ~7.2 earthquakes near populous regions on southern Vancouver Island.
It characterizes fault scarp morphology, rock hardness contrasts across the fault zone, and dextral-reverse slip inversion of an ancient sinistral structure.

ev.notes: Full text, tables, and all 9 figures from the 19-page Seismica article PDF were analyzed.

sum: This study presents an integrated reservoir characterization workflow for the Upper Ordovician Mamuniyat Formation in the I/R oil fields, Murzuq Basin, Libya. By combining multi-well petrophysical analysis from eleven wells with 3D seismic interpretation, seismic attribute analysis (variance, RMS amplitude, energy), and spectral decomposition, the authors map the structural framework and reservoir quality. The analysis reveals a NW-SE-trending fault system controlling reservoir compartmentalization and delineates sand-prone fairways. Integrating these seismic indicators with petrophysical properties into a 3D static reservoir model identifies high-quality reservoir zones in the central, northwestern, and southwestern areas. Additionally, two new prospective zones are identified on the upthrown side of the main fault, validated by blind well testing. This integrated approach reduces spatial uncertainty in structurally complex glacial clastic reservoirs.
本研究结合11口井测井、3D地震属性与谱分解，对利比亚储层进行综合表征。研究揭示了控制储层分隔的NW-SE向断裂系统，圈定了优质砂体。通过构建3D静态储层模型，确定了高质量储层区，并在主断层上升盘预测了两个新有利区，盲井验证效果良好，有效降低了复杂储层预测的不确定性。

t: Integrated workflow combining multi-well petrophysical analysis, 3D seismic interpretation, seismic attributes (variance, RMS amplitude, energy), spectral decomposition, and 3D static reservoir modeling.
整合多井测井、3D地震属性及谱分解的3D静态储层建模方法。
Petrophysical data from eleven wells and 3D seismic reflection data covering the I/R oil fields in the Murzuq Basin, Libya.
利比亚Murzuq盆地I/R油田的11口井测井数据及3D地震反射数据集。
Delineated a NW-SE-trending fault system and sand-prone fairways, identified high-quality reservoir zones, and successfully predicted two new prospective zones on the upthrown side of the main fault.
揭示了NW-SE向断裂系统，确定了优质储层区，并在主断层上升盘预测了两个新有利区。
The resolution of seismic attributes and spectral decomposition may still face challenges in extremely thin reservoir intervals below seismic tuning thickness.
地震属性和谱分解的分辨率在低于地震调谐厚度的极薄储层段可能受限。

First integration of multi-well petrophysics, 3D seismic attributes, and static modeling to quantitatively characterize glacial clastic reservoir heterogeneity and identify new prospects in this field.
首次综合多井物性、3D地震属性与静态建模，定量表征该区冰川碎屑岩储层非均质性。

kc: Developed an integrated workflow combining petrophysics, 3D seismic attributes, and static reservoir modeling.
Mapped a dominant NW-SE-trending fault system controlling reservoir compartmentalization.
Identified two new prospective zones on the upthrown side of the main fault, validated by blind wells.
开发了结合测井物性、3D地震属性和静态储层建模的综合工作流。
绘制了控制储层分隔的NW-SE向主断裂系统。
在主断层上升盘预测了两个新的有利勘探区，并得到了盲井验证。
me: Multi-well petrophysical analysis (shale volume, porosity, water saturation).
3D seismic interpretation and attribute analysis (variance, RMS amplitude, energy).
Spectral decomposition for imaging channelized depositional elements.
3D static reservoir modeling.
多井测井物性分析（泥质含量、孔隙度、饱和度）。
3D地震解释及属性分析（方差、均方根振幅、能量）。
用于刻画河道沉积单元的谱分解技术。
3D静态储层建模。
de: Petrophysical log data from eleven wells in the I/R oil fields, Murzuq Basin.
3D seismic reflection data covering the study area.
利比亚Murzuq盆地I/R油田11口井的测井物性数据。
覆盖研究区的3D地震反射数据。
li: Potential resolution limits of seismic attributes in detecting thin-bedded reservoirs below tuning thickness.
Dependence on the quality and calibration of well-to-seismic ties.
地震属性在检测低于调谐厚度的薄层储层时可能存在分辨率限制。
依赖于井-震标定的质量和准确性。

tm.why: The paper focuses on reservoir characterization and structural fault mapping of the Mamuniyat Formation in the Murzuq Basin using 3D seismic data.

ev.notes: No PDF was available, so the analysis is based on the abstract and metadata.

sum: This study uses 3D numerical thermomechanical modeling with visco-elasto-plastic rheology to investigate rifting dynamics on Venus. By comparing active and inactive rift morphologies, the authors show that wide rift flank uplifts in Ganis, Dali, and Devana Chasmata indicate ongoing or very recent (within tens of millions of years) tectonic activity. The observed topography matches modeled early-stage active rifts with high extension rates of 3–10 cm/yr, suggesting faster extension than previously assumed, likely driven by recent mantle plume activity.
本研究采用3D数值热力学模拟，系统研究了金星裂谷动力学。通过对比活跃与非活跃裂谷地貌，发现Ganis、Dali和Devana裂谷带宽阔的侧翼隆起表明金星目前仍存在活跃的裂谷作用，或活跃于过去几千万年内。模拟结果表明其拉张速率达3-10厘米/年，比此前预估更快，可能与近期活跃的地幔柱活动有关。

t: 3D numerical thermomechanical modeling with visco-elasto-plastic compressible rock rheology to simulate Venusian rifting dynamics.
采用粘-弹性-塑性可压缩岩石流变学的3D数值热力学模拟方法。
Topographic profiles of Ganis, Dali, and Devana Chasmata on Venus compared against synthetic profiles from 3D geodynamic simulations.
金星Ganis、Dali和Devana裂谷的地形剖面数据及数值模拟合成数据。
Wide rift flank uplifts match modeled active rifts with high extension rates of 3-10 cm/yr, indicating ongoing or very recent rifting.
宽阔的裂谷侧翼隆起与3-10厘米/年高拉张速率的模拟结果吻合，表明近期活跃。
Relies on indirect topographic comparisons and assumed rheologies without direct in-situ geodetic or seismic measurements.
依赖于间接的地形对比和假设的流变学参数，缺乏原位大地测量或地震观测。
First to link wide rift flank uplifts to active/recent rifting and quantify high extension rates on Venus using 3D thermomechanical models.
首次利用3D热力学模拟将宽侧翼隆起与活跃裂谷联系起来并估算拉张速率。

kc: Demonstrated that wide rift flank uplifts on Venus indicate active or very recently active rifting (within tens of millions of years).
Estimated relatively high extension rates of 3-10 cm/yr for Venusian rifts, faster than previously assumed.
Inferred a thick thermal lithosphere and strong crust with dry diabase or mafic granulite rheology in Venusian rift zones.
证明了金星上宽阔的裂谷侧翼隆起指示了活跃或近期活跃（数千万年内）的裂谷作用。
估算出金星裂谷具有3-10厘米/年的高拉张速率，比此前预想的更快。
推断出金星裂谷区存在较厚的温标岩石圈以及由干辉绿岩或铁镁质麻粒岩组成的坚硬地壳。
me: 3D numerical thermomechanical modeling of lithospheric extension.
Visco-elasto-plastic compressible rock rheology tailored to Venusian conditions.
Topographic relaxation modeling after extension ceases to compare active vs. inactive rifts.
岩石圈拉张的3D数值热力学模拟。
针对金星条件定制的粘-弹性-塑性可压缩岩石流变学模型。
拉张停止后的地形松弛模拟，用于对比活跃与非活跃裂谷。
de: Synthetic topographic profiles generated from 3D geodynamic simulations.
Topographic observations from Venusian rift zones (Ganis, Dali, and Devana Chasmata).
由3D地球动力学模拟生成的合成地形剖面。
金星裂谷带（Ganis、Dali和Devana裂谷）的地形观测数据。
li: Relies on indirect topographic comparisons and assumed rheologies without direct in-situ geodetic or seismic measurements.
Simplifications in the 3D rheological models and assumed dry compositions.
依赖于间接的地形对比和假设的流变学参数，缺乏原位大地测量或地震观测。
3D流变学模型及假设的干燥成分存在一定简化。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D numerical thermomechanical modeling to investigate lithospheric rifting dynamics and crustal rheology on Venus.
The study focuses on planetary geodynamics and active tectonic processes (rifting and mantle plumes) on Venus.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the abstract and public press releases from ETH Zurich.

sum: This study performs a high-resolution seismicity analysis of the mid-crustal earthquake swarm that preceded the 2017 eruption of Mount Agung, Indonesia. By relocating the seismicity, the authors identify two distinct spatial clusters within the mid-crustal dike-related swarm. These findings provide critical insights into the magmatic plumbing system and the pre-eruptive migration of magma/fluids beneath Mount Agung, highlighting the role of dike intrusion in triggering volcanic unrest.
本研究对印度尼西亚阿贡火山2017年喷发前的中地壳地震群进行了高分辨率地震活动性分析。通过对地震进行高精度重定位，作者在与岩脉相关的中地壳震群中识别出两个截然不同的空间地震簇。这些发现为阿贡火山下方的岩浆管道系统及喷发前岩浆/流体的运移提供了关键见解，突出了岩脉侵入在引发火山活动中的作用。

t: High-resolution earthquake relocation and clustering analysis of the pre-eruptive seismic swarm.
对喷发前地震群进行高分辨率地震重定位和聚类分析。
Local seismic catalog and waveform data capturing the 2017 Mount Agung pre-eruptive swarm.
捕获2017年阿贡火山喷发前震群的地方地震目录和波形数据。
Discovery of two distinct mid-crustal earthquake clusters associated with dike-related magma intrusion.
发现与岩脉相关岩浆侵入有关的两个截然不同的中地壳地震簇。
Potential dependency on 1D velocity models and station coverage for absolute location accuracy.
绝对定位精度可能依赖于一维速度模型和台站覆盖范围。
Delineation of fine-scale dual-cluster structures within the mid-crustal swarm, refining the 2017 Agung pre-eruptive model.
描绘了中地壳震群中细微的双簇结构，完善了2017年阿贡火山喷发前模型。

kc: Identified two distinct mid-crustal earthquake clusters within the pre-eruptive swarm of the 2017 Mount Agung eruption.
Provided high-resolution spatial constraints on the dike-related magmatic intrusion pathway.
识别出2017年阿贡火山喷发前震群中两个截然不同的中地壳地震簇。
为与岩脉相关的岩浆侵入通道提供了高空间分辨率的约束。
me: High-resolution earthquake relocation (e.g., double-difference relocation).
Seismicity cluster analysis to characterize the spatial-temporal evolution of the swarm.
高分辨率地震重定位（如双差定位）。
地震簇分析，以表征震群的时空演化特征。
de: Local seismic network waveform and travel-time data recorded prior to the 2017 Mount Agung eruption.
2017年阿贡火山喷发前记录的地方地震台网波形和走时数据。
li: Potential dependency on the 1D velocity model and station distribution for absolute depth constraints.
绝对深度约束可能依赖于一维速度模型和台站分布。

tm.why: The paper analyzes a pre-eruptive seismic swarm and dike-related intrusion at Mount Agung volcano.
It performs high-resolution seismicity and clustering analysis on a volcanic earthquake swarm.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title and metadata from Crossref.

sum: Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) is ill-posed and often suffers from artifacts and limited resolution. Incorporating deep generative priors directly into FWI requires expensive repeated wavefield simulations. This study proposes a post-FWI refinement strategy using an unconditional/class-conditional Flow Matching (FM) generative model that decouples regularization from data fitting. After training a U-Net on geological prior datasets (Otway and CGG styles), the deterministic FM generation trajectory is guided by optimizing latent variables against observational constraints. A Gaussian smoothing operator constrains large-scale structures from the precomputed FWI velocity model, while a binary masking operator and high-pass frequency filter inject localized high-resolution well-log observations. Backpropagating masked well-log gradients through the U-Net automatically spreads local updates into globally coherent layers. Validated on the synthetic Otway and field CGG and Viking datasets, the method suppresses artifacts, recovers faults, enhances layer continuity, and resolves anisotropy-induced misties without re-running FWI.
针对全波形反演（FWI）的多解性及迭代引入生成先验计算昂贵的问题，本文提出一种基于流匹配（FM）生成模型的后FWI精炼方法。该方法受近端算子启发将正则化与数据拟合解耦，利用预先训练好的U-Net学习地质先验分布。在确定性生成过程中，通过高斯平滑算子引入FWI大尺度背景速度约束，并结合掩码算子与高通滤……

t: The method refines converged FWI velocity models using a pre-trained Flow Matching U-Net by optimizing latent variables along the deterministic ODE generation trajectory under smoothed FWI and masked, high-pass filtered well-log guidance constraints.
利用预训练流匹配U-Net，在平滑FWI和掩码高通滤波测井约束下沿ODE轨迹优化隐变量以精炼FWI模型。

The Flow Matching model is trained on 5,000 samples each of Otway and CGG geological priors (320x304) and evaluated on the synthetic Otway dataset and the field CGG and Viking seismic datasets with well logs.
在Otway和CGG先验集（各5000样本，320×304）上训练，并在Otway合成数据及CGG、Viking实际数据…

Post-FWI prior injection suppresses inversion artifacts, recovers faults, and integrates high-wavenumber well-log structures across synthetic and full-resolution (608x608) field models within 50 to 70 reverse ODE steps without patch-wise stitching.
仅需50至70步逆向生成即可在合成与全尺寸（608×608）实际模型中压制伪影、恢复断层并融合测井高频构造。
Incorporating well-log constraints can trade off against fault sharpness, and applying mismatched geological priors (like faulted Otway priors on continuous layers) introduces artificial faults.
引入测井约束可能折损断层清晰度，且先验类别与实际地质不匹配时会引入虚假断层。

Unlike plug-and-play or diffusion-regularized FWI requiring repeated wavefield simulations, this work decouples prior injection as a fast post-FWI Flow Matching latent optimization with frequency-decomposed sparse well masking.
无需重复波场模拟，将先验注入解耦为后FWI流匹配隐变量优化，并提出频率分解稀疏测井掩码引导。

kc: Proposes a post-FWI prior injection framework using Flow Matching (FM) generative models without requiring additional FWI forward/adjoint iterations.

Introduces a unified latent variable optimization strategy combining smoothed FWI guidance for large-scale structure preservation and masked well-log guidance for localized high-resolution refinement.
Designs a frequency-decomposed joint loss function that injects only high-wavenumber well-log components while retaining low-wavenumber FWI trends, mitigating anisotropy mismatches.
Demonstrates that backpropagating sparse masked well-log gradients through the U-Net prior automatically produces globally coherent structural updates without manual spatial extrapolation.
提出基于流匹配（FM）生成模型的后FWI先验注入框架，无需额外的FWI正演和伴随迭代。
引入统一的隐变量优化策略，结合平滑FWI引导保留大尺度结构，并通过掩码测井引导实现局部高分辨率精炼。
设计频率分解联合损失函数，仅注入测井高频分量并保留FWI低频趋势，有效缓解各向异性导致的速度不匹配。
证明将稀疏掩码测井梯度通过U-Net先验反向传播可自动生成全局相干的构造更新，无需人工空间外推。
me: Proximal splitting concept decoupling data fitting from generative prior regularization as a single post-processing step.
Class-conditional Flow Matching (FM) using a U-Net architecture trained via ODE velocity field matching on 2D velocity models.
Guided deterministic generation via gradient-descent optimization of latent variables along the ODE trajectory.
Gaussian smoothing forward operator for FWI guidance and binary spatial masking with high-pass filtering for sparse well-log guidance.
基于近端分裂思想，将数据拟合与生成先验正则化解耦为独立的后处理步骤。
采用U-Net架构的类别条件流匹配（FM）模型，通过ODE速度场匹配在二维速度模型上进行训练。
沿ODE轨迹对隐变量进行梯度下降优化，实现受控的确定性样本生成。
利用高斯平滑正演算子进行FWI引导，结合二值空间掩码与高通滤波进行稀疏测井引导。
de: Training datasets: 5,000 synthetic velocity samples each for Otway priors (thin stratified layers with faults) and CGG priors (thicker continuous layers) at 320 x 304 resolution.
Otway synthetic dataset test (304 x 320 grid) evaluating fault recovery and well-log velocity profile matching.
CGG field dataset test (608 x 608 full-resolution inference without patching, 5.6 to 17.0 km lateral, 0.375 to 3.975 km depth) with a well log at 10.5 km.
Viking field dataset test (3 km maximum offset, shallow illumination) guided by two interpolated well logs.
训练数据集：Otway先验（含断层薄互层）与CGG先验（较厚连续地层）各5000个合成速度样本，分辨率为320×304。
Otway合成数据测试（304×320网格），评估断层恢复效果与测井速度剖面匹配精度。
CGG实际地震资料测试（608×608全分辨率直接推理，横向5.6–17.0 km，深度0.375–3.975 km），结合10.5 km处测井约束。
Viking实际地震资料测试（最大偏移距3 km，深部照明不足），结合两口插值测井数据进行引导。
li: Jointly enforcing FWI and well-log constraints in the synthetic Otway test slightly degrades fault sharpness compared to FWI-only guidance.
Generated structural styles depend heavily on the user-selected training prior class (e.g., Otway prior hallucinates faults in continuous Viking layers).
Post-FWI refinement does not explicitly enforce seismic waveform data-fitting constraints during generation.
在Otway合成测试中，同时施加FWI和测井约束相比仅用FWI引导会略微降低断层清晰度。
生成构造样式高度依赖所选训练先验类别（如在连续地层的Viking数据中使用Otway先验会产生虚假断层）。
后FWI精炼过程在生成阶段未显式施加地震波形数据拟合约束。

tm.why: The paper develops a post-processing refinement framework specifically designed to enhance velocity models obtained from Full Waveform Inversion (FWI).
The core method relies on a Flow Matching (FM) deep generative model based on a U-Net architecture to store and inject learned geological priors.
The formulation is grounded in proximal splitting theory, decoupling the data-fitting term from the regularization term in ill-posed inverse problems.

ev.notes: Full 18-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including equations, Algorithm 1, and all 12 figures across synthetic (Otway) and field (CGG, Viking) datasets.

sum: This study (and its associated Zenodo repository containing MATLAB codes and data) investigates the mechanics of supraglacial lake hydro-fracture. It explores how stress triggering operates across different timescales—viscous, viscoelastic, and elastic. By modeling these processes, the authors shed light on the pre-conditioning and triggering of rapid lake drainage events, which are crucial for understanding ice-sheet dynamics and subglacial hydrology in Greenland and other glaciated regions.
本研究（及相关的Zenodo代码与数据开源库）探讨了冰川表层湖泊水力破裂的力学机制。文章分析了应力触发在粘性、粘弹性及弹性时间尺度下的演化规律。通过对这些物理过程进行建模，作者揭示了快速湖泊排水事件的前期准备与触发机制，这对于理解格陵兰及其他冰川地区的冰盖动力学和冰下水文学至关重要。

t: Numerical and analytical modeling of stress evolution across viscous, viscoelastic, and elastic timescales in ice sheets.
对冰盖中粘性、粘弹性及弹性时间尺度下的应力演化进行数值与解析建模。
MATLAB codes and synthetic datasets representing ice deformation and stress states during lake drainage.
代表冰湖排水过程中冰体变形和应力状态的MATLAB代码及合成数据集。
Characterization of how stress pre-conditioning and triggering of hydro-fracture vary across different physical timescales.
阐明了应力前期准备和水力破裂触发在不同物理时间尺度下的变化特征。
Potential simplification of ice-sheet geometry and homogeneous viscoelastic rheology assumptions.
可能简化了冰盖几何形状，并采用了均匀粘弹性流变学假设。
A unified framework analyzing supraglacial lake hydro-fracture across viscous, viscoelastic, and elastic timescales.
提出了一个统一分析粘性、粘弹性和弹性时间尺度下冰湖水力破裂的框架。

Integrates viscous, viscoelastic, and elastic timescales to explain ice deformation and fracturing.
Releases open-source MATLAB codes and datasets to reproduce the study's findings.

整合了粘性、粘弹性和弹性时间尺度来解释冰体变形与破裂过程。
开源了用于重现研究结果的MATLAB代码和相关数据集。

Numerical simulation of hydro-fracture propagation under varying stress states.
冰盖的粘弹性与弹性应力建模。
不同应力状态下水力破裂传播的数值模拟。
de: Synthetic datasets and MATLAB scripts simulating stress evolution and lake drainage triggering.
模拟应力演化和冰湖排水触发过程的合成数据集与MATLAB脚本。

模型可能依赖于简化的冰川几何形状和均匀的介质物性假设。

tm.why: The paper models the stress triggering of supraglacial lake hydro-fracture, which is a key process in cryosphere geophysics and glaciology.

sum: This study investigates global seasonal variations in primary (PM, 14–20 s) and secondary (SM, 4–10 s) microseisms using over 20 years of vertical-component acceleration data from 73 global stations. By fitting four-term Fourier series to seasonally smoothed time series, the authors quantify annual amplitude variations and reveal a distinct hemispheric asymmetry. High-latitude Northern Hemisphere (NH) stations exhibit highly correlated PM and SM variations, driven by intense seasonal storms and coastal wave reflections. Conversely, Southern Hemisphere (SH) stations show widespread PM–SM decorrelation due to different ocean wave states and storm patterns. Additionally, anomalous PM–SM correlations are observed in Antarctica (influenced by sea ice) and East Asia (influenced by monsoons and typhoons). This work highlights how global microseism characteristics reflect large-scale atmospheric-oceanic coupling and hemispheric environmental differences.
本研究利用全球和GEOSCOPE网络的73个台站超过20年的垂直分量加速度数据，分析了初级（PM，14-20秒）和次级（SM，4-10秒）微震的全球季节性变化。通过对季节平滑时间序列进行四项傅里叶级数拟合，研究揭示了显著的南北半球不对称性。北半球高纬度台站的PM和SM振幅变化高度相关，反映了强烈的季……

t: Four-term Fourier series fitting of seasonally smoothed vertical-component acceleration time series to model annual harmonic variations of primary and secondary microseisms.
对季节平滑的垂直分量加速度时间序列进行四项傅里叶级数拟合，以模拟初级和次级微震的年谐波变化。
Over 20 years of vertical-component seismic data with >=75% completeness from 73 stations in the Global Seismographic and GEOSCOPE networks.
来自全球地震台网和GEOSCOPE台网73个台站的、完整率不低于75%的20年以上垂直分量地震数据。
Annual periodic functions fit 14%-95% (PM) and 22%-97% (SM) of variance, revealing high PM-SM correlation in the Northern Hemisphere and widespread decorrelation in the Southern Hemisphere.
年周期函数拟合解释了14%-95%（PM）和22%-97%（SM）的信号方差，揭示了北半球高PM-SM相关性与南半球广泛…
The study relies on a sparse global network of 73 land-based stations and vertical-component data, limiting spatial resolution in oceans.
该研究依赖于由73个陆地台站组成的稀疏全球网络和垂直分量数据，限制了海洋区域的空间分辨率。
First long-term (20+ years) global characterization of PM and SM seasonal variations revealing a systematic hemispheric asymmetry in microseism coupling and correlation.
首次利用20年以上长期全球数据刻画PM和SM季节性变化，揭示了微震耦合和相关性中系统的半球不对称性。

kc: Quantified global seasonal variations of primary and secondary microseisms using over 20 years of high-quality seismic data.
Discovered a distinct hemispheric asymmetry in PM-SM correlation, with high correlation in the Northern Hemisphere and widespread decorrelation in the Southern Hemisphere.
Identified regional microseism anomalies in Antarctica (sea ice modulation) and East Asia (monsoon and tropical cyclone influences).
利用20多年的高质量地震数据，量化了初级和次级微震的全球季节性变化。
发现了PM-SM相关性中显著的半球不对称性，北半球呈高相关性，而南半球呈广泛的去相关性。
识别了南极洲（受海冰调制）和东亚（受季风和热带气旋影响）的区域性微震异常。
me: Four-term Fourier series fitting to vertical-component seasonally smoothed acceleration time series.
Correlation analysis between primary (14–20 s) and secondary (4–10 s) microseism annual amplitude variations.
对垂直分量季节平滑加速度时间序列进行四项傅里叶级数拟合。
分析初级（14-20秒）和次级（4-10秒）微震年振幅变化之间的相关性。

Over 20 years of continuous recording with at least 75% data completeness.
来自全球地震台网（GSN）和GEOSCOPE台网的73个台站的垂直分量地震数据。
超过20年的连续记录，且数据完整率至少为75%。

The spatial distribution of stations is constrained by the sparse global network, particularly in oceanic regions.
分析仅限于垂直分量数据，可能忽略了水平分量的微震特征。

tm.why: The paper analyzes global primary and secondary microseisms, which are the dominant components of Earth's ambient seismic noise wavefield.
The study investigates the coupling between ocean wave energy (environmental processes) and the solid Earth, as well as sea ice influences in Antarctica.

ev.notes: No PDF available; analyzed based on the comprehensive abstract and public metadata.

sum: This study proposes a unified "Impedance-Mismatch and Slow-Wave Diffusion Model" to explain remote earthquake triggering and dense major earthquake sequences across the Circum-Pacific belt. Treating global subduction zones as a fluid-saturated nonlinear elastic waveguide network, the theoretical framework couples four mechanisms: post-mainshock low-impedance fracturing that guides dynamic waves along high-impedance arcs, poroelastic Biot slow P-wave diffusion governing delay times t=L^2/(4D), chemo-mechanical stress corrosion accelerating subcritical crack growth, and rate-and-state friction feedback. Calibrated on 29 historical Mw>=7.5 earthquake cases (1976-2004) and validated on 11 recent cases (2005-2026) plus an 8-event 2026 sequence, the model achieves an 87.5% overall explanation rate, outperforming the empirical Tripartite Spatiotemporal Triggering Hypothesis (68.8%). Novel contributions include inverting regional slow-wave diffusion coefficients (varying from 10^3 to 10^6 m^2/s across subduction zones) and unifying point-to-point triggering, small-event anomalies, and long-tail aftershocks into one partial differential equation system.
本研究将全球俯冲带视为饱水非线性弹性波导网络，提出统一的“阻抗失配与慢波扩散模型”以解释远场地震触发。该模型耦合了四个物理过程：震源区破碎导致的波阻抗失配折射、决定延迟时间的孔隙弹性慢P波扩散、降低断层断裂韧性的应力腐蚀，以及速率-状态摩擦正反馈。利用1976-2026年全球41个Mw≥7.5地震序……

t: Treats subduction zones as fluid-saturated waveguides governed by coupled equations for wave impedance reflection, Biot slow P-wave pore-pressure diffusion t=L^2/(4D), stress-corrosion crack growth, and rate-and-state frictional sliding feedback.
将俯冲带视为饱水波导，联立波阻抗反射、Biot慢波扩散、应力腐蚀与摩擦反馈方程。

Evaluated on 41 global Mw>=7.5 earthquake cases (29 historical calibration events from 1976–2004, 11 validation events from 2005–2026, plus 2004 Sumatra reference) and 8 events from the June–August 2026 sequence.
采用1976–2026年全球41个Mw≥7.5大震案例及2026年6–8月8个强震序列事件进行检验。
Achieves an 87.5% overall explanation rate (42/48 event pairs) versus 68.8% for the empirical TSTH model, and reveals regional slow-wave diffusivity varying from 2.8x10^3 to 1.6x10^6 m^2/s (p<0.001).
总体解释率达87.5%（优于原模型的68.8%），反演揭示区域扩散系数跨越三个数量级。

Relies on a 1-D diffusion approximation ignoring 3-D waveguide heterogeneity, simplified Biot coupling, linear uncertainty propagation, and an incomplete 7-region diffusivity database without direct borehole validation.
采用一维扩散近似忽略三维非均匀性，简化了Biot耦合，且缺乏钻孔直接观测验证。
Replaces empirical triggering time windows with a single physical slow-wave diffusion relation t=L^2/(4D) and couples large-to-large remote triggering with small-event stress-corrosion clustering.
用单一慢波扩散物理关系取代经验时间窗，统一了大震触发与小震应力腐蚀丛集。

kc: Proposes a unified partial-differential-equation system combining impedance mismatch, Biot slow-wave diffusion, stress corrosion, and frictional sliding feedback.
Calibrates regional slow-wave diffusion coefficients (D) across seven subduction zones, revealing a statistically significant three-order-of-magnitude variation (10^3 to 10^6 m^2/s).
Achieves an 87.5% explanation rate across 48 historical and recent earthquake pairs, improving upon the empirical TSTH framework by 18.7 percentage points.
Explains the 2026 Circum-Pacific dense sequence, including southwestern China small-event surges and long-tail aftershocks, while formulating falsifiable future predictions.
提出了结合波阻抗失配、Biot慢波扩散、应力腐蚀和摩擦滑动反馈的统一偏微分方程组模型。
校准了七个俯冲带的区域慢波扩散系数（D），揭示了具有统计显著性的三个数量级差异（10^3至10^6 m^2/s）。
在48个历史与近期地震事件对中实现了87.5%的解释率，比原TSTH经验框架提高了18.7个百分点。
成功解释了2026年环太平洋密集强震序列、中国西南小震频次异常及长尾余震，并给出了可证伪的未来预测。
me: 1-D analytical wave impedance reflection and transmission modeling along plate-boundary waveguides.
Poroelastic slow P-wave diffusion equation modeling with delay time t = L^2 / (4D).
Subcritical crack growth and stress-corrosion modeling coupled with Dieterich rate-and-state friction.
Retroactive parameter inversion and statistical hypothesis testing (two-sample t-test) on global earthquake catalogs.
沿板块边界波导的一维解析波阻抗反射与透射建模。
延迟时间为 t = L^2 / (4D) 的孔隙弹性慢P波扩散方程建模。
亚临界裂纹扩展与应力腐蚀耦合Dieterich速率-状态摩擦定律建模。
基于全球地震目录的回溯性参数反演与统计假设检验（双样本t检验）。
de: Global catalog of 41 Mw>=7.5 earthquake sequences (1976–2026) from USGS and National Earthquake Data Center.
Independent calibration dataset (29 historical events, 1976–2004, including the 2004 Sumatra sequence) and validation dataset (11 recent events, 2005–2026).
June–August 2026 Circum-Pacific dense major earthquake sequence (8 events) and CENC regional Mw>=3.5 catalog for southwestern China.
来自USGS和国家地震科学数据中心的1976–2026年全球41个Mw≥7.5大震序列目录。
独立校准数据集（1976–2004年29个历史事件，含2004年苏门答腊序列）与独立验证数据集（2005–2026年11个近期事件）。
2026年6–8月环太平洋密集强震序列（8个事件）以及中国地震台网中心（CENC）的中国西南Mw≥3.5区域小震目录。
li: Incomplete regional diffusion coefficient database, with only seven subduction zones calibrated.
Lack of direct field or borehole pore-pressure measurements to independently verify the inverted effective stress-corrosion coefficient.
1-D diffusion approximation neglects 3-D waveguide curvature and lateral heterogeneities.
Simplified Biot poroelastic coupling that ignores full inertial coupling during the first few hours after a mainshock.
区域扩散系数数据库不完整，目前仅校准了7个俯冲带区域。
缺乏钻孔孔隙压力或流体监测等直接野外观测证据来独立检验反演的有效应力腐蚀系数。
一维扩散近似忽略了三维波导曲率与横向非均匀性效应。
简化了Biot孔隙弹性耦合，未求解包含惯性耦合的完整Biot方程，主震后数小时内可能存在误差。

tm.why: The paper develops a unified physical model for remote earthquake triggering based on poroelastic slow-wave diffusion, stress corrosion, and rate-and-state friction feedback.
It models subcritical crack growth, stress intensity factors, and slip acceleration leading to mainshock and aftershock triggering across subduction networks.
The model is calibrated and validated using global earthquake catalogs of 41 Mw≥7.5 historical events and a dense sequence of 2026 major earthquakes.

ev.notes: Full 32-page preprint PDF (ESS Open Archive, posted 20 August 2026) was read and analyzed, including all mathematical derivations, parameter tables, and validation case studies.

sum: This study analyzes two rare, deep (24.5 km) earthquakes (ML 3.5 and 3.1) that occurred in the southern Bohemian Massif, Czechia, in 2024 and 2025. By integrating instrumental seismological data with over 3,000 crowdsourced macroseismic questionnaires, the authors mapped the spatial distribution of felt intensity (up to IV). The macroseismic response was highly non-circular, showing a strong correlation with regional geology. Specifically, areas underlain by low-attenuation granitoids of the Central Bohemian Pluton exhibited dense, far-reaching reports, whereas the early Palaeozoic sedimentary rocks of the Teplá–Barrandian unit showed sparse reports due to higher attenuation. This demonstrates that citizen science and crowdsourced macroseismic data can effectively map deep crustal attenuation and complement sparse instrumental networks in low-seismicity regions.
本文分析了2024年和2025年发生于捷克波希米亚地块南部的两次罕见深源（24.5 km）地震（ML 3.5和3.1）。研究结合仪器地震分析与3000多份公众宏观烈度调查问卷，绘制了烈度空间分布图（最大烈度IV）。结果显示，宏观烈度分布呈明显的非圆形，受区域地质构造控制：中波希米亚岩基的花岗岩区由于……

t: Integration of instrumental seismological analysis with crowdsourced macroseismic questionnaires to map felt intensity distributions.
结合仪器地震学分析与公众众包宏观烈度问卷调查，绘制有感烈度分布图。
Over 1,500 macroseismic questionnaires collected for each of two rare earthquakes (ML 3.5 and 3.1) in the Bohemian Massif.
针对波希米亚地块两次罕见地震（ML 3.5和3.1）收集的每场超过1500份的宏观烈度问卷。
Non-circular intensity distribution revealing low attenuation in the Central Bohemian Pluton and high attenuation in the Teplá–Barrandian sedimentary rocks.
非圆形的烈度分布揭示了中波希米亚岩基的低衰减和特普拉-巴兰地阶沉积岩的高衰减特征。
Spatial resolution of macroseismic data is limited by population density and subjective public reporting.
宏观烈度数据的空间分辨率受人口密度和公众主观报告的限制。
Using citizen-science crowdsourced data to constrain deep crustal geological structures and attenuation in a low-seismicity region.
利用公民科学众包数据在低活动性地区约束深部地壳地质构造与衰减特征。

kc: Demonstrated that crowdsourced macroseismic data can map lateral variations in crustal attenuation.
Documented two rare, unusually deep (24.5 km) earthquakes in the southern Bohemian Massif.
Showed a clear correlation between macroseismic intensity distribution and major geological units (Central Bohemian Pluton vs. Teplá–Barrandian).
证实了公众众包宏观烈度数据可以用于绘制地壳衰减的横向变化。
记录了波希米亚地块南部两次罕见且异常深（24.5 km）的地震。
展示了宏观烈度分布与主要地质单元（中波希米亚岩基与特普拉-巴兰地阶）之间的清晰相关性。

Seismological analysis of earthquake location and depth.
Spatial correlation of macroseismic intensity with geological and tectonic maps.
公众众包宏观烈度问卷收集与烈度评估。
地震定位与深度的地震学分析。
宏观烈度与地质和构造图的空间相关性分析。
de: Over 1,500 macroseismic questionnaires collected for each of the two earthquakes (March 2024 ML 3.5 and April 2025 ML 3.1).
Instrumental seismic data from regional networks to constrain earthquake locations and depths (24.5 km).
针对两次地震（2024年3月ML 3.5和2025年4月ML 3.1）每场收集了超过1500份宏观烈度问卷。

众包数据的密度本质上受人口密度和公众参与度的限制。

tm.why: The paper uses macroseismic observations to constrain deep geological and crustal structures in the Bohemian Massif.

sum: This paper presents TL-BiRNN-Pick, an end-to-end automated microseismic monitoring framework for underground mines. To overcome the scarcity of labeled mining data, the authors use transfer learning, pretraining an encoder-decoder bidirectional recurrent neural network on the large-scale DiTing 2.0 natural earthquake dataset and fine-tuning it on mining seismic signals. The framework integrates DBSCAN association, enhanced Geiger localization, and double-difference relocation. Tested on 996 mining waveforms, it achieved an F1 score of 0.933 and an RMSE of 8.23 ms. A 16-day application at the Dongtan Coal Mine detected 1,271 events (a 3-4x increase over traditional methods) and improved the magnitude of completeness to -1.64, demonstrating its effectiveness for mine safety.
本文提出了一种用于地下矿山端到端自动微震监测的迁移学习双向循环神经网络框架（TL-BiRNN-Pick）。针对矿山标注数据稀缺问题，该方法利用在大规模DiTing 2.0天然地震数据集上预训练的模型，并在特定矿震信号上进行微调。框架集成了DBSCAN关联、改进的Geiger定位和双差重定位算法。在9……

t: An encoder-decoder bidirectional recurrent neural network (TL-BiRNN-Pick) pretrained on natural earthquakes and fine-tuned on mining seismic signals.
采用在天然地震上预训练并在矿震信号上微调的编码器-解码器双向循环神经网络。
A dataset of 996 mining seismic waveforms for evaluation, and 16 days of continuous monitoring data from the Dongtan Coal Mine.
用于评估的996个矿山地震波形，以及东滩煤矿16天的连续监测数据。
Achieved a precision of 0.947, F1 score of 0.933, and identified 1,271 microseismic events in a 16-day application, improving magnitude of completeness by 0.24 units.
实现0.947的精度和0.933的F1值，16天内识别出1271个微震事件，完备震级提升0.24。
The study focuses primarily on P-wave phase picking, and performance in extremely noisy or complex multi-phase mining environments remains to be fully tested.

Combines transfer learning from natural earthquakes to mining seismology with a complete waveform-to-catalog workflow including DBSCAN and double-difference relocation.
将天然地震迁移学习引入矿山微震，并结合DBSCAN和双差定位构建了完整工作流。

Integrated phase picking, DBSCAN association, Geiger localization, and double-difference relocation into a seamless waveform-to-catalog workflow.
Demonstrated a significant increase in detected microseismic events and improved magnitude of completeness in a real-world coal mine application.
开发了TL-BiRNN-Pick，一种基于迁移学习的深度学习矿山微震震相拾取框架。
将震相拾取、DBSCAN关联、Geiger定位和双差重定位整合到无缝的“波形到编目”工作流中。
在实际煤矿应用中显著增加了检测到的微震事件数量，并提高了完备震级。

Bidirectional Recurrent Neural Network (BiRNN) with an encoder-decoder architecture for P-wave phase picking.
DBSCAN clustering algorithm for event association.
Enhanced Geiger localization and double-difference relocation for event positioning.
使用基于DiTing 2.0天然地震数据集预训练模型的迁移学习。

使用DBSCAN聚类算法进行事件关联。

Real-world application using 16 days of continuous seismic data from the Dongtan Coal Mine.

sum: This study analyzes ~600 pre-eruptive volcano-tectonic (VT) earthquakes recorded prior to the March 1998 eruption of Piton de la Fournaise volcano, La Réunion. Using manually picked first-motion polarities and FPFIT, the authors determine over 400 high-quality fault plane solutions (FPS) along a vertically migrating dike from ~6 km below sea level (BSL) to ~2 km above sea level (ASL). The dominant P- and T-axis orientations show a systematic depth-dependent transition: below 2 km BSL, P-axes are mostly vertical due to volcanic edifice loading; above 2 km BSL, P-axes rotate to sub-horizontal and dike-perpendicular, reflecting regional tectonic compression and shallow dike overpressure. By combining a 2D phase-field damage dike propagation model with 3D elastic models of edifice loading and tectonic stress, the authors demonstrate how a depth-variable background stress field and magma overpressure (~30 MPa) explain the observed seismic focal mechanism rotations during vertical magma ascent.
本研究分析了1998年留尼汪岛富尔奈斯火山喷发前岩脉垂直侵入引发的约600次火山构造地震。利用初动极性计算了400多个高质量断层面解（深度从海平面下6 km至海平面上2 km），发现主压应力轴（P轴）和主张应力轴（T轴）随深度发生系统性偏转：深部（>2 km BSL）P轴近垂直，受火山锥体荷载主导；……

t: Calculated >400 fault plane solutions with FPFIT from manual first-motion polarities, analyzed P/T-axes in depth bins, and simulated stress fields using a 2D phase-field damage dike model and 3D elastic edifice/tectonic models.
利用FPFIT由初动极性计算400多个断层面解，结合二维相场损伤岩脉模型和三维弹性荷载/构造模型模拟应力场。

Nearly 600 volcano-tectonic earthquakes recorded 3–4 days before the March 1998 Piton de la Fournaise eruption, migrating vertically from ~6 km BSL to ~2 km ASL, yielding >400 high-quality fault plane solutions.
1998年富尔奈斯火山喷发前3-4天记录的约600次从海平面下6km垂直迁移至海平面上2km的火山构造地震。
Dominant P-axes transition from vertical at 6–2 km BSL (edifice-loading control) to sub-horizontal at 2–0 km BSL (tectonic influence) and dike-perpendicular at 0–1 km ASL (dike overpressure ~30 MPa).
优势P轴从深部（6-2km BSL）近垂直转为2-0km BSL近水平，并在0-1km ASL垂直于岩脉（对应约30 M…

Hypocenter and FPS uncertainties prevent resolving event positions relative to the instantaneous dike tip/margins or performing formal stress inversions, restricting interpretation to coarse depth-binned patterns.
定位和震源机制误差限制了事件相对于瞬时岩脉尖端位置的分辨及正式应力反演，仅能作粗粒度深度分箱分析。
Probes depth-dependent stress variations down to 6 km BSL during a rare vertical dike propagation event by integrating a 2D phase-field damage propagation model with 3D edifice-loading models.
结合二维相场损伤扩展模型与三维火山荷载模型，首次揭示达海平面下6km的垂直岩脉侵入期间随深度变化的应力转换。

kc: Calculated over 400 high-quality fault plane solutions for vertically migrating VT earthquakes prior to the 1998 Piton de la Fournaise eruption.

Identified a systematic depth-dependent rotation in dominant P- and T-axes from loading-dominated at depth (6 to 2 km BSL) to tectonic- and dike-overpressure-dominated near the surface (2 km BSL to 1 km ASL).
Developed a 2D damage-based poroelastic phase-field model of vertical dike ascent combined with 3D elastic edifice-loading and tectonic stress models.
计算了1998年富尔奈斯火山喷发前垂直迁移火山构造地震的400多个高质量断层面解。
揭示了P轴和T轴方向随深度的系统性旋转：从深部（海平面下6至2 km）受火山荷载主导过渡到浅部受构造应力和岩脉超压主导。
建立了二维基于损伤的多孔弹性相场岩脉上升模型，并结合了三维火山锥荷载与构造应力弹性模型。
me: First-motion polarity fault plane solution calculation using FPFIT and depth-binned Kamb-density stereonet analysis.
2D coupled rock deformation and channel-flow magma migration simulation using a phase-field damage poroelasticity framework.
3D finite-element elastic modeling of topographic edifice loading and regional tectonic compression in COMSOL, plus 3D kinematic forward modeling of surface deformation.
使用FPFIT基于初动极性计算断层面解，并按深度分箱进行Kamb密度赤平投影分析。
利用相场损伤多孔弹性框架进行二维岩石变形与通道流岩浆运移耦合数值模拟。
基于COMSOL开展三维地形锥体荷载与区域构造挤压弹性建模，并进行地表形变三维运动学正演模拟。
de: Seismic waveform data from the Observatoire Volcanologique du Piton de la Fournaise (OVPF) covering ~600 VT earthquakes recorded 3–4 days prior to the March 1998 eruption.
Global Multi-Resolution Topography (GMRT) digital elevation model used to build the 3D La Réunion volcanic edifice mesh.
Comparison with published 1998 RADARSAT co-eruptive InSAR surface deformation observations.
富尔奈斯火山观测台（OVPF）记录的1998年3月喷发前3-4天内约600次火山构造地震波形数据。
用于构建留尼汪岛火山锥三维网格的全球多分辨率地形（GMRT）数字高程模型。
与已发表的1998年RADARSAT同喷发InSAR地表形变观测结果进行对比验证。
li: Data are insufficient to robustly resolve a formal stress tensor inversion in each depth interval or classify events relative to the instantaneous dike tip, body, and margins.
Dike propagation is simplified to a 2D vertical cross-section ignoring lateral propagation and full 3D coupling with topography.
The 3D elastic edifice-loading calculation assumes instantaneous emplacement and full elasticity, representing an upper bound on loading differential stress.
数据不足以在各深度区间稳健反演完整的应力张量，也无法按瞬时岩脉尖端、主体和边缘对单个地震事件进行精细分类。
岩脉扩展被简化为二维垂直剖面，忽略了水平横向扩展以及与三维地形的完全耦合。
三维弹性火山锥荷载计算假设火山瞬时形成且完全弹性，因此给出的荷载差应力属于上限估计。

tm.why: The paper investigates volcano-tectonic earthquakes generated during pre-eruptive vertical dike propagation at Piton de la Fournaise volcano.
The authors calculate over 400 fault plane solutions from first-motion polarities and couple them with phase-field damage modeling of fracture propagation.

sum: This study investigates the global heterogeneity of the lithosphere across Venus's volcanic plains (77% of the surface) by analyzing models of effective elastic thickness (Te), crustal thickness (Tc), and subsurface load fraction (F) derived from gravity and topography, alongside catalogs of ~85,000 volcanoes, coronae, and impact craters. Using Kruskal-Wallis tests, Dunn post-hoc analyses, and unsupervised fuzzy clustering, the authors identify three statistically distinct provinces: the Beta-Atla-Themis (BAT) region, northern plains, and southern plains. Outside the BAT region, the remaining volcanic plains (61% of the surface) exhibit a striking hemispheric dichotomy: the northern plains have an effective elastic thickness ~8 km thinner and roughly twice the spatial density of volcanoes compared to the southern plains. Monte Carlo cratering simulations show this dichotomy could reflect age differences or coexisting geodynamical regimes (e.g., plutonic squishy lid in the north versus stagnant lid in the south).
本研究结合重力与地形反演的有效弹性厚度（Te）、地壳厚度（Tc）和次表层载荷比（F）模型，以及火山、冕状物和撞击坑目录，探讨了金星火山平原岩石圈的全球非均质性。通过非参数统计检验和模糊聚类分析，识别出三个统计性质显著不同的区域：BAT区、北部平原和南部平原。研究首次发现BAT区以外的火山平原（占表面……

t: The authors applied Kruskal-Wallis and Dunn post-hoc tests, plus unsupervised fuzzy clustering (fanny algorithm in R), to analyze effective elastic thickness (Te), crustal thickness (Tc), and load factor (F) across mapped Venusian volcanic provinces.
应用Kruskal-Wallis检验、Dunn检验及无监督模糊聚类，分析金星火山平原的Te、Tc和F参数。
Used global wavelet-derived models of Te, Tc, and F sampled at 211.22 km resolution, Magellan SAR imagery, and global catalogs of ~85,000 volcanoes, coronae, and impact craters.
采用211.22 km分辨率的全球Te、Tc、F模型，麦哲伦SAR图像，以及约8.5万座火山、冕状物和撞击坑目录。
Outside the BAT region, northern volcanic plains have an effective elastic thickness ~8 km thinner than southern plains (p = 1.70×10^-111) and host twice the volcano spatial density.
BAT区外，北部平原有效弹性厚度比南部薄约8 km（p=1.70×10^-111），且火山空间密度为南部的两倍。
Scarce impact craters bias age determinations; Monte Carlo simulations yield a wide 95% confidence age ratio (-0.13 to 0.20), preventing ruling out conductive cooling age differences.
撞击坑稀少导致定年偏差，蒙特卡洛模拟年龄比范围较宽（-0.13至0.20），无法排除传导冷却年龄差异。

First identification and statistical validation of a global hemispheric dichotomy in lithospheric thickness and volcano spatial density between Venus's northern and southern volcanic plains outside the BAT region.
首次识别并统计证实了BAT区外金星南北火山平原在岩石圈厚度和火山空间密度上的全球二分性。

kc: Demonstrates that Venus's volcanic plains comprise three statistically distinct lithospheric provinces: BAT, northern plains, and southern plains.
Discovers a hemispheric dichotomy outside the BAT region where northern plains have ~8 km lower effective elastic thickness and double the volcano spatial density compared to southern plains.
Validates the separation of northern and southern plains autonomously using unsupervised fuzzy clustering on geophysical parameters (Te and Tc).
证实金星火山平原包含三个具有显著统计差异的岩石圈省：BAT区、北部平原和南部平原。
发现BAT区以外的火山平原存在半球二分性，北部平原比南部平原的有效弹性厚度薄约8 km，且火山空间密度是南部的两倍。
利用基于地球物理参数（Te和Tc）的无监督模糊聚类算法，自主验证了北部与南部平原的划分。
me: Spatial sampling and geological province classification of spherical harmonic gravity and topography inversion models (Te, Tc, F) using QGIS.
Non-parametric Kruskal-Wallis tests and Dunn's post-hoc tests with Bonferroni correction to evaluate statistical differences across provinces.
Unsupervised fuzzy clustering (fanny algorithm in R) using Te and Tc to autonomously classify volcanic plains.
Stochastic Monte Carlo simulations of impact crater accumulation (10,000 realizations per age increment) to constrain relative surface age differences.
利用QGIS对球谐重力与地形反演模型（Te、Tc、F）进行均匀空间采样和地质省分类。
应用非参数Kruskal-Wallis检验和带Bonferroni校正的Dunn事后检验评估各省之间的统计差异。
基于Te和Tc参数使用R语言fanny算法进行无监督模糊聚类，实现火山平原的自主分类。
开展撞击坑随机累积的蒙特卡洛统计模拟（每个年龄增量10,000次模拟），以约束南北平原的相对年龄差异。
de: Global models of crustal thickness (Jiménez-Díaz et al., 2015) and effective elastic thickness and load factor (Ruiz et al., 2026) from Magellan gravity and topography.
NASA Magellan altimetry and full-resolution (75-100 m/pixel) S-band SAR imagery for geological mapping.
Global catalogs of ~85,000 volcanoes (Hahn & Byrne, 2023), coronae (Gülcher et al., 2020, 2023, 2025), and ~942 impact craters (Herrick et al., 1997).
基于麦哲伦号重力和地形数据反演的全球地壳厚度模型（Jiménez-Díaz等，2015）以及有效弹性厚度与载荷因子模型（Ruiz等，2026）。
用于绘制地质省图的NASA麦哲伦号测高数据和全分辨率（75-100米/像素）S波段合成孔径雷达（SAR）图像。
全球约85,000座火山目录（Hahn & Byrne, 2023）、冕状物数据库（Gülcher等，2020, 2023, 2025）及撞击坑数据库（Herrick等，1997）。
li: Absolute age determinations by crater counting on Venus are strongly biased by the scarce impact crater population, leaving relative age ratios wide (-0.13 to 0.20 at 95% confidence).

Unknown parameters such as planetary cooling history and crustal radioactive element concentration prevent definitive disambiguation between age differences and contemporary geodynamic regime variations.
金星撞击坑数量稀少导致撞击坑计数的绝对定年存在较大偏差，95%置信区间下的相对年龄比范围较宽（-0.13至0.20）。
行星冷却历史和地壳放射性元素富集程度等未知因素限制了对岩石圈年龄差异与当代地球动力学体制差异的明确区分。

tm.why: The paper investigates the spatial heterogeneity of effective elastic thickness, crustal thickness, and subsurface load fraction across Venusian volcanic plains and discusses implications for mantle convection and lithospheric geodynamical regimes.
The study focuses on the planetary interior structure, volcanism, and geodynamics of Venus using gravity, topography, and radar imagery datasets.

sum: This study presents array-scale (~500 × 500 km) radially and azimuthally anisotropic shear-velocity models to 300-km depth from two broadband ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) deployments in the Pacific: Young ORCA (~43 Ma) and Old ORCA (~90 Ma). Combining ambient-noise cross-correlations (5–25 s Rayleigh and 5–10 s Love waves) with teleseismic Rayleigh waves (12–150 s), the authors invert for V_SV, radial anisotropy (ξ), and azimuthal anisotropy (G and E). Both sites exhibit positive shallow radial anisotropy and a high-velocity lid over a low-velocity zone. Young ORCA shows strong (~3%) spreading-parallel lithospheric anisotropy, whereas Old ORCA displays weak (1–2%) anisotropy rotated ~30° from fossil spreading and a sharp fabric transition at ~70 km marking a dehydration-controlled lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary. Both show strong (~3%) APM-aligned anisotropy in the shallow asthenosphere (70–200 km) that rotates deeper, demonstrating small-scale convective deformation missed by global tomography.
本研究利用太平洋Young ORCA（~43 Ma）和Old ORCA（~90 Ma）两个宽频带海底地震仪阵列（~500×500 km），结合背景噪声互相关（5–25 s瑞利波与5–10 s勒夫波）和远震瑞利波（12–150 s）相速度频散，反演了至300 km深度的剪切波速度及径向、方位各向异性模……

t: Two-step linearized least-squares inversion of array-average Rayleigh (5–150 s) and Love (5–7.5 s) phase velocities and azimuthal variations using MINEOS kernels and bootstrap resampling for smooth and layered 1D models.
利用MINEOS核与Bootstrap重采样，对瑞利波与勒夫波相速度及方位变化进行两步最小二乘反演。

Surface-wave dispersion (5–150 s) from ambient noise and 133/182 teleseismic events recorded on two 30-station broadband OBS arrays (500 × 500 km) at ~43 Ma (Young ORCA) and ~90 Ma (Old ORCA) Pacific seafloor.
太平洋~43 Ma和~90 Ma两个30台宽频带OBS阵列记录的背景噪声与远震面波频散数据。

Young ORCA has ~3% spreading-parallel lithospheric anisotropy (<50 km), whereas Old ORCA has weak (0.5–2%), ~30°-rotated lithospheric fabric above a sharp ~70 km LAB; both show ~3% APM-aligned asthenospheric anisotropy (70–200 km).
Young ORCA岩石圈具~3%平行古扩张各向异性；Old ORCA弱且偏转30°，70 km处呈急剧LAB转变。
Mode interference restricts Love waves to <8 s, limiting V_SH resolution to shallow depths, and broad surface-wave kernels limit sensitivity to sharp vertical velocity and rheological gradients.
高阶模干扰限制勒夫波周期（<8 s），且宽面波敏感度核对尖锐垂向流变梯度分辨率有限。

First array-scale broadband OBS comparison of radial and azimuthal anisotropy to 300 km depth at Young and Old ORCA, revealing multi-scale lithospheric and asthenospheric fabrics smoothed out in global models.
首次获得Young和Old ORCA至300 km深度的阵列尺度各向异性模型，揭示全球模型遗漏的小尺度变形。

kc: Constructed high-resolution 1D radially and azimuthally anisotropic shear-velocity models to 300 km depth at ~43 Ma and ~90 Ma Pacific seafloor sites.
Demonstrated contrasting lithospheric fabrics: canonical spreading-parallel corner flow at Young ORCA versus weak, ~30°-rotated fabric at Old ORCA linked to complex ridge migration.
Identified a sharp anisotropic transition at ~70 km depth beneath Old ORCA supporting a dehydration-controlled rheological lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary.
Resolved a strong (~3%) APM-parallel asthenospheric shear channel (70–200 km) overlying rotated deeper fabric driven by pressure or buoyancy flow, which global models underpredict.
构建了太平洋~43 Ma和~90 Ma洋底区域至300 km深度的1D径向与方位各向异性剪切波速度高分辨率模型。
揭示了截然不同的岩石圈组构：Young ORCA表现为典型的平行扩张角流，而Old ORCA表现为与复杂洋脊迁移相关的弱且偏转~30°的组构。
在Old ORCA下方~70 km深度识别出急剧的各向异性转变，支持脱水控制的流变学岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）。
分辨出70–200 km深度内平行于绝对板块运动的强（~3%）软流圈剪切通道及更深处受压力或浮力流驱动的旋转组构，指出全球模型低估了其强度与变化。
me: Automated tilt and compliance noise removal on vertical OBS recordings to enhance teleseismic signals and extract 5–10 s first-overtone (1S) Rayleigh waves from ambient noise.
Ambient-noise cross-correlation Bessel-function spectral fitting (Menke & Jin, 2015) for 1S and 0S Rayleigh waves and 0T Love waves.
Automated Surface-Wave Measurement System (ASWMS) multichannel cross-correlation and Eikonal/finite-frequency tomography for 12–150 s teleseismic Rayleigh waves.
Two-step linearized least-squares depth inversion with MINEOS kernels and bootstrap uncertainty estimation using both smooth and layered depth parameterizations.
对OBS垂直分量进行自动倾斜与顺应性噪声去除，以增强远震信号并从背景噪声中提取5–10 s一阶高阶模（1S）瑞利波。
利用背景噪声互相关贝塞尔函数谱拟合（Menke & Jin, 2015）提取1S和0S瑞利波以及0T勒夫波相速度。
采用自动面波测量系统（ASWMS）多道互相关及程函/有限频层析成像获取12–150 s远震瑞利波相速度及方位各向异性。
结合MINEOS敏感度核与Bootstrap不确定性评估，采用平滑与分层两种参数化方案进行两步线性化最小二乘深度反演。

sum: To test whether mantle magma supply or trans-crustal processes control volcanic diversity along the Alaska Peninsula, this study constructs a 3-D P-wave attenuation (1/Qp) model using 67,818 t* measurements from 2,867 local earthquakes recorded by amphibious arrays (including AACSE OBS stations). Utilizing independently constrained corner frequencies and a propagation correction term, t* values are inverted via transdimensional Bayesian MCMC tomography (QtomoMCMC) with Voronoi cells and geographical station weighting. Results reveal strong high-attenuation anomalies (1/Qp > 0.0075) in the mantle wedge beneath the Pavlof and Chirikof-Kodiak segments, interpreted via rock physics modeling (YT24) as partial melting driven by deep slab dehydration, whereas the central Shumagin-Chignik segments exhibit lower attenuation and limited melting. Because mantle melting variations do not match surface eruption styles, and crustal Vp/Vs changes abruptly across the Becharof discontinuity, surface volcanism is likely modulated by trans-crustal stress regimes. High fore-arc crustal attenuation indicates fluid-rich, fractured scattering.

Demonstrated substantial along-strike variations in mantle wedge partial melting controlled by deep slab dehydration (high melting in Pavlof and Chirikof-Kodiak; limited in Shumagin-Chignik).
Showed that mantle magma supply alone does not explain surface volcanic diversity, highlighting the role of trans-crustal stress regimes across the Becharof discontinuity.
Identified strong scattering attenuation in the southwestern fore-arc overriding crust, correlating with high Vp/Vs, fluid release, and elevated aftershock activity.

3-D transdimensional Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) attenuation tomography (QtomoMCMC) parameterized with irregular Voronoi cells (100 chains, 1 million iterations each).

sum: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) is highly nonlinear and prone to cycle skipping under poor initial models, noise, or missing low frequencies, especially in vertical seismic profiling (VSP) with limited illumination. While neural network-based reparameterized FWI empirically improves robustness, its underlying mechanism remains unclear. This study investigates reparameterized FWI via Gauss-Newton Hessian and Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) theory alongside 2D/3D loss landscape visualization. Results show that network parameterization projects updates onto low-frequency NTK eigenmodes, transforming sharp local minima into broad, flat, gently convex basins. Guided by these insights, the authors propose a physics-informed Transformer-based reparameterized FWI (PIT-FWI) combining a channel bottleneck fusion module, a 12-layer Transformer encoder, and a bilinear-interpolation CNN decoder. Synthetic tests on 2D Sigsbee, Marmousi, 3D Overthrust, and 2D marine Chevron 2014 datasets demonstrate that PIT-FWI outperforms conventional AD-FWI and UNet-FWI under poor initial models, 10 dB noise, 8 Hz low-frequency cutoffs, and sparse shots.

Demonstrates superior VSP and surface FWI robustness across 2D Sigsbee, Marmousi, 3D Overthrust RVSP, and Chevron 2014 marine benchmarks under poor initial models, 10 dB SNR, and missing low frequencies up to 8 Hz.

tm.why: The paper focuses on improving the robustness of full-waveform inversion (FWI) for velocity model reconstruction in VSP and surface geometries.
It uses deep neural networks, specifically a physics-informed Transformer-CNN architecture, to reparameterize the velocity model in FWI and analyzes the resulting neural network loss landscape.
It conducts theoretical and empirical analyses of the Gauss-Newton Hessian, neural tangent kernel (NTK), spectral bias, and 2D/3D loss landscape curvature of the inverse problem.

sum: This study presents a seismological investigation of subaqueous slopes in Lake Lucerne, Switzerland, using Ocean Bottom Seismometers (OBS) in single-station and array configurations. Ambient-noise data were processed to extract microtremor horizontal-to-vertical (H/V) spectral ratios and phase-velocity dispersion curves of Scholte and Love waves. These observables were jointly inverted to estimate shear-wave velocity (VS) profiles. Crucially, the inversion utilized the forward-modeling tool hvgeneralized, which computes the full H/V spectrum while explicitly accounting for the overlying water layer and water-sediment coupling. This approach overcomes the limitations of standard land-based assumptions. The resulting VS profiles characterize the internal structure of unconsolidated lacustrine sediments, demonstrating the efficacy of OBS-based passive seismic methods for subaqueous landslide hazard assessment.

sum: This publication is an Author Correction to a previously published study that evaluates the landslide hazards and risks associated with new and existing settlements constructed on hillslopes weakened by the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence in Turkey. The original study highlights the critical need for post-earthquake landslide susceptibility assessments to guide safe reconstruction and urban planning, preventing future disasters in seismically weakened mountainous terrains.
该文献是针对先前发表研究的作者勘误。原研究评估了土耳其2023年卡赫拉曼马拉什地震序列后，在受损变弱的斜坡上重建和新建定居点所面临的滑坡灾害与风险。研究强调了震后滑坡易发性评估对于指导安全重建和城市规划、避免在地震弱化山区发生二次灾害的关键作用。

sum: BackTrackBB is an open-source program designed for the detection and space-time location of seismic sources. It utilizes multi-scale, frequency-selective statistical coherence of wavefields recorded by dense seismic networks and local arrays. This specific Zenodo release documents a benchmark experiment configuration using a synthetic dataset to evaluate the software's performance on the Marenostrum V supercomputer. The workflow runs over a simulated 2-day period, generating 1,300 tasks (including 864 computationally intensive btbb_block tasks). Utilizing 108 nodes, the execution completes in approximately 11 minutes, though CPU usage averages 35.2% due to load imbalances. This release highlights the tool's high-performance computing capabilities for large-scale seismic monitoring.

sum: This study investigates the September 2022 Chihshang earthquake sequence (Mw 6.6 foreshock and Mw 7.0 mainshock) in Taitung, Taiwan, to understand earthquake nucleation and triggering mechanisms. By integrating seismic waveforms (Pn/Pg and Rayleigh waves) and InSAR deformation data, the authors construct a three-fault rupture model. Relative hypocenter and centroid locations are determined and validated using GNSS and InSAR observations. Static Coulomb stress change calculations reveal that subsequent subevents were triggered by preceding ones, demonstrating a cascading rupture process. This study highlights the complex interaction of faults during the sequence and provides critical insights for assessing seismic hazards in regions with increased stress.
本研究针对2022年9月台湾池上地震序列（Mw 6.6前震与Mw 7.0主震），联合地震波形与InSAR形变数据构建了三断层破裂模型。通过Pn/Pg和Rayleigh波确定了相对震源与形变中心，并利用GNSS数据进行验证。静态库仑应力计算表明，后续子事件由前期事件触发，呈级联破裂特征。该成果对评估区……

sum: Metamorphic fluids released during subduction drive seismicity, metasomatism, and arc magmatism, yet fingerprinting their lithological sources remains difficult. This study uses Gibbs free energy minimization (Perple_X) coupled with the Deep Earth Water (DEW) model and lagged speciation algorithm to predict equilibrium mineralogy and C-O-H fluid compositions along hot (Cascadia) and cold (Honshu) subduction geotherms under closed and open (Rayleigh fractionation) assumptions. Four idealized lithologies are modeled: impure carbonate, average subducted sediment (GLOSS), hydrated MORB, and serpentinized harzburgite. Results show that Si dominates solute loads in most fluids except harzburgite, where Mg and Ca prevail during brucite and antigorite breakdown. Sediment-derived fluids exhibit higher Na proportions than basalt-derived fluids. Diagnostic major-element ratios (Mg/Si, K/Na, Ca/Mg, Ca/Al, S/Ca) track specific mineral breakdown pulses and generally align with natural metasomatic records and fluid inclusions, providing quantitative geochemical fingerprints of subduction zone fluid sources.
俯冲带变质流体对地震活动、交代作用和弧岩浆作用至关重要，但识别其岩石来源较为困难。本研究结合Perple_X吉布斯自由能最小化、深部地球水（DEW）模型与滞后形态算法，在封闭和开放系统假设下，模拟了热（Cascadia）和冷（Honshu）俯冲地温线下四种理想岩性（不纯碳酸盐岩、全球平均俯冲沉积物G……

t: Equilibrium phase assemblages and C-O-H electrolytic fluid speciation are calculated up to 6 GPa using Perple_X with the lagged speciation algorithm, combining the Holland & Powell (2011) dataset and the Deep Earth Water (DEW) database.
结合Holland & Powell数据库与DEW模型，利用Perple_X滞后形态算法计算6 GPa内平衡矿物相与C-…

Four water-saturated, sulfur-bearing idealized bulk compositions—impure limestone, Global Average Subduction Sediments (GLOSS), hydrated MORB, and serpentinized harzburgite—modeled along hot (Cascadia) and cold (Honshu) slab-top geotherms.
选取不纯灰岩、GLOSS沉积物、水化MORB和蛇纹石化方辉橄榄岩，沿冷热俯冲地温线模拟。

Harzburgite dehydration fluids have ~2 orders of magnitude higher Mg/Si ratios (<600°C) than MORB/GLOSS (0.6–0.8). During GLOSS lawsonite breakdown, Na constitutes 13.5%–18.6% and Na+Si constitutes 36.5%–55% of dissolved solutes.

Calculations omit chlorine, underestimating absolute solubilities of chloride-complexing cations (Na, K, Mg, Ca, Al) by up to an order of magnitude, and assume congruent mineral dissolution.
模型未包含氯元素，低估了形成氯络合物阳离子的溶解度（可达一个数量级）。

Establishes quantitative major-element solute ratio fingerprints (Mg/Si, K/Na, Ca/Mg, Ca/Al, S/Ca) linking specific dehydration reactions and subducting lithologies to metasomatic features and fluid inclusions.

kc: Quantifies evolving mineralogy, dehydration reaction stoichiometries, and C-O-H fluid solute compositions for four representative subducted lithologies along hot (Cascadia) and cold (Honshu) geotherms.
Identifies diagnostic major-element ratios (Mg/Si, K/Na, Ca/Mg, Ca/Al, S/Ca) that distinguish fluids derived from serpentinized harzburgite, MORB, GLOSS sediments, and impure limestone.
Validates thermodynamic lagged-speciation fluid predictions against natural metasomatic rock records, fluid inclusions, and high-pressure experimental datasets.
量化了四种代表性俯冲岩性在热（Cascadia）和冷（Honshu）地温线下的矿物演化、脱水反应化学计量及C-O-H流体溶质组成。
提出了具有诊断意义的主量元素比值（Mg/Si、K/Na、Ca/Mg、Ca/Al、S/Ca），用于区分蛇纹石化方辉橄榄岩、MORB、沉积物和灰岩来源的流体。
将热力学滞后形态流体预测结果与天然交代岩石记录、流体包裹体和高压实验数据集进行了对比验证。
me: Gibbs free energy minimization in Perple_X using the Holland & Powell (2011) thermodynamic dataset and Deep Earth Water (DEW) electrolyte database.
Lagged speciation algorithm to iteratively refine mineral dissolution and C-O-H fluid speciation up to 6 GPa.
Comparison of 2D pseudosections, 1D closed-system (isochemical) paths, and 1D open-system (Rayleigh fluid fractionation) paths along Syracuse et al. (2010) Cascadia and Honshu slab-top geotherms.
基于Holland & Powell (2011)热力学数据库和深部地球水（DEW）电解质数据库，使用Perple_X进行吉布斯自由能最小化计算。
采用滞后形态算法迭代计算高达6 GPa条件下的矿物溶解与C-O-H流体物种形态。
对比了沿Cascadia和Honshu板片顶部地温线的二维视剖面图、一维封闭系统（等化学）路径和一维开放系统（瑞利流体分馏）路径。
de: Four idealized bulk rock compositions from literature: Guatemala impure carbonate, Global Average Subduction Sediments (GLOSS), hydrated MORB, and serpentinized harzburgite.
Published natural fluid inclusion datasets and high-pressure experimental mineral/rock solubility datasets used for benchmarking and comparison.
来自文献的四种理想全岩成分：危地马拉不纯碳酸盐岩、全球平均俯冲沉积物（GLOSS）、水化洋中脊玄武岩（MORB）和蛇纹石化方辉橄榄岩。
已发表的天然流体包裹体数据集和高压矿物/岩石溶解度实验数据集，用于基准测试和对比。
li: Models assume a chlorine-free chemical system, meaning predicted cation concentrations (Na, K, Mg, Ca, Al) represent lower bounds compared to natural saline brines.
Open-system models only fractionate and remove generated fluids without allowing external fluid influx from adjacent lithologies, underpredicting carbonate decarbonation.
Fluid speciation calculations fail to converge at low temperatures with high CO2/H2O ratios or when fluids are completely exhausted at high temperatures.
模型假设为无氯体系，因此对于易形成氯络合物的阳离子（Na、K、Mg、Ca、Al），预测溶解度仅代表天然卤水体系的下限。
开放系统模型仅移除产生的流体而不考虑外部流体流入，低估了需要外来含水流体驱动的碳酸盐岩脱碳作用。
在低温高CO2/H2O比值或高温流体耗尽区域，流体形态计算无法收敛。

ev.notes: Full 20-page PDF text, 1 table, and 7 figures were analyzed directly.

sum: This paper presents a novel deep learning approach for real-time multi-station microseismic event detection using the YOLOv5 computer vision model. Continuous multi-channel seismic data are converted into 20-second grayscale waveform images, where microseismic events are manually annotated. By leveraging transfer learning from pre-trained computer vision models, the network is trained on field-observed datasets. Compared to traditional STA/LTA and existing multi-station schemes, the proposed method significantly reduces false positives while maintaining a high recall rate. When tested on an independent dataset from a different area, the model achieved a precision of 0.9832 and a recall of 0.9702. The method is robust, computationally efficient for real-time monitoring, and easily updatable with new training samples.
