sum: This study proposes a novel method to detect interannual and fine-scale spatiotemporal variations in interplate coupling by combining geodetic and seismic data. First, a reference 3D tectonic stressing rate field is computed from a long-term geodetic slip-deficit rate model. Next, the 'misfit angle' between the observed slip direction of intraplate earthquake focal mechanisms (within overriding and subducting plates) and the predicted tangential traction on the fault plane is evaluated. Small misfit angles indicate persistence of the reference coupling state, whereas larger angles reflect local stress perturbations from decoupling or slow slip events (SSEs). Validated against the 2001–2005 Tokai SSE and applied to 27 years of F-net CMT and GEONET GNSS data in Tohoku-Oki, the method captures pre-2011 unlocking in the mainshock zone, decadal aseismic transients, and fine-scale coupling fluctuations unresolvable by geodesy alone.
本研究提出一种结合大地测量与地震数据检测板块间耦合时空演化的方法。首先利用长期GNSS滑动亏损率模型计算三维参考构造应力率场，随后计算板内地震震源机制滑动方向与断层面上预测切向牵引力之间的“失配角”。小失配角代表参考耦合状态持续，大失配角则反映慢滑移事件（SSE）或解耦引起的局部应力扰动。该方法在2……

t: Computes 3D reference tectonic stressing rates from a geodetic slip-deficit model, then averages the misfit angles between intraplate earthquake slip directions and predicted fault-plane tangential tractions across space and time.
由大地测量滑动亏损模型计算三维参考构造应力率，并对板内地震滑动方向与预测切向牵引力的失配角进行时空加权平均。

Uses 10-year GEONET GNSS surface velocities (1998–2008) for slip-deficit inversion and NIED F-net CMT focal mechanisms (February 1997–December 2023, shallower than 80 km) along the Tohoku-Oki subduction zone.
使用日本东北冲10年GEONET地表速度（1998–2008）及1997–2023年深度80 km以浅的F-net震源机…

Misfit angles in the 2011 Tohoku-Oki mainshock area decreased from 2002 to 2008 (persistent coupling), shifted to an increasing trend after 2008 (pre-seismic unlocking/SSEs), and showed a ~9-year quasi-periodic fluctuation.
2011年主震区失配角在2002–2008年下降（持续耦合），2008年后转为上升（震前解耦/SSE），并呈约9年准周期…

The misfit angle is a qualitative, indirect proxy that cannot uniquely constrain physical slip quantities and can be affected by focal mechanism uncertainties or fluid-related background stress changes.
失配角为定性间接指标，无法直接量化滑移量，且受震源机制误差或流体引起的背景应力变化影响。

Integrates intraplate earthquake focal mechanisms with geodetic slip-deficit stressing rates to detect interannual and fine-scale offshore coupling variations undetectable by geodetic inversions or sparse repeating earthquakes alone.
融合板内震源机制与大地测量应力率，探测仅靠大地测量或重复地震无法分辨的年际和精细尺度板间耦合变化。

kc: Developed a joint geodetic-seismic framework using intraplate focal mechanism misfit angles relative to reference tectonic stressing rates to monitor interplate coupling.
Validated the misfit-angle indicator using the 2001–2005 Mw 7.1 Tokai long-term slow slip event, confirming sensitivity to stressing rate perturbations.
Revealed 27 years of fine-scale, interannual coupling variations and pre-2011 megathrust unlocking along the Tohoku-Oki boundary beyond geodetic resolution.
开发了联合大地测量与地震数据的框架，利用板内震源机制相对于参考构造应力率的失配角监测板间耦合状态。
利用2001–2005年Mw 7.1东海长期慢滑移事件验证了失配角指标，证实其对应力率扰动的敏感性。
揭示了日本东北冲板块边界27年来超越大地测量分辨率的精细尺度、年际耦合变化及2011年大震前的解耦过程。
me: Strain data inversion of GNSS surface velocities using bicubic B-splines in an elastic-viscoelastic layered half-space to obtain reference slip-deficit rates.
Calculation of 3D reference tectonic stressing rate tensors using dislocation theory in a multilayered elastic/viscoelastic medium.
Classification of interplate vs. intraplate earthquakes using Kagan angles (≤35° threshold) and systematic hypocenter depth correction relative to the plate interface.
Spatiotemporal Gaussian-weighted averaging of focal mechanism misfit angles between earthquake slip vectors and predicted tangential tractions.
在弹性-粘弹性分层半空间中利用双三次B样条对GNSS地表速度进行应变数据反演，获取参考滑动亏损率。
利用多层弹性/粘弹性介质中的位错理论计算三维参考构造应力率张量。
利用Kagan角（≤35°阈值）区分板间与板内地震，并相对于板块界面进行系统的震源深度校正。
对地震滑动矢量与预测切向牵引力之间的震源机制失配角进行时空高斯加权平均。
de: GEONET F3 daily GNSS coordinate solutions (March 1998 to March 2008 for Tohoku-Oki; March 2005 to February 2011 for Tokai).
NIED F-net centroid moment tensor (CMT) catalog from February 1997 to December 2023 (depths ≤ 80 km).
Synthetic robustness tests evaluating near-trench slip-deficit uncertainties, CMT quality subsets (variance reduction > 80%), and ±5 km random depth perturbations.
GEONET F3每日GNSS坐标解（东北冲为1998年3月至2008年3月；东海地区为2005年3月至2011年2月）。
1997年2月至2023年12月的NIED F-net质心矩张量（CMT）目录（深度≤80 km）。
评估近海沟滑动亏损不确定性、CMT高质量子集（方差缩减>80%）以及±5 km随机深度扰动的合成稳健性测试。
li: Provides a qualitative indicator of deviations from a reference coupling state rather than a direct quantitative estimate of slip or slip rate.
Assumes a temporally stable background stress field, which can be locally violated by massive coseismic stress drops or fluid-related perturbations.
Spatial and temporal resolution is limited in offshore or sparse-seismicity regions with few available focal mechanisms.
仅提供偏离参考耦合状态的定性指标，而非滑动量或滑动速率的直接定量估计。
假设背景应力场随时间保持稳定，但这可能在大地震同震应力降或流体相关扰动区局部失效。
在可用震源机制较少的海域或地震稀疏区，时空分辨率受到限制。

tm.why: The paper develops a method to detect spatiotemporal variations in interplate coupling and slow slip events (SSEs) along the Tohoku-Oki subduction zone using intraplate earthquake focal mechanisms and geodetic slip-deficit models.
The method directly relies on analyzing centroid moment tensor (CMT) focal mechanism solutions and slip directions of intraplate earthquakes relative to tectonic stressing rates.
The study models 3D tectonic stressing rates in an elastic/viscoelastic layered lithosphere and asthenosphere driven by subduction plate boundary coupling.

ev.notes: Full 20-page PDF read and analyzed, including all 12 figures, equations, methodological steps, and discussions.

sum: This study presents a high-precision relocated seismicity catalog for northwestern South America to investigate intermediate-depth earthquakes. The refined earthquake locations reveal a highly complex subducting slab geometry and delineate multiple distinct seismicity clusters, including the well-known Bucaramanga nest. These high-resolution spatial patterns provide critical constraints on the deformation, dehydration, and stress state of the subducting Nazca and Caribbean plates beneath Colombia, advancing our understanding of intermediate-depth earthquake triggering mechanisms and regional geodynamics.
本研究通过高精度重新定位的地震目录，分析了西北南美洲的中源地震活动。精细的地震定位揭示了极其复杂的俯冲板块几何结构，并清晰刻画了包括布卡拉曼加（Bucaramanga）地震巢在内的多个独立地震群。这些高分辨率的空间分布特征为理解哥伦比亚下方纳斯卡板块和加勒比板块的俯冲变形、脱水机制及应力状态提供了关……

t: High-precision earthquake relocation of intermediate-depth events in northwestern South America to resolve fine-scale spatial structures.
对西北南美洲中源地震进行高精度地震重新定位，以解析微细观空间结构。
Regional seismic network arrival times and waveform data capturing intermediate-depth seismicity clusters in Colombia.
记录哥伦比亚中源地震群的区域地震台网走时与波形数据。
Identification of complex, segmented slab geometries and multiple distinct intermediate-depth seismicity clusters, including the Bucaramanga nest.
识别出复杂的、分段的板块几何结构以及包括布卡拉曼加地震巢在内的多个独立中源地震群。
Relocation accuracy is constrained by the aperture and density of the regional seismic network.
定位精度受限于区域地震台网的孔径和台站密度。
First high-resolution mapping of multiple intermediate-depth clusters in NW South America, revealing detailed slab geometric complexities.
首次对西北南美洲多个中源地震群进行高分辨率制图，揭示了详细的板块几何复杂性。

kc: Constructed a high-precision relocated seismicity catalog for intermediate-depth earthquakes in northwestern South America.
Revealed complex, non-planar slab geometries and multiple distinct seismicity clusters.
Provided new insights into the geodynamics and slab deformation of the Nazca and Caribbean plates beneath Colombia.
构建了西北南美洲中源地震的高精度重新定位地震目录。
揭示了复杂的非平面板块几何结构和多个独立的中源地震群。
为哥伦比亚下方纳斯卡板块和加勒比板块的地球动力学与板块变形提供了新见解。
me: High-precision earthquake relocation techniques using regional travel-time data.
Spatial clustering analysis of intermediate-depth seismicity.
利用区域走时数据的高精度地震重新定位技术。
中源地震活动的空间聚类分析。
de: Seismic arrival time data from regional networks in Colombia and northwestern South America.
Relocated catalog of intermediate-depth earthquakes.
来自哥伦比亚及西北南美洲区域台网的地震走时数据。
重新定位的中源地震目录。
li: Relocation accuracy is constrained by the aperture and density of the regional seismic network.
Lack of direct physical measurements of slab temperature and hydration state.
定位精度受限于区域地震台网的孔径和台站密度。
缺乏对板块温度和水化状态的直接物理测量。

tm.why: The study utilizes a high-precision relocated seismicity catalog to analyze intermediate-depth earthquakes.
The paper investigates the complex slab geometry and subduction dynamics in northwestern South America.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, authors, publication venue, and public metadata snippets indicating high-precision relocated seismicity catalog and slab geometry analysis.

sum: Slow slip events (SSEs) in subduction zones offer continuous surface displacements to study fault mechanics, yet instrumental flicker noise and standard smoothing obscure underlying physical drivers. This study introduces a physics-based AI forecasting framework combining a 1D thermo-poro-mechanical PDE model (governing serpentine dehydration, pore pressure, and temperature) with automated manifold reconstruction. Applied to GNSS time series from Cascadia and seven East Coast stations in New Zealand's Hikurangi margin alongside USGS earthquake catalogs, the method models bimodal SSE oscillations via a relaxation ODE optimized with Differential Evolution. Using Takens' Embedding Theorem and a station-adaptive local linear K-Nearest Neighbors algorithm on the resolved 3D attractors, the model forecasts the 2024 M5.8 earthquake with a timing error of -6.09 ± 3.42 days. Furthermore, Maximum Lyapunov Exponent analysis shows the physics filter doubles the regional predictability horizon to 37.9 ± 4.3 days with decadal stability, demonstrating deterministic seismic forecasting.
俯冲带慢滑移事件（SSEs）为地震预测提供了窗口，但仪器噪声和传统滤波掩盖了潜在物理机制。本文提出一种基于物理的AI预测框架，将控制蛇纹石脱水、孔隙压力和温度的热-孔隙-力学耦合偏微分方程作为物理滤波器，结合差分进化优化和Takens相空间重构，从Cascadia及新西兰Hikurangi俯冲带GN……

t: Couples a thermo-poro-mechanical PDE physics filter and a Differential Evolution-optimized modal relaxation ODE with Takens' phase space reconstruction and a station-adaptive local linear K-Nearest Neighbors algorithm for trajectory forecasting.
结合热-孔隙-力学PDE滤波、差分进化优化的模态弛豫ODE、Takens相空间重构及自适应局部线性KNN预测算法。
Eastern component GNSS displacement time series from Cascadia (ALBH) and seven GeoNet stations in New Zealand's Hikurangi margin (since 2002), paired with USGS M>5.0 seismic catalog triggers.
Cascadia（ALBH）及新西兰Hikurangi俯冲带7个GeoNet台站的东向GNSS时间序列与USGS地震目录…
Autonomously predicted the 2024 M5.8 earthquake timing with an error of -6.09 ± 3.42 days across 100 windows, while doubling the regional predictability horizon to 37.9 ± 4.3 days.
以-6.09±3.42天误差自主预测2024年M5.8地震，并将区域可预测性极限翻倍至37.9±4.3天。
The macroscopic 1D model lacks spatial degrees of freedom for localized asperities or rupture hindrance, and does not yet integrate network coordinates for epicenter triangulation.
宏观1D模型缺乏局部凹凸体破裂受阻的空间自由度，且未整合台网坐标反演震中。

Uses a thermo-poro-mechanical PDE framework as a physics-based filter to remove correlated flicker noise and isolate a low-dimensional deterministic attractor, enabling week-ahead deterministic seismic forecasting.
将多物理场耦合模型作为滤波器滤除闪烁噪声并提取低维确定性吸引子，实现提前一周的确定性地震预测。

kc: Developed a thermo-poro-mechanical physics-based filter that isolates low-dimensional deterministic 3D attractors from noisy GNSS slow slip displacement data.
Created an automated modal optimization pipeline using a first-order relaxation ODE and Differential Evolution to capture bimodal deep and shallow SSE transitions in the Hikurangi margin.
Demonstrated autonomous seismic forecasting of the 2024 M5.8 Hikurangi earthquake with an accuracy of -6.09 ± 3.42 days using local linear K-Nearest Neighbors phase space projection.
Established via Maximum Lyapunov Exponent analysis that the physics-based manifold doubles the regional predictability horizon to 37.9 ± 4.3 days with decadal stability.
开发了基于热-孔隙-力学模型的物理滤波器，从含噪GNSS慢滑移位移数据中提取出低维确定性三维吸引子。
构建了结合一阶弛豫常微分方程与差分进化算法的自动模态优化流程，捕捉Hikurangi俯冲带深浅部双模态慢滑移转换。
利用局部线性K近邻相空间投影实现了对2024年M5.8地震的自主预测，时间误差为-6.09 ± 3.42天。
通过最大李雅普诺夫指数分析证实，物理流形将区域可预测性极限翻倍至37.9 ± 4.3天，并具有十年尺度的稳定性。
me: 1D thermo-poro-mechanical coupled PDE modeling of serpentine dehydration, temperature, and pore pressure solved via rational spectral collocation.
Automated seismic trigger selection using a 14-day rolling-median saliency filter (2.5 mm threshold) and Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) validation.
Reduced-order modal weight relaxation ODE optimized via a 15-trajectory Differential Evolution ensemble.
Phase space reconstruction using Takens' Embedding Theorem, Mutual Average Information, False Nearest Neighbors, and PCA rotation.

Deterministic trajectory projection using station-adaptive local linear K-Nearest Neighbors with tricube weighting and Ridge regularization, evaluated by the Rosenstein Maximum Lyapunov Exponent algorithm.
采用有理谱配点法求解描述蛇纹石脱水、温度与孔隙压力演化的1D热-孔隙-力学耦合偏微分方程。
利用14天滑动中值显著性滤波器（2.5毫米阈值）和赤池信息量准则（AIC）进行自动地震触发事件筛选。
通过15轨差分进化集合优化一阶模态权重弛豫常微分方程（ODE）。
基于Takens嵌入定理、互平均信息、伪近邻法和主成分分析（PCA）旋转进行相空间重构。
结合三次方核加权与岭回归正则化的站点自适应局部线性K近邻（KNN）算法进行相空间轨迹预测，并用Rosenstein算法计算最大李雅普诺夫指数。
de: GNSS displacement time series from station ALBH in Cascadia and seven East Coast cluster stations (GISB, KOKO, MAHI, PAWA, CKID, CNST, PORA) in New Zealand from the GeoNet network (dating back to 2002).
USGS ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog (ComCat) for regional events M > 5.0 within a 300 km radius.
Pre-computed numerical strain rate pulses representing diffusion-dominated (red) and heat-generation-dominated (black) limit cycles.
Walk-forward forecasting and temporal jittering stability tests across five tectonic epochs (2016 M7.0, 2016 M5.9, 2018 quiet control, 2021 M7.3, and 2024 M5.8).
Cascadia俯冲带ALBH站以及新西兰GeoNet网络东海岸簇7个GNSS站（GISB, KOKO, MAHI, PAWA, CKID, CNST, PORA，自2002年起）的位移时间序列。
USGS综合地震目录（ComCat）中300公里半径内M > 5.0的区域地震事件。
预先计算的代表扩散主导（红模）和产热主导（黑模）极限环的数值应变率脉冲。
跨越5个构造时期（2016年M7.0、2016年M5.9、2018年平静控制期、2021年M7.3和2024年M5.8）的前向滚动预测与时间抖动稳定性测试。
li: The macroscopic 1D physical model lacks spatial degrees of freedom for localized rupture hindrance, causing amplitude deviations at distant stations like PAWA.
Station reconstructions are processed independently without a spatially coordinated network grid for triangulation and epicenter inversion.
宏观1D物理模型缺乏局部破裂受阻的空间自由度，导致远场台站（如PAWA）预测与观测位移幅值存在偏差。
各台站独立处理，尚未建立用于三角测量和震中反演的空间协同台网网格。

tm.why: The paper models slow slip events in subduction zones using a thermo-poro-mechanical framework driven by serpentine dehydration reactions.
The study pairs physics-based manifold reconstruction with Differential Evolution ensemble optimization and a K-Nearest Neighbors algorithm to forecast seismic events.
The framework addresses deterministic seismic forecasting, predicting an M5.8 earthquake one week early with a 5-6 week predictability horizon.

ev.notes: Full 44-page arXiv PDF (including main text, 5 main figures, supplementary methods/text, 7 supplementary figures, and 8 supplementary tables) was analyzed.

sum: This study documents the global prevalence of anti-similar earthquakes—events with nearly identical but polarity-flipped waveforms—at intermediate depths. The authors identify new occurrences in Colombia (beyond the Bucaramanga Nest), the Alaska subduction zone, and the Vrancea nest in Romania. Combined with existing observations from Japan and Chile, these findings suggest that anti-similar sequences are a characteristic feature of intermediate-depth seismicity. The authors propose that these events are driven by either conjugate faulting (potentially promoted by eclogitization-induced stresses) or sub-parallel faulting. This work expands our understanding of intermediate-depth earthquake physics and faulting mechanisms.
本研究揭示了中源深度反相似地震（即波形几乎相同但极性相反的地震）的全球普适性。作者在哥伦比亚（除布卡拉曼加巢外的新区域）、阿拉斯加俯冲带和罗马尼亚弗朗恰（Vrancea）地震巢中发现了新的反相似地震。结合日本和智利的已有报道，这些新观测表明反相似地震序列可能是中源地震的特征性过程。其物理机制可解释为……

t: Waveform similarity and polarity inversion analysis to identify event pairs with nearly identical but flipped waveforms.
利用波形相似度和极性反转分析来识别波形几乎相同但相反的地震对。
Seismic waveform datasets from intermediate-depth zones in Colombia, Alaska, and Romania.
来自哥伦比亚、阿拉斯加和罗马尼亚中源地震带的地震波形数据集。
Discovery of new anti-similar earthquake sequences in Colombia, Alaska, and Romania, proving their global prevalence.
在哥伦比亚、阿拉斯加和罗马尼亚发现了新的反相似地震序列，证实了其全球普适性。
Difficulty in uniquely distinguishing between conjugate and sub-parallel faulting mechanisms.
难以唯一确定是共轭断层机制还是次平行断层机制。
First systematic documentation of the global prevalence of intermediate-depth anti-similar earthquakes beyond localized studies.
首次系统性地证明了中源反相似地震在地球范围内的普遍存在，而非局限于个别地区。

kc: Identified new intermediate-depth anti-similar earthquake sequences in Colombia, Alaska, and Romania.
Demonstrated that anti-similar earthquakes are a globally prevalent, characteristic feature of intermediate-depth seismicity.
Proposed conjugate faulting (linked to eclogitization) and sub-parallel faulting as the primary physical mechanisms.
在哥伦比亚、阿拉斯加和罗马尼亚发现了新的中源反相似地震序列。
证明了反相似地震是中源地震活动中一种全球普遍存在的特征性现象。
提出了共轭断层作用（与榴辉岩化相关）和次平行断层作用作为其主要物理机制。
me: Waveform similarity and polarity analysis to identify anti-similar earthquake pairs.
Seismicity cluster analysis at intermediate depths in subduction zones.
利用波形相似度与极性分析来识别反相似地震对。
对俯冲带中源地震活动进行群集分析。
de: Seismic waveform data from intermediate-depth earthquake nests and subduction zones in Colombia, Alaska, and Romania.
来自哥伦比亚、阿拉斯加和罗马尼亚中源地震巢及俯冲带的地震波形数据。
li: The exact physical mechanism (conjugate vs. sub-parallel faulting) remains difficult to distinguish without higher-resolution focal mechanisms.
Observations are limited to highly productive intermediate-depth seismic nests.
在缺乏更高分辨率震源机制解的情况下，难以明确区分共轭断层与次平行断层这两种物理机制。
观测目前仍局限于高活动性的中源地震巢。

tm.why: The paper investigates anti-similar earthquakes, which represent conjugate or sub-parallel faulting mechanisms at intermediate depths.
It documents and detects new occurrences of anti-similar earthquake sequences across multiple global subduction zones.
It links intermediate-depth seismicity to geodynamic processes such as eclogitization-induced stresses in subducting slabs.

ev.notes: Analyzed the paper based on the provided abstract and Google CSE search results indicating the paper's structure (3 figures, 3 tables). Since no PDF was available, figure analyses and source anchors are omitted.

sum: This theoretical paper introduces a variational-adjoint interpretation of quantum mechanics, where the interaction between forward and adjoint wavefunctions defines a general Fréchet sensitivity kernel. This framework demonstrates that the Born probability density is a special, positive-definite case of these sensitivity kernels when the adjoint wavefunction is the complex conjugate of the forward wavefunction. The formulation extends to other quantum observables such as momentum, energy, and spin, framing them as Fréchet sensitivity kernels. This work bridges concepts from geophysical inverse theory (adjoint state methods, sensitivity kernels) with quantum mechanics, offering potential applications in quantum control, quantum metrology, and time-symmetric quantum interpretations.
本文提出量子力学的变分伴随解释，利用前向与伴随波函数的相互作用定义Fréchet敏感核。研究表明，波恩概率密度仅是伴随波函数为前向波函数共轭时的特例。该框架可推广至动量、能量和自旋等量子观测物理量，建立了地球物理反演（伴随状态法）与量子力学的理论联系，在量子控制和精密测量中具有应用前景。

t: A variational-adjoint framework defining the interaction between forward and adjoint wavefunctions to construct Fréchet sensitivity kernels for quantum observables.
利用前向与伴随波函数相互作用定义量子观测物理量Fréchet敏感核的变分伴随框架。
No physical datasets are used; the study relies on theoretical mathematical derivations of quantum mechanics equations.
未使用物理数据集，研究完全依赖于量子力学方程的理论数学推导。
Shows that Born probability is a special positive-definite Fréchet kernel, and extends this sensitivity formulation to momentum, energy, and spin.
证明波恩概率是特殊的正定Fréchet核，并将该敏感性公式推广至动量、能量和自旋。
The formulation is currently theoretical and requires practical implementation in quantum control or metrology applications.
该公式目前仅停留在理论阶段，需要在量子控制或测量中进行实际应用。
Interpreting quantum wavefunctions and observables through the lens of geophysical-style variational-adjoint sensitivity kernels.
从地球物理变分伴随敏感核的角度重新解释量子波函数和观测物理量。

kc: Introduces a novel variational-adjoint interpretation of quantum mechanics.
Formulates quantum observables (momentum, energy, spin) as Fréchet sensitivity kernels.
Demonstrates that the Born probability density is a special positive-definite case of Fréchet sensitivity kernels.
Establishes a theoretical link between adjoint-based sensitivity analysis (common in seismology) and quantum mechanics.
提出了一种新型的量子力学变分伴随解释框架。
将动量、能量、自旋等量子观测物理量公式化为Fréchet敏感核。
证明了波恩概率密度是Fréchet敏感核在特定条件下的正定特例。
建立了伴随敏感性分析（地球物理常用方法）与量子力学之间的理论联系。
me: Variational-adjoint formulation of wavefunctions.
Fréchet sensitivity kernel derivation for quantum operators.
波函数的变分伴随公式化方法。
量子算符的Fréchet敏感核推导。
de: Theoretical derivations and conceptual proofs of quantum observables as sensitivity kernels.
量子观测物理量作为敏感核的理论推导与概念证明。
li: The framework is purely theoretical and lacks experimental validation in quantum systems.
该框架目前纯属理论推导，缺乏在实际量子系统中的实验验证。

tm.why: The paper reformulates quantum mechanics observables using variational-adjoint methods and Fréchet sensitivity kernels, which are core mathematical concepts in geophysical inverse theory.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the arXiv abstract and metadata.

sum: Continuous magmatic records capturing slab thermal perturbations from slab tearing are scarce. This study analyzes K-Sr-Nd isotopes of basalts from four Aeolian arc islands and K isotopes of Ionian subducting plate sediments, alongside compiled regional geochemical data across the Italian Peninsula. The authors identify an abrupt shift at Stromboli volcano ~13,000 years ago, marked by potassium-rich lavas with elevated δ41K and enriched Sr-Nd isotopes. Batch and Rayleigh fractionation modeling shows pre-13 ka rocks reflect bulk addition of dehydrated sediment in a cold subduction setting, whereas post-13 ka rocks require high-temperature sediment melting (supercritical fluids). This cold-to-hot slab transition is linked to sub-slab asthenospheric upwelling through a slab tear formed in the early Pleistocene (~1–2 Ma), demonstrating a rapid (<1–2 Myr) magmatic response and explaining the southeastward progression of K-rich volcanism across Italy.
本研究分析了伊奥利亚弧四个火山岛玄武岩的K-Sr-Nd同位素及俯冲沉积物的K同位素，并汇编了意大利半岛火山地球化学数据。结合瑞利与批式分馏模型，发现Stromboli火山在约1.3万年前突然出现富钾岩浆，其高δ41K和富集Sr-Nd同位素指示高温沉积物熔融（超临界流体）；而1.3万年前的岩石则反映冷……

t: Measured K-Sr-Nd isotopes in Aeolian basalts and Ionian sediments using MC-ICP-MS and TIMS, combined with batch and Rayleigh isotope fractionation modeling during slab dehydration and melting.
利用MC-ICP-MS和TIMS测定玄武岩与沉积物K-Sr-Nd同位素，并结合板片脱水与熔融分馏模型。
Basaltic rock samples from Alicudi, Filicudi, Salina, and Stromboli, DSDP Site 374 sediments, and compiled GEOROC geochemical and eruption age datasets across the Italian Peninsula.
伊奥利亚弧四岛玄武岩、DSDP 374站位沉积物，以及意大利半岛GEOROC地球化学和喷发年龄汇编数据。

Post-13 ka Stromboli lavas show abrupt K enrichment (K2O/Na2O > 1), elevated δ41K (-0.39‰ to -0.34‰), and enriched Sr-Nd isotopes, demonstrating high-temperature sediment melting triggered within <1–2 Myr of slab tearing.
13 ka以来Stromboli熔岩富钾、δ41K升高且Sr-Nd富集，证实板片撕裂在1–2百万年内引发高温沉积物熔融。
Potassium isotope fractionation during high-temperature sediment melting is poorly constrained, and temporal geochemical data in the Roman and Campania provinces remain limited.
沉积物熔融过程中的钾同位素分馏约束不足，且Roman和Campania地区数据有限。
Provides the first continuous temporal magmatic record and K-isotope constraint capturing a rapid (<1–2 Myr) cold-to-hot slab thermal transition driven by sub-slab mantle upwelling.
首次提供捕捉板片下地幔上涌驱动冷-热板片快速转换的连续时间岩浆记录与钾同位素证据。

kc: Documented an abrupt geochemical and K-Sr-Nd isotopic shift at Stromboli volcano around 13 ka BP marking a transition from bulk sediment addition to high-temperature sediment melting.
Demonstrated that sub-slab asthenospheric upwelling through an early Pleistocene slab tear heated the cold Ionian slab within 1–2 million years.
Connected the southeastward younging of low-K to high-K magmatic transitions across the Italian Peninsula to lateral propagation of slab tearing.
揭示了Stromboli火山在约13 ka BP发生的地球化学与K-Sr-Nd同位素突变，标志着从整体沉积物加入到高温沉积物熔融的转变。
证实了早更新世板片撕裂引发的板片下软流圈上涌在1–2百万年内快速加热了原本寒冷的Ionian俯冲板片。
将意大利半岛从低钾到高钾岩浆作用的向东南变年轻趋势与板片撕裂的横向扩展联系起来。
me: High-precision potassium isotope (δ41K) analysis via collision-cell MC-ICP-MS and Sr-Nd isotope analysis via TIMS.
Batch and Rayleigh K isotope fractionation modeling during deep subduction zone sediment dehydration and supercritical fluid generation.
Spatiotemporal synthesis of major/trace element, radiogenic isotope, and eruption age data from the GEOROC database and geological memoirs.
利用碰撞池MC-ICP-MS进行高精度钾同位素（δ41K）分析，以及利用TIMS进行Sr-Nd同位素分析。
开展俯冲带深部沉积物脱水与超临界流体生成过程中的批式与瑞利钾同位素分馏数值模拟。
综合GEOROC数据库和地质专著中的主微量元素、放射性同位素及喷发年龄数据进行时空演化分析。
de: Fresh basalt samples from four Aeolian islands (Alicudi, Filicudi, Salina, Stromboli) and marine sediment cores from DSDP Site 374 on the Ionian plate.
Compiled dataset of major/trace elements, Sr-Nd isotopes, and stratigraphic eruption ages for volcanic provinces across the Italian Peninsula (Tuscany, Roman, Campania, Aeolian).
来自伊奥利亚弧四个岛屿（Alicudi、Filicudi、Salina、Stromboli）的新鲜玄武岩样品，以及Ionian板块DSDP 374站位的海洋沉积物岩芯。
汇编的意大利半岛各岩浆省（Tuscany、Roman、Campania、Aeolian）火山岩的主微量元素、Sr-Nd同位素及地层喷发年龄数据集。
li: Potassium isotope fractionation behavior during high-pressure sediment melting and supercritical fluid generation is not experimentally constrained and relies on assumed fractionation factors.
Geochronological and geochemical data in the Roman and Campania magmatic provinces are relatively sparse, requiring further sampling to tightly constrain transition timings.
高压下沉积物熔融和超临界流体生成过程中的钾同位素分馏行为缺乏实验约束，依赖于假设的分馏系数。
Roman和Campania岩浆省的年代学与地球化学数据相对有限，需要进一步采样以精确约束转变时间。

tm.why: The paper investigates slab tearing, sub-slab asthenospheric mantle upwelling, and slab thermal transitions in the Aeolian subduction zone.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF analyzed, including text, figures, and methods.

sum: Assessing seismic hazard in densely populated intraplate urban regions like the Seoul metropolitan area is challenging due to low seismicity rates and obscured surface fault traces. This study constructs a high-resolution 3-D S-wave velocity model down to 40 km depth using data from 74 broadband seismic stations. The authors jointly invert relative teleseismic S-wave travel times (3,837 picks from 229 events), ambient-noise Rayleigh-wave group and phase velocities (1–10 s), and Helmholtz-tomography phase velocities (10–30 s). The model reveals three prominent low-velocity anomalies (L1, L2, L3) corresponding to major fault zones. L1 represents a ~15 km deep southwestward extension of the Pocheon Fault hosting recent earthquake swarms, truncated by a high-velocity gneiss barrier. L2 delineates a deep shear zone (15–40 km) linking the Wangsukcheon and Singal faults, while L3 images the Gyeonggang Fault dipping ~60° NW into the upper mantle for the first time.
本研究利用首尔大都市区74个宽频带台站数据，联合反演远震S波相对走时、背景噪声瑞利波群速度与相速度（1–10 s）以及亥姆霍兹层析成像相速度（10–30 s），构建了深度达40 km的高分辨率三维S波速度模型。研究发现了三个与主要断层相关的显著低速异常（L1、L2、L3）：L1代表抱川断层向西南延伸……

t: Joint LSQR inversion of teleseismic S-wave relative travel times, ambient-noise Rayleigh-wave group/phase velocities (1–10 s), and Helmholtz phase velocities (10–30 s) on a spherical triangular tessellation grid (5 km regional, 3 km Seoul).
基于球面三角剖分网格，采用LSQR联合反演远震S波相对走时与1–30 s瑞利波群速度和相速度。

Waveforms from 74 broadband stations across Seoul (2018–2021), yielding 3,837 teleseismic S-wave arrival times from 229 events, 962 group and 1,822 phase velocity paths (1–10 s), and 1,859 Helmholtz phase velocity paths (10–30 s).
74个宽频带台站记录的3,837条远震S波走时、962条群速度和3,681条相速度频散路径。

Resolved three major low-velocity fault anomalies to 40 km depth: L1 (≤15 km) along the Pocheon Fault hosting CS2 swarm, L2 (15–40 km) linking Wangsukcheon and Singal faults, and L3 dipping ~60° NW along Gyeonggang Fault.
揭示三个深达40 km的低速带：抱川断层延伸段L1、深部剪切带L2及西北倾角60°的京江断层L3。

Amplitude recovery and spatial resolution degrade along peripheral profiles (G1–g1, G2–g2, and northern transects A–a, B–b) due to sparser station coverage, and velocity interpretations remain inherently non-unique.
研究区边缘剖面受台站稀疏影响分辨率下降，且波速异常解释存在多解性。

First high-resolution joint body- and surface-wave tomographic model beneath Seoul that images the 60° NW-dipping Gyeonggang Fault to 40 km depth and maps deep extensions of the Pocheon and Wangsukcheon faults.
首次通过体波与面波联合反演清晰成像京江断层60°西北倾角及抱川、旺宿川断层深部延伸。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution 3-D S-wave velocity model down to 40 km depth beneath the Seoul metropolitan area by jointly inverting teleseismic S-wave travel times and broadband Rayleigh-wave dispersion (1–30 s).

Identified a shallow low-velocity zone (L1, ≤15 km) as the southwestward extension of the Pocheon Fault associated with the northern Seoul earthquake swarm (CS2), bounded by a rigid banded-gneiss barrier.
Resolved a deep low-velocity shear zone (L2, 15–40 km) linking the Wangsukcheon and Singal faults at depth, and imaged for the first time the ~60° NW-dipping geometry of the Gyeonggang Fault (L3).
通过联合反演远震S波走时和宽频带瑞利波频散数据（1–30 s），构建了首尔大都市区地下40 km深度的高分辨率三维S波速度模型。
识别出与首尔北部震群（CS2）相关的浅部低速异常（L1，≤15 km），证实其为抱川断层向西南的延伸，并受控于高波速条带状片麻岩屏障。
揭示了深部15–40 km处连接旺宿川与新葛断层的深部剪切带（L2），并首次成像了向西北倾角约60°、延伸至上地幔的京江断层（L3）。
me: Multi-Channel Cross-Correlation (MCCC) applied to 229 teleseismic events (Mw ≥ 5.5) to measure relative S-wave arrival time residuals.

Ambient-noise cross-correlation with Frequency-Time Normalization (FTN) and Automatic Frequency-Time Analysis (AFTA) to extract 1–10 s Rayleigh-wave group and phase velocities, combined with 10–30 s Helmholtz phase velocities.

Least-squares (LSQR) 3-D joint inversion parameterized on a spherical triangular tessellation grid (5 km regional spacing, 3 km finer spacing in Seoul) with L-curve regularization and Moho/hypocenter adjustments.
对229个远震事件（Mw ≥ 5.5）应用多道互相关（MCCC）方法，测量相对S波到时残差。
结合频率-时间归一化（FTN）与自动频时分析（AFTA）对背景噪声进行互相关，提取1–10 s瑞利波群速度和相速度，并融合10–30 s亥姆霍兹相速度数据。
基于球面三角剖分网格（区域5 km间距、首尔加密至3 km间距），采用LSQR算法和L曲线正则化进行三维联合反演，同时反演莫霍面深度与震源参数微调。
de: Waveform recordings from 74 broadband seismic stations (3 KIGAM permanent, 11 KMA permanent, 60 Yonsei temporary stations) operated between July 2018 and May 2021.

3,837 relative teleseismic S-wave arrival times (July 2018–May 2020), plus 962 group velocity and 1,822 phase velocity ray paths (1–10 s) from one year of ambient noise (May 2020–May 2021), supplemented by 1,859 phase velocity paths (10–30 s).
Horizontal and vertical checkerboard resolution tests (15×15 km regional, 8×8 km in Seoul) and synthetic structural recovery tests for anomalies L1, L2, and L3.
2018年7月至2021年5月期间部署在首尔大都市区的74个宽频带地震台站（3个KIGAM固定台、11个KMA固定台、60个延世大学流动台）波形记录。
水平与垂直检测板分辨率测试（区域15×15 km，首尔8×8 km）以及针对L1、L2和L3异常体的合成结构恢复测试。
li: Seismic velocity is inherently non-unique and can reflect variations in lithology, porosity, temperature, or fluid content rather than solely fault damage.
Spatial resolution degrades near the edges of the array with sparse station coverage, notably along northern transects (A–a, B–b) and distal Gyeonggang Fault profiles (G1–g1, G2–g2).
地震波速度本身具有非唯一性，低速异常可能同时受岩性、孔隙度、温度或流体含量变化的影响。
台站覆盖稀疏的边缘区域空间分辨率有所下降，特别是北部剖面（A–a、B–b）以及远离首尔的京江断层剖面（G1–g1、G2–g2）。

tm.why: The study performs a 3-D joint inversion of teleseismic S-wave relative travel times and Rayleigh-wave phase and group velocity dispersion curves.
Short-period Rayleigh-wave group and phase velocities (1–10 s) are extracted from one year of continuous vertical-component ambient noise cross-correlations.
The paper resolves 3-D S-wave velocity structure and deep fault geometries extending from the shallow crust down to 40 km depth into the uppermost mantle.

ev.notes: Full 23-page Accepted Manuscript PDF from Scientific Reports was analyzed, including text, equations, references, and all 5 main figures.

sum: This study presents an integrated framework coupling 1D nonlinear free-field ground-response analysis with 3D soil-pile-bridge finite-element modeling to evaluate a pile-supported bridge in the liquefiable alluvial basin of Sakarya, Türkiye. Using data from seven boreholes with SPT and laboratory testing, the authors quantified liquefaction triggering (up to 0.33 m volumetric settlement) and static consolidation settlements (0.55–0.79 m). Seven NGA-West2 ground motion records were spectrally matched to a deterministic Mw 7.2 target spectrum and propagated through DEEPSOIL to derive relative free-field horizontal displacements (~0.43 m). Imposing these displacement demands onto a 3D Mohr-Coulomb model in MIDAS GTS NX yielded peak pile axial, shear, and bending forces (5.75 MN, 2.93 MN, and 3.08 MN·m) concentrated at the stiff-to-liquefiable soil interface. The novelty lies in directly transferring deformation-controlled 1D nonlinear demands into a 3D soil-structure interaction model, guiding local transverse reinforcement design while eliminating residual settlement via rock-socketed piles.
本研究提出了一种将一维非线性自由场场地响应分析与三维土-桩-桥有限元建模相结合的综合框架，用于评估土耳其萨卡里亚可液化冲积盆地中的桩基桥梁。基于7个钻孔的标准贯入试验（SPT）和室内试验数据，量化了液化触发（体积沉降达0.33 m）和固结沉降（0.55–0.79 m）。选取7条匹配Mw 7.2目标谱……

t: Couples 1D nonlinear site-response analysis (DEEPSOIL) of spectrally matched ground motions with a 3D Mohr-Coulomb finite-element soil-pile-bridge model (MIDAS GTS NX) using displacement-driven free-field boundaries and explicit pile-soil interfaces.
将匹配目标谱的一维非线性场地响应（DEEPSOIL）与位移驱动的三维Mohr-Coulomb土-桩-桥有限元模型（MID…

Seven boreholes (215 m total depth) with SPT and laboratory tests along the Adapazarı–Karasu highway in Sakarya, Türkiye, plus seven NGA-West2 earthquake records matched to a deterministic Mw 7.2 target spectrum.
土耳其萨卡里亚7个钻孔（总深215 m）的SPT与室内试验数据，以及匹配Mw 7.2目标谱的7条NGA-West2强震记…

Liquefaction volumetric settlements reach 0.33 m and consolidation settlements 0.55–0.79 m. Coupled 3D analysis yields ~0.43 m free-field horizontal displacement and peak pile axial (5.75 MN), shear (2.93 MN), and bending (3.08 MN·m) forces at the stiff-liquefiable interface.
液化沉降达0.33 m，固结沉降0.55–0.79 m；自由场水平位移约0.43 m，桩峰值轴力5.75 MN、剪力2.…

Assumes 1D vertically propagating shear waves, a single critical soil profile (SK-3) in 3D, decoupled Mohr-Coulomb continuum without pore-pressure coupling in 3D, and lacks field dynamic instrumentation.
假设一维垂直剪切波、三维采用单一最不利剖面与解耦Mohr-Coulomb模型，且缺乏现场动力监测标定。

Directly couples deformation-controlled 1D nonlinear free-field displacement demands with a 3D soil-pile-bridge finite-element model, capturing internal force concentrations at stratigraphic stiffness transitions that decoupled models miss.
直接耦合变形控制的一维非线性自由场位移需求与三维土-桩-桥有限元模型，捕捉地层刚度突变处的内力集中。

kc: Developed an explicit 1D-to-3D coupling workflow linking nonlinear free-field site response (DEEPSOIL) with 3D soil-pile-bridge finite element analysis (MIDAS GTS NX).
Characterized subsurface stratigraphy, liquefaction triggering (up to 0.33 m settlement), and consolidation settlements (0.55–0.79 m) across 7 boreholes in the Adapazarı–Karasu corridor.
Demonstrated that peak pile shear forces (2.93 MN) and bending moments (3.08 MN·m) concentrate at the stratigraphic stiffness transition between stiff and liquefiable layers.

Designed a rock-socketed pile foundation (1.2 m diameter, 40 m length) with locally enhanced transverse stirrup reinforcement (Ø14/10) that reduces residual foundation settlement to a few millimeters.
开发了将一维非线性自由场场地响应（DEEPSOIL）与三维土-桩-桥有限元分析（MIDAS GTS NX）显式耦合的分析流程。
基于7个钻孔数据，表征了Adapazarı–Karasu走廊的地层结构、液化触发（沉降达0.33 m）及固结沉降（0.55–0.79 m）。
证明了桩身峰值剪力（2.93 MN）和弯矩（3.08 MN·m）集中在硬土层与可液化层之间的刚度过渡带。
设计了局部加密箍筋（Ø14/10）的嵌岩桩基础（直径1.2 m，长40 m），将残余基础沉降控制在几毫米以内。
me: SPT-based simplified liquefaction triggering assessment (Youd and Idriss 2001; TBEC 2018) and post-liquefaction volumetric settlement calculation using LiqSVs.
Analytical and 1D numerical (Settle3D) consolidation settlement evaluation under embankment loading.
Deterministic seismic hazard analysis (Mw 7.2 scenario on NAFZ) using NGA-West2 GMPEs and spectral matching of 7 strong-motion records.
1D nonlinear site-response modeling in DEEPSOIL using Darendeli curves, MRDF, and GQ/H constitutive models to compute relative displacement profiles.
3D finite-element soil-pile-structure interaction modeling in MIDAS GTS NX using a Mohr-Coulomb continuum, explicit pile-soil interface elements, and Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer free-field boundaries.
基于SPT的简化液化触发评估（Youd and Idriss 2001；TBEC 2018）及利用LiqSVs计算液化后体积沉降。
路堤荷载作用下的解析法与一维数值法（Settle3D）固结沉降评估。
采用NGA-West2地面运动预测方程（GMPE）进行确定性地震危险性分析（NAFZ上的Mw 7.2情景）及7条强震记录的谱匹配。
在DEEPSOIL中结合Darendeli曲线、MRDF和GQ/H本构模型进行一维非线性场地响应建模，计算相对位移剖面。
在MIDAS GTS NX中采用Mohr-Coulomb连续介质、显式桩-土界面单元和Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer自由场边界进行三维有限元土-桩-结构相互作用建模。
de: Seven geotechnical boreholes (SK-1 to SK-7, cumulative depth 215 m) with in-situ Standard Penetration Tests (SPT) and rock coring.
Laboratory geotechnical and geomechanical testing (Atterberg limits, natural water content, undrained shear strength, uniaxial compressive strength, point load index).
Seventeen candidate NGA-West2 strong-motion records screened down to 7 horizontal accelerograms (Erzincan, Kobe, Düzce, Tottori, Bam, Parkfield, Darfield).
7个岩土工程钻孔（SK-1至SK-7，累计深度215 m），包含原位标准贯入试验（SPT）和岩石取芯。
室内岩土与岩石力学试验（阿太堡界限、天然含水率、不排水抗剪强度、单轴抗压强度、点荷载强度指数）。
从NGA-West2数据库的17条候选强震记录中筛选出7条水平加速度记录（Erzincan、Kobe、Düzce、Tottori、Bam、Parkfield、Darfield）。
li: 1D free-field site response assumes vertically propagating shear waves, neglecting 2D/3D basin-edge wave propagation effects.
A single representative critical borehole profile (SK-3) was used for the 3D finite-element model rather than a fully spatially variable 3D stratigraphy.
The 3D soil continuum uses an elastic-perfectly plastic Mohr-Coulomb model driven by prescribed displacements rather than a fully coupled effective-stress pore-pressure model.
No site-specific dynamic instrumentation, inclinometer, centrifuge, or shaking-table data were available for direct empirical calibration.
一维自由场场地响应假设剪切波垂直传播，忽略了二维/三维盆地边缘波传播效应。
三维有限元模型采用了单一的代表性最不利钻孔剖面（SK-3），而非完全空间可变的三维地层模型。
三维土体连续介质采用位移驱动的理想弹塑性Mohr-Coulomb模型，而非完全耦合的有效应力孔隙水压力模型。
缺乏场地特定的动力监测仪器、测斜仪、离心机或振动台数据进行直接标定。

tm.why: The study performs deterministic seismic hazard analysis, ground motion spectral matching, nonlinear site-response modeling, and liquefaction evaluation for bridge foundations.
It couples 1D nonlinear shear-wave propagation (DEEPSOIL) with 3D finite-element continuum modeling (MIDAS GTS NX) using transmitting boundary conditions.

ev.notes: Full 65-page manuscript PDF (Scientific Reports Article in Press) including all 17 figures and 7 tables was analyzed.

sum: Traditional structural damage identification relies on finite element (FE) model updating, modal identification, or supervised machine learning. This paper introduces a training-free, data-driven framework that constructs a fully connected sensor network using pairwise spatial correlations (Pearson and Spearman) of accelerometer time histories. Damage is localized by tracking edge-weight drops relative to an undamaged baseline. Validated on a full-scale seven-story reinforced-concrete building tested on the UCSD shake table across four earthquake damage states and one brace-modification state, the Spearman percent-drop indicator achieves strong rank agreement (mean rho = 0.79, and 0.86–0.94 for moderate-to-severe states) with published FE updating results. Furthermore, network weighted-degree centrality identifies the most informative reference sensors to recover the first three natural frequencies via the random decrement technique (RDT) within 3–5.5% error, while signed edge changes reveal structural response redistribution after brace stiffening where the FE parameterization is inapplicable.
本文提出一种无需训练的数据驱动建筑损伤定位方法，将传感器视为节点、加速度时程的成对空间相关性视为边权重构建传感器网络，通过相对于基线的边权重下降定位损伤。利用UCSD七层足尺钢筋混凝土剪力墙振动台试验数据（4个地震损伤状态和1个支撑加固状态）进行验证，Spearman相关性百分比下降指标在中重度损伤……

t: Constructs a weighted graph from pairwise absolute Spearman correlations of longitudinal accelerometer records, scoring substructure damage by percentage edge-weight drop relative to baseline and selecting modal reference sensors via thresholded weighted-degree centrality.
由纵向加速度计成对Spearman绝对相关性构建加权图，以边权重百分比下降定位子结构损伤，并用阈值加权度中心性优选参考传…

29 longitudinal accelerometer channels (sampled at 240 Hz) from a full-scale seven-story RC building on the UCSD shake table during 8-minute 0.03 g white-noise excitations across baseline, four earthquake damage states, and one brace-modification state.
UCSD七层足尺钢筋混凝土建筑振动台试验的29个纵向加速度通道（240 Hz），含基线、4个震损及1个支撑加固状态的8分…

Unreliable for mild damage (S1), provides relative localization rather than stiffness-loss quantification, requires a baseline state, and uses only scalar zero-lag longitudinal correlations.
对轻微损伤（S1）不可靠，仅提供相对定位而非刚度损失量化，需基线状态，且仅使用纵向零时滞标量相关。

Provides a training-free, model-free spatial-correlation network that simultaneously localizes structural damage, diagnoses brace rehabilitation redistribution, and selects optimal reference sensors for modal extraction.
提出免训练、无模型的空间相关网络，同时实现结构损伤定位、支撑加固响应重分布诊断及模态参考传感器优选。

Introduces thresholded weighted-degree centrality to select optimal reference sensors for extracting the first three natural frequencies via the random decrement technique.
Demonstrates that signed edge-weight changes capture structural response redistribution during a brace-stiffening rehabilitation state where calibrated FE models lack comparable parameters.

Damage localization scoring via one-sided percentage drop and Fisher-z transformed drop relative to the undamaged baseline state S0.
Thresholded weighted-degree centrality calculation to rank sensor coupling and trigger multi-channel random decrement technique (RDT) modal extraction.
Monte Carlo permutation tests (200,000 shuffles), digitization perturbation checks, and 30-second block baseline variability bounds for statistical validation.
基于29个纵向加速度计通道，利用Pearson、Spearman及混合相关性权重构建成对统计相关图。
通过相对于未损伤基线状态S0的单侧百分比下降和Fisher-z变换下降计算损伤定位得分。
计算阈值加权度中心性以评估传感器耦合强度，并触发多通道随机减量技术（RDT）提取模态频率。
采用蒙特卡洛置换检验（20万次）、数字化扰动检验及30秒分块基线变异性界限进行统计鲁棒性验证。

Four progressive earthquake-induced damage states (S1, S2, S3.1, S4) excited by historical records from the 1971 San Fernando and 1994 Northridge earthquakes, plus one brace-stiffened state (S3.2).
Eight-minute 0.03 g RMS white-noise base excitation records (0.25–25 Hz) sampled at 240 Hz across 29 longitudinal channels after each state.
在UCSD-NEES振动台上测试的足尺七层钢筋混凝土剪力墙建筑切片试验数据。
由1971年San Fernando和1994年Northridge历史地震记录激励产生的4个渐进损伤状态（S1、S2、S3.1、S4）及1个支撑加固状态（S3.2）。
每个状态后采集的8分钟、0.03 g RMS白噪声基底激励响应记录（0.25–25 Hz，采样率240 Hz，29个纵向通道）。

Acts as a relative localization screen rather than quantifying physical stiffness loss, and requires a structure-specific baseline reference.
Uses only scalar zero-lag correlations of longitudinal channels, omitting multidirectional responses, phase delays, and nonlinear interactions.

仅作为相对定位筛查工具而非刚度损失量化工具，且需要特定结构的参考基线。

sum: Conventional seismic waveform inversion relies on mathematical optimization, suffering from obscure physical interpretation of gradients, multi-parameter cross-coupling, and high computational costs. This paper proposes a Physical-Structure-Driven Waveform Inversion Imaging (PSDWII) framework. It decomposes seismic wave propagation into three physical stages: incident wave propagation, heterogeneity interaction generating virtual sources with specific radiation patterns, and secondary wave propagation. Using reverse-time (adjoint) extrapolation, the framework first obtains an approximate inversion of the subsurface virtual source (interpreting the adjoint wavefield physically), and then applies deconvolution and angle-domain linear inversion to remove the incident wavefield and radiation patterns. This unifies three methods without objective functions, gradients, or Hessian inverses: physical-structure-driven FWI (PSDFWI), stratigraphic physical properties imaging with angle-domain common-image gather inversion (PSDSI), and stratigraphic structures migration (PSDMig). The paradigm avoids cross-correlation-induced mathematical coupling and achieves analytical amplitude compensation equivalent to least-squares migration.
针对传统数学优化驱动的地震波形反演物理意义不明、多参数耦合严重及计算量大等问题，本文提出物理结构驱动的地震波形反演成像框架（PSDWII）。该方法将地震波传播分解为入射波传播、产生具有辐射模式的虚拟源、次生波传播三个物理过程。通过逆时（伴随）外推获得地下虚拟源的近似反演，再利用反褶积和角度域线性反演……

t: PSDWII first applies reverse-time adjoint propagation to observed secondary wavefields to invert subsurface virtual sources, then uses time-consistent deconvolution and angle-domain linear inversion to remove incident wavefields and radiation patterns.
利用逆时伴随传播重构地下虚拟源，再通过时间一致性反褶积和角度域线性反演去除入射波场与辐射模式。
This paper is a theoretical synthesis without new numerical figures; it references prior numerical validations on point scatterers, acoustic random layered models, and the Marmousi model.
纯理论框架论文，无新增图表，引用了前期在Marmousi模型、层状模型和点散射体上的数值验证。

Using reconstructed incident wavefields in the deconvolution denominator cancels forward and adjoint propagation operators (ratio approximately 1), achieving amplitude preservation equivalent to inverse Hessian compensation in least-squares migration.
重构入射波场做分母可抵消正伴随传播算子（比值近似1），解析实现等价于最小二乘偏移Hessian逆的保幅效果。

Deconvolution division is analytically exact under idealized assumptions, but requires special numerical stabilization under band-limited data, noise, limited illumination, and background velocity errors.
反褶积除法在限带数据、噪声、有限照明及背景速度误差下存在数值稳定性问题，需特殊处理。

Shifts waveform inversion from mathematical optimization to a physical-structure-driven paradigm without objective functions, gradients, or Hessian inverses, replacing cross-correlation with virtual-source deconvolution.
摒弃目标函数、梯度与Hessian求逆，用虚拟源反褶积替代互相关，实现物理结构驱动反演并消除数学耦合。

kc: Proposes the PSDWII framework based on 'two propagations + one virtual source', eliminating objective functions, gradients, and Hessian inversions.
Provides a clear physical interpretation of the adjoint wavefield as the approximate inversion of the subsurface virtual source.
Replaces traditional cross-correlation gradient updates with time-consistent deconvolution (division) to prevent mathematical multi-parameter coupling.
Formulates three unified methods: PSDFWI for velocity/density/modulus building, PSDSI for Zoeppritz-free impedance/lithology inversion, and PSDMig for true-amplitude structural reflectivity imaging.
基于“两次传播+一个虚拟源”的物理结构提出PSDWII框架，无需构建目标函数、计算梯度或Hessian矩阵求逆。
赋予伴随波场明确的物理意义，将其解释为地下虚拟源的近似反演结果。
用时间一致性的反褶积（除法）替代传统梯度法中的互相关运算，从源头上避免了多参数数学耦合。
建立了统一的三种具体方法：全波形反演（PSDFWI）、不依赖Zoeppritz方程的地层物性成像与道集反演（PSDSI）以及地层构造偏移成像（PSDMig）。
me: Decomposes wave propagation into incident wavefield forward modeling, virtual source excitation (scattering, volume reflection, or surface reflection), and secondary wavefield propagation.
Applies the adjoint propagation operator (reverse-time extrapolation) to observed secondary wavefields or residuals to reconstruct the approximate subsurface virtual source.
Uses deconvolution removal (division by the incident wavefield and wave operator derivative) and angle-domain common-image gather linear inversion to extract decoupled physical parameters.
将地震波传播分解为入射波正向传播、异质体相互作用产生虚拟源（散射、体反射或面反射）以及次生波传播三个阶段。
对观测次生波场或残差应用伴随传播算子（逆时外推），重构地下虚拟源的近似反演结果。
利用反褶积运算（除以入射波场和波算子导数）及角度域共成像点道集线性反演，提取解耦的地下物理属性参数。
de: Purely theoretical and methodological paper synthesizing a unified mathematical framework for acoustic and scalar wave equations.
References previously published numerical experiments on point scatterers, random layered acoustic models, and the Marmousi model for empirical validation.
纯理论与方法学论文，推导了声波和标量波方程下的统一数学反演成像框架。
引用了作者前期在点散射体、声波随机层状模型和Marmousi模型上的数值实验作为验证支撑。
li: Relies on idealized assumptions of time consistency and first-order Born (primary reflection) approximation.
Deconvolution (division) stability is sensitive to band-limited data, noise, limited illumination, and background velocity traveltime errors in practical engineering.
理论推导基于时间一致性和一阶Born近似（一次反射近似）的理想化假设。
反褶积（除法）运算在实际限带数据、噪声、有限照明及背景速度走时误差下的数值稳定性面临工程挑战。

tm.why: The paper develops a unified physical-structure-driven waveform inversion imaging framework (PSDWII) encompassing full-waveform inversion (PSDFWI) and reverse-time migration/imaging.

The paper reformulates the mathematical foundations of seismic waveform inversion by replacing objective-function gradient optimization and Hessian inversion with virtual-source adjoint projection and deconvolution.

ev.notes: Evaluated from the complete 16-page PDF manuscript. The paper is a purely theoretical and methodological treatise containing 51 mathematical equations and no figures or tables.

sum: This article serves as the introduction to the BSSA Special Section on 'Advancing Physics-Based Ground-Motion Simulations for Seismic Hazard Applications.' It outlines the state-of-the-art in numerical wave propagation, source characterization, and site-response modeling. The collection of papers highlights the transition from empirical ground-motion models to fully physics-based 3D simulations, addressing key challenges such as high-frequency wave propagation, computational efficiency, and validation against observed data. It emphasizes the integration of these simulations into engineering practices and seismic hazard mitigation strategies.
本文是BSSA“推进地震危险性应用中基于物理的地面运动模拟”专题的引言。文章概述了数值波动传播、震源表征和场地响应建模的最新进展。该专题收录的文章展示了从经验地面运动模型向完全基于物理的三维模拟的转变，解决了高频波传播、计算效率以及观测数据验证等关键挑战，强调了将模拟融入工程实践与防震减灾中的重要性……

t: Review and synthesis of physics-based ground-motion simulation methodologies, including deterministic 3D wave propagation and hybrid broadband techniques.
综述并综合了基于物理的地面运动模拟方法，包括确定性三维波传播和混合宽频技术。
Synthesized observations and simulated datasets from multiple studies featured in the special section.
综合了该专题中多项研究的观测数据和模拟数据集。
Highlights the growing viability and accuracy of physics-based simulations for engineering and seismic hazard applications.
突出了基于物理的模拟在工程和地震危险性应用中日益增长的可行性和准确性。
Limited to a high-level editorial overview without presenting new primary scientific data or novel algorithms.
仅限于高水平的社论概述，未提出新的原始科学数据或新算法。
Provides a comprehensive, up-to-date editorial synthesis of the state-of-the-art in physics-based ground-motion modeling for 2026.
提供了2026年基于物理的地面运动模拟最新技术水平的全面、最新的社论综合。

kc: Introduces and contextualizes a special section dedicated to physics-based ground-motion simulations.
Summarizes recent progress in numerical methods, high-performance computing, and 3D Earth models for seismic hazard.
Highlights the integration of simulated ground motions into engineering design and risk assessment.
介绍并系统化了致力于基于物理的地面运动模拟的专题。
总结了用于地震危险性分析的数值方法、高性能计算和三维地球模型的最新进展。
强调了将模拟地面运动整合到工程设计和风险评估中的重要性。
me: Review of deterministic 3D wave propagation modeling (e.g., finite-difference, spectral-element methods).
Review of hybrid broadband simulation techniques combining low-frequency deterministic and high-frequency stochastic approaches.
对确定性三维波动传播模拟（如有限差分、谱元法）的综述。
对结合低频确定性和高频随机方法的混合宽频模拟技术的综述。
de: Synthesis of various validation datasets, including historical earthquake recordings and synthetic seismograms.
对各种验证数据集的综合，包括历史地震记录和合成地震图。
li: As an introductory editorial, it does not present new independent research or specific quantitative models.
Highlights ongoing community challenges such as high-frequency simulation limits and computational costs.
作为一篇引导性社论，它没有提出新的独立研究或具体的量化模型。
指出了高频模拟限制和计算成本等持续存在的社区挑战。

tm.why: The paper is an introduction to a special section explicitly focused on ground-motion simulations for seismic hazard applications.
Physics-based ground-motion simulations heavily rely on numerical wave propagation techniques.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the metadata and editorial nature of the BSSA special section introduction.

sum: Deep learning seismic denoisers typically process either time-series waveforms or time-frequency spectrograms, each having distinct tradeoffs. This study systematically benchmarks four comparable UNet architectures trained on local Swiss earthquake recordings (EQS dataset): a time-domain (TD) model, a time-frequency domain (TFD/EQS) model, a parallel hybrid (TD+TFD) model, and a sequential hybrid (EQShyb) model. While TD preserves sharp phase onsets at high SNRs, it misses weak signals at low SNRs; conversely, TFD captures low-SNR signals but introduces acausal smearing artifacts around phase onsets. The novel sequential hybrid model EQShyb first extracts weak signals in the time-frequency domain and then refines waveforms in the time domain using multiplicative mask conditioning and a custom weighted-hinge loss. Tested on in-distribution Swiss data and out-of-distribution Italian (INSTANCE) data, EQShyb surpasses state-of-the-art benchmarks (DeepDenoiser, WaveDenoiser, CDiffSD) in waveform reconstruction, P/S phase picking (via EQTransformer and PhaseNet), and first-motion polarity classification.
本文系统评估了输入表征对深度学习地震图去噪的影响，基于瑞士近震数据集（EQS）设计并对比了四种同构UNet模型：时间域（TD）、时频域（TFD/EQS）、并行混合（TD+TFD）及顺序混合模型（EQShyb）。研究表明，TD模型在高信噪比下能保持尖锐初动但低信噪比下漏检严重；TFD模型能捕获弱信号但……

t: A sequential hybrid UNet (EQShyb) first predicts STFT masks in the time-frequency domain and then refines waveforms in the time domain using multiplicative mask conditioning and a custom weighted-hinge loss.
顺序混合UNet（EQShyb）先在时频域预测STFT掩码，再结合乘性掩码条件与自定义加权合页损失在时间域精化波形。
Models are trained on the Swiss EQS dataset (1–30 km epicentral distance, M0.0–3.5 velocity waveforms) and tested out-of-distribution on a 2019–2020 subset of the Italian INSTANCE dataset (<30 km).
在瑞士EQS近震速度波形（1–30 km，M0.0–3.5）上训练，并在意大利INSTANCE子集（<30 km）上进行…
EQShyb achieves 230 dB median noise suppression, reduces amplitude underestimation at -15 dB to ~0.1 log units on detected events, increases low-SNR phase picks >5x, and improves polarity accuracy.
EQShyb实现230 dB中位噪声抑制，-15 dB下振幅低估仅0.1对数单位，低信噪比震相拾取提升超5倍并提高极性准…
Performance degrades at very low SNRs with high spectral overlap, and the near-epicentral training data limits direct generalization to teleseismic distances or large-magnitude events.
极低信噪比及频谱重叠下性能受限；仅用近震训练，无法直接泛化至远震或大震。

First controlled benchmark isolating time, time-frequency, and hybrid domain representations in seismic denoising, introducing a sequential hybrid architecture (EQShyb) that resolves time-frequency onset smearing.
首次受控对比地震去噪中的时域、时频域与混合域表征，提出消除时频初动涂抹伪影的顺序混合架构。

kc: Systematically isolates and benchmarks the effect of input domain representation (time, time-frequency, parallel hybrid, sequential hybrid) using comparable fully convolutional UNet architectures.
Introduces EQShyb, a sequential hybrid denoiser combining time-frequency mask prediction with time-domain refinement trained via multiplicative mask conditioning and a custom weighted-hinge loss.
Demonstrates significant downstream improvements in P/S phase picking and automated first-motion polarity determination down to very low SNRs on both Swiss and out-of-distribution Italian datasets.
采用可比的纯卷积UNet架构，系统隔离并评估了输入数据表征（时间域、时频域、并行混合、顺序混合）对地震信号去噪的影响。
提出了顺序混合去噪器EQShyb，将时频域掩码预测与时间域波形精化相结合，并引入乘性掩码条件和自定义加权合页损失函数。
在瑞士数据集及意大利分布外数据集上证明了该方法在极低信噪比下显著提升了P/S波震相拾取和初动极性自动判定的性能。
me: Four fully convolutional UNet variants operating on 3-component velocity waveforms: TD, TFD (STFT-based masking), parallel TD+TFD, and sequential TFD2TD (EQShyb).
Custom refinement loss for EQShyb combining an error-weighted MAE loss (emphasizing TFD errors and ±50 samples around phase onsets) with a hinge loss enforcing ≥5% improvement over TFD.
Downstream evaluation using SeisBench implementations of EQTransformer and PhaseNet for phase picking, plus a custom CNN classifier with test-time dropout for first-motion polarity.
构建了四种处理三分量速度波形的纯卷积UNet变体：时间域（TD）、时频域（基于STFT掩码的TFD）、并行混合（TD+TFD）和顺序混合（TFD2TD/EQShyb）。
为EQShyb设计了自定义精化损失，将基于TFD误差及初动附近±50采样点加权的MAE损失与要求比TFD提升至少5%的合页损失相结合。
利用SeisBench中的EQTransformer和PhaseNet评估下游震相拾取，并训练了带测试时Dropout的轻量级CNN分类器评估初动极性判定。
de: Trained and tested in-distribution on the Swiss EQS dataset (1–30 km epicentral distance, M0.0–3.5, 100 Hz, instrument-response deconvolved velocity records).

Evaluated out-of-distribution generalization on a non-overlapping 2019–2020 subset of the Italian INSTANCE dataset (<30 km distance, M0.0–6.5) against DeepDenoiser, WaveDenoiser, CDiffSD, and unsupervised thresholding.
Evaluated across SNR steps from -15 dB to 5 dB (10,000 event-noise pairs per step) and on continuous broadband and urban strong-motion recordings in Switzerland.
在瑞士EQS数据集（震中距1–30 km，震级M0.0–3.5，100 Hz采样率，去除仪器响应的速度波形）上进行训练和分布内测试。
在意大利INSTANCE数据集的2019–2020年无重叠子集（震中距<30 km，M0.0–6.5）上进行分布外泛化评估，并与DeepDenoiser、WaveDenoiser、CDiffSD及无监督阈值法对比。
在-15 dB至5 dB信噪比区间（每步10,000对事件-噪声组合）以及瑞士宽频带和城市强震连续记录上进行了全面性能与计算效率测试。
li: Performance degrades at very low SNRs and when spectral overlap between earthquake signal and background noise is substantial, reflecting fundamental information loss.

Trained exclusively on near-epicentral (1–30 km) local earthquake recordings in Switzerland, so it is not expected to generalize directly to teleseismic distances or large-magnitude events without retraining.
在极低信噪比以及地震信号与噪声频谱高度重叠时去噪性能下降，这受限于底层信息丢失的物理极限。
模型仅在瑞士近震（震中距1–30 km）数据上训练，若不重新训练或微调，难以直接泛化至远震距离或大震级事件。

tm.why: The paper designs, trains, and benchmarks four deep learning UNet architectures for seismic waveform denoising across time, time-frequency, and hybrid domains.
The denoising models are directly evaluated on downstream earthquake detection, P and S phase picking using EQTransformer and PhaseNet, and first-motion polarity determination for catalog monitoring.

sum: Mirror-like Surfaces (MSs) in carbonate faults can form during both seismic and aseismic slip. To distinguish their origins, this study measures sterane (20S, %αββ) and hopane (22S, ββ) thermal maturity parameters in bitumen from natural MSs and underlying slip zones in bituminous dolostones from the Central Apennines, Italy. These are compared against rotary-shear experiments at seismic (1–3 m/s) and sub-seismic (0.0001 m/s) slip rates, plus static-heating experiments at 400 °C (2 s to 12 h). Results show higher thermal maturity in most natural and experimental seismic MSs compared to adjacent slip zones. Static heating alters biomarker concentrations in <30 s and increases maturity parameters after 1–5 min. Notably, frictional heating produces a distinct sterane-hopane maturation trend compared to sedimentary burial. This novel application of sterane 20S and hopane 22S biomarkers effectively identifies coseismic frictional heating pulses on fault mirrors.

Natural fault mirrors from Upper Triassic bituminous dolostones (Central Apennines, Italy; displacements 0.001–11.22 m), alongside rotary-shear experiments (0.0001, 1, and 3 m/s at 20 MPa) and 400 °C static-heating experiments (2 s to 12 h).

Static heating at 400 °C increases hopane 22S from 0.27 to 0.41 after 1 min and sterane 20S from 0.07 to 0.15 after 5 min. Seismic rotary-shear and most natural MSs show elevated maturity relative to slip zones.

sum: The uplift mechanisms and pre-Pleistocene history of the Nahuelbuta Forearc Range in the Northern Patagonian Andes have remained poorly constrained due to dense vegetation and weathering. This study integrates surface geomorphic mapping, a surface classification model, morphometric drainage analysis, and linear river-profile inversion to reconstruct the landscape evolution of the range. Results reveal a warped, low-relief relic landscape abandoned around 2.5 Ma, marking the onset of rapid rejuvenation totaling ~1400 m of cumulative uplift. River inversions resolve three main uplift pulses (2.5–1.8 Ma, 1.7–0.7 Ma, and 0.6–0 Ma) that lag Late Cenozoic Patagonian glacial expansions by ~1.0–1.2 Myr, matching the estimated sediment travel time along the subduction channel. Scaling analyses and existing seismic reflection and microseismicity data confirm that glacially modulated tectonic underplating drives long-wavelength oscillatory uplift, while ongoing north-south shortening reactivates inherited trench-perpendicular reverse faults.

Drainage networks and low-relief surfaces were extracted from the 30-m FABDEM Copernicus DEM and CHELSA climate data, calibrated using published 10Be denudation rates, fluvial incision rates, and marine terrace uplift rates.

River inversions reveal landscape rejuvenation starting at ~2.5 Ma with ~1400 m cumulative uplift across three main pulses (2.5–1.8 Ma, 1.7–0.7 Ma, and 0.6–0 Ma) reaching peak uplift rates of 1.20–1.82 mm/yr.

Provides one of the first natural examples of oscillatory forearc uplift cycles driven by glacially modulated tectonic underplating, previously predicted primarily by numerical simulations.

sum: This theoretical study cross-examines the traditional slab-pull hypothesis using six independent constraints: atomic-scale high-pressure physics, asthenospheric rheological anisotropy, subduction-zone bidirectional kinematics, asthenospheric horizontal motion, deep-focus earthquake mechanisms, and tensile versus compressive stress transmission thresholds. By synthesizing published mineral physics experiments, seismic anisotropy, focal mechanisms, and plate kinematics, the author argues that under deep-mantle pressures (>13 GPa), tensile deviatoric stress relaxes within 10²–10³ years via Maxwell relaxation and diffusional creep, and triggers self-limiting necking failure. Furthermore, outer-rise normal faulting disrupts shallow elastic continuity, deep earthquakes are shear-dominated rather than tensile, and the asthenosphere exhibits near-solid vertical compressive resistance (K ~ 10¹¹ Pa) alongside fluid-like horizontal shear impedance. While acknowledging local slab negative buoyancy, the paper concludes that long-range elastic tension over hundreds of kilometers is physically untenable, proposing horizontal tectonic compression from mid-ocean ridges and overriding plate advance as a more consistent driving framework.
本文从原子尺度高压物理、软流圈流变各向异性、俯冲带双向运动学、软流圈水平运动、全球深源地震观测及拉压应力传递差异六个独立维度，对传统远程弹性“板片拉力”假说进行交叉检验。基于已有矿物物理实验、地震各向异性及震源机制数据，研究表明深部地幔超高压（>13 GPa）下张性偏应力在10²–10³年内即发生麦……
