sum: This study investigates whether observed discrete faulting and paleoclimate histories can replicate the topographic and geomorphic characteristics of the central Nepal Himalaya. The authors integrate forward-modeled Neogene structural-kinematic reconstructions from balanced cross-sections and ECHAM5 general circulation model paleo-precipitation predictions into the CASCADE landscape evolution model over ~10 Myr. Testing three end-member scenarios (in-sequence, out-of-sequence, and out-of-sequence with climate change), the simulations confirm that motion along a few major discrete faults controls Himalayan topographic evolution, outperforming climate-driven erosional changes. The study identifies two alternating topography-generating mechanisms: lateral translation of uplifted topography during foreland fault activity, and hinterland river incision during temporary foreland fault inactivity coeval with hinterland out-of-sequence faulting. This tectonic switch reproduces the prominent physiographic transition (PT2) and the regional shift from strike-parallel to strike-perpendicular river networks.
本研究探讨了断层活动和古气候历史如何塑造尼泊尔中部喜马拉雅的地形特征。作者将基于平衡剖面的新近纪构造运动学重建与ECHAM5古降水预测相结合，输入CASCADE地表过程模型，模拟了约10 Myr的地貌演化。通过对比顺序、乱序及乱序耦合气候变化三种端元模型，证实少数大型断层的活动主导了喜马拉雅地形演化……

t: Integrates 2D structural-kinematic displacement fields from balanced cross-sections and ECHAM5 GCM paleo-precipitation into the hybrid CASCADE landscape evolution model on a remeshing TIN grid over ~10 Myr.
将平衡剖面二维运动学位移场与GCM古降水耦合至CASCADE地表过程模型，模拟10 Myr演化。

Evaluated three end-member kinematic/climatic scenarios (~9.67–10.07 Myr duration, 20 mm/yr shortening) against central Nepal 30 m DEM topography, river steepness (ksn), local relief, TRMM precipitation, and 10Be erosion rates.
测试三种构造与气候端元模型，并与尼泊尔30米DEM、河道陡度、局部起伏度及10Be侵蚀率对比。

All three models statistically replicate bulk topography (KS p = 0.14–0.18). Temporary MBT inactivity paired with hinterland OOS faulting (1.21–0.37 Ma) drives northward fluvial incision and reproduces PT2.
三种模型均统计重现了整体地形（KS p=0.14–0.18）；MBT停滞与后陆乱序断层促进了河流下切与PT2形成。

Models omit dynamic orographic precipitation, along-strike kinematic variations, lithologic variability, vegetation, and glacial erosion, leading to underestimated local relief and ksn at high elevations.
未包含动态地形雨、断层横向变化、岩性差异及冰川侵蚀，导致高海拔局部起伏度和ksn偏低。

Demonstrates that alternating foreland lateral translation and hinterland out-of-sequence faulting—rather than continuum wedge mechanics or climate change—drives Himalayan topography and drainage network geometry.
揭示前陆侧向平移与后陆乱序断层交替机制（而非连续楔理论或气候）主导了喜马拉雅地貌与水系格局。

kc: Coupled structural-kinematic reconstructions and GCM paleo-precipitation into the CASCADE surface processes model for central Nepal over 10 Myr.
Identified two alternating topography-generating modes: lateral translation during foreland thrusting and hinterland incision during out-of-sequence faulting.
Demonstrated that discrete fault kinematics, rather than climate change or pervasive small-scale faulting, primarily control Himalayan physiography and PT2.
将尼泊尔中部10 Myr以来的构造运动学重建与GCM古降水预测耦合到CASCADE地表过程模型中。
提出了两种交替的造貌机制：前陆逆冲期间的地形侧向平移与后陆乱序断层活动期间的后陆河流下切。
证明了离散断层运动学（而非气候变化或广泛的小规模断层）主导了喜马拉雅地貌和PT2的形成。
me: Coupled 2D balanced cross-section structural kinematics with the 3D CASCADE hybrid landscape evolution model.
Imposed spatially and temporally variable paleo-precipitation derived from ECHAM5 GCM time-slice simulations and Bayesian classification.
Evaluated model-data misfits against DEM-derived topography, normalized river steepness (ksn), local relief, and 10Be erosion rates using Wasserstein, Euclidean, chi-squared, and KS statistics.
将二维平衡剖面构造运动学与三维CASCADE混合地貌演化模型相耦合。
加载了由ECHAM5全球环流模型时间切片模拟和贝叶斯分类导出的时空可变古降水场。
利用Wasserstein距离、欧氏距离、卡方和KS统计量，结合DEM地形、河道陡度指数、局部起伏度和10Be侵蚀率评估模型拟合度。
de: Three primary numerical model scenarios (In-sequence, Out-of-sequence, Out-of-sequence & Climate Change) plus 11 sensitivity models varying transport coefficients and precipitation.
Observational constraints along swath AA' in central Nepal: 30 m ASTER DEM, TRMM mean annual precipitation, and published 10Be cosmogenic nuclide erosion rates.
三个主要数值模拟场景（顺序、乱序、乱序耦合气候变化）以及11个改变输运系数和降水的敏感性实验。
尼泊尔中部AA'条带的观测约束：30米分辨率ASTER DEM、TRMM年均降水量以及已发表的10Be宇宙成因核素侵蚀率。
li: Imposed precipitation lacks dynamic orographic feedbacks and GCMs neglect evolving topography and plate configurations.
Models neglect along-strike lateral variations in fault kinematics, lithological erodibility variations, vegetation, and glacial erosion.
Isostatic rebalancing in CASCADE uses a simplified tapered topography rather than full dynamic coupling.
预设降水缺乏动态地形雨反馈，且GCM未考虑演化的地形和板块构造格局。
模型忽略了断层运动学的走滑横向变化、岩性可蚀性差异、植被以及冰川侵蚀作用。
CASCADE中的均衡调整采用简化的楔形地形，而非完全动态耦合。

tm.why: The paper investigates the tectonic and structural-kinematic evolution of the Himalayan fold-thrust belt coupled with surface processes over geological time scales.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF analyzed, including text, equations, figures, and tables.

sum: This study investigates the physical mechanisms behind the patchy along-trench distribution of megathrust earthquakes and arc volcanoes in the Central American subduction zone. Using 226,185 P-wave and 114,846 S-wave local arrival times along with 359,172 teleseismic Rayleigh-wave phase-amplitude pairs (25–100 s), the authors perform a two-plane-wave phase-velocity inversion followed by a joint 3-D shear-wave velocity (Vs) tomographic inversion down to 200 km depth. The high-resolution model reveals that large megathrust earthquakes (Mw ≥ 7.0) and strongly coupled segments in Guatemala and Costa Rica coincide with high-Vs forearc asperities and subslab low-Vs anomalies (~0.4% partial melt yielding ~1 MPa buoyancy stress). Meanwhile, large arc volcanoes sit above discrete crust and mantle-wedge low-Vs zones, while slab rollback beneath Nicaragua and slab-edge asthenospheric upwelling beneath Costa Rica explain along-arc geochemical variations.
本研究结合7,417个近震的P/S波走时数据与1,362个远震的瑞利面波（25–100 s）相速度数据，通过联合反演构建了中美洲俯冲带地壳与上地幔高分辨率三维横波速度（Vs）模型。结果显示，Mw≥7.0的大逆冲地震及强闭锁区（危地马拉、哥斯达黎加）不仅对应弧前高Vs凹凸体，还位于板下低Vs异常（约0……

t: Two-plane-wave tomography is applied to teleseismic Rayleigh waves (25–100 s) to obtain phase velocities, which are then jointly inverted with local P- and S-wave arrival times for 3-D crustal and upper-mantle Vs structure.
对25–100 s远震瑞利波进行双平面波成像获取相速度，再与近震P/S波到时联合反演三维Vs结构。

226,185 P-wave and 114,846 S-wave arrival times from 7,417 local earthquakes (1990–2025, 883 stations) and 359,172 Rayleigh-wave phase-amplitude pairs (25–100 s) from 1,362 teleseismic events (2000–2020, 200 stations).
7,417个近震的P/S波到时数据（883个台站）与1,362个远震的359,172对瑞利波相位振幅数据。

Subslab low-Vs anomalies (Vs = 4.21 km/s vs. 4.43 km/s background at 100 km depth) beneath coupled Guatemala and Costa Rica segments indicate ~0.4% partial melt, generating ~1 MPa buoyancy stress across the megathrust.
强耦合区板下低Vs异常（4.21 km/s）指示约0.4%部分熔融，在板块界面产生约1 MPa浮力应力。

Seismic anisotropy is neglected in the isotropic inversion, and attributing subslab Vs reductions solely to partial melt ignores thermal/compositional effects, making the ~1 MPa stress an upper bound.
反演未考虑各向异性，且忽略温度或成分对低速异常的贡献，1 MPa应力仅为上限。

First joint inversion of local body-wave arrival times and teleseismic Rayleigh-wave data across Central America resolving fine-scale structural links to both megathrust earthquake and volcanic arc segmentation.
首次联合近震体波与远震面波反演中美洲三维Vs结构，统一解释大震与火山分段机制。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution 3-D Vs model of the Central American subduction zone (50–100 km lateral, 25–50 km vertical resolution) via joint inversion of local body-wave arrival times and teleseismic Rayleigh waves.

Demonstrated that strongly coupled megathrust segments and Mw ≥ 7.0 earthquakes correlate with both shallow high-Vs/high-gravity forearc asperities and subslab low-Vs buoyant asthenosphere (~1 MPa normal stress increase).

Linked arc volcano volume and geochemical segmentation (U/Th, Ba/La, La/Yb) to mantle wedge low-Vs distribution, deep slab dehydration beneath Nicaragua (>130 km), and Galapagos-modified toroidal flow beneath Costa Rica.
通过近震体波走时与远震瑞利面波联合反演，构建了中美洲俯冲带高分辨率三维Vs模型（横向分辨率50–100 km，垂向25–50 km）。
证实强耦合逆冲断层段及Mw≥7.0大震与浅部高Vs/高重力弧前凹凸体及板下低Vs浮力软流圈（增加约1 MPa正应力）密切相关。
将火山体积与地球化学分段（U/Th、Ba/La、La/Yb）与地幔楔低Vs分布、尼加拉瓜深部板片脱水（>130 km）及哥斯达黎加板片边缘软流圈上涌联系起来。
me: Two-plane-wave tomography using teleseismic fundamental-mode Rayleigh-wave phase and amplitude data at periods of 25–100 s to obtain 2-D phase velocity maps.
Joint tomographic inversion of local P- and S-wave arrival times and Rayleigh-wave phase velocities for 3-D crustal and upper mantle Vs structure.
Quantitative estimation of subslab partial melt fraction and resulting buoyancy normal stress across the megathrust interface using experimental velocity-melt relationships.
Revision of the Slab2 upper boundary geometry down to 200 km depth using relocated intermediate-depth earthquakes with hypocentral uncertainties < 5 km.
利用25–100 s周期的远震基阶瑞利面波相位和振幅数据开展双平面波层析成像，获取二维相速度分布。
联合反演近震P波、S波到时与瑞利面波相速度，构建地壳及上地幔三维Vs速度结构。
基于实验波速-熔融关系定量估算板下地幔部分熔融比例及其在板块界面产生的浮力正应力。
利用震源定位不确定性小于5 km的重新定位中源地震，修正了中美洲下方至200 km深度的Slab2板片上边界几何形态。
de: 226,185 P-wave and 114,846 S-wave arrival times from 7,417 local earthquakes (Aug 1990 – Mar 2025) recorded at 883 stations from the ISC database.

359,172 phase-amplitude pairs of fundamental-mode Rayleigh waves (25–100 s) measured from vertical-component seismograms of 1,362 teleseismic events (M ≥ 5.8, depth < 100 km, distance 30°–150°, Feb 2000 – Dec 2020) across 200 stations.
Checkerboard and restoring resolution tests confirming 50–100 km lateral and 25–50 km vertical resolution down to 150–200 km depth.
来自ISC数据库的883个台站记录的7,417个近震（1990年8月至2025年3月）的226,185条P波和114,846条S波到时数据。
200个台站记录的1,362个远震事件（M≥5.8，深度<100 km，震中距30°–150°，2000年2月至2020年12月）垂直分量波形中提取的359,172对基阶瑞利面波（25–100 s）相位-振幅数据对。
棋盘格测试与恢复分辨率测试，证实地表至150–200 km深度范围内横向分辨率达50–100 km、垂向分辨率达25–50 km。
li: Isotropic tomographic inversion does not account for seismic anisotropy, which may slightly bias the estimated Vs amplitudes.
Limited spatial resolution around the plate interface means Vs anomalies in the megathrust zone represent volume-averaged features combining both the subducting slab and overriding plate.

Subslab low-Vs anomalies could partly reflect temperature or compositional variations rather than purely partial melt, making the ~0.4% melt fraction and ~1 MPa buoyancy stress an upper-bound estimate.
各向同性层析成像反演未考虑地震各向异性，可能对估计的Vs波速振幅产生轻微偏差。
板块界面附近有限的空间分辨率导致大逆冲带的Vs异常代表俯冲板片与上覆板块的体积平均特征。
板下低Vs异常可能部分反映温度或成分变化而非纯粹部分熔融，因此约0.4%熔融比例和约1 MPa浮力应力仅为上限估计。

tm.why: The core methodology is a joint tomographic inversion of local P- and S-wave arrival times and teleseismic Rayleigh-wave dispersion data.
The study images the 3-D Vs structure of the crust, mantle wedge, Cocos slab, and subslab asthenosphere beneath the Central American subduction zone.
The paper links structural heterogeneities and subslab buoyancy stress (~1 MPa) to along-trench variations in megathrust locking, coupling, and earthquake segmentation.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was analyzed, including text, equations, figures, and references.

sum: Deep long-period (DLP) earthquakes occur beneath volcanoes worldwide, yet their generation mechanisms remain debated. This study tests whether DLP occurrence is driven by magmatic volatile exsolution across the transcrustal magma system along the Alaska-Aleutian arc. The authors integrate 34 years (1989–2023) of Alaska Volcano Observatory seismic catalog data from 22 volcanoes with geophysical constraints on Moho and storage depths, 488 bubble-corrected melt inclusions (MIs), and two independent parental CO2 estimates (using CO2/Nb ratios with gas isotopes, and mass-balance fluxes). Results reveal an arc-scale DLP peak at ~32 km BSL near the Moho and an upward increase from 27 to 10 km BSL paralleling MI entrapment depths. Predicted CO2 concentrations required for volatile saturation at maximum DLP depths increase from west to east, matching parental CO2 trends. This novel arc-scale synthesis demonstrates that near-Moho DLPs reflect first boiling during magma ascent, while mid-crustal DLPs result from magma stalling and second boiling.
深部长周期（DLP）地震的成因机制尚存争议。本研究以阿拉斯加-阿留申弧为对象，结合1989–2023年22座火山的地震目录、488个熔体包裹体（MI）挥发分数据以及两种独立的母岩浆CO2估算方法（微量元素CO2/Nb结合气体同位素法、质量平衡通量法），并利用VESIcal和Thermobar进行溶解……

t: Combines filtered AVO seismic catalog DLP depths with MIMiC-corrected melt inclusion barometry (VESIcal/Thermobar) and two parental CO2 models: trace element CO2/Nb with gas isotopes (Method A) and magmatic mass-balance fluxes (Method B).
结合AVO地震目录DLP深度、MIMiC校正熔体包裹体温压计及两种母岩浆CO2估算模型（微量元素同位素法与质量平衡法）。

34 years of AVO seismic catalog data (1989–2023) at 22 volcanoes, 488 melt inclusions from 16 volcanoes, published Moho and magma storage depths, whole-rock Nb, and volcanic gas CO2 flux and isotope datasets.
22座火山的34年AVO地震目录、16座火山的488个熔体包裹体、莫霍面与储库深度、全岩Nb及火山气体通量数据。

Aggregated arc-scale DLPs peak at ~32 km BSL near the Moho and increase upward from 27 to 10 km BSL paralleling melt inclusion depths; DLP-predicted and parental CO2 concentrations increase from west to east.
全弧DLP在莫霍面附近（~32 km）呈峰值，并在27至10 km随包裹体深度向上增加；预测与母岩浆CO2自西向东增加。

Large uncertainties in slab carbon fractions and long-term magma production rates, smaller seismic network apertures in the western arc limiting depth resolution, and missing geochemical or seismic data at several volcanoes.
板片碳比例与长期岩浆产率不确定性大，西段台网孔径小限制深度分辨率，部分火山缺失地球化学或地震数据。
First full-arc synthesis comparing DLP earthquake depth distributions directly against independent geochemical constraints on parental magma CO2 exsolution and melt inclusion crystallization depths.
首次在全弧尺度将DLP深度分布与母岩浆CO2初始出溶深度及熔体包裹体结晶深度进行系统对比。

kc: Synthesized 34 years of AVO seismic catalog data (1989–2023) across 22 Alaska-Aleutian volcanoes with 488 bubble-corrected melt inclusions and geophysical Moho/storage depth constraints.

Developed two independent methods to estimate parental magma CO2 concentrations across the arc: trace element CO2/Nb combined with volcanic gas C-He isotopes (Method A) and magmatic mass-balance flux modeling corrected for diffuse degassing (Method B).

Demonstrated that arc-scale DLP depth distributions peak near the Moho (~32 km BSL, driven by first boiling) and increase from 27 to 10 km BSL in alignment with melt inclusion crystallization depths and second boiling.
综合了阿拉斯加-阿留申弧22座火山34年的AVO地震目录（1989–2023年）、488个气泡校正熔体包裹体数据以及地球物理莫霍面与岩浆储库深度约束。
建立了两种独立估算母岩浆CO2浓度的方法：结合火山气体碳氦同位素的微量元素CO2/Nb法（方法A）和经扩散脱气校正的岩浆质量平衡通量法（方法B）。
证实全弧尺度DLP深度分布在莫霍面附近（~32 km，由一次沸腾驱动）存在峰值，并在27至10 km深度内随熔体包裹体结晶深度同步增加（由二次沸腾驱动）。
me: Catalog filtering of AVO long-period (LP) earthquakes (depths >= 10 km BSL for DLPs, >= 4 stations within 20 km, vertical error < 3 km, azimuthal gap <= 180 degrees).
Post-entrapment modification and vapor bubble correction of melt inclusions using MIMiC, followed by H2O-CO2 saturation pressure and depth modeling via MagmaSat in VESIcal and Thermobar.

Parental magma CO2 estimation via whole-rock Nb concentrations, MORB CO2/Nb ratios (603 +- 69), and slab carbon fractions (Method A), alongside arc-segment passive/diffuse CO2 flux to magma mass flux ratios (Method B).
AVO长周期（LP）地震目录筛选（DLP定义为海平面以下>=10 km，山顶20 km内至少4个台站，垂向误差<3 km，方位角间隙<=180度）。
利用MIMiC对熔体包裹体进行捕获后改造与气泡校正，并通过VESIcal中的MagmaSat模型和Thermobar计算H2O-CO2饱和压力与深度。
基于全岩Nb含量、MORB的CO2/Nb比值（603±69）及俯冲板片碳比例估算母岩浆CO2（方法A），并结合分段被动/扩散CO2通量与岩浆质量通量比值进行估算（方法B）。
de: Alaska Volcano Observatory (AVO) seismic catalog from 1989 to 2023 covering 22 active volcanoes with adequate seismic monitoring networks.
Geochemical dataset of 488 melt inclusions (olivine-, orthopyroxene-, and plagioclase-hosted) from 16 volcanoes, plus published whole-rock Nb and volcanic gas isotope datasets.
Compiled geophysical estimates of magma storage depths and seismic Moho depths (from receiver functions, active-source, and surface-wave studies) along the Alaska-Aleutian arc.
1989年至2023年阿拉斯加火山观测站（AVO）涵盖22座具备足够监测网络的活火山的地震目录。
来自16座火山的488个熔体包裹体（赋存于橄榄石、斜方辉石和斜长石中）地球化学数据集，以及已发表的全岩Nb和火山气体同位素数据。
沿阿拉斯加-阿留申弧汇编的岩浆储库地球物理深度估算值及地震莫霍面深度（源自接收函数、主动源和面波研究）。
li: Significant uncertainties exist in mantle-to-slab carbon fraction estimates (Method A) and long-term steady-state magma flux and diffuse degassing scaling assumptions (Method B).
Smaller seismic network apertures in the western Aleutian islands (mean 19 km) and high ocean noise limit vertical location resolution for deeper DLP events.
Substantial data gaps remain, with several eastern volcanoes lacking melt inclusion or whole-rock Nb data, and several geochemically rich western/central volcanoes lacking adequate seismic networks.
地幔与板片碳贡献比例估算（方法A）以及长期稳态岩浆通量和扩散脱气比例假设（方法B）存在较大不确定性。
西阿留申群岛较小的地震台网孔径（平均19 km）和较高的海洋噪声限制了对更深部DLP事件垂向定位的分辨率。
仍存在明显的数据空白，部分东部火山缺乏熔体包裹体或全岩Nb数据，而部分地球化学数据丰富的中西部火山缺乏足够的地震台网。

tm.why: The paper investigates the origin of deep long-period (DLP) earthquakes beneath 22 volcanoes along the Alaska-Aleutian arc by integrating seismic catalogs with geochemical volatile constraints.
It examines transcrustal magma systems, Moho depth variations, and volatile fluxing from the subducting slab across the crust-mantle boundary along an active subduction arc.
The study relies on a 34-year seismic catalog (1989–2023) from the Alaska Volcano Observatory, filtering LP events by depth, vertical error, and network azimuthal gap.

ev.notes: Full 26-page PDF was provided and analyzed, including all text sections, 6 figures, and 3 tables.

sum: This study reconstructs the tectonic and source-to-sink evolution of the Lorca and Sorbas-Vera basins in the Eastern Betics from 15 to 4 Ma, spanning a major slab tearing interval. By combining structural analysis with detrital zircon U-Pb dating of basement units and basin fill, the authors show how upper-crustal extension directions shifted repeatedly in response to migrating dynamic topography and mantle upwelling. Pre-slab-tearing NW-SE extension (15–10.5 Ma) transitioned to NE-SW extension during slab tearing (10.5–7 Ma), accompanied by maximum subsidence and magmatism. Post-slab-tearing flexural rebound and mantle upwelling drove topographic uplift, reversing sediment routing. This work highlights the profound impact of deep lithospheric processes, such as slab tearing and delamination, on surface topography, drainage networks, and basin sedimentation.
本研究结合结构分析与碎屑锆石U-Pb定年，重建了东贝蒂克Lorca和Sorbas-Vera盆地在15至4 Ma板片撕裂期间的构造与物源演化。研究表明，深部板片撕裂与地幔上涌驱动的动态地形变化导致上地壳拉张方向发生多次转变。板片撕裂前（15-10.5 Ma）为NW-SE向拉张；撕裂期间（10.5-7……

t: Combines structural analysis with detrital zircon U-Pb dating of basement units and basin fill to reconstruct tectonic evolution.
结合结构分析与基底及盆地填充物的碎屑锆石U-Pb定年方法。
Detrital zircon U-Pb geochronological data and structural measurements from the Lorca and Sorbas-Vera basins, Eastern Betics.
来自东贝蒂克Lorca和Sorbas-Vera盆地的碎屑锆石U-Pb年代学数据与结构测量数据。
Identified shifts in extension directions (NW-SE to NE-SW) and sediment routing changes driven by slab tearing and mantle upwelling between 15 and 4 Ma.
确定了15至4 Ma期间由板片撕裂和地幔上涌驱动的拉张方向转变及物源反转过程。
Resolution of timing and spatial extent of slab tearing is constrained by the availability of datable basin-fill sequences.
板片撕裂的时间和空间范围分辨率受限于可定年的盆地填充序列的分布。
Establishes a direct link between deep slab tearing dynamics, migrating dynamic topography, and upper-crustal source-to-sink drainage reorganization.
建立了深部板片撕裂动力学、迁移动态地形与上地壳物源-汇水系统重组之间的直接联系。

kc: Reconstructed the 15 to 4 Ma tectonic and source-to-sink evolution of the Lorca and Sorbas-Vera basins.

sum: This study evaluates the applicability of various ground-motion models (GMMs) for probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA) in the French Lesser Antilles. Utilizing a newly compiled, high-quality regional strong-motion database, the authors perform a comprehensive analysis of observed ground motions against model predictions. The research addresses the critical need for region-specific hazard characterization in active subduction zones, providing insights into which GMMs best capture the attenuation and site effects characteristic of the Lesser Antilles arc. The findings help reduce epistemic uncertainty in seismic hazard maps for the region, contributing to improved building codes and risk mitigation strategies.
本研究利用新构建的法国小安的列斯群岛强震数据库，评估了适用于该地区概率地震危险性分析的地面运动模型（GMM）。通过对比强震观测与模型预测，分析了不同模型的适用性。研究识别出最能反映该俯冲带衰减和场地效应的GMM，降低了危险性评估的认知不确定性，为当地防震减灾和建筑规范提供了科学依据。

sum: This study presents a multiscale shear-wave velocity model of the Bhutan Himalaya crust down to ~50 km depth using surface wave dispersion from ambient noise and teleseismic Rayleigh waves recorded by the GANSSER network. The model reveals significant lateral heterogeneity in the upper crust and images the Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT) as a continuous low-velocity layer. The MHT exhibits a flat-ramp geometry, with a ramp emerging at ~10 km depth in western Bhutan and dipping to ~20 km in eastern Bhutan. In central Bhutan, a disruption of this low-velocity layer and a concave-upward lower-crustal anomaly suggest a potential crustal tear or segmentation of the thrust system, providing critical insights into the regional deformation and seismic hazard.
本研究利用GANSSER台网记录的背景噪声和远震瑞利波面波频散数据，构建了不丹喜马拉雅地区深至50公里的多尺度剪切波速度模型。结果显示上地壳存在显著的横向非均匀性，并将主喜马拉雅逆冲断裂（MHT）成像为连续的低速层。MHT呈现出平-坡几何特征：不丹西部在约10公里深度出现坡折，而东部则较缓地倾斜至约……

Resolution of the crustal tear and deep structures is constrained by the frequency band of teleseismic waves and station distribution.

First multiscale surface wave tomography in Bhutan providing evidence of a lateral crustal tear/segmentation of the MHT beneath central Bhutan.
首次在不丹进行多尺度面波成像，提供了不丹中部下方MHT存在横向地壳撕裂/分段的证据。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution multiscale shear-wave velocity model of the Bhutan Himalaya crust down to ~50 km depth.
Imaged the flat-ramp geometry of the Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT) and documented its lateral variations between western and eastern Bhutan.
Identified a potential crustal tear or segmentation of the MHT beneath central Bhutan based on low-velocity layer disruption.

基于低速层的破裂，首次发现了不丹中部下方MHT可能存在地壳撕裂或分段的证据。

Teleseismic Rayleigh wave dispersion analysis to constrain deeper crustal structure.

Ambient noise data for upper crustal constraints.

sum: This study investigates the 2023 Târgu Jiu intraplate seismic sequence in Romania, triggered by a Mw 4.9 foreshock and Mw 5.4 mainshock at ~20 km depth, followed by over 4,400 aftershocks. Using permanent and temporary seismic network recordings, the authors integrate HypoDD hypocenter relocation, Brune spectral analysis, FPFIT focal mechanisms (60 events), Win-Tensor stress inversion, and Pyrocko pseudo-dynamic rupture modeling. Results reveal a stable NNW-SSE extensional stress regime (R' = 0.57) reactivating a NE-SW striking, SE-dipping normal fault system. The mainshocks exhibit stress drops of ~3.6 MPa and ~4.7 MPa, source durations of ~1.3 s and ~2.0 s, and peak slips of ~0.05 m and ~0.12 m. Forward rupture scenarios indicate unilateral upward propagation toward the northwest, matching synthetic directivity patterns and upward aftershock migration (20 to 10 km depth). This represents the first pseudo-dynamic rupture modeling of a moderate intraplate sequence in southeastern Europe.
本研究探讨了2023年罗马尼亚Târgu Jiu板内地震序列（含Mw 4.9前震、Mw 5.4主震及4400余次余震）。利用密集台网波形数据，综合了HypoDD双差重定位、S波谱分析、60个震源机制解、应力张量反演及Pyrocko伪动力学破裂正演模拟。结果表明该区处于NNW-SSE向伸展应力场（R'……

t: Integrates HypoDD double-difference relocation, Brune S-wave spectral analysis, FPFIT focal mechanism determination, Win-Tensor stress inversion, and Pyrocko pseudo-dynamic forward rupture modeling assuming unilateral upward propagation at Vr = 0.6 Vs.
结合HypoDD重定位、Brune谱分析、震源机制与应力反演，以及Pyrocko伪动力学破裂正演模拟。

100 Hz continuous broadband and strong-motion waveforms from the permanent Romanian Seismic Network and six temporary stations, capturing a Mw 4.9 foreshock, Mw 5.4 mainshock, and 4,460 aftershocks in 2023–2024.

The Mw 4.9 and Mw 5.4 events nucleated at ~20 km depth on a SE-dipping normal fault under NNW-SSE extension (R'=0.57), with stress drops of 3.6 and 4.7 MPa, durations of ~1.3 and ~2.0 s, and peak slips of ~0.05 and ~0.12 m.

Rupture parameters were prescribed a priori in forward simulations rather than inverted from waveforms, and NW directivity was inferred qualitatively without quantitative ground-motion directivity analysis.

kc: Characterized the 2023 Târgu Jiu sequence (Mw 4.9 foreshock, Mw 5.4 mainshock, >4,400 aftershocks) in a region previously considered to have only low background seismicity.
Determined a consistent NNW-SSE extensional stress regime (R' = 0.57) from 60 focal mechanisms, confirming the reactivation of inherited NE-SW striking, SE-dipping normal faults.
Estimated source parameters via spectral analysis and scaling relations, yielding stress drops of 3.6 MPa (Mw 4.9) and 4.7 MPa (Mw 5.4), and peak slips of ~0.05 m and ~0.12 m.
Demonstrated via pseudo-dynamic forward modeling that deep nucleation (~20 km) and unilateral upward-NW rupture propagation explain the asymmetric aftershock distribution and upward migration.
刻画了此前被视为低背景地震活动区的2023年Târgu Jiu地震序列（Mw 4.9前震、Mw 5.4主震及4400余次余震）。
基于60个震源机制解反演获得稳定的NNW-SSE向伸展应力体制（R' = 0.57），证实了NE-SW走向、SE倾向先存正断层的复活。
通过谱分析与经验标度率估算震源参数，得出前震与主震应力降分别为3.6 MPa和4.7 MPa，峰值滑动量约为0.05 m和0.12 m。
通过伪动力学正演模拟证实，深部成核（约20 km）及向西北单侧向上破裂传播能够解释不对称的余震分布及向上迁移特征。

S-wave displacement spectral analysis using Brune's circular source model to estimate seismic moment, corner frequency, source radius, and static stress drop.
Focal mechanism determination from P-wave first-motion polarities using FPFIT (≥10 polarities per event) and regional stress tensor inversion using Win-Tensor.

Catalog of 4,462 detected and located earthquakes (ML 0.0 to 5.7) between February 2023 and August 2024, with 1,100 events (ML ≥ 1.5) selected for HypoDD relocation.

罗马尼亚固定地震台网（RSN）及6个临时台站（配备CMG-40T宽频带和EpiSensor强震仪）的100 Hz连续波形记录。

sum: This study investigates the evolution of magma permeability during the viscous-brittle transition using uniaxial compression experiments on rhyolite lava from Niijima Island, Japan. Experiments were conducted at 806–955 °C and strain rates of 10^-6.5 to 10^-1.3 s^-1. Results show that under viscous deformation (Weissenberg number Wi < 10^-3.4), permeability remains stable or decreases slightly at high strain. Conversely, under brittle deformation (Wi > 10^-2.5), permeability increases by up to two orders of magnitude due to the formation and widening of large cracks. This suggests that efficient outgassing occurs in high-Wi regions (shallow/outer conduit parts), leading to a zoned conduit structure with a highly permeable brittle plug overlying viscous vesicular magma.

t: Uniaxial compression experiments on rhyolite lava at 806–955 °C and strain rates of 10^-6.5 to 10^-1.3 s^-1, measuring gas permeability before and after deformation.
在806–955 °C和不同应变率下对流纹岩进行单轴压缩实验，并测量变形前后的气体渗透率。
Natural rhyolite lava from Niijima Island, Japan, containing 15–25 vol% phenocrysts and 20–35 vol% porosity.

Viscous deformation (Wi < 10^-3.4) slightly decreases permeability at large strain, while brittle deformation (Wi > 10^-2.5) increases permeability by two orders of magnitude due to crack formation.

sum: This study uses 2D physics-based earthquake sequence simulations, constrained by laboratory experiments and seismological observations, to investigate induced seismicity in the Groningen gas field. The authors analyze how fault offset, stratigraphic layering, lithology-dependent elastic and frictional properties, and fault healing govern rupture characteristics. They find that earthquake nucleation consistently occurs within the Slochteren sandstone reservoir. Heterogeneous elastic parameters exert a dominant control on rupture behavior, suppressing slip rates and limiting rupture extent, whereas heterogeneous friction has a minor effect. Runaway rupture into the underburden is exceptionally rare (occurring in <0.1% of simulations). Mapping these outcomes onto the Groningen fault network indicates that 99% of fault segments have a very low probability of propagating beyond the reservoir thickness. This demonstrates that lithological heterogeneity imposes strong physical constraints on rupture extent, providing physics-based limits on maximum magnitude ($M_{max}$) for hazard assessment.
本研究采用受实验室实验和地震观测约束的二维物理地震序列模拟，研究了格罗宁根气田的诱发地震活动。作者分析了断层位错、地层分层、岩性相关的弹性和摩擦性质以及长期断层愈合对破裂特征的控制。结果表明，地震成核始终发生于Slochteren砂岩储层中。非均匀弹性参数对破裂行为起主导控制作用，显著抑制了滑动速率……

结合实验室实验和地震观测的二维物理地震序列模拟，用以模拟断层位错、地层分层及岩性相关性质。

2000次地震序列模拟的合成数据，结合格罗宁根气田断层网络的结构和岩性数据。

Nucleation occurs in the reservoir; heterogeneous elastic parameters dominate rupture limitation; runaway rupture into the underburden is extremely rare (<0.1%), limiting rupture width for 99% of faults.

Simplified 2D geometry and reliance on laboratory-derived frictional parameters which may not fully scale to reservoir-scale fault zones.

Results depend heavily on the accuracy of laboratory-derived frictional parameters and simplified stratigraphic models.

sum: Establishing Ground Motion Prediction Equations (GMPEs) suffers from multicollinearity, and researchers typically design multi-step regression strategies subjectively without quantitative standards. This study proposes a quantitative method for constructing GMPE modeling strategies using Fields' relative importance decomposition algorithm. By decomposing the coefficient of determination (R2) into covariance-based relative importance weights for each model component (source, distance attenuation, hanging wall, fault style), parameters are estimated and fixed sequentially in ascending order of their explanatory contribution using random-effects regression. The strategy was applied to rock-site (Vs30 > 500 m/s) peak ground acceleration (PGA) records from 21 shallow crustal earthquakes in the NGA-West2 database. Results show that source and distance terms account for >90% of R2, while hanging wall and fault style contribute ~6%. The resulting GMPE exhibits unbiased inter- and intra-event residuals and matches NGA-West1/2 distance, magnitude, and hanging-wall scaling characteristics.
针对地面运动预测方程（GMPE）回归中缺乏定量建模策略的问题，本文提出一种基于相对重要性分析的建模策略构建方法。该方法利用协方差分解各模型分量（震源、距离衰减、上盘效应、断层类型）对决定系数（R2）的解释贡献度，按贡献度升序结合随机效应回归逐步确定并固定模型系数。研究选取NGA-West2数据库中2……

t: Decomposes the GMPE's coefficient of determination (R2) into covariance-based relative importance weights for each model term, then estimates and fixes regression coefficients sequentially in ascending order of explanatory contribution using random-effects regression.
利用协方差分解GMPE各分量的R2相对重要性权重，按解释力升序结合随机效应回归逐步估计并固定参数。

Strong-motion records at free-surface rock sites (Vs30 > 500 m/s) from 21 shallow crustal earthquakes (Ms >= 4.7) in the NGA-West2 database, including western US events plus Chi-Chi, Darfield, and Manjil mainshocks.
选用NGA-West2数据库中21次浅源地壳地震（Ms>=4.7）在自由地表基岩场地（Vs30>500 m/s）的强震记…

Source and distance attenuation terms contributed >90% to R2, while hanging wall and fault style explained ~6%. The resulting rock-site PGA model achieved σ = 0.244 (τ = 0.134, θ = 0.203) with unbiased residuals.
震源和距离衰减项贡献超90%的R2，上盘和断层类型占约6%；PGA模型总标准差σ为0.244，残差无偏。
The case study model omits explicit local site condition terms (targeting rock sites only), relies on limited near-field hanging wall data (11%), and compares Ms directly against NGA-West Mw.

Introduces an objective, quantitative relative-importance decomposition approach to determine the step-by-step parameter estimation order for GMPE regressions, replacing subjective ad-hoc modeling strategies.
首次引入相对重要性分解算法定量确定GMPE分步回归的参数估计顺序，克服了以往主观设定策略的局限。

kc: Proposes a quantitative, model-agnostic GMPE regression strategy based on relative importance decomposition of R2.
Establishes an ascending-order parameter estimation sequence (hanging wall, fault style, distance attenuation, source terms) combined with random-effects regression.
Validates the strategy on NGA-West2 rock-site PGA records, demonstrating unbiased residuals and high consistency with NGA-West1 and NGA-West2 models.
提出基于决定系数（R2）相对重要性分解的定量化、通用型GMPE回归建模策略。
建立了结合随机效应回归的升序参数估计流程（依次为上盘效应、断层类型、距离衰减和震源项）。

Multi-step single-level random-effects regression fixing parameters in ascending order of relative importance.

基于Fields (2003)协方差性质的决定系数（R2）相对重要性分解算法。
按相对重要性升序逐步估计并固定参数的单水平随机效应回归。
近场震级饱和超参数的最小二乘预先估计。

Comparison of derived rock-site PGA predictions against 10 NGA-West1 and NGA-West2 empirical GMPEs across distance, magnitude, and hanging-wall scenarios.

Hanging wall data account for only 11% of the dataset, and inconsistent magnitude scales (Ms vs Mw) required direct comparison without conversion.

sum: This paper presents a multisensor seismic experiment in the Cook Inlet segment of the Alaska-Aleutian subduction zone, combining 11 onshore broadband seismographs with an offshore distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) campaign on fiber-optic cables. The deployment aims to investigate the subduction interface's structure and properties to understand slip, tremor, and plate locking. The combined dataset successfully records local earthquakes, teleseismic waves, and environmental/oceanographic noise. Despite high noise levels from the basin and indoor deployment sites, the DAS data provides detailed insights into oceanographic processes in the inlet. This integrated onshore-offshore approach bridges the gap between environmental forcing and seismic response, offering a novel dataset for subduction zone imaging and environmental seismology.
本文介绍在阿拉斯加库克湾俯冲带开展的陆海联合地震观测实验。该实验结合了11个陆地宽频带台站与近海光缆分布式声学传感（DAS）技术。联合数据集成功记录了本地地震、远震及环境噪声。DAS数据揭示了丰富的海洋动力学过程。该研究展示了多传感器联合观测在探测俯冲带结构及桥接陆海环境信号方面的独特优势。

t: Deployment of an onshore broadband seismic network combined with offshore distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) on fiber-optic cables to record multi-scale seismic and environmental signals.
联合部署陆地宽频带台网与近海光缆DAS，记录多尺度地震与环境信号。
Seismic data from 11 onshore broadband seismographs and offshore DAS recordings from fiber-optic cables in the Cook Inlet, Alaska.
来自阿拉斯加库克湾11个陆地宽频带地震仪和近海光缆的DAS地震观测数据。
Successful recording of local and teleseismic earthquakes alongside rich oceanographic and environmental noise signals that bridge offshore forcing and onshore response.
成功记录了本地和远震地震信号，以及揭示陆海耦合特征的丰富海洋与环境噪声信号。
High noise levels in the broadband data caused by the basin environment and indoor station placement.
由于盆地环境和室内台站布设导致宽频带数据中存在较高的背景噪声。
First joint onshore broadband and offshore DAS deployment in the Cook Inlet to study subduction zone processes and environmental noise.

Demonstrates the capability of offshore DAS to record oceanographic processes and local noise sources.
Provides a complementary dataset bridging offshore environmental forcing and onshore seismic response.

Offshore Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) campaign using existing fiber-optic cables.
Joint analysis of local earthquakes, teleseismic waves, and ambient noise.

DAS strain/velocity data from offshore fiber-optic cables in the Cook Inlet.

sum: This study investigates the February 2025 earthquake swarm across the Santorini, Kolumbo, Anydros, and Amorgos volcanic fields in the south-central Aegean back-arc. Using 4,869 high-precision relocated earthquakes (NLL-SSST-coherence) from January 2024 to March 2025, the authors show that seismicity initiated at ~15 km depth beneath Santorini and Kolumbo before migrating northeastward and shallowing to 5–8 km toward Anydros and Amorgos. Full moment-tensor inversions (TDMT_INV) of regional broadband waveforms for 30 events (Mw >= 4.5), supplemented by teleseismic body-wave inversion (MT5) for the largest Mw 5.4 event, reveal normal, oblique-normal, and strike-slip mechanisms with substantial positive non-double-couple (ISO and CLVD) components (~60% with epsilon >= 0.2). Stress tensor inversion (StressInverse) indicates a dominant NW–SE extensional/transtensional regime (R = 0.19). The novelty lies in systematically quantifying full MT non-DC components and linking shallow tensile crack opening to deep magmatic intrusion and lithospheric mantle upwelling.
本研究分析了2025年2月爱琴海中南部圣托里尼-阿莫尔戈斯火山区的地震群。基于2024年1月至2025年3月期间4869个高精度重定位地震（NLL-SSST-coherence），发现地震始于圣托里尼和科伦umbo下方约15 km深处，随后向北东方向迁移并变浅至5–8 km。对30个Mw≥4.5事件……

t: Time-domain full and deviatoric moment-tensor inversions (TDMT_INV) of regional broadband waveforms for 30 events, teleseismic body-wave inversion (MT5) for the Mw 5.4 shock, and iterative principal stress inversion (StressInverse).
对30个地震进行区域全矩张量反演，对Mw 5.4地震进行远震体波反演，并开展迭代主应力反演。

4,869 relocated earthquakes (Jan 2024–Mar 2025) using NOA-IG phase picks, regional three-component broadband waveforms (44–394 km) for 30 events (Mw >= 4.5), and teleseismic P/SH waveforms for the Mw 5.4 event.
2024年1月至2025年3月4869个重定位地震、30个Mw≥4.5事件的区域三分量宽频带波形及远震波形。
Seismicity migrated NE and upward from ~15 km to ~5–8 km; 18 of 30 events are non-DC dominated (~60% have epsilon >= 0.2), and stress inversion reveals NW–SE transtension (R = 0.19, mu = 0.5).
地震向北东迁移并由15 km变浅至5–8 km；约60%事件具显著正非双力偶分量（ε≥0.2），呈北西-南东向张扭体制。
Teleseismic inversion was limited to the Mw 5.4 event due to low amplitudes, F-tests mostly showed p >= 0.05 between DEV and full MT, and sigma_1/sigma_2 have ~80° uncertainty.
远震反演仅限于Mw 5.4事件；F检验多显示p≥0.05；正断与走滑共存导致σ1和σ2不确定性达80°。

Systematic quantification of full moment-tensor non-DC components (epsilon parameter) and crustal stress tensor for the 2025 Santorini–Amorgos swarm, linking tensile crack opening to deep magmatic intrusion.
系统量化了2025年震群全矩张量非双力偶参数与地壳应力场，将张裂隙开启与深部岩浆侵入相联系。

kc: Analyzed spatio-temporal evolution of 4,869 high-precision relocated earthquakes from 2024–2025, showing NE migration and upward propagation from ~15 km to ~5–8 km depth.
Determined full and deviatoric moment-tensor solutions for 30 earthquakes (Mw >= 4.5), identifying ~60% of events with significant positive non-DC components (epsilon >= 0.2).
Constrained the 10 February 2025 Mw 5.4 largest shock using both regional full MT and teleseismic P/SH body-wave inversions (~9 s rupture duration, NE–SW normal faulting).
Performed iterative stress tensor inversion with fault instability constraints, resolving a NW–SE transtensional regime (R = 0.19, friction mu = 0.5) and linking it to mantle upwelling.
分析了2024–2025年4869个高精度重定位地震的时空演化，揭示了从约15 km向5–8 km深度的向上传播及北东向迁移。
测定了30个Mw≥4.5地震的全矩张量和偏量矩张量解，发现约60%的事件具有显著的正非双力偶分量（ε≥0.2）。
利用区域全矩张量和远震P/SH体波反演约束了2025年2月10日最大Mw 5.4地震（破裂持续约9秒，北东-南西向正断层）。
开展带断层不稳定性约束的迭代应力张量反演，确定了北西-南东向张扭构造体制（R=0.19，摩擦系数μ=0.5）并与地幔上涌相联系。

Time-domain regional full and deviatoric moment-tensor inversion (TDMT_INV) using 1D Haskell Green's functions, depth sensitivity tests, and F-test model comparison.
Teleseismic P- and SH-body waveform inversion (MT5) and P-wave first-motion polarity analysis for the Mw 5.4 event.
Iterative joint inversion for principal stress orientations and fault instability using the StressInverse algorithm.
结合震源特定台站走时校正与波形相干性的NonLinLoc高精度地震重定位（NLL-SSST-coherence）。
采用一维Haskell格林函数的时间域区域全矩张量与偏量矩张量反演（TDMT_INV），包含深度敏感性测试与F检验模型对比。
针对Mw 5.4地震的远震P波和SH体波波形反演（MT5）及P波初动极性分析。
利用StressInverse算法开展主应力方向与断层不稳定性的迭代联合反演。
de: Phase arrival data from NOA-IG for 4,869 earthquakes between 2 January 2024 and 23 March 2025 relocated with a combined 1D velocity model.
Three-component broadband regional waveforms (epicentral distance 44–394 km, filtered at 0.02–0.05 or 0.02–0.10 Hz) from KOERI, AFAD, HL, MN, HT, and GE networks for 30 events (Mw >= 4.5).
Teleseismic waveforms (14 long-period P, 1 long-period SH, and 6 broadband P at 30°–90° distance) from IRIS-DMC for the 10 February 2025 Mw 5.4 earthquake.
来自NOA-IG的2024年1月2日至2025年3月23日期间4869个地震的震相到时数据及组合一维速度模型重定位目录。
来自KOERI、AFAD、HL、MN、HT和GE台网的30个Mw≥4.5地震的三分量宽频带区域波形（震中距44–394 km，滤波频带0.02–0.05或0.02–0.10 Hz）。
来自IRIS-DMC的2025年2月10日Mw 5.4地震远震波形数据（震中距30°–90°的14个长周期P波、1个长周期SH波和6个宽频带P波）。
li: Teleseismic body-waveform inversion could only be reliably performed for the largest Mw 5.4 event due to insufficient amplitudes for smaller earthquakes at teleseismic distances.
F-test comparisons between full MT and deviatoric MT inversions mostly yielded p >= 0.05, indicating no statistically significant waveform fit improvement despite physical preference for full MT.
Stress inversion yielded large uncertainties (~80°) for sigma_1 and sigma_2 orientations due to the coexistence of normal and strike-slip faulting in a transitional regime.
由于较小地震在远震距离上振幅不足，远震体波反演仅能可靠地应用于最大的Mw 5.4事件。
全矩张量与偏量矩张量反演的F检验大多得出p≥0.05，表明尽管物理上倾向于全矩张量，但波形拟合在统计上无显著改善。
由于过渡构造体制下正断层和走滑断层共存，应力反演中σ1和σ2方向存在较大不确定性（约80°）。

tm.why: The study performs full moment-tensor and teleseismic waveform inversions for 30 earthquakes (Mw >= 4.5) in the 2025 Santorini–Amorgos swarm, decomposing DC, CLVD, and ISO source components.
The paper investigates volcano-tectonic seismicity across the Santorini, Kolumbo, and Anydros volcanic centers, linking high non-DC components to magma intrusion and tensile cracking.
The authors invert for the regional crustal stress tensor and connect shallow extensional volcano-tectonic processes with upper-mantle upwelling in the Hellenic back-arc.

sum: This study investigates three-dimensional seismic wave propagation and ground-motion amplification in coupled basin-mountain systems using a multi-domain indirect boundary element method (IBEM). The model decomposes the system into closed basin and mountain subdomains (using full-space Green's functions) and an open layered half-space (using distributed-load half-space Green's functions). Parametric simulations under vertically incident harmonic plane SV waves are conducted across coupled, basin-only, and mountain-only configurations, varying mountain height and basin depth. Results show that surrounding mountains shield the basin at low frequencies, enhance edge amplification via constructive interference at intermediate frequencies, and experience strong high-frequency vertical amplification fed by basin scattering. Notably, an exceptionally large resonance-like amplification (peak horizontal/vertical factors of 21.05 and 23.41) occurs at a specific geometric ratio (b/a=0.6, h/w=0.6). Comparative 2D cross-sectional simulations severely underestimate high-frequency amplification and completely miss this 3D geometric resonance.
本研究采用多域间接边界元法（IBEM）探讨了三维盆山耦合系统中的地震波传播与地面运动放大效应。该方法将系统分解为盆地、山体闭合子域（全空间格林函数）和层状半空间开子域（半空间格林函数）。通过改变山高与盆深，对比分析了耦合、纯盆地、纯山体及二维模型的频域SV波响应。结果表明：山体在低频时屏蔽盆地反应，……

t: A 3D multi-domain indirect boundary element method decomposes the system into closed basin/mountain subdomains (full-space Green's functions) and an open layered half-space (half-space Green's functions), coupled via interface continuity.
提出三维多域间接边界元法，将盆山系统分解为闭合盆地/山体子域和开放层状半空间并耦合求解。

Synthetic parametric 3D and 2D simulations of an axisymmetric semi-ellipsoidal basin surrounded by a Gaussian mountain under vertically incident harmonic plane SV waves at dimensionless frequencies η=0.5, 1, 2, and 5.
对高斯山体环绕的轴对称半椭球盆地开展无量纲频率η=0.5, 1, 2, 5的垂直入射SV波三维与二维合成模拟。

Surrounding mountains shield the basin at η=0.5 but amplify edge motions at η=1. A 3D geometric resonance at b/a=0.6, h/w=0.6 (η=1) yields peak horizontal/vertical amplifications of 21.05 and 23.41, versus 2.59 and 0.72 in 2D.
低频山体屏蔽盆地，中频增强边缘放大；b/a=0.6且h/w=0.6在η=1发生三维共振，峰值达21.05和23.41，远…

Assumes an idealised axisymmetric geometry, homogeneous linear viscoelastic materials, and frequency-domain vertically incident harmonic plane SV waves, limiting direct site-specific quantitative applicability.
限于理想轴对称几何、线性粘弹性材料及垂直入射SV波频域分析，缺乏时域模拟。
Isolates 3D basin-mountain coupling via multi-domain IBEM and discovers an anomalous 3D geometry-controlled resonance (b/a=0.6, h/w=0.6) completely missed by 2D models.
利用多域边界元分离了三维盆山耦合效应，发现了二维模型无法捕捉的三维几何控制共振放大现象。

kc: Developed an efficient 3D multi-domain indirect boundary element method coupling full-space and non-singular distributed-load half-space Green's functions for basin-mountain systems.

Isolated frequency-dependent basin-mountain coupling mechanisms: low-frequency topographic shielding, intermediate-frequency constructive edge interference, and high-frequency energy shifting to mountains.
Discovered an extraordinary 3D geometry-controlled resonance at b/a=0.6 and h/w=0.6 (η=1), yielding peak horizontal and vertical amplification factors of 21.05 and 23.41.
Demonstrated that 2D cross-sectional models severely underestimate high-frequency topographic amplification and fail to capture 3D resonant coupling.
开发了结合全空间与非奇异分布荷载半空间格林函数的三维多域间接边界元法，高效模拟盆山系统。
揭示了盆山耦合的频率依赖机制：低频地形屏蔽、中频边缘相长干涉以及高频能量向山体转移。
发现在特定几何比例（b/a=0.6, h/w=0.6, η=1）下存在三维几何共振，水平和竖向峰值放大系数分别高达21.05和23.41。
证实二维剖面模型严重低估高频地形放大效应，且无法捕捉三维几何共振耦合。
me: Multi-domain indirect boundary element method (IBEM) with domain decomposition into closed basin, closed mountain, and open layered half-space subdomains.
Full-space point-load Green's functions for closed subdomains and non-singular uniformly distributed-load half-space Green's functions for the open subdomain.
Direct stiffness method for computing free-field responses of the layered viscoelastic half-space under vertically incident harmonic plane SV waves.
Parametric frequency-domain analysis across dimensionless frequencies (η = 0.5, 1, 2, 5) and comparison against 2D cross-sectional models.
采用多域间接边界元法（IBEM），将系统分解为闭合盆地、闭合山体子域和开放层状半空间子域。
闭合子域采用全空间点荷载格林函数，开放子域采用非奇异均布荷载半空间格林函数。
利用直接刚度法计算垂直入射简谐平面SV波在层状粘弹性半空间中的自由场响应。
在无量纲频率（η = 0.5, 1, 2, 5）下进行参数化频域分析，并与二维剖面模型进行对比。
de: Benchmark verification against analytical/numerical solutions for a 3D axisymmetric Gaussian mountain (Sánchez-Sesma, 1983) and a hemispherical basin (Mossessian & Dravinski, 1990).
Synthetic parametric experiments comparing coupled basin-mountain, mountain-only, and basin-only models in layered and uniform half-spaces.
Parametric variations of mountain height-to-half-width ratio (h/w = 0.3, 0.6, 1.0, 1.7) and basin depth-to-half-width ratio (b/a = 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0) in 3D and 2D.
通过三维轴对称高斯山体（Sánchez-Sesma, 1983）和半球形盆地（Mossessian & Dravinski, 1990）经典算例验证数值模型。
开展层状和均匀半空间中盆山耦合、纯山体和纯盆地模型的合成参数化对比实验。
在三维和二维条件下系统改变山体高宽比（h/w = 0.3, 0.6, 1.0, 1.7）和盆地深宽比（b/a = 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.0）。
li: Restricted to an idealised axisymmetric geometry (semi-ellipsoidal basin surrounded by a Gaussian mountain).
Assumes homogeneous linear viscoelastic materials within each subdomain and vertically incident harmonic plane SV waves.
Analysis is conducted solely in the frequency domain without time-domain transient waveform simulations.
局限于理想化的轴对称几何构型（由高斯型山体环绕的半椭球形盆地）。
假设各子域为均质线性粘弹性材料，且仅考虑垂直入射的简谐平面SV波。
仅在频域内进行分析，未开展时域瞬态地震波响应模拟。

tm.why: The paper systematically investigates three-dimensional ground motion amplification in intermontane sedimentary basins surrounded by mountain topography.
It develops and applies a three-dimensional multi-domain indirect boundary element method using full-space and half-space Green's functions to simulate seismic wave scattering.

ev.notes: Full 24-page PDF of the Scientific Reports article in press was read and analysed, including abstract, mathematical formulation, benchmark verifications, parametric 3D/2D comparisons, discussion, and all 12 figures and 1 table.

sum: Deploying artificial intelligence in high-stakes industrial domains like healthcare, energy grids, and subsurface geophysical exploration often leads to severe failures despite high benchmark accuracy. This paper introduces a conceptual framework that reframes industrial AI reliability as a system-level structural alignment problem across four interacting worlds: physical, representational, machine, and human cognitive. These worlds connect through two critical interfaces—digitalization (mapping physical processes to data representations) and goal encoding (translating human intent into machine objectives)—which jointly define an admissible solution space characterized by existence, non-uniqueness, robustness, and interpretability. Case studies of surgical navigation malfunctions, the 2025 Iberian power blackout, and costly dry holes in subsurface exploration demonstrate that diverse domain failures share a common upstream structural mechanism. The novelty lies in shifting AI evaluation and governance from model-centric metrics to controlling upstream interface misalignments and solution-space dynamics.
针对高风险工业领域AI模型在基准测试中表现优异却在实际部署中失效的问题，本文提出一种系统级结构对齐理论框架。该方法将物理、表征、机器与人类认知四个世界通过数字化与目标编码两个关键接口相连，并用存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性和可解释性刻画解空间。通过对医疗导航事故、2025年伊比利亚大停电及地下地球物理勘探……

t: Proposes a structural framework organizing industrial AI reliability around four interacting worlds (physical, representational, machine, human cognitive) linked by two interfaces (digitalization and goal encoding) that shape a four-attribute solution space.
提出围绕物理、表征、机器与人类认知四世界及数字化、目标编码双接口的AI可靠性结构框架。

Examines three real-world industrial AI failure domains: the TruDi surgical navigation recalls in healthcare, the April 2025 Iberian power grid blackout, and costly dry holes in geophysical subsurface investigation.
剖析三个工业AI失效案例：TruDi手术导航故障、2025年伊比利亚大停电及地下勘探干井。

Demonstrates that dominant domain failures—interpretability in healthcare (>100 TruDi malfunctions), robustness in grids (15 GW loss in 5s), and non-uniqueness in subsurface dry holes—stem from compounded interface misalignments.
证明医疗可解释性、电网鲁棒性及地下勘探非唯一性等主导失效均源于上游双接口的复合失配。

The framework is conceptual rather than operational, lacking algorithmic methods for detecting interface mismatches, assuming static world decompositions, and abstracting away institutional and socio-technical dynamics.
框架偏重概念层面，缺乏检测失配的具体算法，且忽略了动态演化与社会制度因素。

Integrates data-centric AI, underspecification, and alignment concepts into a unified system-level structural framework that traces reliability failures to upstream digitalization and goal-encoding interfaces rather than model-centric metrics.
将数据中心AI、欠规范与对齐整合为统一结构框架，将可靠性从模型指标转向系统级上游接口对齐。

kc: Proposes a four-world (physical, representational, machine, human cognitive) and two-interface (digitalization, goal encoding) framework for industrial AI reliability.

Characterizes the AI solution space via four coupled structural attributes—existence, non-uniqueness, robustness, and interpretability—and maps their causal, trade-off, and constrained feedback loops.
Demonstrates through healthcare, energy grid, and subsurface exploration case studies that domain-specific AI failures stem from shared upstream interface misalignments.
提出了涵盖物理、表征、机器与人类认知四个世界及数字化、目标编码两个接口的工业AI可靠性框架。
通过存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性和可解释性四个耦合属性刻画AI解空间，揭示其因果、权衡与约束反馈回路。
结合医疗、电网和地下勘探案例，证明不同领域的AI失效均源于上游接口的结构性失配。
me: Conceptual systems-theory framework decomposing AI pipelines into physical, representational, machine, and human cognitive worlds.
Structural analysis of upstream interfaces (digitalization and goal encoding) and their propagation into solution-space attributes.
Comparative cross-domain failure diagnosis and governance design across healthcare, power grids, and subsurface geophysical investigation.
将AI全流程解构为物理、表征、机器与人类认知四个交互世界的系统理论概念框架。
对上游接口（数字化与目标编码）及其向解空间属性传播机制的结构化分析。
跨医疗、电网与地下地球物理勘探领域的失效诊断与治理机制对比分析。
de: Case study of healthcare AI: TruDi surgical navigation system malfunctions and patient injuries (2021–2025).
Case study of energy grid AI: April 28, 2025 Iberian cascading blackout affecting over 50 million people with 15 GW generation loss.
Case study of subsurface investigation AI: multi-physics geophysical inference (seismic, gravity, EM, well logs) and dry hole drilling risks.
医疗AI案例研究：TruDi手术导航系统在2021至2025年间的故障与患者损伤事件。
电网AI案例研究：2025年4月28日影响超5000万人、5秒内损失15吉瓦电力的伊比利亚级联大停电。
地下勘探AI案例研究：多物理场地球物理反演（地震、重力、电磁、测井）与干井钻探风险分析。
li: Conceptual rather than operational: lacks concrete algorithmic methods, diagnostic tests, or quantitative metrics to detect interface mismatches.
Assumes a static decomposition of worlds and interfaces rather than modeling dynamic co-evolution over system lifecycles.
Abstracts away socio-technical, institutional, and political factors such as stakeholder conflicts and organizational inertia.
框架偏重概念而非操作层面，缺乏检测接口失配的具体算法、诊断测试或量化指标。
假设四个世界与接口呈静态分解，未充分建模系统生命周期内的动态协同演化。
抽象掉了利益相关者冲突、激励机制和组织惯性等社会技术与制度因素。

tm.why: The paper examines AI reliability in subsurface exploration and geophysical inversion (including seismic, gravity, electromagnetic, and well-log integration) as one of its three core domain applications, co-authored by several computational geophysicists.

It frames AI learning and geophysical subsurface inference through classical inverse problem concepts: existence, intrinsic non-uniqueness, robustness (stability), and interpretability of the admissible solution space.

ev.notes: Full 34-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including all 5 figures, 7 theoretical propositions, and Section 5.3 on subsurface geophysical exploration.

sum: This study investigates the 3D geodynamic viability and tectonic responses of subduction polarity reversal (SPR) propagation during arc-continent collision. Using 3D numerical modeling and systematic parameter testing, the authors demonstrate that SPR propagation is highly dependent on the thermal age and rheological strength of the subducting lithosphere. Specifically, SPR propagation only occurs when the lithosphere is thermally aged and rheologically strong. Conversely, young or rheologically weak lithosphere leads to slab tearing or break-off, which halts the propagation. These findings provide critical geodynamic insights into the initiation of the Vitiaz and Andaman-Sumatra trenches, as well as the occurrence of slab tearing in the Philippine and Vanuatu subduction zones.
本研究利用三维数值模拟探讨了弧-陆碰撞背景下俯冲极性反转（SPR）传播的地球动力学可行性与构造响应。系统参数测试表明，SPR的传播高度依赖于俯冲岩石圈的热年龄和流变强度：只有当岩石圈热老化且流变强度较高时，SPR才能顺利传播；而年轻或流变较弱的岩石圈则会导致板块撕裂或断裂，从而中断SPR传播。该成果……

t: 3D numerical geodynamic modeling of lithospheric deformation and subduction polarity reversal under varying thermal and rheological parameters.
采用三维数值地球动力学模拟，研究不同热和流变参数下岩石圈变形及俯冲极性反转。
Synthetic 3D geodynamic model simulations with parameterized lithospheric properties, compared qualitatively with regional tectonic observations.
基于参数化岩石圈性质的三维合成地球动力学模拟，并与区域构造观测进行定性对比。
SPR propagation occurs only with thermally aged and rheologically strong lithosphere; young or weak lithosphere results in slab tearing or break-off.
SPR传播仅在热老化和流变坚硬的岩石圈中发生；年轻或软弱岩石圈会导致板块撕裂或断裂。
Simplified initial geometries and rheological formulations that may omit fine-scale natural complexities.
初始几何形状和流变学公式较为简化，可能忽略了细微的自然复杂性。
First systematic 3D geodynamic investigation of the propagation of subduction polarity reversal along-strike during arc-continent collision.
首次系统地对弧-陆碰撞过程中俯冲极性反转沿走向传播进行了三维地球动力学研究。

kc: Established a 3D numerical geodynamic model to investigate the propagation of subduction polarity reversal (SPR) along arc-continent convergent margins.
Demonstrated that SPR propagation requires a thermally aged and rheologically strong subducting lithosphere.
Explained why young or rheologically weak lithosphere leads to slab tearing or break-off instead of SPR propagation.
Provided geodynamic explanations for trench initiation (Vitiaz, Andaman-Sumatra) and slab tearing (Philippine, Vanuatu).
建立了三维数值地球动力学模型，研究了弧-陆碰撞汇聚边界上俯冲极性反转（SPR）的传播过程。
证实了SPR的传播需要俯冲岩石圈具备高热龄和强流变性。
阐明了年轻或流变较弱的岩石圈为何会导致板块撕裂或断裂而非SPR传播。
为Vitiaz和安达曼-苏门答腊海沟的启动以及菲律宾和瓦努阿图的板块撕裂提供了动力学解释。
me: 3D numerical geodynamic modeling of lithospheric deformation and subduction processes.
Systematic parameter sensitivity testing (varying thermal age and rheological strength of the lithosphere).
岩石圈变形与俯冲过程的三维数值地球动力学模拟。
系统参数敏感性测试（改变岩石圈的热年龄和流变强度）。
de: 3D synthetic geodynamic simulations of arc-continent collision and subduction polarity reversal.
Comparison of model results with tectonic observations from the Vitiaz, Andaman-Sumatra, Philippine, and Vanuatu subduction zones.
弧-陆碰撞和俯冲极性反转的三维合成地球动力学模拟。
将模型结果与Vitiaz、安达曼-苏门答腊、菲律宾和瓦努阿图俯冲带的构造观测进行对比。
li: The simplified rheological and thermal models may not capture all complex 3D geological heterogeneities of specific natural subduction zones.
简化的流变学和热学模型可能无法完全捕捉特定自然俯冲带的所有复杂三维地质非均匀性。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D geodynamic simulations to investigate subduction polarity reversal and lithospheric deformation during arc-continent collision.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the JGR Solid Earth abstract and public metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: InSAR deformation measurements suffer from long-wavelength errors that bias 3-D surface deformation estimates when combined with GNSS using conventional geometric or strain models. This paper introduces a combined adjustment model that incorporates systematic parameters (second-order polynomials for DInSAR, first-order for MAI) to represent InSAR long-wavelength errors, defines them via GNSS minimum constraints, and optimizes observation weights using least-squares variance component estimation (LS-VCE). Validated through synthetic experiments and applied to the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake (using 1249 GEONET GNSS stations, 14 PALSAR frames, and 8 ASAR frames), the method constrains datum deviations to under 1 mm (synthetic) and 2 mm (real data). Compared to geometric and strain models, it reduces 3-D deformation MAE relative to JPL reference solutions by 83–89% horizontally and 37–82% vertically, while recovering realistic fault-slip magnitudes (31 m max slip) and bilateral strike-slip components.
针对InSAR长波误差导致GNSS与InSAR联合估计三维形变产生严重偏差的问题，本文提出一种顾及长波误差的联合平差模型。该方法引入附加系统参数表征长波误差，利用GNSS最小约束定义基准，并通过最小二乘方差分量估计（LS-VCE）优化异源观测随机模型。基于模拟数据及2011年日本东北Mw9.0级地震……

t: A combined adjustment model introducing second- and first-order polynomial systematic parameters for InSAR/MAI long-wavelength errors, constrained by GNSS minimum constraints and weighted iteratively via least-squares variance component estimation (LS-VCE).
引入多项式系统参数表征InSAR/MAI长波误差，结合GNSS最小约束与LS-VCE构建全局联合平差模型。
Synthetic datasets and real observations of the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake comprising 1249 GEONET GNSS stations, 14 frames of L-band PALSAR, and 8 frames of C-band ASAR processed with DInSAR and MAI.
模拟数据及2011年日本东北地震的1249个GNSS站、14景PALSAR和8景ASAR（DInSAR与MAI）数据。

For the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake, the proposed model reduces 3-D deformation MAE relative to JPL solutions by 89.32%/89.27% (E), 83.33%/85.25% (N), and 37.5%/82.14% (U) compared to geometric and strain models.
相比几何与应变模型，实测E、N、U向形变MAE分别降低89.3%、83.3%~85.3%和37.5%~82.1%。
Requires at least six GNSS stations per SAR frame, incurs high computational cost, is less effective for small-amplitude signals, and cannot separate individual error sources.
单景需至少6个GNSS站，计算开销大，对小幅形变受限，且无法分离具体误差源。

Replaces step-by-step polynomial correction with a global combined adjustment that simultaneously estimates 3-D deformation, long-wavelength error parameters, and multi-source observation variance components.
摒弃传统分步校正，实现三维形变、长波误差参数与异源观测方差分量的全局同步估计。

kc: Formulated a global combined adjustment model that simultaneously estimates 3-D surface deformation and InSAR long-wavelength error parameters using GNSS minimum constraints.
Integrated least-squares variance component estimation (LS-VCE) to optimize the stochastic weighting across five heterogeneous observation types (ascending/descending DInSAR and MAI, plus GNSS).
Demonstrated on the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake that accounting for long-wavelength errors reduces horizontal deformation MAE by >83% and resolves 11 m of previously underestimated fault slip.
构建了利用GNSS最小约束同时估计三维地表形变与InSAR长波误差参数的全局联合平差模型。
引入最小二乘方差分量估计（LS-VCE），优化了升降轨DInSAR、MAI及GNSS五类异源观测数据的随机模型定权。
在2011年日本东北大地震应用中证明，顾及长波误差可将水平形变平均绝对误差降低83%以上，并修正了传统几何模型对最大断层滑动量达11米的低估。
me: Functional modeling of InSAR long-wavelength errors using a second-order polynomial model (SPM) for DInSAR LOS and first-order model for Multiple Aperture InSAR (MAI) azimuth data.
Definition of datum and long-wavelength error parameters via minimum constraint theory anchored to GNSS LOS-projected displacements.
Iterative stochastic model optimization using Förstner-simplified Least-Squares Variance Component Estimation (LS-VCE).
Coseismic fault-slip inversion using the Steepest Descent Method (SDM) to evaluate physical reliability of the derived 3-D deformation fields.
对DInSAR视线向采用二阶多项式（SPM）、对MAI方位向采用一阶多项式进行InSAR长波误差函数建模。
基于最小约束理论，利用投影至雷达视线向的GNSS位移对基准偏差和长波误差参数进行先验定义。
采用Förstner简化的最小二乘方差分量估计（LS-VCE）进行迭代随机模型优化。
利用最速下降法（SDM）开展同震断层滑动分布反演，检验三维形变场的物理可靠性。
de: Synthetic dataset based on JPL ARIA coseismic displacements interpolated to 600 m resolution across 3 PALSAR and 3 ASAR frames with added polynomial errors and Gaussian noise (10–60 mm).
Real-data case study of the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake combining 1249 GEONET GNSS station time series (processed with GipsyX 1.0) with 14 L-band PALSAR and 8 C-band ASAR frames.

Comparative evaluation across three adjustment strategies: Case I (geometric + coherence WLS), Case II (geometric + strain + SM-VCE), and Case III (proposed combined model + LS-VCE), plus step-by-step SPM+Case I.
基于JPL ARIA同震位移场构建的模拟数据集（涵盖3景PALSAR和3景ASAR，分辨率600 m，加入多项式长波误差与10–60 mm高斯噪声）。
2011年日本东北地震实测数据，融合1249个GEONET连续GNSS站点时间序列（GipsyX 1.0解算）与14景L波段PALSAR、8景C波段ASAR影像。
三种平差方案对比实验：方案I（几何模型+相干系数加权最小二乘）、方案II（几何与应变模型+SM-VCE）、方案III（本文联合平差模型+LS-VCE）以及分步校正方案（SPM+方案I）。
li: Best suited for large-amplitude deformation where signal greatly exceeds unmodeled higher-order systematic errors; limited benefit for small-amplitude signals.
Requires at least six GNSS stations with usable time series within each SAR frame coverage, limiting use in sparse GNSS regions.
High computational and memory cost for joint adjustment and VCE, necessitating downsampling of InSAR data to 600 x 600 m resolution.

主要适用于信号远大于未建模残余系统误差的大梯度形变，对小幅形变信号改善有限。

sum: This study constructs a detailed seismic crustal stratigraphy of Mars from the Cerberus Fossae source region of marsquake S0235b to the InSight landing site. By combining seismic waveforms from event S0235b and receiver functions from four quality-A marsquakes, the authors resolve a four-layer crustal model at the landing site and a three-layer model at the source side. A key novelty is the discovery of a low-velocity layer sandwiched between high-velocity layers on both sides (at 2.7–4.3 km depth on the source side and 3.9–6.2 km depth on the landing site), exhibiting strong negative SH-SV shear-wave anisotropy (-16% and -18%, respectively). The crust-mantle boundary is placed at 29.5 km (source) and 23.0 km (landing site). Synthetic tests confirm that these features and both P- and S-wave velocities are well resolved by the waveform data.
本研究利用S0235b火星地震波形及4个A类火星地震的接收函数，构建了从Cerberus Fossae震源区到InSight着陆点的详细火星地壳地震层序。研究发现着陆点下方为四层介质，震源侧为三层介质。其核心创新点在于首次发现两侧均夹有一个低速层（震源侧深2.7–4.3 km，着陆点深3.9–6.2……

A 3-layer source-side model (Moho at 29.5 km) and a 4-layer landing-site model (Moho at 23.0 km), both featuring a low-velocity layer with -16% to -18% SH-SV anisotropy.

sum: This study presents 3D dynamic rupture simulations to investigate the physical mechanisms controlling earthquake rupture jumps across normal-fault stepovers. By systematically varying prestress, principal stress orientation, and fault geometry (gap and overlap distances), the authors identify key factors enabling jumps up to 5 km. They reveal a fundamental trade-off: closely spaced faults enhance jump potential but limit earthquake magnitude due to stress-shadowing. The largest magnitudes occur when the receiver fault lies on the hanging wall of the emitter fault at specific configurations. Crucially, the study demonstrates that static Coulomb stress change approaches fail to fully capture these dynamic rupture complexities, as dynamic jumping is rarer than static criteria predict. This work enhances seismic hazard assessment for normal-fault systems.
本研究利用三维动态破裂模拟，探讨了正断层阶区地震破裂跳跃的物理机制。通过改变应力与断层几何，发现破裂最大可跳跃5公里。紧密相邻断层虽易于跳跃，但应力遮蔽会限制震级。最大震级发生于接收断层位于发射断层上盘的特定配置。动态模拟表明，实际破裂跳跃比静态库仑应力准则预测的更罕见，对正断层地震危险性评估具有重……

t: 3D dynamic rupture simulations of normal-fault segments systematically varying prestress, stress orientation, and geometry.

Synthetic fault models with stepover gaps up to 5 km and varying relative positions.

Ruptures jump up to 5 km; closely spaced faults limit magnitude via stress-shadowing; static Coulomb stress overpredicts connectivity.

sum: For over two centuries, inverse-problem solving has been dominated by the objective-driven paradigm, which constructs an objective function and minimizes it iteratively. However, this approach suffers from computational bottlenecks, ambiguous physical meaning of gradients, and multi-parameter mathematical coupling requiring expensive Hessian matrices. This paper articulates an emerging cross-domain paradigm: structure-driven methodology. Instead of iterative search, it advocates deconstructing a problem, identifying its intrinsic mathematical or physical structure, and constructing a direct solution via division, inversion, or deconvolution. Drawing on examples from the Liouville-variant Goldbach conjecture, the 3D Kakeya conjecture, Noether's theorem, deep learning (PSDBP and diffusion seismic denoising), and forty years of geophysical inversion (gravity and seismic imaging), the author proposes Structure-Driven Inversion (SDI), comprising Mathematical (MSDI) and Physical (PSDI) branches. Structure-driven methodology complements objective-driven search as a custom direct strategy, shifting the core question from 'how to search faster' to 'what is the problem's structure.'
两百多年来，反问题求解一直由构建并迭代最小化目标函数的“目标驱动”范式主导，面临计算瓶颈、梯度物理意义模糊及多参数耦合等局限。本文提出了跨领域的“结构驱动”方法论范式及结构驱动反演（SDI），包含数学结构驱动（MSDI）和物理结构驱动（PSDI）。该方法结合数论、纯数学、物理、深度学习及作者近四十年……

t: Structure-Driven Inversion (SDI) decomposes a problem to identify mathematical (unitary diagonalization) or physical (causal chain) structures, directly constructing solutions via division or deconvolution rather than iterative optimization.
通过解构问题识别数学（酉对角化）或物理（因果链）结构，利用除法或反褶积直接构建反演解。

The paper examines cross-domain theoretical and practical examples, including number theory proofs, pure mathematics, Noether's theorem, 3D gravity inversion, seismic reverse time migration, and deep neural networks.
综合数论证明、纯数学、物理对称性、三维重力反演、地震逆时偏移与神经网络等跨领域案例。

Replacing objective-driven multiplication/cross-correlation with structure-driven division/deconvolution naturally decouples multi-parameter contributions and eliminates the need for an expensive Hessian matrix in inverse problems.
以除法/反褶积替代互相关/乘法，实现多参数自然解耦，消除了对昂贵Hessian矩阵的需求。

Structure-driven methodology is a custom direct strategy that requires identifiable structure; when intrinsic structure is missing, it degenerates back to the general objective-driven search strategy.
属于定制化直接策略，依赖可识别的内禀结构；若结构缺失则退化为目标驱动搜索。
Articulates a cross-domain paradigm shift from iterative objective-function search to direct structure exploitation, formalizing Mathematical and Physical Structure-Driven Inversion (MSDI and PSDI).
提出从迭代搜索向结构利用的跨领域范式转变，系统建立数学与物理结构驱动反演（SDI）。

kc: Proposes and articulates structure-driven methodology as a cross-domain paradigm contrasting with the two-century-old objective-driven optimization tradition.
Formulates the Structure-Driven Inversion (SDI) framework, divided into Mathematical Structure-Driven Inversion (MSDI) and Physical Structure-Driven Inversion (PSDI).
Replaces cross-correlation/multiplication in gradient-based methods with division/inversion/deconvolution, naturally decoupling parameters without needing an expensive Hessian matrix.
Synthesizes cross-domain corroboration across number theory, pure mathematics, physics, potential-field inversion, seismic migration/imaging, and deep learning.
提出并阐述了“结构驱动方法论”这一跨领域范式，与延续两百余年的“目标驱动”优化传统形成对比与互补。
系统构建了结构驱动反演（SDI）框架，包含数学结构驱动反演（MSDI）和物理结构驱动反演（PSDI）。
以除法/求逆/反褶积取代基于梯度方法中的互相关/乘法，实现多参数自然解耦，消除了对昂贵Hessian矩阵的需求。
综合了数论、纯数学、物理学、位场反演、地震偏移成像及深度学习等多个领域的跨学科印证。
me: Four-step structure-driven logical chain: deconstruct the problem, identify intrinsic relationships (orthogonality, causality, hierarchy), exploit structure to construct a direct solver, and solve.
Mathematical Structure-Driven Inversion (MSDI): exploits unitary diagonalization of translation-invariant operators in the spectral domain to directly build pseudo-inverses.
Physical Structure-Driven Inversion (PSDI): exploits the causal chain of wave propagation (incident wave -> virtual source -> secondary wave) via virtual-source projection and deconvolution.

Physical Structure-Driven Back-Propagation (PSDBP): analogizes neural network weights to stiffness matrices and activations to constitutive relations, using analytical function inversion instead of chain-rule differentiation.
结构驱动四步逻辑链：解构问题、识别组件间内禀关系（正交性、因果性、层级性等）、利用结构直接构建求解方法、求解问题。
数学结构驱动反演（MSDI）：利用平移不变算子的酉对角化性质，在谱域直接构建伪逆算子。
物理结构驱动反演（PSDI）：利用波传播的因果链（入射波→虚拟源→二次波），通过虚拟源投影和反褶积直接求解。
物理结构驱动反向传播（PSDBP）：将神经网络层间连接类比为刚度矩阵、激活函数类比为本构关系，用解析函数求逆代替链式法则求导。
de: Conceptual and methodological review drawing on historical and recent theoretical proofs (Liouville-variant Goldbach conjecture, 3D Kakeya conjecture, Noether's theorem).
Synthesis of the author's prior geophysical inversion applications, including 3D spectral-domain gravity inversion and seismic waveform/least-squares reverse time migration.
Synthesis of recent deep learning applications, including PSDBP and signal-fitting diffusion models for prestack seismic denoising (SFDDPM).
概念与方法论综述，引证历史及近期理论证明案例（Liouville变体哥德巴赫猜想、三维Kakeya猜想、Noether定理）。
总结作者过往地球物理反演应用，包括三维谱域重力反演、地震波形反演成像及最小二乘逆时偏移。
总结近期深度学习应用，包括物理结构驱动反向传播（PSDBP）及用于叠前地震去噪的信号拟合扩散模型（SFDDPM）。
li: Structure-driven methodology relies on the presence of identifiable mathematical or physical structure; when such structure is missing, it degenerates to objective-driven search.
This article is a high-level philosophical and methodological synthesis without standalone new numerical benchmarks or experimental datasets presented in the text.
结构驱动方法依赖于可识别的数学或物理结构；当缺乏此类内禀结构时，该方法退化为目标驱动的通用搜索策略。
本文为高层次的方法论与哲学综述，正文中未展示独立的全新数值基准测试或实验数据集。

sum: RiptideRemix is an interactive dashboard developed during the 2025 Ocean Hack Week to synthesize marine acoustic and geophysical data into musical compositions. It integrates pre-processed audio clips from major repositories, including Ocean Networks Canada (ONC), SAGE, OrcaSound, and NCEI. Users can manipulate pitch, speed, and repetition in a visual audio mixer to create 'songs' while viewing corresponding waveforms and spectrograms. The tool serves an educational purpose by providing detailed descriptions of sensors, environments, and seismic wave characteristics, bridging data science, acoustic processing, and public outreach.

sum: While previous studies in the Northern and Central Apennines focused on destructive coseismic sequences (1997 Colfiorito, 2009 L'Aquila, 2016–2017 Amatrice–Visso–Norcia), this paper investigates the 2018–2024 interseismic phase to understand long-term seismogenic behavior. The authors relocated 54,151 events from the INGV catalog using hypoDD and identified 187 significant clusters via nearest-neighbor declustering. Background seismicity and most clusters align along a 2–3 km thick low-angle layer between 7 and 15 km depth. Calculations of seismic-to-total moment ratios and effective stress drops demonstrate that 67% of the clusters are driven by aseismic processes. Moving southeastward from Colfiorito to L'Aquila, cluster volumes decrease, depths increase, and the low-angle seismicity layer vanishes in the seismically quiet L'Aquila area. Comparisons with the 2011–2016 interseismic period reveal persistent activation of the same structures dominated by swarm and foreshock–mainshock–aftershock behaviors, highlighting the role of upper-crustal structural inheritance.
本研究聚焦意大利中北部亚平宁山脉2018-2024年震间期，旨在揭示长期发震机制。研究利用hypoDD对INGV目录中54,151个事件进行重定位，并通过最近邻去丛集算法识别出187个地震丛集。通过计算地震矩占比和有效应力降，发现67%的丛集由无震过程驱动。背景地震和多数丛集分布在7-15 km深处……

t: Relocated catalog earthquakes using double-difference hypoDD, extracted clusters via nearest-neighbor space-time-magnitude declustering, and quantified driving mechanisms using seismic-to-total moment ratios, effective stress drops, and Ogata & Katsura (2012) sequence classification.
利用hypoDD双差重定位和最近邻去丛集算法提取丛集，并计算地震矩占比、有效应力降及序列分类。

55,278 INGV catalog earthquakes (-0.1 <= ML <= 4.6) from January 2018 to August 2024 across the Northern-Central Apennines using 196 stations, compared against ~114,000 events from the 2011–2016 interseismic catalog.
INGV目录2018-2024年亚平宁中北部55,278次地震（196个台站），并与2011-2016年约11.4万次事…

54,151 events were relocated and 187 clusters (>=10 events) identified; 67% are aseismically driven (moment ratio <0.5, effective stress-drop <1 MPa), classified as 42% swarms, 36% foreshock-mainshock-aftershocks, and 21% mainshock-aftershocks.
重定位54,151次事件并识别187个丛集；67%受无震过程驱动，包含42%震群、36%前震-主震-余震和21%主震-余…
Neglecting surface topography (~1000 m) and relative location uncertainties in hypoDD caused a depth offset between the 2018–2024 and 2011–2016 interseismic catalogs.
