First comprehensive characterization and multi-period comparison of interseismic cluster mechanics across the Northern-Central Apennines, linking southward shifts in aseismic cluster volume and depth to inherited upper-crustal lithology.
首次系统对比亚平宁震间期丛集力学机制，将无震丛集体积与深度的南北差异归因于上地壳构造继承性。

kc: Relocated 54,151 interseismic earthquakes (2018–2024) in the Northern and Central Apennines using hypoDD and identified 187 clusters with >=10 events.
Demonstrated via seismic-to-total moment ratio (<0.5) and effective stress-drop (<1 MPa) that 67% of interseismic clusters are driven by aseismic processes.
Revealed systematic NW-to-SE variations: cluster volume and number decrease, cluster depth increases, and the 7–15 km deep low-angle seismicity layer disappears in the L'Aquila area.

Showed through comparison with the 2011–2016 interseismic phase that both periods illuminate identical structures with swarm (42%–55%) and foreshock–mainshock–aftershock (36%–43%) behavior, controlled by upper-crustal lithological inheritance.
使用hypoDD重定位了亚平宁中北部2018-2024年震间期的54,151次地震，并识别出187个包含至少10个事件的地震丛集。
通过地震矩与总矩之比（<0.5）和有效应力降（<1 MPa），证明67%的震间期丛集由无震过程驱动。
揭示了从西北向东南的系统性变化：丛集体积和数量减小、深度增加，且7-15 km深处的低角度地震层在拉奎拉地区消失。
通过与2011-2016年震间期对比，表明两个时期激活了相同的构造，以震群（42%–55%）和前震-主震-余震（36%–43%）为主，受上地壳岩性继承性控制。
me: Double-difference earthquake relocation using hypoDD with the Chiaraluce et al. (2011) 1D velocity model tested against five alternative regional models.
Space-time-magnitude nearest-neighbor declustering (Zaliapin & Ben-Zion, 2020) with fractal dimension 1.9, b=0, and threshold eta_0 = -3.4.
Estimation of cluster physical mechanics using the seismic-to-total moment ratio (Danré et al., 2022) and effective stress-drop (Fischer & Hainzl, 2017).
Temporal sequence classification into mainshock-aftershocks (MA), foreshocks-mainshocks-aftershocks (FMA), and swarms (S) based on magnitude differences (Ogata & Katsura, 2012).
采用hypoDD双差定位算法和Chiaraluce等（2011）的一维速度模型（并与其余五种区域模型对比验证）进行地震重定位。
应用Zaliapin和Ben-Zion（2020）的时空震级最近邻去丛集算法（分形维数1.9，b=0，阈值η0 = -3.4）。
利用地震矩占比（Danré等，2022）和有效应力降（Fischer & Hainzl，2017）评估每个丛集的物理驱动机制。
基于震级差分类法（Ogata & Katsura，2012）将地震丛集划分为主震-余震型（MA）、前震-主震-余震型（FMA）和震群型（S）。
de: INGV seismic catalog from 01/01/2018 to 31/08/2024 in the Northern and Central Apennines (42.1°–43.2° N, 12.4°–13.6° E), totaling 55,278 events (-0.1 <= ML <= 4.6) recorded by 196 stations within 200 km.
Template-matching relocated catalog of the 2011–2016 interseismic period (~114,000 events) from Sugan et al. (2023) for multi-phase interseismic comparison.

Published coseismic catalogs and literature parameters for the 1997 Colfiorito, 2009 L'Aquila (Valoroso et al., 2013), and 2016–2017 Amatrice–Visso–Norcia (Tan et al., 2021; Volpe et al., 2023) sequences.
意大利国家地球物理与火山学研究所（INGV）2018年1月1日至2024年8月31日亚平宁中北部（42.1°–43.2° N, 12.4°–13.6° E）地震目录，包含200 km内196个台站记录的55,278个事件（-0.1 <= ML <= 4.6）。
Sugan等（2023）基于模板匹配重定位的2011-2016年震间期地震目录（约114,000个事件），用于跨震间期对比。
已发表的1997年Colfiorito、2009年L'Aquila（Valoroso等，2013）和2016-2017年Amatrice-Visso-Norcia（Tan等，2021；Volpe等，2023）同震序列目录。
li: Topography (~1000 m average elevation) was not accounted for during hypoDD relocation, introducing a systematic absolute depth offset compared to the 2011–2016 catalog.
Cluster internal areas are calculated as 2D apparent areas from boundary events, which can bias moment ratio estimates for volumetric or near-vertical fault distributions.
The 2018–2024 catalog lacks template-matching enhancement, resulting in fewer detected events and clusters compared to the 2011–2016 template-matched catalog.
hypoDD重定位未考虑地形（平均海拔约1000米），导致与2011-2016年目录相比存在系统性的绝对深度偏差。
丛集面积由边界事件计算为二维视面积，对于三维体积分布或近垂直断层上的地震可能会产生偏差。
2018-2024年目录未经模板匹配扩充，因此检测到的事件和丛集数量少于2011-2016年模板匹配目录。

tm.why: The study relocates a 55,278-event earthquake catalog using hypoDD and applies a nearest-neighbor declustering algorithm to analyze interseismic cluster dynamics.
By computing seismic-to-total moment ratios and effective stress drops, the authors show that 67% of interseismic clusters are driven by aseismic processes.
Along-strike variations in interseismic cluster depth, volume, and activity are linked to inherited upper-crustal structural and lithological transitions between the Northern and Central Apennines.

ev.notes: Full 42-page manuscript PDF (accepted manuscript / preprint format) including abstract, main text (§1–§6), all 7 figures, and references was read and analyzed.

sum: To overcome the poor spatial resolution of volcanic tremor localization caused by sparse networks and complex wavefields, this paper proposes a maximum likelihood estimation (MLE)-based iterative peeling interferometric imaging method. The approach combines the noise robustness of interferometry with an iterative deblurring framework. By constructing data-driven empirical wavelets and updating an adaptive whitening filter via the Sherman-Morrison formula, it sequentially removes source responses from the residual wavefield, suppressing sidelobe interference. Synthetic and field applications to the 2011 Katla volcano tremor data demonstrate that the method achieves high-resolution source localization consistent with known ice cauldrons, even under adverse array geometries and multi-source interference.
针对稀疏台网和复杂波场导致的火山震颤定位分辨率低的问题，本文提出一种基于最大似然估计（MLE）的迭代剥离干涉成像方法。该方法结合了干涉测量的抗噪性与迭代去模糊框架，通过构建数据驱动的经验小波并利用Sherman-Morrison公式动态更新自适应白化滤波器，从残差波场中顺序剥离源响应，从而抑制旁瓣干……

t: An MLE-based iterative peeling interferometric imaging method that uses data-driven empirical wavelets and an adaptive whitening filter to sequentially strip source responses.
一种基于最大似然估计的迭代剥离干涉成像方法，利用数据驱动经验小波和自适应白化滤波器顺序剥离源响应。
Synthetic datasets modeled after the Katla volcano scenario and field passive seismic data recording the 2011 Katla volcanic tremor.
模拟Katla火山场景的合成数据集以及记录2011年Katla火山震颤的野外被动地震数据。
Achieved significantly higher spatial resolution than existing techniques in synthetic tests and successfully recovered source locations consistent with known ice cauldrons in field data.
在合成测试中实现了显著高于现有技术的分辨率，并在实际数据中成功恢复了与已知冰釜一致的震源位置。
Potential sensitivity to highly complex velocity errors and increased computational demands during iterative peeling of numerous sources.
对极复杂速度误差的潜在敏感性，以及在迭代剥离大量震源时计算需求增加。
Combines interferometry with an iterative peeling framework and Sherman-Morrison-based adaptive whitening to deblur source images from sparse arrays.
将干涉测量与迭代剥离框架及基于Sherman-Morrison的自适应白化相结合，消除了稀疏台阵的源图像模糊。

kc: Developed an MLE-based iterative peeling interferometric imaging method to improve volcanic tremor localization resolution.
Introduced an adaptive whitening filter dynamically updated via the Sherman-Morrison formula to suppress sidelobe interference from sparse arrays.
Validated the method using synthetic Katla volcano scenarios and 2011 field data, successfully locating sources near known ice cauldrons.
开发了一种基于最大似然估计（MLE）的迭代剥离干涉成像方法，提高了火山震颤定位的分辨率。
引入了通过Sherman-Morrison公式动态更新的自适应白化滤波器，以抑制稀疏台阵产生的旁瓣干扰。
利用Katla火山合成场景和2011年实测数据验证了该方法，成功定位了已知冰釜附近的震颤源。
me: Interferometric imaging for robust source localization under weak phase signatures.
Maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) framework for iterative source peeling.
Data-driven empirical wavelet construction.
Adaptive whitening filter dynamically updated using the Sherman-Morrison formula.
干涉成像技术，用于在弱相位特征下进行鲁棒的震源定位。
用于迭代源剥离的最大似然估计（MLE）框架。
数据驱动的经验小波构建。
利用Sherman-Morrison公式动态更新的自适应白化滤波器。
de: Synthetic tests based on the Katla volcano scenario with adverse array geometries and multi-source interference.
Field application using passive seismic data from the 2011 Katla volcano eruption/tremor event.
基于Katla火山场景的合成测试，包含恶劣台阵几何和多源干扰。
使用2011年Katla火山喷发/震颤事件的被动地震数据进行野外应用。
li: Relies on the accuracy of the constructed empirical wavelets and velocity models, though it shows some robustness to velocity inaccuracies.
Computational cost may increase with the number of iterative peeling steps and grid search size.
依赖于构建的经验小波和速度模型的准确性，尽管其对速度不确定性表现出一定的鲁棒性。
计算成本可能会随着迭代剥离步骤和网格搜索大小的增加而增加。

tm.why: The paper focuses on high-resolution localization of volcanic tremors.
The proposed method is based on iterative peeling interferometric imaging.
The core objective is the spatial localization of passive seismic sources.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, which outlines the methodology, synthetic testing, and field application to Katla volcano.

sum: Plagioclase controls mid-to-lower crustal rheology, yet its crystal plasticity is poorly quantified because brittle failure dominates standard laboratory experiments. This study uses focused-ion-beam milled micropillars (~1 μm diameter) compressed inside a scanning electron microscope at 25, 300, and 800 °C and strain rates of 10^-3 to 10^-1 s^-1 to isolate slip systems and mechanical twinning in natural anorthite (An96) across three crystal orientations. Transmission electron microscopy and diffraction identify active deformation mechanisms. Results show plastic deformation dominates at the micron scale without cleavage cracking. Pericline twinning is the easiest mechanism with a critical resolved shear stress (CRSS) of ~300 MPa, insensitive to temperature and strain rate, making it a promising high-stress paleopiezometer. In contrast, dislocation slip exhibits strong thermal softening: slip on {011}<100> is consistently softer than conjugate slip on {011}<0-11> or {0-11}<011>, providing first direct quantitative constraints on individual slip systems in anorthite.
斜长石主导中下地壳流变性质，但常规实验中脆性破裂占优，难以量化其晶体塑性。本研究利用聚焦离子束制备约1微米直径的天然钙长石（An96）单晶微柱，在扫描电镜内于25、300和800 °C及10^-3至10^-1 s^-1应变率下对三个晶向进行单轴压缩，并结合透射电镜解析变形机制。结果表明微米尺度下塑性……

t: Uniaxial compression of FIB-milled ~1 μm single-crystal anorthite micropillars inside an SEM at 25–800 °C and strain rates of 10^-3 to 10^-1 s^-1, followed by TEM/SAED nanostructural analysis.
在扫描电镜内对FIB制备的1微米钙长石单晶微柱进行25–800°C单轴压缩，并结合TEM/SAED分析。
36 micropillar compression tests across three crystallographic orientations ({110}, {-110}, {001}) cut from a natural An96 single crystal from Yoichi, Japan, with 9 pillars analyzed via TEM.
对日本北海道An96天然单晶的三个晶向共进行36次微柱压缩测试，并对9个微柱进行TEM表征。
Pericline twinning is athermal and rate-insensitive with a CRSS of ~300 MPa. Slip systems soften strongly with temperature; {011}<100> is consistently weaker than {011}<0-11> or {0-11}<011>.
斜律双晶CRSS约300 MPa且不随温率和应变率变化；滑移系随升温软化，{011}<100>最易激活。
Directly applying micron-scale CRSS values to natural rocks is limited by unquantified sample size effects and ambiguity between surface dislocation nucleation versus lattice resistance.
尺寸效应尚未明确，且难以区分表面位错形核与晶格阻力，限制了向天然岩石尺度的直接外推。
First successful use of micropillar compression to suppress brittle fracture in anorthite and directly quantify individual slip-system and twinning CRSS values.
首次利用微柱压缩抑制钙长石脆性破裂，直接测定了其特定滑移系和机械双晶的临界分切应力。

kc: Demonstrated that micropillar compression suppresses brittle cleavage cracking and enables purely plastic deformation in anorthite even at room temperature.
Quantified the critical resolved shear stress (CRSS) for mechanical pericline twinning in anorthite at ~300 MPa, showing it is athermal and strain-rate insensitive.
Determined the relative strength and temperature sensitivity of specific anorthite slip systems, showing {011}<100> is softer than {011}<0-11> / {0-11}<011>.
证明微柱压缩能抑制脆性解理裂纹，使钙长石即使在室温下也能发生纯塑性变形。
量化了钙长石机械斜律双晶的临界分切应力（CRSS约为300 MPa），证实其具有非热激活和应变率不敏感特性。
测定了钙长石特定滑移系的相对强度与温度敏感性，表明{011}<100>比{011}<0-11> / {0-11}<011>更易滑移。
me: Focused-ion beam (FIB) milling of ~1 μm diameter cylindrical micropillars in three crystallographic orientations ({110}, {-110}, {001}).
In-situ uniaxial micropillar compression inside an SEM at 25, 300, and 800 °C and strain rates of 10^-3 to 10^-1 s^-1.
Post-deformation nanostructural characterization using transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and selected area electron diffraction (SAED).
利用聚焦离子束（FIB）在三个晶体取向（{110}、{-110}、{001}）上加工直径约1微米的圆柱形微柱。
在扫描电镜（SEM）内于25、300和800 °C以及10^-3至10^-1 s^-1应变率下进行原位单轴微柱压缩实验。
利用透射电子显微镜（TEM）和选区电子衍射（SAED）对变形后的纳米结构进行表征。
de: 36 uniaxial compression tests on natural anorthite (An96) single-crystal micropillars from Yoichi, Hokkaido, Japan.
TEM bright-field imaging and SAED indexing on 9 representative deformed micropillars across temperatures and orientations.
对采自日本北海道余市町的天然钙长石（An96）单晶微柱进行了36次单轴压缩测试。
对涵盖不同温度和取向的9个代表性变形微柱进行了TEM明场成像与SAED标定。
li: Extrapolating micron-scale CRSS values to natural millimeter-sized grains is uncertain due to unquantified sample size effects.
Cannot conclusively distinguish whether slip strength is controlled by surface dislocation nucleation or lattice (Peierls) resistance.
Pillars were not oriented to test the commonly discussed (010)[001] slip system.
由于样品尺寸效应尚未量化，将微米尺度的CRSS值外推至天然毫米级矿物颗粒存在不确定性。
尚无法明确区分控制滑移强度的主导机制是表面位错形核还是晶格（Peierls）阻力。
实验微柱的取向未能测试前人常讨论的(010)[001]滑移系。

tm.why: The study quantifies the crystal-plastic deformation and slip-system strength of anorthite (plagioclase), which controls the rheology of the mid-to-lower continental crust.

ev.notes: Full 37-page PDF including all text, Table 1, and Figures 1–13 was read and analyzed.

sum: Understanding volcanic unrest driven by hydrothermal activity requires constraining subsurface rock properties governing fluid storage and failure. This study investigates the 2021–ongoing unrest at La Fossa Caldera (Vulcano Island, Italy) by correlating outcropping volcanic analogues with stratigraphy from two deep geothermal wells (VP1 and IV1). Using high-resolution 3D X-ray microtomography (µCT), digital rock physics fluid flow simulations, and in-situ 4D uniaxial compressive and indirect tensile strength testing, the authors characterise key caldera-fill lithologies. They identify a highly porous (52%) and permeable (1.69×10⁻¹¹ m²) welded scoria horizon at ~615–655 m depth beneath the caldera centre, bounded by low-porosity, high-strength lava units (tensile strength ~13–17 MPa). Integrated with geodetic, magnetotelluric, and microseismic observations, this provides the first laboratory-grounded physical framework showing how the lava units act as seals, enabling ~8 MPa fluid overpressure and triggering fracture reactivation and degassing without requiring shallow magma intrusion.
本研究针对意大利武尔卡诺岛La Fossa破火山口2021年至今的热液动荡，结合钻井地层对比，对代表性露头岩石开展了高分辨率X射线显微CT（µCT）成像、数字岩石物理渗流模拟及原位4D单轴抗压与间接抗拉力学测试。结果在破火山口中心下方约615–655米深处识别出一个高孔隙度（52%）、高渗透率（1.……

t: Combined petrographic observations, density measurements, 3D X-ray microtomography (µCT) pore-network fluid flow simulations, and time-resolved in-situ 4D µCT uniaxial compressive and indirect tensile strength testing on outcrop analogues correlated with deep geothermal boreholes.
结合岩相学、密度测量、三维µCT孔隙渗流模拟及原位4D µCT单轴抗压与抗拉强度测试，分析与深井对比的露头样品。

Ten volcanic and intrusive rock sample suites collected from subaerial outcrops on Vulcano Island, stratigraphically correlated with subsurface units down to >1360 m depth in the AGIP geothermal wells VP1 and IV1.
采集自武尔卡诺岛地表露头的10组火山岩与侵入岩样品，与VP1和IV1地热井地下地层对比。

The interbedded welded scoria unit (615–655 m in VP1) exhibits 52% porosity, 1.69×10⁻¹¹ m² simulated permeability, and low strength (UCS 13.2 MPa, ITS 2.66 MPa), bounded by impermeable lavas with UCS of 60–104 MPa and ITS of 13–17 MPa.
熔结浮岩层（VP1井615–655米）孔隙度达52%、渗透率1.69×10⁻¹¹ m²，上下被抗压60–104 MPa的…

Measurements reflect matrix-scale properties of fresh subaerial analogues rather than fracture-controlled bulk permeability or hydrothermally altered rocks at depth, and do not directly constrain in-situ stresses.
测量基于新鲜露头基质尺度，未直接包含深部强热液蚀变、宏观裂隙网络及原位应力条件。

First integrated laboratory-scale microstructural, petrophysical, and 4D in-situ geomechanical characterisation of the La Fossa Caldera succession linked with geophysical observations to explain the 2021–ongoing hydrothermal unrest.
首次对La Fossa破火山口地层开展综合微观与4D原位力学表征，并结合地球物理观测解释2021年以来的热液动荡。

kc: Provides the first integrated laboratory-scale microstructural, petrophysical, and geomechanical characterisation of representative lithologies from the La Fossa Caldera subsurface succession.

Identifies a porous (52%) and permeable welded scoria horizon at 615–655 m depth (VP1) and 190–260 m depth (IV1) acting as the main hydrothermal reservoir, confined by strong, low-permeability lava units.

Integrates laboratory strength constraints (caprock tensile strength ~14 MPa) with geodetic (~8–8.5 MPa overpressure) and microseismic data to propose a conceptual model of cyclic fracture reactivation during the 2021–ongoing unrest.
首次对代表La Fossa破火山口地下地层序列的岩性进行了综合的实验室尺度微观结构、岩石物理和地质力学表征。
识别出位于615–655米（VP1井）和190–260米（IV1井）深处的高孔隙度（52%）、高渗透率熔结浮岩层作为主要热液储层，其受坚固的低渗熔岩单元封闭。
将实验室强度约束（盖层抗拉强度约14 MPa）与大地测量（约8–8.5 MPa超压）及微震数据相结合，提出了2021年至今动荡期间裂隙周期性重新激活的概念模型。
me: Stratigraphic and petrographic correlation of fresh subaerial outcrop samples with deep geothermal borehole logs (VP1 and IV1).
3D high-resolution X-ray microtomography (µCT) and digital rock physics (lattice Boltzmann / Stokes solver in PerGeos) to quantify total/connected porosity and matrix permeability.
In-situ 4D X-µCT uniaxial compressive strength (UCS) and Brazilian indirect tensile strength (ITS) experiments, validated against conventional ASTM laboratory testing.
将新鲜地表露头样品与深部地热钻孔（VP1和IV1）剖面进行地层学和岩相学对比。
利用三维高分辨率X射线显微断层扫描（µCT）和数字岩石物理（PerGeos中的格子玻尔兹曼/斯托克斯求解器）量化总孔隙度、连通孔隙度和基质渗透率。
开展原位4D X-µCT单轴抗压强度（UCS）和巴西劈裂间接抗拉强度（ITS）实验，并与常规ASTM实验室测试结果进行对比验证。
de: Ten volcanic and intrusive outcrop sample suites (car2, gp1, tgr, vl178-11, sl, vl175b14, vl175b1, vl102, vl105, moga) representing eruptive epochs EE2 to EE8 down to >1360 m depth.
High-resolution 3D µCT scans (pixel size 2.01–5.24 µm) and single-phase fluid flow numerical simulations on reconstructed pore networks.
Time-resolved 4D µCT mechanical tests (~15 µm voxel size) and conventional BRAVA apparatus rock mechanics measurements.
采集代表EE2至EE8喷发期、对应地下深度达1360米以上的10组火山岩与侵入岩露头样品（car2, gp1, tgr, vl178-11, sl, vl175b14, vl175b1, vl102, vl105, moga）。
高分辨率三维µCT扫描（像素尺寸2.01–5.24 µm）以及基于重构孔隙网络的单相流体流动数值模拟。
时间分辨4D µCT力学测试（体素尺寸约15 µm）以及常规BRAVA岩石力学实验设备测量。
li: Measurements were performed on fresh subaerial outcrop analogues rather than actual drill cores, which have undergone extensive hydrothermal (argillic and silicic) alteration at depth.
Permeability simulations reflect micron-scale matrix pore networks and do not capture bulk rock-mass permeability governed by macroscopic fracture networks.
In-situ stress field, effective stress, fracture density, and mechanical anisotropy at depth are not directly constrained by the room-temperature laboratory dataset.
测量基于新鲜地表露头类似物而非实际钻孔岩芯，而深部岩石实际上经历了强烈的泥化和硅化热液蚀变。
渗透率模拟仅反映微米尺度的基质孔隙网络，未涵盖受宏观裂隙网络控制的岩体整体渗透率。
常温实验室数据集无法直接约束深部的原位应力场、有效应力、裂隙密度和力学各向异性。

tm.why: The study investigates the 2021-ongoing hydrothermal unrest at La Fossa Caldera (Vulcano Island), integrating laboratory rock physics with geophysical, geodetic, and volcano-seismic observations.

ev.notes: Full 21-page PDF of the article in press was read and analysed, including all text sections, 7 figures, and 2 tables.

sum: This study performs 3D spectral-element simulations of seismic wave propagation in the Swiss Rhône Valley to investigate the impact of realistic Alpine topography on ground motion. By comparing topographic and flat-surface models for three local earthquakes, the authors identify a systematic component asymmetry: mountain sites experience horizontal deamplification (median 0.80–0.97× at 0.05–0.50 Hz) but consistent vertical amplification (1.16–2.32×). This asymmetry is attributed to topography-induced mode conversion and constructive interference from Alpine ridge geometry. The study highlights that sparse observational networks may fail to capture these complex 3D effects, demonstrating the value of physics-based simulations with uniform synthetic grids for seismic hazard assessment.
本研究对瑞士罗讷河谷进行三维谱元模拟，量化阿尔卑斯地形对地面运动的影响。通过对比地形与平坦模型对三次本地地震的响应，发现山体场地水平向运动在低中频段减弱（0.80-0.97倍），而垂直向显著放大（1.16-2.32倍）。这种不对称性源于地形诱发的模式转换与山脊干涉。研究表明，物理模拟能有效弥补稀疏观……

t: 3D spectral-element simulations of seismic wave propagation incorporating DEM-based topography and a 3D crustal velocity model.
结合数字高程模型和三维地壳速度结构的三维谱元地震波传播模拟方法。
Simulations of three local earthquakes (Mw 3.2–4.5) recorded on a real seismic network and a uniform synthetic grid.
三次本地地震（Mw 3.2-4.5）在实际地震台网和均匀合成网格上的模拟记录。
Mountain sites show horizontal deamplification (0.80–0.97×) and vertical amplification (1.16–2.32×) at 0.05–0.50 Hz, indicating strong component asymmetry.
山体场地在低中频段表现出水平向减弱和垂直向放大的不对称性。
Analysis is restricted to three local earthquake events and specific Alpine valley geometry.
研究仅限于三次特定本地地震事件和特定的阿尔卑斯河谷几何结构。
Revealing systematic component-dependent asymmetry (horizontal deamplification vs. vertical amplification) using spatially unbiased synthetic receiver grids.
利用空间无偏的合成接收器网格，揭示了系统性的分量相关地形效应。

kc: Quantified frequency- and component-dependent topographic effects in the Swiss Rhône Valley using 3D physics-based simulations.
Discovered a systematic component asymmetry where horizontal motion is deamplified but vertical motion is amplified at mountain sites.
Demonstrated that sparse observational networks can bias the characterization of topographic effects compared to spatially uniform synthetic grids.
利用三维物理模拟量化了瑞士罗讷河谷与频率和分量相关的地形效应。
发现了系统性的分量不对称性，即山体场地的水平向运动减弱，而垂直向运动被放大。
表明与空间均匀的合成网格相比，稀疏的实际观测网络可能会对地形效应的表征产生偏差。
me: 3D spectral-element method (SEM) for seismic wave propagation.
Digital elevation model (DEM) for free-surface topography representation.
Spectral ratio analysis (Topo/flat) to isolate topographic effects.
用于地震波传播的三维谱元法（SEM）。
用于自由表面地形表征的数字高程模型（DEM）。
用于隔离地形效应的谱比分析（地形/平坦）。
de: 3D crustal velocity model of Switzerland with geotechnically constrained near-surface layers.
Simulations of three local earthquakes (Mw 3.2–4.5).
Comparison between a real seismic network and a spatially uniform synthetic grid of receivers.
包含岩土工程约束近地表层的瑞士三维地壳速度模型。
三次本地地震（Mw 3.2-4.5）的模拟。
实际地震台网与空间均匀合成接收器网格之间的对比。
li: The study is limited to three specific local earthquake sources and a single regional velocity model.
Near-surface geotechnical layers may still lack fine-scale heterogeneity.
研究仅限于三次特定的本地地震源和单一的区域速度模型。
近地表岩土层可能仍缺乏细微尺度的非均匀性。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D spectral-element simulations to model seismic wave propagation in complex Alpine topography.
The study quantifies how realistic topography affects ground motion and discusses implications for seismic hazard assessment.
