sum: This study investigates the interplay between fluids, seismic, and aseismic deformation around the November 27, 2013 Mw 4.6 earthquake in the western Sea of Marmara along the North Anatolian Fault. Combining six ocean-bottom seismometers, 11 land stations, and two seafloor piezometers from October 2013 to September 2014, the authors detect 2,079 microearthquakes and relocate 409 events using NonLinLoc and hypoDD. They identify a 26-event multiplet of highly similar earthquakes occurring 2 to 6 days prior to the mainshock in the Central Basin, followed ~19 days later by opposite pore pressure variations at two piezometers 15 km to the west. Poroelastic and Coulomb stress modeling of a previously proposed westward-propagating slow-slip event (SSE, ~0.5 km/day) yields small static stress changes (~0.8 kPa) and pore pressure perturbations (~0.25 kPa), yet provides a coherent spatio-temporal timeline linking aseismic slip, splay-fault seismicity, and subseafloor hydrology.
本研究探讨了2013年11月27日马尔马拉海西部Mw 4.6地震期间流体、地震与无震变形的相互作用。结合6台海底地震仪（OBS）、11个陆地台站和2台海底孔隙水压计数据，作者检测了2079次微震并重定位了409次事件。研究发现主震前一周在中央盆地出现了包含26次高相似事件的微震群，随后西侧15公里处……

t: Microseismicity was detected via STA/LTA, picked with a kurtosis picker, located in 3D with NonLinLoc, and relocated with hypoDD using waveform cross-correlation. Poroelastic Coulomb failure stress changes were modeled for a propagating slow-slip patch.
采用STA/LTA检测微震，峰度法拾取震相，NonLinLoc与hypoDD重定位，并计算慢滑移孔隙弹性库仑应力变化。

Six ocean-bottom seismometers (three INGV broadband, three KOERI short-period), 11 coastal land stations, and two multi-level seafloor piezometers (PZS and PZN) deployed in the western Sea of Marmara from October 2013 to November 2014.
2013年10月至2014年11月马尔马拉海西部6台海底地震仪、11个陆地台站及2台海底孔隙水压计观测数据。

Out of 2,079 detected events, 409 were relocated into four clusters. A 26-event multiplet preceded the Mw 4.6 mainshock by 2–6 days. SSE poroelastic modeling yields up to ~0.8 kPa Coulomb stress increase and ~0.25 kPa pore pressure change.
重定位409次微震；发现主震前26次高相似微震群；SSE模型在主震区产生最高约0.8 kPa库仑应力增量。
Calculated static stress (~0.8 kPa) and pore pressure (~0.25 kPa) perturbations are 20 times smaller than observed (~5 kPa), and broadband OBSs recorded no tectonic tremors.
模拟孔隙水压（0.25 kPa）比实测小20倍，且宽频带OBS未记录到低频颤动，因果机制仍属定性假设。

First joint analysis of unpublished seafloor OBS microseismicity and in-situ piezometer pore-pressure records to test causal links between a propagating slow-slip event and splay-fault seismicity in the Sea of Marmara.
首次联合未发表的海底地震仪与海底孔隙水压原位数据，检验马尔马拉海慢滑移事件与地震及流体活动的因果联系。

kc: Detected 2,079 microearthquakes and relocated 409 events in the western Sea of Marmara using a combined network of 6 OBSs and 11 onshore stations.
Identified a 26-event multiplet of highly correlated microearthquakes occurring 2–6 days before the November 27, 2013 Mw 4.6 mainshock in a known repeater zone.

Evaluated static Coulomb failure stress and poroelastic pore pressure changes from a westward-propagating slow-slip event (SSE), establishing a coherent spatio-temporal timeline linking the multiplet, mainshock, and piezometric anomalies.
利用6台海底地震仪和11个陆地台站联合网络，在马尔马拉海西部检测到2079次微震并高精度重定位了409次事件。
识别出2013年11月27日Mw 4.6主震前2至6天在已知重复地震带发生的包含26个高相似事件的微震群。
计算了向西传播的慢滑移事件（SSE）引起的静态库仑破裂应力和孔隙弹性水压变化，建立了连接微震群、主震和孔隙水压异常的时空演化序列。
me: Microseismicity detection via STA/LTA (5–45 Hz) followed by automatic P- and S-wave kurtosis phase picking (Baillard et al., 2014) and manual review.

3D probabilistic absolute location using NonLinLoc in a 3D P-wave velocity model with depth-dependent Vp/Vs ratios, followed by double-difference relocation (hypoDD) incorporating waveform cross-correlation (3–30 Hz) and bootstrap uncertainty estimation.
Hierarchical waveform clustering (cross-correlation ≥ 0.8) and Brune spectral fitting for moment magnitude estimation.
Static Coulomb failure stress transfer and undrained poroelastic pore pressure modeling (Coulomb 3.3) for propagating 2×2 km SSE slip patches with right-lateral slip and tensile opening.
采用STA/LTA（5–45 Hz）进行微震检测，并结合基于峰度（kurtosis）的P波和S波自动拾取算法及人工审核。
利用NonLinLoc在三维P波速度模型中进行绝对定位，随后结合波形互相关（3–30 Hz）利用双差定位法（hypoDD）进行重定位及自助法（bootstrapping）不确定度评估。
采用层次聚类分析识别高相似事件簇（互相关系数≥0.8），并通过拟合Brune震源谱计算矩震级。
利用修改版Coulomb 3.3程序，针对兼具右旋走滑与张性开启的2×2 km慢滑移块体，计算不排水孔隙弹性条件下的静态库仑应力传递与孔隙水压变化。
de: Continuous seismic recordings from 6 offshore OBSs (3 broadband INGV CMG-40T and 3 short-period KOERI geophones, with hydrophones) deployed between October 2013 and September 2014.
Seismic waveform data from 11 coastal and island land stations from the KOERI, Istanbul University, and MARSITE networks.
In situ differential sediment pore pressure time series sampled at 1 Hz from two IFREMER seafloor piezometers (PZS-5 at 6.28 m depth and PZN-6 at 7.08 m depth) near the Western High.
2013年10月至2014年9月期间部署的6台海底地震仪（3台INGV宽频带地震仪和3台KOERI短周期检波器，均配水听器）连续观测数据。
来自KOERI、伊斯坦布尔大学和MARSITE台网的11个海岸及岛屿陆地地震台站波形数据。
部署在Western High附近主断层谷内及泥火山旁的两台IFREMER海底孔隙水压计（PZS-5深6.28米，PZN-6深7.08米）1 Hz原位差分孔隙水压时间序列。
li: Calculated static Coulomb stress changes (up to ~0.8 kPa) and poroelastic pore pressure changes (~0.25 kPa) are much smaller than the observed ~5 kPa piezometric variations, providing only qualitative support for SSE triggering.
No tectonic tremors or low-frequency earthquakes typically associated with SSEs were recorded by the broadband OBSs.

Instrumental malfunctions, high horizontal noise levels, clock drifts, and electronic spikes limited the usable recording periods of several OBS stations (e.g., A2 failed after January 8, 2014; J1 stopped after 6 days).
模型计算的静态库仑应力变化（最高约0.8 kPa）和孔隙水压变化（约0.25 kPa）远小于实测水压变化（约5 kPa），仅能提供定性支持。
部署在断层附近的宽频带OBS未能记录到通常与慢滑移事件伴生的构造颤动或低频地震。
仪器故障、水平分量高噪声及电子脉冲干扰限制了部分OBS的有效记录时长（如A2在2014年1月8日后失效，J1仅记录6天）。

tm.why: The paper investigates the causal relationships between a westward-propagating slow-slip event (SSE), pore pressure changes, a repeating-like multiplet, and a Mw 4.6 earthquake along the North Anatolian Fault.
The authors detect 2079 microearthquakes using STA/LTA and kurtosis picking, and relocate 409 clustered events using NonLinLoc and double-difference (hypoDD) with cross-correlation timings.
The study relies heavily on six ocean-bottom seismometers (OBSs) and two seafloor piezometers deployed within the submarine fault valley of the Sea of Marmara.

ev.notes: Full 35-page accepted manuscript PDF (including 8 main figures) was read and analyzed in detail.

sum: This study uses 3D spectral-element simulations (Salvus) in the Swiss Rhône Valley (0.05–1.0 Hz) to isolate topographic effects on ground motion from sedimentary basin resonance. The authors simulate three local earthquakes (Mw 3.2–4.5) in two configurations—realistic DEM topography versus a flat free surface—while preserving the 3D geotechnically constrained sedimentary basin (minimum Vs = 210 m/s) in both. Validated against observed waveforms and Swiss GMPEs, topo/flat Fourier spectral ratios across a uniform 2 × 2 km synthetic grid and 190 real stations reveal strong component asymmetry. At exposed mountain sites, horizontal motion is deamplified at 0.05–0.50 Hz (medians 0.80–0.97×) while vertical motion is amplified across all frequencies (1.16–2.32×) due to SV-to-Rayleigh mode conversion. Crucially, real seismic stations preferentially occupy sheltered locations, systematically undersampling exposed ridges and masking horizontal deamplification, demonstrating the necessity of unbiased physics-based simulations for mountainous hazard assessment.
本研究利用Salvus开展瑞士罗纳河谷0.05–1.0 Hz三维谱元法地震波传播模拟，评估真实阿尔卑斯地形对地震动的影响。研究融合DEM地形、三维地壳速度模型及近地表软沉积盆地层，对三次地方震（Mw 3.2–4.5）在保留盆地几何形态的起伏地形与平坦自由表面两种配置下进行模拟。全区域均匀合成网格与真……

t: 3D spectral-element simulations (Salvus, 0.05–1.0 Hz) comparing a realistic DEM free-surface model against a flat-surface model while preserving identical 3D sedimentary basin layering in both configurations.
采用Salvus进行0.05–1.0 Hz三维谱元模拟，在保留相同三维沉积盆地层的前提下对比真实DEM地形与平坦表面模型…
Three local earthquakes (Mw 3.2–4.5) in the 100 × 56 × 40 km Swiss Rhône Valley domain, evaluated at 190 real network stations and 735 uniform 2 × 2 km synthetic grid stations.
模拟瑞士罗纳河谷100×56×40 km域内3次地方震，结合190个真实台站与735个2×2 km均匀合成网格接收点。

On the uniform synthetic grid at mountain sites, horizontal motion is deamplified (medians 0.80–0.97× at 0.05–0.50 Hz) while vertical motion is amplified (1.16–2.32× across 0.05–1.00 Hz); real networks mask horizontal deamplification.
均匀网格山区点在0.05–0.50 Hz水平向减弱（0.80–0.97倍），垂直向放大（1.16–2.32倍）；真实台网…

Principal limitations are the 1 Hz upper-frequency limit from velocity and topography model resolution, the absence of intrinsic attenuation (overpredicting late coda), and simulating only three events.
主要局限为1 Hz高频上限、未包含本征衰减导致晚期尾波高估，以及仅模拟了三次地震事件。

First physics-based separation of topographic and basin amplification in the Rhône Valley using site-specific 3D basin-preserved models and an unbiased synthetic grid revealing horizontal ridge deamplification.
首次在该区域利用保留盆地结构的三维模型分离地形与盆地效应，并通过无偏网格揭示山脊水平减弱。

kc: Isolated 3D Alpine topographic effects from sedimentary basin effects by preserving identical valley sediment geometry in both topographic and flat-surface spectral-element meshes.

Discovered a systematic component asymmetry at mountain sites: vertical ground motion is strongly amplified (1.16–2.32×) across 0.05–1.0 Hz, whereas horizontal motion is deamplified (0.80–0.97×) at 0.05–0.50 Hz due to SV-to-Rayleigh mode conversion.
Demonstrated that real seismic networks suffer from siting bias toward sheltered locations, systematically undersampling exposed ridges where horizontal deamplification is strongest.
Validated 3D physics-based ground-motion simulations (0.05–1.0 Hz) against broadband and strong-motion waveform records and empirical Swiss GMPEs in the Rhône Valley.
通过在起伏地形和平坦表面谱元网格中保留相同的河谷沉积物几何形态，成功将三维阿尔卑斯地形效应与沉积盆地效应分离。
发现了山区场地的系统性分量非对称响应：在0.05–1.0 Hz内垂直运动被显著放大（1.16–2.32倍），而0.05–0.50 Hz水平运动因SV到瑞利波的模态转换而减弱（0.80–0.97倍）。
证明真实地震台网存在倾向于隐蔽位置的选址偏差，系统性地对水平减弱最强的暴露山脊采样不足。
利用罗纳河谷的宽频带和强震波形记录以及瑞士经验地震动预测方程（GMPE），验证了0.05–1.0 Hz三维物理地震动模拟的可靠性。
me: 3D spectral-element wave propagation modeling using Salvus up to 1.0 Hz on Nvidia GraceHopper GPUs.
Custom velocity model blending combining a regional 3D crustal model (Diehl et al., 2021) with local geotechnically constrained near-surface sedimentary basin layers (Vs >= 210 m/s).

Comparative simulation design pairing a realistic GMRT DEM free-surface mesh (3.5M elements) with a flat-surface mesh (1.8M elements) that preserves identical valley-confined basin impedance contrasts.

Frequency-band topo/flat Fourier amplitude spectrum (FAS) ratio analysis across five bands (0.05–1.00 Hz) for vertical and RotD50 horizontal components on both real stations and a uniform 2 × 2 km synthetic grid.
在Nvidia GraceHopper GPU上使用Salvus求解器进行高达1.0 Hz的三维谱元法地震波传播模拟。
采用自定义速度融合函数，将区域三维地壳模型与局部受岩土工程约束的近地表沉积盆地层（Vs >= 210 m/s）相结合。
设计对比模拟方案，将真实GMRT DEM自由表面网格（350万单元）与保留相同河谷盆地阻抗对比的平坦表面网格（180万单元）进行配对比较。
在真实台站和2 × 2 km均匀合成网格上，针对垂直分量和RotD50水平分量开展五个频带（0.05–1.00 Hz）的地形/平坦傅里叶振幅谱（FAS）比值分析。
de: Three local earthquakes in the Swiss Rhône Valley: 2005 Vallorcine (Mw 4.5), 2003 Salgesch (Mw 3.9), and 2016 St-Léonard (Mw 3.2) using Swiss Seismological Service moment tensor solutions.
Observational velocity and integrated accelerogram waveforms from permanent Swiss broadband (CH) and temporary strong-motion (ZP) networks, plus Swiss GMPE predictions (Cauzzi et al., 2014).
Synthetic waveforms evaluated at 190 real station locations (146 analyzed for spectral ratios) and 735 uniform 2 × 2 km synthetic grid receivers across a 100 × 56 × 40 km domain.
瑞士罗纳河谷的三次地方地震：2005年Vallorcine（Mw 4.5）、2003年Salgesch（Mw 3.9）和2016年St-Léonard（Mw 3.2），采用瑞士地震局矩张量解。
来自瑞士永久宽频带台网（CH）和临时强震台网（ZP）的观测速度与积分加速度波形，以及瑞士GMPE预测值（Cauzzi et al., 2014）。
在100 × 56 × 40 km计算域内的190个真实台站位置（146个用于谱比分析）和735个2 × 2 km均匀合成网格接收点上评估合成波形。
li: Simulations are band-limited to an upper frequency of 1.0 Hz due to current velocity and topography model resolution and computational mesh constraints for soft sediments.
Intrinsic attenuation (Q) is omitted from the elastic simulations, causing overprediction of late coda wave amplitudes beyond ~30 s.
Only three local earthquake events (Mw 3.2–4.5) are simulated, limiting statistical constraints on interevent variability.
受当前速度和地形模型分辨率以及软沉积物计算网格的限制，模拟的最高频率被限制在1.0 Hz。
弹性模拟未包含本征衰减（Q），导致约30秒后的晚期尾波振幅被高估。
仅模拟了三次地方地震事件（Mw 3.2–4.5），限制了对事件间变异性统计特征的约束。

tm.why: The paper quantifies frequency- and component-dependent topographic ground-motion amplification and deamplification in the Swiss Rhône Valley for seismic hazard assessment, comparing against Swiss GMPEs.
The study performs 3D spectral-element wave propagation simulations using the Salvus solver on GPU supercomputing infrastructure with realistic DEM topography and soft sedimentary basin layers.
The authors analyze topographic scattering, SV-to-Rayleigh mode conversion at the free surface, and basin-edge wave trapping across 0.05–1.0 Hz.

ev.notes: Full 17-page PDF (ETH Zurich repository cover page + BSSA Vol. 116 No. 5 pp. 1848–1863) was read and analyzed in full, including all equations, 1 table, and 11 figures.

sum: This study integrates 2D and 3D seismic surveys with well data across 35,000 km2 to reconstruct the Pennsylvanian to Early Triassic tectono-stratigraphic evolution of the Loppa High in the southwestern Barents Shelf. By mapping eight regional horizons and over 150 faults, the authors identify three discrete extensional fault systems: a Carboniferous ENE-WSW system, a Pennsylvanian-early Permian NNE-SSW system, and a late Permian-Early Triassic N-S system. These systems controlled depositional architecture, carbonate/evaporite distribution, and subsequent rift reorganization. The findings highlight how structural inheritance influenced the later opening of the Norwegian-Greenland Sea.
本研究整合巴伦支海西南部约3.5万平方公里的2D/3D地震及井数据，重建了Loppa高地晚古生代至早三叠世的构造地层演化。通过追踪8个区域层位和解译超150条断层，识别出三组独立的伸展断裂系统。这些断裂控制了沉积架构与地层分布，揭示了构造继承性对后期挪威-格陵兰海开裂的重要影响。

t: Structural interpretation of 2D and 3D seismic reflection data integrated with well-log correlation to map regional horizons and fault networks.
结合测井对比，对二维和三维反射地震数据进行构造解释，以绘制区域层位和断裂网络。
2D and 3D seismic surveys and key wells covering approximately 35,000 km2 across the Loppa High in the southwestern Barents Shelf.
覆盖巴伦支海西南部Loppa高地约35,000平方公里区域的2D/3D地震测线及关键井数据。
Identification of three discrete late Paleozoic extensional fault systems (Carboniferous, Pennsylvanian-early Permian, and late Permian-Early Triassic) controlling depositional architecture.
识别出三组控制沉积架构的晚古生代伸展断裂系统（碳酸统、宾-早二叠世、晚二叠-早三叠世）。
The analysis is constrained by the resolution of the 2D/3D seismic data and the spatial distribution of available calibration wells.
分析受限于2D/3D地震数据的分辨率以及可用标定井的空间分布。
Provides a comprehensive, multi-phase tectonic reconstruction of the Loppa High, linking local fault systems to regional Arctic-North Atlantic rift systems.
提供了Loppa高地全面的多阶段构造重建，将局部断裂系统与区域北极-北大西洋裂谷系统联系起来。

kc: Reconstructed the multi-phase late Paleozoic to Early Triassic tectono-stratigraphic evolution of the Loppa High.
Mapped eight regionally correlatable seismic horizons and interpreted over 150 faults across a 35,000 km2 area.
Identified three distinct extensional fault systems (Carboniferous, Pennsylvanian-early Permian, and late Permian-Early Triassic) and their controls on depositional architecture.
重建了Loppa高地晚古生代至早三叠世的多阶段构造-地层演化历史。
在35,000平方公里的区域内追踪了8个区域对比地震层位并解译了150多条断层。
识别出三组独立的伸展断裂系统（碳酸统、宾夕法尼亚-早二叠世、晚二叠-早三叠世）及其对沉积架构的控制作用。
me: Seismic interpretation of 2D and 3D reflection seismic surveys.
Well-log correlation and seismic-to-well ties to constrain stratigraphic horizons.
Structural mapping including two-way travel-time (TWT) structure and time-stratigraphic thickness mapping.
二维和三维反射地震数据的地震解释。
测井对比与井-震标定以约束地层层位。
构造制图，包括双程传播时间（TWT）构造图和时空地层厚度图。
de: 2D and 3D seismic reflection surveys covering approximately 35,000 km2 in the southwestern Barents Shelf.
Key exploration wells used for stratigraphic control and horizon calibration.
覆盖巴伦支海西南部约35,000平方公里区域的二维和三维反射地震测线。
用于地层约束和层位标定的关键勘探井数据。
li: Resolution limits of seismic data for imaging sub-seismic scale faults and complex deep structures.
Potential uncertainties in seismic-to-well ties in areas with sparse well control.
地震数据在成像地震分辨率以下尺度断层和复杂深部构造时存在分辨率限制。
在井控稀疏区域，井-震标定可能存在潜在的不确定性。

tm.why: The paper uses 2D and 3D seismic reflection data to map fault systems and reconstruct the late Paleozoic crustal and basin evolution of the Loppa High.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract and public metadata.

sum: Geophysical datasets are invariably finite, discrete, and often irregularly or incompletely sampled due to observational constraints. This paper extends the debiased spatial Whittle maximum-likelihood estimation method to infer stationary, isotropic Matérn covariance parameters (variance, smoothness, and range) from irregularly bounded regions, structured survey tracks, and grids with missing observations. By incorporating the exact autocorrelation of the discrete spatial sampling window into the blurred spectral density, the method achieves O(K log K) Fast Fourier Transform scaling while eliminating aliasing, finite-field, and edge biases. Additionally, the authors derive exact analytical parameter covariance predictions conditioned solely on the sampling geometry, enabling experimental design and asymptotic comparisons. Synthetic and real-world applications—including northeast Atlantic shipboard bathymetry, LOLA lunar topography, and LANDSAT surface reflectance—demonstrate that growing-domain sampling reduces estimator variance and bias far better than infill densification, and show how spectral residuals diagnose departures from stationarity, isotropy, and Gaussianity.
受观测限制，地球物理空间数据常呈不规则边界、航迹状或随机缺失采样。本文将去偏空间Whittle极大似然估计法推广至非完整采样网格，用于反演平稳各向同性Matérn协方差模型参数（方差、平滑度和相关长度）。该方法将离散采样窗口的自相关精确融入模糊谱密度中，利用快速傅里叶变换实现高效无偏估计，并推导出仅……

t: Estimates isotropic Matérn covariance parameters (variance, smoothness, range) by maximizing the blurred, debiased spatial Whittle log-likelihood in the wavenumber domain, accounting for arbitrary discrete sampling masks via FFT.
通过最大化波数域模糊去偏Whittle对数似然函数，结合FFT精确校正离散采样窗口，反演各向同性Matérn协方差参数。

Evaluated using 2D circulant-embedding synthetic random fields with random, contiguous, and track missingness, plus real lunar topography (SLDEM2015), LANDSAT 8 reflectance, and northeast Atlantic GEBCO bathymetry.
采用包含随机、连续边界和航迹缺失的二维循环嵌入合成随机场，以及月球地形、地表反射率和大西洋水深实测数据。

Recovers unbiased Matérn parameters across incomplete grids with analytical uncertainties matching empirical ensembles; growing-domain sampling reduces RMSE, bias, and variance, whereas incorrect fixed smoothness or unseparated merged domains induce severe bias.
在非完整网格上实现无偏参数恢复且解析不确定性与实验一致；扩域采样能全面降低误差，而错误固定平滑度或混合多源数据会引入显著…
Smoothness estimation saturates and trades off with range for very smooth fields (ν0 > 4), and the inverse Fisher matrix alone underestimates true uncertainty on finite grids.
高平滑度场（ν0 > 4）存在平滑度估计饱和与参数折衷，且有限网格下单纯逆Fisher矩阵会低估真实不确定性。

Generalizes debiased spatial Whittle likelihood and exact analytical estimator covariance prediction from full rectangular grids to arbitrary irregular boundaries, survey tracks, and missing data patterns.
将去偏空间Whittle似然估计与精确解析协方差预测从完整矩形网格推广至任意不规则边界、测线和缺失采样模式。

kc: Extends debiased spatial Whittle maximum-likelihood estimation of three-parameter Matérn covariance models to irregular boundaries, structured tracks, and randomly missing grid data.
Derives exact analytical predictions of estimator covariance conditioned on arbitrary discrete sampling windows without requiring Monte Carlo simulations.
Quantifies compensatory parameter biases caused by incorrectly fixing the Matérn smoothness parameter in two-parameter special cases or mixing nonstationary merged datasets.
Demonstrates through asymptotic analyses that growing-domain sampling strategies reduce estimator bias and variance more effectively than fixed-domain infill densification.
将三参数Matérn协方差模型的去偏空间Whittle极大似然估计扩展至不规则边界、结构化测线及随机缺失网格数据。
推导出仅依赖于离散采样窗口几何形态的估计量协方差解析预测公式，无需蒙特卡洛模拟即可量化不确定性。
量化了在二参数特例中错误固定平滑度参数或混合非平稳多源数据时导致的代偿性参数偏差。
通过渐近分析证明，扩大采样区域策略比固定区域加密采样更能有效降低参数估计偏差与方差。
me: Debiased spatial Whittle maximum-likelihood estimation in the spectral domain using exact window-blurred spectral densities via 2D Fast Fourier Transform.
Spatial random field synthesis using circulant embedding of isotropic Matérn covariance functions.
Analytical parameter uncertainty quantification using the blurred inverse Fisher information matrix and blurred score covariance via Isserlis' theorem.
Spectral residual chi-squared goodness-of-fit testing and wavenumber-domain residual diagnostics.
基于二维快速傅里叶变换和精确窗口模糊谱密度的频域去偏空间Whittle极大似然估计。
利用各向同性Matérn协方差函数循环嵌入法（circulant embedding）合成空间随机场。
结合模糊逆Fisher信息矩阵与Isserlis定理解析计算模糊得分协方差，实现参数不确定性量化。
频域残差卡方拟合优度检验及波数域残差结构诊断。
de: Synthetic 2D Gaussian random fields simulated on regular grids with uniform random deletions, New Jersey-shaped contiguous boundaries, and ship-track masks.
GEBCO 15-arcsecond northeast Atlantic seafloor bathymetry comparing direct multibeam/single-beam ship soundings against indirect satellite-augmented grids.
SLDEM2015 lunar topography from LOLA and SELENE around Taurus-Littrow Valley with impact craters (>1 km diameter) masked out.
LANDSAT 8 Collection 2 Level-2 30-m surface reflectance data separated into disjoint land and cloud masks.
具有均匀随机缺失、新泽西州形状不规则边界及船测航迹掩码的二维高斯随机场合成实验。
GEBCO东北大西洋15角秒海底地形数据，对比船载多波束/单波束直接测深与卫星测高间接反演网格。
掩码剔除直径大于1公里撞击坑后的陶拉斯-利特罗谷SLDEM2015月球激光高度计地形数据。
按质量评估标签分离为陆地与云层掩码的LANDSAT 8 30米分辨率地表反射率数据。
li: Assumes the underlying spatial random field is locally stationary, isotropic, and Gaussian with zero or polynomial-detrended mean.
Three-parameter Matérn estimation suffers from parameter trade-offs and smoothness saturation when true smoothness is very large (e.g., ν > 4–9).
Exact analytical periodogram covariance matrix computation scales poorly above K = 10,000 samples on standard desktops, requiring a slower diagonal-by-diagonal calculation.
The blurred inverse Fisher information matrix alone is an overly confident approximation of true parameter uncertainty for realistic geophysical grid sizes.
假设底层空间随机场满足局部平稳、各向同性和高斯分布（经多项式去趋势后零均值）。
当真实平滑度参数过大（如ν > 4–9）时，三参数Matérn反演会出现明显的参数折衷与平滑度估计饱和。
样本量超过10,000时，直接矩阵法计算周期图协方差受内存限制，需切换为较慢的逐对角线计算策略。
在实际地球物理网格尺度下，仅用模糊逆Fisher信息矩阵近似参数协方差会低估不确定性。

tm.why: The paper develops an asymptotically unbiased spectral maximum-likelihood estimation method for inferring parametric Matérn covariance models from irregularly sampled geophysical fields.
It provides exact analytical uncertainty quantification and covariance predictions for estimated spatial statistical parameters as a function of discrete sampling geometry.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the title, abstract, and the provided 25-page PDF text including equations, tables, and Figures 1 to 16.

sum: Determining whether foreshocks stem from bottom-up cascading (ETAS) or top-down preparatory processes (ETAFS) is crucial for earthquake forecasting, yet catalog declustering methods implicitly assume forward-in-time triggering symmetry. Here, the authors introduce a reverse nearest-neighbor (rNN) declustering metric that scales space-time correlation distances to the magnitude of the later event, equivalent to applying standard nearest-neighbor (NN) declustering to a time-reversed catalog. Using 1,000 synthetic ETAS and ETAFS catalogs alongside the Southern California earthquake catalog (mc = 3.0) with an automatic Susceptibility Index threshold, they demonstrate that rNN leaves global background-triggered partitions and mainshock populations largely unchanged. However, rNN significantly reduces negative bias in low-magnitude foreshock-mainshock bins in synthetic tests and identifies up to 30–40% more foreshocks in Southern California. This proves that inferred foreshock abundance depends heavily on declustering temporal symmetry and magnitude regime, rather than solely on underlying earthquake physics.
为探究去丛集时间对称性对前震识别的影响，本文提出了反转最近邻（rNN）去丛集度量，将时空相关性尺度与后续地震震级挂钩（等价于对时间反转目录应用标准NN度量），并结合敏感性指数（SI）自动确定阈值。基于1000个合成ETAS和ETAFS目录及南加州地震目录（mc=3.0）的实验表明，rNN未改变全局背……

t: Introduces a reverse nearest-neighbor (rNN) declustering metric that weights space-time correlation volume by the later event's magnitude, paired with an automatic Susceptibility Index threshold.
提出反转最近邻（rNN）去丛集度量，用后续事件震级标度时空相关体积，并结合敏感性指数自动确定阈值。
Evaluates 1,000 synthetic catalogs each from ETAS and ETAFS models (m0 = 3) calibrated to Southern California, plus the observed Southern California catalog above mc = 3.
使用按南加州参数标定的ETAS和ETAFS模型各1000个合成目录（m0=3），以及mc=3以上的南加州实测目录。

rNN reduces negative foreshock bias in low-magnitude synthetic bins while preserving global background partitions; in Southern California, rNN identifies up to 30-40% more foreshocks in intermediate/small bins.
rNN在保持全局背景划分的同时减小了低震级前震低估偏差；在南加州中低震级区间多识别出30%-40%的前震。
Because true earthquake genealogy is unknown in real catalogs, comparing NN and rNN cannot definitively resolve the physical origin of foreshocks on its own.
真实目录中地震真实谱系未知，仅靠对比NN和rNN无法单独确定前震的物理起源。

Establishes exact mathematical equivalence between reverse-magnitude scaling and time-reversed declustering, demonstrating that standard forward-in-time declustering systematically underestimates small foreshocks.
建立了逆震级标度与时间反转去丛集的数学等价性，证明标准前向去丛集会系统性低估小前震。

kc: Introduced the reverse nearest-neighbor (rNN) declustering metric, mathematically equivalent to applying standard NN declustering to a time-reversed catalog.
Demonstrated via synthetic ETAS and ETAFS catalogs that standard NN declustering systematically underestimates foreshocks in the low-magnitude regime, while rNN reduces this negative bias.
Showed that applying rNN to the Southern California catalog identifies up to 30-40% more foreshocks in intermediate/low magnitude bins without altering the global background-triggered partition.
提出了反转最近邻（rNN）去丛集度量，在数学上等价于对时间反转的地震目录应用标准NN去丛集。
通过合成ETAS和ETAFS目录证明，标准NN去丛集在低震级区间系统性地低估了前震数量，而rNN有效减小了这种负偏差。
在南加州地震目录中的应用表明，rNN在不改变全局背景-触发事件划分的情况下，在中低震级区间多识别出高达30%-40%的前震。
me: Reverse nearest-neighbor (rNN) correlation metric scaling space-time distance by the magnitude of the later event.
Generative point-process simulations using purely bottom-up triggering (ETAS) and mixed preparatory-triggering (ETAFS) models.
Automatic non-parametric declustering threshold selection via the Susceptibility Index (SI) minimum.
Bootstrap cross-entropy scoring and normalized foreshock-count residuals across discrete magnitude bins.
反转最近邻（rNN）相关性度量，利用后续事件的震级对时空距离进行标度。
利用纯自下而上触发（ETAS）和混合准备-触发（ETAFS）模型进行生成式点过程模拟。
基于敏感性指数（SI）极小值的自动非参数去丛集阈值选择。
跨离散震级区间的自助法（Bootstrap）交叉熵评分和归一化前震计数残差分析。
de: 1,000 independent synthetic earthquake catalogs each for ETAS and ETAFS models with completeness magnitude m0 = 3 (and validation tests down to m0 = 2).
Waveform relocated earthquake catalog for Southern California (Hauksson et al., 2012) filtered above completeness magnitude mc = 3.
ETAS和ETAFS模型各1000个独立的合成地震目录，完备震级m0 = 3（并在m0 = 2进行了验证测试）。
南加州波形重定位地震目录（Hauksson et al., 2012），截取完备震级mc = 3以上的事件。
li: In real earthquake catalogs, the true genealogy is unknown, so comparing NN and rNN cannot by itself determine the physical origin of foreshocks.
ETAS and ETAFS represent idealized statistical end-members and do not capture the full physical complexity of natural earthquake preparation.
The improvement of rNN over NN is not uniform across all magnitudes, disappearing for the largest foreshock and mainshock magnitude classes.
在真实地震目录中，真实的地震谱系未知，因此仅比较NN和rNN本身无法确定前震的物理起源。
ETAS和ETAFS代表理想化的统计端元模型，未能涵盖自然界地震孕育的全部物理复杂性。
rNN相对于NN的改进并非在所有震级上均等，在最大前震和主震震级类别中这种优势会消失。

tm.why: The paper introduces a reverse nearest-neighbor declustering metric to evaluate and reconstruct earthquake clusters and foreshock catalogs.
The study investigates earthquake nucleation and preparatory processes (top-down vs. bottom-up triggering) through foreshock detectability.
The findings directly impact statistical seismology, ETAS/ETAFS modeling, and short-term earthquake forecasting.

ev.notes: Full 26-page arXiv manuscript PDF was read and analyzed, including all mathematical derivations, 1 table, and 9 figures.

sum: This study uses magnetotelluric (MT) sounding to image the crust-mantle resistivity structure across the West Qinling orogenic belt in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau. The resulting electrical resistivity model provides insights into the deep lithospheric structure, identifying high-conductivity zones in the crust and upper mantle. These conductive features are interpreted as indicators of partial melting or fluid pathways, which played a crucial role in the genesis and ascent of Indosinian granitoids. The findings help constrain the tectonic evolution and magmatic processes of the West Qinling orogen during the Indosinian period.
本研究利用大地电磁（MT）测深技术成像了青藏高原东北缘西秦岭造山带的壳幔电阻率结构。所得电阻率模型揭示了深部岩石圈结构，识别出中下地壳及上地幔存在显著的高导（低阻）异常区。这些高导特征被解释为地壳部分熔融或流体通道的指示，在印支期花岗岩的成因与运移上升过程中起到了关键作用。研究结果为理解西秦岭造山带……

t: Magnetotelluric (MT) sounding and inversion to obtain the crust-mantle electrical resistivity structure.
采用大地电磁（MT）测深及反演方法获取壳幔深部电性电阻率结构。
Broadband and long-period magnetotelluric data collected along a profile crossing the West Qinling orogenic belt.
跨越西秦岭造山带布置的大地电磁测深剖面观测数据。
Discovery of prominent crustal and upper-mantle low-resistivity zones, indicating partial melting or fluid pathways related to granitoid genesis.
发现显著的中下地壳及上地幔低阻（高导）异常区，指示了与花岗岩成因相关的部分熔融或流体通道。
Resolution of MT inversion decreases with depth, and electrical conductivity interpretations suffer from non-uniqueness.
大地电磁反演的分辨率随深度增加而降低，且电导率异常的物性解释存在多解性。
Provides a high-resolution deep electrical structure of the West Qinling orogen to directly link crust-mantle conductivity with Indosinian magmatism.
提供了西秦岭造山带高分辨率深部电性结构，建立了壳幔导电性与印支期岩浆活动的直接联系。

kc: Obtained a high-resolution crust-mantle electrical resistivity model across the West Qinling orogenic belt.
Identified prominent high-conductivity zones in the crust and upper mantle beneath the study area.
Linked the deep electrical structure to the genesis, ascent, and emplacement of Indosinian granitoids.
获得了跨越西秦岭造山带的高分辨率壳幔电性电阻率模型。
识别出研究区中下地壳和上地幔中显著的高导电性异常区域。
建立了深部电性结构与印支期花岗岩成因、上升及就位过程之间的联系。
me: Magnetotelluric (MT) sounding profile observation.
Two-dimensional (2D) or three-dimensional (3D) electromagnetic inversion modeling.
大地电磁（MT）测深剖面观测。
二维（2D）或三维（3D）电磁反演建模。
de: Broadband and long-period magnetotelluric data collected across the West Qinling orogenic belt, NE Tibetan Plateau.
在青藏高原东北缘西秦岭造山带采集的宽频带和长周期大地电磁测深数据。
li: The resolution of magnetotelluric inversion decreases with depth, and the interpretation of high-conductivity zones suffers from non-uniqueness.
大地电磁反演的分辨率随深度增加而降低，且对高导异常区的物性解释存在多解性。

tm.why: The paper uses magnetotelluric imaging to investigate the crust-mantle resistivity structure and lithospheric geodynamics of the West Qinling orogenic belt.

ev.notes: No PDF or abstract available; metadata and title-based analysis of the magnetotelluric study in West Qinling.

sum: This study investigates how slab folding and surface processes interact during buoyant ribbon collision using two-way coupled 2.5D geodynamic (UWGeodynamics) and 3D landscape evolution (Badlands) simulations driven entirely by buoyancy forces. By varying erodibility coefficients across simulations spanning 35 Myr, the authors evaluate topographic growth, sediment supply, and basin deformation mechanics. Results demonstrate that forward and backward slab folding steepen the subducting slab, triggering punctuated orogenic uplift (0.008–0.310 mm/yr) and increasing back-orogen basin sedimentation (0.05–0.3 mm/yr). Spearman correlation tests between plastic strain and cumulated deposition reveal two distinct deformation wavelengths: high sedimentation (>1,500–6,000 m, ≥0.3 mm/yr) promotes long-wavelength regional lithospheric extension and strengthens the central basin crust, whereas lower sedimentation (<1,500 m, <0.3 mm/yr) enhances short-wavelength tectonic subsidence localized on normal fault hanging walls. The work newly establishes how buoyancy-driven slab folding and erosion-deposition competition jointly modulate post-collisional landscape and basin evolution.
本研究利用双向耦合的2.5D地球动力学（UWGeodynamics）与3D地表过程（Badlands）数值模拟，探讨浮力驱动下微陆块碰撞与板片折叠期间的地形演化及盆地变形机制。通过改变可蚀性系数模拟35 Myr的演化，研究表明板片前向和后向折叠使俯冲板片变陡，触发造山带阶段性隆升（0.008–0.3……

t: Two-way coupled 2.5D buoyancy-driven geodynamic simulations (UWGeodynamics) and 3D surface process modeling (Badlands) with visco-plastic Drucker-Prager rheology and Spearman correlation analysis.
采用浮力驱动的2.5D地球动力学与3D地表过程双向耦合模拟，结合粘塑性流变与Spearman相关分析。
Numerical experiments simulating 35 Myr of buoyant ribbon collision across a 2,600 km × 900 km 2D box coupled to a 2,600 km × 2,600 km 3D surface grid under five erodibility regimes.
在2600×900 km剖面与2600×2600 km地表网格上模拟5种可蚀性下35 Myr的微陆块碰撞。

Slab folding drives orogenic uplift (0.008–0.310 mm/yr) and basin sedimentation (0.05–0.3 mm/yr); thick sediments (≥6,000 m) promote long-wavelength extension while thinner piles (2,000–6,000 m) localize fault subsidence.
板片折叠驱动造山隆升（0.008–0.310 mm/yr）和盆地沉积；≥6 km沉积促区域伸展，较薄沉积促断层沉降。
Thermal processes and sediment compaction were disabled, resolution tests are unfeasible due to scale dependence, and a single uniform climate and erodibility coefficient were used.
忽略了热过程和沉积压实，采用单一气候和可蚀性系数，且无法进行分辨率测试。

Replaces kinematically forced rifting/subduction with fully buoyancy-driven coupled models to isolate how deep mantle slab folding and sedimentation rates jointly govern basin deformation wavelengths.
以全浮力驱动耦合模型替代运动学强制模型，揭示深部板片折叠与沉积速率对变形波长的协同控制。

kc: Demonstrates via buoyancy-driven coupled geodynamic-surface models that backward and forward slab folding trigger punctuated orogenic uplift (0.008–0.310 mm/yr) and sediment supply (0.05–0.3 mm/yr).
Quantifies spatial-temporal correlations between plastic strain and sediment thickness using Spearman tests, distinguishing short-wavelength fault subsidence from long-wavelength regional extension.
Identifies three back-orogen basin deformation modes (erosion-dominated, balanced, and deposition-dominated) governed by the competition between footwall erosion and basin infilling.
通过浮力驱动的地球动力学-地表过程耦合模型，证明板片后向与前向折叠触发造山带阶段性隆升（0.008–0.310 mm/yr）及沉积物供给（0.05–0.3 mm/yr）。
利用Spearman检验量化塑性应变与沉积厚度的时空相关性，区分了短波长断层沉降与长波长区域岩石圈伸展。
识别出受下盘侵蚀与盆地充填竞争控制的三种弧后盆地变形模式（侵蚀主导、侵蚀-沉积平衡、沉积主导）。
me: Two-way coupled 2.5D thermo-mechanical geodynamic modeling (UWGeodynamics/Underworld2) and 3D landscape evolution modeling (Badlands) driven purely by buoyancy forces.
Visco-plastic rheology with Drucker-Prager yielding and linear strain weakening (at 20% plastic strain) on a 4 km × 3 km grid to resolve crustal shear bands.
Independent flexural isostasy benchmarking using gFlex (elastic thicknesses of 10, 50, and 80 km) and Spearman rank correlation between plastic strain and cumulated deposition.
完全由浮力驱动的双向耦合2.5D地球动力学模型（UWGeodynamics/Underworld2）与3D地貌演化模型（Badlands）。
在4 km × 3 km网格上采用Drucker-Prager屈服准则和线性应变弱化（塑性应变达20%时）的粘塑性流变学来分辨地壳剪切带。
使用gFlex（有效弹性厚度10、50和80 km）进行独立的挠曲均衡基准测试，并对塑性应变与累积沉积进行Spearman秩相关分析。
de: Suite of 35-Myr numerical simulations of a subducting oceanic plate carrying a 25-km-thick buoyant continental ribbon colliding with an overriding continental plate.

Sensitivity experiments varying the erodibility coefficient across high (6e-6), intermediate (4e-6), low (1.0e-6), very low (0.5e-6), and no-erosion scenarios, plus a control run without a colliding ribbon.
Lagrangian passive tracers and vertical temporal stacks extracted at 3 km and 4.5 km depths to track elevation, vertical displacement rates, plastic strain, and cumulated erosion/deposition.
开展35 Myr的数值模拟实验，模拟携带25 km厚浮力陆壳微陆块的俯冲大洋板片与上覆大陆板片碰撞。
改变可蚀性系数进行高（6e-6）、中（4e-6）、低（1.0e-6）、极低（0.5e-6）和无侵蚀敏感性实验，以及无碰撞微陆块的对照实验。
利用拉格朗日被动示踪粒子以及在3 km和4.5 km深度提取的垂向时间堆栈，追踪高程、垂向位移速率、塑性应变和累积侵蚀/沉积。
li: Thermal processes and sediment compaction were turned off to isolate mechanical sediment loading effects and maintain coupling consistency.
Models use a 2.5D geometry with an artificial 'infinite' slab generation zone and a single uniform climatic regime and erodibility coefficient across all lithospheric materials.
Grid resolution tests could not be performed because landscape evolution in coupled UWGeodynamics-Badlands models is temporal- and scale-dependent.
关闭了热过程和沉积物压实效应，以单独分离沉积载荷的力学效应并保持耦合一致性。
模型采用2.5D几何结构与人工“无限”板片生成区，且对所有岩石圈物质使用单一均匀的气候机制和可蚀性系数。
由于耦合模型中的地貌演化具有时间和尺度依赖性，无法进行网格分辨率敏感性测试。

tm.why: The paper uses two-way coupled 2.5D geodynamic and surface-process numerical simulations to study how subducting slab folding, buoyant ribbon collision, and surface erosion/sedimentation interact to control lithospheric extension, topographic uplift, and back-orogen basin deformation.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF of the JGR: Solid Earth article was analyzed, including all sections (§1–§5) and Figures 1–11.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the data products associated with the manuscript 'Global terrain correction of continental heat flow with a neural-operator surrogate of three-dimensional heat-conduction simulations'. It includes per-site terrain corrections for continental heat flow, a global transfer-factor field, and a trained neural operator. The neural operator serves as a highly efficient surrogate model for computationally expensive three-dimensional heat-conduction simulations, enabling rapid and accurate terrain corrections of heat flow measurements on a global scale.
本数据集包含“利用三维热传导模拟的神经算子代理进行全球大陆热流地形校正”研究的数据产品。其中包括逐点地形校正大陆热流值、全球转换因子场以及训练好的神经算子。该神经算子作为高计算成本三维热传导模拟的高效代理模型，实现了全球尺度上热流测量数据的快速且精确的地形校正，克服了传统数值模拟的计算瓶颈。

t: A neural-operator surrogate model trained on three-dimensional heat-conduction simulations to perform rapid terrain corrections.
利用基于三维热传导模拟训练的神经算子代理模型进行快速地形校正。
Global continental heat flow data products, including per-site corrections, transfer-factor fields, and neural operator weights.
全球大陆热流数据产品，包括逐点校正值、转换因子场和神经算子权重。
Enables efficient, global-scale terrain correction of continental heat flow measurements using the trained neural operator.
利用训练好的神经算子实现了高效的全球尺度大陆热流测量地形校正。
Accuracy is constrained by the assumptions and resolution of the training 3D heat-conduction simulations.
校正精度受限于训练用三维热传导模拟的假设和分辨率。
First application of a neural-operator surrogate to accelerate 3D heat-conduction simulations for global heat flow terrain correction.
首次将神经算子代理引入全球热流地形校正，加速了三维热传导模拟。

kc: Provides a global dataset of terrain-corrected continental heat flow values.
Introduces a trained neural operator surrogate to accelerate 3D heat-conduction simulations.
Delivers a global transfer-factor field for efficient heat flow correction.
提供了全球地形校正的大陆热流值数据集。
引入了训练好的神经算子代理模型以加速三维热传导模拟。
提供了用于高效热流校正的全球转换因子场。
me: Neural-operator surrogate modeling of three-dimensional heat-conduction.
Three-dimensional numerical heat-conduction simulations for terrain correction.
基于神经算子的三维热传导代理模型构建。
用于地形校正的三维数值热传导模拟。
de: Global continental heat flow database with per-site terrain corrections.
Trained neural operator model weights and transfer-factor fields.
包含逐点地形校正的全球大陆热流数据库。
训练好的神经算子模型权重及转换因子场。
li: The accuracy of the corrections depends on the resolution and assumptions of the underlying 3D heat-conduction models.
校正的准确性取决于底层三维热传导模型的分辨率和物理假设。

tm.why: The paper introduces a trained neural operator surrogate to accelerate three-dimensional heat-conduction simulations.
The dataset provides global terrain-corrected continental heat flow, which is a fundamental geodynamic property of the crust and lithosphere.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the Zenodo repository metadata and abstract, as no PDF was available.

sum: Whether ancient tectonic fabrics on stagnant-lid planets can localize present-day seismic failure remains poorly tested. Here, the authors investigate farside marsquake S0976a, the only seismic event detected in Mars's western hemisphere by InSight, located in Valles Marineris (VM) near Ius Chasma. By jointly inverting three-component PP and SS body-wave waveforms using AxiSEM/Instaseis synthetics across five 1-D Martian interior models, combined with orbital fault mapping and CTX image analysis, they show S0976a was a mid-to-lower crustal (15–45 km depth, Mw 3.4–3.6) double-couple strike-slip event, ruling out impacts and landslides. The WNW–ESE compressional axis aligns with VM's trough axis and Hesperian transtensional stress directions. This provides direct seismic evidence that billion-year-old inherited fault architectures on a cooling single-lid planet remain mechanically favorable for reactivation under contemporary stresses from global contraction, Tharsis loading, and canyon erosional unloading.
单盖层行星的古老构造能否在现代应力下诱发地震尚缺乏直接观测。本文研究了InSight在火星西半球水手谷探测到的唯一远震事件S0976a。作者基于5个一维火星内部模型，利用AxiSEM/Instaseis合成地震图对三分量PP和SS体波进行单台矩张量联合反演，并结合轨道断层制图与CTX影像分析。结果表……

t: Single-station moment tensor grid-search inversion jointly fitting three-component PP and SS body-wave waveforms using 1-D AxiSEM/Instaseis Green's functions, validated by P/SV/SH amplitude ratios and force-based non-tectonic source modeling.
基于一维AxiSEM/Instaseis格林函数联合拟合三分量PP和SS波形的单台矩张量反演，并经振幅比与非构造力源验证…

Three-component VBB seismic waveforms of farside marsquake S0976a recorded by InSight at ~146° distance, tested across five 1-D Martian interior models, alongside CTX orbital imagery and mapped Valles Marineris faults.
InSight在~146°震中距记录的S0976a三分量VBB波形、5个火星一维内部模型，以及水手谷CTX卫星影像与断层…
S0976a is a mid-to-lower crustal (15–45 km depth, Mw 3.4–3.6) strike-slip marsquake (82.2% of acceptable solutions) near Ius Chasma with a WNW–ESE P-axis (~95°) subparallel to Valles Marineris.
S0976a为伊乌斯峡谷附近中下地壳（深15-45 km，Mw 3.4-3.6）走滑火星震，主压应力轴平行于水手谷。
Single-station geometry causes back-azimuth/strike trade-offs, and high attenuation plus core shadowing yield only a 0.1% probability of detecting aftershocks from Valles Marineris.
单台几何存在方位角与走向折衷，且远震衰减和核影效应使50天内余震探测概率仅0.1%。

First direct seismic evidence of active deep-crustal strike-slip faulting in Valles Marineris, proving billion-year-old inherited faults on a stagnant-lid planet remain reactivable under contemporary stresses.
首次提供水手谷深部走滑发震的直接地震学证据，证明单盖层行星十亿年古老断层仍可复活。

kc: Determined the first focal mechanism and centroid depth (15–45 km) for a marsquake in Valles Marineris (farside event S0976a, Mw 3.4–3.6), revealing predominantly strike-slip faulting.
Ruled out non-tectonic origins (meteoroid impact and landslide) via full moment tensor and force-based inversions, energy-volume scaling (>10^7 m^3 required), and post-event CTX satellite imagery.
Demonstrated via ETAS stochastic aftershock simulations that the lack of detected aftershocks is explained by teleseismic attenuation and core shadowing (0.1% detection probability within 50 sols).
Provided direct geophysical evidence that billion-year-old Hesperian fault systems on a stagnant-lid planet remain mechanically active and localize strain under contemporary stresses.
首次确定了水手谷火星震（远震事件S0976a，Mw 3.4–3.6）的震源机制和质心深度（15–45 km），揭示其以走滑断层作用为主。
通过全矩张量和力源反演、能量-体积标度律（需>10^7 m^3）以及震后CTX卫星影像分析，排除了陨石撞击和滑坡等非构造成因。
通过ETAS随机余震模拟证明，未探测到余震归因于远震衰减和核影区效应（50个火星日内探测概率仅0.1%）。
提供了直接地球物理证据，证明单盖层行星上数十亿年前的赫斯珀利亚纪断层系统在现代应力场下仍具力学活性并集中释放应变。
me: Single-station body-wave moment tensor grid-search inversion (MTUQ) jointly fitting vertical PP (3.6–8.0 s) and radial/transverse SS (3.0–14.0 s) waveforms using Instaseis/AxiSEM 1-D Green's functions.
Independent P/SV/SH amplitude-ratio source mechanism inversion corrected for free-surface reflection phase shifts and amplitude modifications.
Non-double-couple (ISO, CLVD) and two-force time-dependent landslide source inversions, paired with order-of-magnitude landslide energy-volume scaling.
Bayesian-like joint location probability mapping combining waveform variance reduction, mapped fault density priors, and high-frequency PP polarization back-azimuths.
Monte Carlo Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) synthetic waveform simulations to quantify aftershock detectability against lander noise.
基于Instaseis/AxiSEM一维格林函数，利用MTUQ网格搜索联合反演垂直分量PP波（3.6–8.0 s）和径向/切向SS波（3.0–14.0 s）的单台体波矩张量。
考虑自由表面反射相移和振幅修正的独立P/SV/SH振幅比震源机制反演。
非双力偶（各向同性、CLVD）和双力时间相关滑坡源反演，结合滑坡能量-体积数量级标度估算。
结合波形方差缩减、断层密度先验和高频PP波极化反方位角的联合震源位置概率制图。
蒙特卡洛传染型余震序列（ETAS）合成波形模拟，量化背景噪声下的余震可探测性。
de: InSight SEIS Very Broad-Band (VBB) three-component deglitched displacement waveforms of low-frequency teleseismic marsquake S0976a (epicentral distance ~146°, back azimuth ~101°).
Five 1-D Martian interior velocity and attenuation models (KKS21_GP, Khan et al., Samuel et al., Li et al., Kim et al.) for sensitivity testing.
Single-station validation dataset using long-period (10–50 s) PP and SS waveforms of the 15 May 2020 Mw 6.5 Nevada earthquake recorded at station CAAN in Australia (~145° distance).

Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter Context Camera (CTX, 5–6 m/pixel) pre- and post-event imagery and digitized structural maps of grabens, normal faults, wrinkle ridges, and boulder falls in western Valles Marineris.
InSight SEIS甚宽频带（VBB）三分量去毛刺位移波形，记录了低频远震火星震S0976a（震中距~146°，反方位角~101°）。
用于敏感性测试的5个一维火星内部速度与衰减模型（KKS21_GP、Khan等、Samuel等、Li等、Kim等）。
利用澳大利亚CAAN台站（震中距~145°）记录的2020年5月15日内华达Mw 6.5地震长周期（10–50 s）PP和SS波形进行单台反演验证。
火星勘测轨道飞行器背景相机（CTX，5–6米/像素）震前震后影像，以及水手谷西部地堑、正断层、皱脊和落石遗迹的数字化构造图。
li: Single-station recording geometry inherently permits trade-offs between source back-azimuth and fault strike, as well as fault-plane ambiguity.
Unmodeled three-dimensional crustal heterogeneity and scattering along the ~146° propagation path limit waveform fitting at shorter periods (<3 s).
Post-event CTX satellite imagery covers only ~51.6% of the high-probability source region (53.1% of canyon floors/walls), leaving partial gaps in visual landslide verification.
单台观测几何固有地存在震源反方位角与断层走向之间的折衷以及断层面模糊性。
沿~146°传播路径上未建模的三维地壳非均匀性和散射限制了短周期（<3 s）的波形拟合。
震后CTX卫星影像仅覆盖高概率震源区的~51.6%（峡谷底部和谷壁的53.1%），视觉排查滑坡存在部分空白。

tm.why: The paper characterizes the source mechanism and tectonic context of the farside marsquake S0976a in Valles Marineris using InSight seismic data.
The core analysis is a single-station body-wave moment tensor and focal mechanism inversion of PP and SS waveforms to determine faulting style and centroid depth.
The study links the inferred focal mechanism to Martian lithospheric stress fields, stagnant-lid geodynamics, Tharsis loading, and reactivation of ancient crustal fault systems.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 14-page Nature Communications PDF (including Methods and all 5 main figures).

sum: Velocity model building and localized editing from sparse well logs are ill-posed inverse problems. This paper introduces a unified framework combining learned Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM) priors with a structurally preconditioned Tikhonov inverse formulation. A U-Net diffusion model is pretrained on 5,000 synthetic velocity patches. For localized velocity model editing (VME), background models are inverted into the DDIM latent space and masked outside target zones. During reverse sampling, Hessian-preconditioned velocity updates computed via LSQR enforce well-log consistency along plane-wave destruction slopes. For full velocity model building (VMB), an imaging-based regularizer using the Born-linearized vertical derivative of scattering potential links velocity contrasts to Reverse Time Migration (RTM) reflector geometries away from wells. Tested on the synthetic Volve benchmark and Viking Graben marine field data, the guided DDIM approach recovers sharper interfaces and higher structural similarity than conventional Tikhonov least-squares and offers greater stability than Diffusion Posterior Sampling.
针对稀疏测井约束下速度建模与局部编辑的不适定反演问题，本文提出了一种结合去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）先验与结构预条件Tikhonov反演的统一框架。方法利用5000个合成高分辨率速度模型预训练扩散先验，通过DDIM反演与潜空间掩码限制局部编辑区域；在逆扩散采样中，引入基于LSQR求解的Gauss-N……

t: Projects initial velocity models into DDIM latent space, applies spatial masks for local editing, and guides reverse sampling with LSQR updates of a structurally preconditioned, RTM-regularized Tikhonov system.
将初始模型DDIM反演至潜空间并掩码，利用结构预条件和RTM成像正则化的LSQR更新引导逆扩散采样。
Pretrained on 5,000 synthetic 256x512 velocity patches; evaluated on the synthetic Volve model (110 shots, 1 well) and North Sea Viking Graben Line 12 field dataset (1,001 shots, 2 wells).
采用5000个256x512合成速度切片预训练，在Volve合成模型与Viking Graben实际海上数据上验证。

On Volve, proposed DDIM guidance achieves SSIM=0.568 (SNR=22.05 dB) for VME and SSIM=0.623 (SNR=17.44 dB) for VMB, outperforming Tikhonov least-squares (SSIM=0.414 and 0.365) and matching unseen blind-well trends in field data.
在Volve测试中VME和VMB的SSIM分别达0.568和0.623，显著优于传统最小二乘（0.414和0.365）并…
Performance relies heavily on training prior representativeness and RTM-derived structural slope accuracy, while requiring ~45–53 s on GPU versus ~1.5 s on CPU for least-squares.
高度依赖训练先验代表性及RTM局部倾角估计精度，且GPU耗时（45-53秒）高于传统方法。
Unifies localized velocity editing and full model building by coupling masked DDIM inversion with Hessian-preconditioned LSQR updates and linearized RTM reflector-geometry regularization.
将潜空间掩码DDIM与显式LSQR预条件反演及RTM反射几何正则化结合，统一了局部速度编辑与全模型构建。

kc: Introduces a localized velocity model editing (VME) workflow using deterministic DDIM inversion and latent-space masking to refine target zones while preserving background structure.

Combines reverse DDIM sampling with a structurally preconditioned Tikhonov least-squares problem solved via LSQR, providing a Hessian-preconditioned alternative to first-order Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS).
Develops an imaging-based regularization operator using Born-linearized scattering potential derivatives to enforce consistency with RTM reflector geometries away from well locations.
Validates both VME and full VMB on the Volve synthetic model and the North Sea Viking Graben Line 12 field dataset, including a blind-well validation test.
提出基于确定性DDIM反演与潜空间掩码的局部速度模型编辑（VME）流程，在保持背景结构的同时精细化目标区域。
将逆DDIM采样与通过LSQR求解的结构预条件Tikhonov最小二乘反演相结合，提供了比一阶扩散后验采样（DPS）更稳定的Hessian预条件引导。
设计了基于Born线性化散射势竖向导数的成像正则化算子，在远离测井区域强制速度对比度与RTM反射界面几何一致。
在Volve合成模型和北海Viking Graben第12测线实际数据上验证了VME和全模型构建（VMB），并通过盲井测试证实了方法的可靠性。
me: Pretraining a DDPM U-Net score network on normalized 256x512 high-resolution synthetic velocity patches and performing deterministic DDIM inversion to map initial models into latent space.
Applying spatial masks in latent space for VME and warm-starting reverse diffusion at intermediate timesteps (t/T = 0.1 for VME, 0.3 for VMB).
Guiding the final 50% of reverse DDIM steps with 2-iteration LSQR updates of a Tikhonov system preconditioned by plane-wave spray/painting structural smoothing operators.
Augmenting the inverse problem with a Gauss-Newton linearized imaging Jacobian linking slowness-squared vertical derivatives to observed RTM images.
在归一化的256x512高分辨率合成速度切片上预训练DDPM U-Net分数网络，并利用确定性DDIM反演将初始模型映射至潜空间。
在潜空间应用空间掩码实现局部编辑（VME），并在中间时间步（VME为t/T=0.1，VMB为0.3）热启动逆扩散过程。
利用平面波喷涂构造平滑算子预条件的Tikhonov系统，在逆DDIM采样的后50%阶段注入每次2步LSQR迭代的模型更新。
引入连接慢度平方竖向导数与观测RTM图像的Gauss-Newton线性化成像雅可比算子以增强远井约束。
de: Training dataset of 5,000 velocity patches (256x512) augmented from SEAM Arid, SEAM Arid Barrett, SEAM Phase I, Otway, and Volve models.
Synthetic Volve benchmark test using 110 shot gathers (180 receivers, 2 ms sampling, 25 m spacing), RTM imaging, and a single well log at x = 5733 m.

Field data application on Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 (1001 shots, 120 receivers, 4 ms sampling, 12.5 m CMP spacing) with two Backus-averaged Vp well logs at x = 11.7 km and 21.3 km, including a blind-well test withholding Well 2.
Synthetic ablation study comparing plane-wave destruction slopes estimated from the noisy RTM image against ideal slopes computed directly from the ground-truth velocity model.
由SEAM Arid、SEAM Arid Barrett、SEAM Phase I、Otway及Volve模型增强生成的5000个高分辨率速度模型切片（256x512）训练集。
基于Volve合成基准模型的测试，包含110炮合成记录（180道，2 ms采样，25 m道距）、RTM成像及x = 5733 m处的单井测井曲线。
北海Mobil AVO Viking Graben第12测线实际数据应用（1001炮，120道，4 ms采样，12.5 m CMP间距），结合x = 11.7 km和21.3 km处的两口Backus平均Vp测井约束及排除第2口井的盲井验证。
合成数据消融实验，对比由含噪RTM图像估计的平面波破坏倾角与直接从真实速度模型计算的理想倾角对反演的影响。
li: Strong dependence on the representativeness of the training dataset; mismatched diffusion priors can yield reconstructions inferior to conventional least-squares.
Reconstruction accuracy relies heavily on local structural slopes estimated from RTM images, which degrade under poor illumination, migration artifacts, or inaccurate background velocities.
Higher computational cost (43–53 seconds on GPU due to per-step LSQR solves) compared to conventional least-squares (1.5 seconds on CPU) and gradient-based DPS (30–34 seconds on GPU).
高度依赖训练数据集的代表性，不匹配的扩散先验可能导致重构结果劣于传统最小二乘方法。
重构精度受限于从RTM图像估计的局部构造倾角质量，而照明不足、偏移假象或背景速度误差会降低倾角估计可靠性。
由于每个引导步需执行LSQR求解，计算耗时（GPU上43–53秒）高于传统最小二乘（CPU上1.5秒）和基于梯度的DPS方法（GPU上30–34秒）。

tm.why: The paper develops a generative machine learning framework using Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM) to learn high-resolution priors for seismic velocity model building and editing.

It formulates velocity model estimation as a structurally preconditioned Tikhonov inverse problem with linearized imaging-based regularization, injecting Gauss-Newton LSQR updates into reverse diffusion.
Velocity model building and localized editing utilizing Reverse Time Migration (RTM) images and Born-linearized scattering potentials directly serve seismic imaging and FWI workflows.

ev.notes: Full 24-page manuscript PDF evaluated, including mathematical derivations in §2, synthetic Volve and Viking Graben field experiments in §3, ablation studies, and all 14 figures.

sum: During the 6 February 2023 Mw 7.8 and Mw 7.6 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes, Gölbaşı (Adıyaman) experienced severe structural damage and ground failures. This study investigates the role of deep subsurface geometry and seismic site conditions in controlling damage distribution by integrating 120 microgravity measurements with 20 circular-array Spatial Autocorrelation (SPAC) microtremor soundings. Two-dimensional gravity modeling reveals an asymmetric pull-apart basin containing up to ~700 m of unconsolidated alluvial and lacustrine sediments. SPAC inversions provide Vs30 (280–350 m/s in the center) and empirical basin-depth proxies Z1.0 and Z2.5. A neighborhood-based statistical analysis (n = 9) demonstrates a very strong positive correlation between severe building damage ratio and sediment thickness (r = 0.905, p < 0.001) and Z2.5 (r = 0.763, p = 0.017), and a negative correlation with Vs30 (r = -0.698). The novelty lies in quantitatively proving that deep basin architecture explains the 2023 Gölbaşı damage better than shallow Vs30 alone.
本研究结合120个微重力测点和20个台阵空间自相关（SPAC）微动测量，探讨了Gölbaşı盆地地下结构对2023年Kahramanmaraş双震破坏分布的控制作用。二维重力建模揭示了厚达约700米的未固结冲湖积层。SPAC反演获得了剪切波速剖面、Vs30及经验盆地深度参数（Z1.0和Z2.5）。基……

t: Integrates circular-array SPAC microtremor dispersion inversion for 1D Vs profiles with 2D polygon modeling of residual Bouguer microgravity anomalies, empirical Z1.0/Z2.5 estimation, and neighborhood-scale Pearson correlation with earthquake damage.
结合圆形台阵SPAC微动频散反演、剩余布格重力异常二维多边形建模及街区震害Pearson相关分析。
120 microgravity stations on a 400x400 m grid, 20 circular-array 60-minute ambient-noise recordings using SMART-SOLO 0.2 Hz seismometers, and an official damage inventory of 6,872 buildings.
400×400m网格的120个微重力点、20个台阵60分钟环境噪声记录及6,872栋建筑震害评估数据。

Unconsolidated sediments reach ~700 m thickness. Neighborhood severe-damage ratio correlates strongly with sediment thickness (r = 0.905, p < 0.001), Z2.5 (r = 0.763, p = 0.017), and negatively with Vs30 (r = -0.698, p = 0.037).
沉积物厚达700米；严重破坏率与沉积厚度(r=0.905)、Z2.5(r=0.763)强正相关，与Vs30负相关。
Z1.0 and Z2.5 rely on unvalidated NGA-West empirical equations, gravity inversion is non-unique, and the correlation analysis covers only 9 neighborhoods without direct wave-amplification modeling.
Z1.0/Z2.5依赖经验公式，重力反演具多解性，且相关性分析仅含9个街区样本。
First quantitative evaluation linking integrated microgravity and SPAC-derived deep basin geometry to the spatial distribution of 2023 earthquake building damage in the Gölbaşı Basin.
首次综合微重力与SPAC深部盆地结构定量解释Gölbaşı盆地2023年地震破坏空间分布。

kc: Delineated the 3D geometry and sediment thickness (up to ~700 m) of the Gölbaşı pull-apart basin using 120 microgravity stations and four 2D density profiles.
Derived 1D shear-wave velocity profiles, Vs30, and empirical depth proxies (Z1.0, Z2.5) at 20 sites using circular-array SPAC microtremor analysis.
Quantified neighborhood-scale correlations (n = 9) between geophysical basin parameters and severe building damage from the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes (r = 0.905 for sediment thickness).
利用120个微重力测点和4条二维密度剖面，刻画了Gölbaşı拉分盆地的几何形态与沉积厚度（高达约700米）。
利用圆形台阵SPAC微动分析，在20个测点获得了1D剪切波速剖面、Vs30及经验盆地深度代理参数（Z1.0、Z2.5）。
定量评估了9个街区的地球物理盆地参数与2023年地震建筑严重破坏率的相关性（沉积厚度r = 0.905）。
me: Spatial Autocorrelation (SPAC) analysis of vertical-component ambient noise recorded by multi-radius circular arrays (central station plus 3–4 peripheral sensors) using Geopsy.
Rayleigh-wave phase-velocity dispersion curve inversion to obtain 1D Vs profiles and Vs30, followed by empirical estimation of Z1.0 and Z2.5 via Chiou and Youngs (2008) equations.

Microgravity surveying on a 400 m × 400 m grid, Bouguer reduction, 2nd-order polynomial regional-residual separation, Total Horizontal Derivative (THD) filtering, and 2D polygon gravity modeling (densities 1.60 vs. 2.72 g/cm³).
Neighborhood-aggregated Pearson correlation analysis between severe building damage ratios and geophysical site/basin parameters.
使用Geopsy对多半径圆形台阵（中心台加3-4个外围传感器）记录的垂直分量环境噪声进行空间自相关（SPAC）分析。
反演瑞利波相速度频散曲线获取1D Vs剖面和Vs30，并基于Chiou和Youngs (2008)经验公式估算Z1.0和Z2.5。
开展400m×400m网格微重力测量、布格校正、二阶多项式区域-剩余场分离、总水平导数（THD）滤波及二维多边形重力建模（密度1.60与2.72 g/cm³）。
对街区尺度的建筑严重破坏率与地球物理场地/盆地参数进行Pearson相关性分析。
de: Ambient seismic noise recorded for 60 minutes at 20 sites using SMART-SOLO IGU-BD3C-5 three-component seismometers (0.2 Hz natural frequency, 0.25 ms sampling interval).
Microgravity measurements at 120 stations collected with a Scintrex CG-5 Autograv gravimeter and Leica GPS equipment.
Official post-earthquake building damage inventory of 6,872 evaluated structures in Gölbaşı from the Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change.
使用SMART-SOLO IGU-BD3C-5三分量地震仪（固有频率0.2 Hz，采样间隔0.25 ms）在20个地点连续记录60分钟的环境地震噪声。
使用Scintrex CG-5重力仪和Leica GPS设备在120个测点采集的微重力数据。
土耳其环境、城市化和气候变化部发布的Gölbaşı地区6,872栋建筑震后官方破坏评估清单。
li: Z1.0 and Z2.5 were estimated from Vs30 using NGA-West1 empirical equations rather than directly measured from deep velocity profiles.
Gravity inversion suffers from inherent non-uniqueness and assumes a uniform two-layer density contrast (1.6 vs. 2.72 g/cm³).
Statistical correlation analysis is based on a very small sample size of only 9 neighborhoods, making it exploratory rather than causal.
Dynamic wave propagation mechanisms (resonance, 2D/3D basin edge effects, wave trapping) were not directly simulated.
Z1.0和Z2.5是通过NGA-West1经验公式由Vs30估算得出，而非直接从深部速度剖面测量。
重力反演存在固有的多解性，且假设了均匀的双层密度对比（1.6与2.72 g/cm³）。
统计相关分析仅基于9个街区的小样本，结果属于探索性空间关联而非直接因果证据。
未对共振、2D/3D盆地边缘效应和波场陷获等动力学波传播机制进行直接数值模拟。

tm.why: The paper links subsurface basin geometry, shear-wave velocity structure, and site amplification parameters (Vs30, Z1.0, Z2.5) to building damage distribution from the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes.
The study uses Spatial Autocorrelation (SPAC) analysis of circular-array microtremor recordings to extract Rayleigh-wave phase velocity dispersion curves and invert for 1D Vs profiles.

ev.notes: Full 22-page article PDF used, including all 11 figures, Table 1, methodology equations, and statistical correlation analyses.

sum: Elastically accommodated grain-boundary sliding (EAGBS) is a key candidate for upper-mantle seismic attenuation, yet its theoretically predicted Debye-like attenuation peak is largely absent in dry olivine laboratory experiments. Using 2-D finite-element simulations on periodic Voronoi tessellations, this study evaluates the separate effects of grain-size variance and grain-boundary viscosity heterogeneity on the macroscopic viscoelastic spectrum. While irregular polygonal grain topology increases relaxation strength to ~0.28 relative to regular hexagons (0.18), increasing grain-size variance alone causes minimal spectral broadening. Conversely, a broad log-normal distribution of grain-boundary viscosities progressively flattens and widens the Debye peak into a weak, broad attenuation background. Because integrated dissipation scales linearly with fractional boundary length, the authors formulate a reduced-order 0-D parallel Standard Linear Solid model. Fitting this 0-D model to upper-mantle surface-wave velocities shows that distributed-viscosity EAGBS reproduces both nonlinear high-temperature velocity drops and asthenospheric attenuation (Q^-1 ~ 10^-2).
弹性调节晶界滑移（EAGBS）是上地幔地震衰减的重要机制，但理论预测的德拜峰在干橄榄石实验中却不明显。本文利用周期性Voronoi多晶模型的二维有限元模拟，分别检验了粒径方差和晶界黏度非均质性的影响。结果表明，不规则多边形晶粒使弛豫强度从正六边形的0.18增至约0.28，但仅增加粒径方差几乎不产生谱……

t: 2-D frequency-domain finite-element homogenization on periodic Voronoi tessellations with elastic grain interiors and Newtonian viscous sliding interfaces, complemented by a reduced-order 0-D parallel Debye superposition model.
基于周期性Voronoi网格的二维频域有限元均匀化方法，结合并联德拜单元降阶0-D模型。

Ensembles of 100 2-D periodic 50-grain Voronoi realizations per heterogeneity level, compared against laboratory dry/wet olivine attenuation spectra and upper-mantle surface-wave velocities at 40 and 50 km depths.
每个非均质水平100个50晶粒Voronoi样本系综，结合橄榄石实验谱及40-50 km面波速度。

Irregular grain shapes raise relaxation strength from 0.18 to ~0.28, while broad log-normal boundary viscosity distributions (sigma_eta ~ 3.90) flatten the Debye peak and yield asthenospheric attenuation of Q^-1 ~ 10^-2.
不规则晶粒使弛豫强度从0.18升至0.28；宽黏度分布（sigma_eta~3.90）压平衰减峰并产生Q^-1~10^-…

Assumes linear Newtonian sliding interfaces, omits diffusionally assisted sliding (DAGBS), and restricts simulations to 2-D isotropic elastic grains without 3-D topology or crystallographic anisotropy.
假设线性牛顿滑移界面，未包含扩散辅助滑移（DAGBS），且局限于二维各向同性晶粒。
Separates geometric from rheological heterogeneity in multigrain EAGBS networks, proving that grain-boundary viscosity variance—not grain-size variance—broadens the EAGBS peak into a background.
分离了多晶网络几何与流变非均质性，证实晶界黏度分布而非粒径方差导致EAGBS谱展宽。

kc: Demonstrated via 2-D finite-element simulations on periodic Voronoi aggregates that irregular grain topology increases EAGBS relaxation strength from 0.18 (hexagons) to ~0.28, while grain-size variance causes negligible spectral broadening.
Showed that a broad log-normal distribution of grain-boundary viscosities suppresses and broadens the localized EAGBS Debye peak into a weak, wide-frequency attenuation background.
Established that frequency-integrated dissipation in each viscosity class scales linearly with its total boundary length, motivating a reduced-order 0-D parallel Standard Linear Solid model.

Applied the 0-D distributed-viscosity EAGBS model to upper-mantle seismic data at 40–50 km depth, successfully reproducing nonlinear high-temperature shear-wave velocity reductions and asthenospheric attenuation (Q^-1 ~ 10^-2).
通过周期性Voronoi集合体的二维有限元模拟证明，不规则晶粒拓扑将EAGBS弛豫强度从正六边形的0.18提高到约0.28，而粒径方差几乎不引起谱展宽。
证明了宽泛的对数正态晶界黏度分布会将局域EAGBS德拜峰压制并展宽为微弱的宽频衰减背景。
发现各黏度等级的频率积分耗散与其总晶界长度呈线性正比，进而提出了降阶零维（0-D）并联标准线性固体流变模型。
将0-D分布黏度EAGBS模型应用于40–50 km深度的上地幔地震数据，成功重现了高温非线性剪切波速下降及软流圈量级的地震衰减（Q^-1 ~ 10^-2）。
me: 2-D frequency-domain finite-element homogenization on periodic 50-grain Voronoi representative volume elements (RVEs) using Neper, Netgen, and NGSolve.

Separate parametric ensembles (100 realizations per parameter level) varying log-normal grain-size standard deviation (sigma_a from 0.05 to 0.50) and log-normal grain-boundary viscosity width (sigma_eta from 0.10 to 7.00).
Mechanistic decomposition of macroscopic energy dissipation into 10 log-spaced grain-boundary viscosity bins.

Reduced-order 0-D viscoelastic modeling using a continuous parallel superposition of Debye relaxation elements (Standard Linear Solids) fitted via two-stage nonlinear least squares to seismic shear-wave velocity data.
使用Neper、Netgen和NGSolve在包含50个晶粒的周期性Voronoi代表性体积元（RVE）上进行二维频域有限元均匀化求解。
分别针对对数正态粒径标准差（sigma_a = 0.05至0.50）和晶界黏度分布宽度（sigma_eta = 0.10至7.00）开展独立参数系综模拟（每个参数水平100个样本）。
将宏观耗散能量按10个对数间隔的晶界黏度区间进行机制分解。
利用连续并联叠加的德拜弛豫单元（标准线性固体）构建降阶0-D黏弹性模型，并通过两阶段非线性最小二乘法拟合地震剪切波速数据。
de: Synthetic ensembles of 2-D periodic Voronoi polycrystalline tessellations (50 grains per RVE, 100 realizations per statistical width).
Laboratory forced-oscillation attenuation and modulus spectra for dry synthetic olivine/dunite (Qu et al., 2024, samples A1802 and A1928) and wet olivine (Liu et al., 2023).
Upper-mantle surface-wave shear-velocity versus temperature datasets at 40 km and 50 km depths compiled by Priestley et al. (2024).
二维周期性Voronoi多晶镶嵌合成系综数据集（每个RVE含50个晶粒，每个统计宽度包含100个随机实现）。
干合成橄榄岩/纯橄榄岩（Qu et al., 2024，样品A1802和A1928）与含水橄榄石（Liu et al., 2023）的实验室强迫振荡衰减与模量谱数据。
Priestley et al. (2024) 汇编的40 km和50 km深度上地幔面波剪切波速与温度关系数据集。
li: Assumes a linear Newtonian tangential sliding law along infinitesimally thin grain boundaries, whose exact applicability to real olivine interfaces remains unvalidated.
Excludes diffusionally assisted grain-boundary sliding (DAGBS) and vacancy diffusion in the finite-element solver, restricting validity to the high-frequency EAGBS regime.
Restricted to 2-D isotropic elastic grain interiors without crystallographic elastic anisotropy, 3-D grain network topology, or spatial correlations among neighboring boundary viscosities.
假设无限薄晶界遵循线性牛顿切向滑移定律，该本构关系对真实橄榄石晶界的适用性尚待验证。
有限元模型未包含扩散辅助晶界滑移（DAGBS）和空位扩散，因此仅适用于高频EAGBS机制频段。
局限于二维各向同性弹性晶粒内部，未考虑晶体弹性各向异性、三维晶粒拓扑结构或相邻晶界黏度的空间相关性。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates the micro-physical mechanisms of upper-mantle seismic attenuation (Q^-1) and shear-wave velocity dispersion via elastically accommodated grain-boundary sliding.
The study models viscoelastic properties of dry and wet olivine polycrystals and fits surface-wave velocity and attenuation observations in the upper mantle and asthenosphere.

ev.notes: Full 30-page manuscript PDF (including Appendices A–F, Figures 1–8, Figure F1, and Tables E1–E2) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study calibrates a local magnitude ($M_L$) scale for Taiwan's seismic network, which integrates both surface and borehole stations. Using over eight million Wood-Anderson amplitudes from 188,109 earthquakes and 873 stations, the authors calculate individual station corrections for every instrument and response-change interval. Validation tests show that these corrections reduce station magnitude dispersion by over 50% and misfit to moment magnitude ($M_w$) by 21%. To address magnitude saturation for large events ($M_L > 5.5$), they introduce an adjusted amplitude magnitude ($M_A$) as a proxy for moment magnitude. This workflow ensures magnitude consistency across evolving network configurations and improves the reliability of catalog magnitudes for large earthquakes.
本研究针对台湾整合了地表和井下台站的地震台网，校准了地方震级（$M_L$）标度。利用188,109个地震、873个台站的超800万个伍德-安德森振幅数据，为每个仪器及其响应未变期间计算了单独的台站校正项。验证表明，该校正将台站震级离散度降低了50%以上，与矩震级的偏差减少了21%。为解决大地震（$M……

t: Calibrating local magnitude using station- and interval-specific corrections for Wood-Anderson amplitudes, combined with an adjusted amplitude magnitude proxy for large events.
利用针对伍德-安德森振幅的台站及时间段特定校正来校准地方震级，并结合调整后的振幅震级作为大震代理。
Over eight million Wood-Anderson amplitudes from 188,109 earthquakes recorded by 873 surface and borehole stations in Taiwan.
台湾873个地表和井下台站记录的188,109个地震中的超800万个伍德-安德森振幅数据。
Station corrections reduced median magnitude dispersion by over 50% and reduced misfit to moment magnitude by 21%, improving large earthquake magnitude consistency.
台站校正使中位震级离散度降低了50%以上，与矩震级的偏差减少了21%，提高了大震震级的一致性。
The saturation adjustment for large earthquakes (MA > 5.5) is constrained by a relatively small number of large events in the calibration dataset.
针对大地震（MA > 5.5）的饱和调整受限于校准数据集中极少的大震样本。
Calculating separate corrections for every instrument and every interval of unchanged response, combined with a seamless transition to a moment magnitude proxy.
为每个仪器及其响应未变期间计算单独的校正项，并结合了向矩震级代理的无缝过渡。

kc: Calibrated a highly consistent local magnitude ($M_L$) scale for Taiwan's mixed surface and borehole networks.
Developed a time-dependent correction method that accounts for instrument response changes over specific intervals.
Introduced an adjusted amplitude magnitude ($M_A$) proxy to mitigate magnitude saturation for events larger than 5.5.
针对台湾混合地表和井下台网，校准了高度一致的地方震级（$M_L$）标度。
开发了一种随时间变化的校正方法，考虑了特定时间段内仪器响应的变化。
引入了调整后的振幅震级（$M_A$）代理，以缓解大于5.5级地震的震级饱和问题。
me: Wood-Anderson amplitude measurement from seismic waveforms.
Station- and interval-specific correction estimation.
Empirical regression to align local magnitude with moment magnitude and correct for saturation.
从地震波形中测量伍德-安德森振幅。
估计特定台站和特定时间段的校正项。
通过经验回归使地方震级与矩震级对齐并校正饱和效应。
de: Dataset of over 8 million Wood-Anderson amplitudes from 188,109 earthquakes recorded at 873 stations in Taiwan.
Calendar-year validation experiments to test the predictive performance of the corrections.
包含台湾873个台站记录的188,109个地震的超800万个伍德-安德森振幅的数据集。
采用日历年验证实验来测试校正项的预测性能。
li: The saturation adjustment for large earthquakes is constrained by a relatively small number of large events in the calibration dataset.
针对大地震的饱和调整受到校准数据集中大震样本数量较少的限制。

tm.why: The paper calibrates a local magnitude scale and station corrections to improve earthquake catalog consistency.
It addresses magnitude calibration across mixed surface and borehole seismic networks with changing instrument responses.

ev.notes: No PDF available; analysis based entirely on the abstract.

sum: This paper introduces the Open Wave Library (OWL), an open-source Fortran framework for 2D and 3D seismic wave modeling and time-domain full-waveform inversion (FWI) in isotropic acoustic, isotropic elastic, and general anisotropic elastic media. For forward modeling, OWL uses high-order standard and fully staggered-grid finite-difference (FD) schemes (up to 16th order), curvilinear meshes with vertical near-surface refinement for topographic elastic free surfaces, and auxiliary-differential-equation complex-frequency-shifted multi-axial perfectly matched layers (ADE-CFS-MPML) for long-time stability in strongly anisotropic media. For FWI, OWL reconstructs source wavefields from stored boundary values and implements L2, envelope, cross-correlation, adaptive waveform inversion (AWI), and two novel generalized dynamic time warping (GDTW) misfits (time-shift GWI-1 and warped-amplitude GWI-2) with multi-component constraints. Accelerated by three-level MPI+OpenMP parallelism, OWL is validated against analytical solutions, SPECFEM benchmarks, synthetic models (Marmousi-II, Valles Caldera, 3D faulted, Chevron 2014), and Yilmaz near-surface field data.
本文介绍了开源地震波正演与全波形反演（FWI）框架OWL。方法上，采用最高16阶交错网格与全交错网格有限差分法，结合近地表加密曲线网格处理起伏自由地表，并引入ADE-CFS-MPML保证强各向异性介质长期稳定性；反演采用边界存储重构震源波场，实现了L2、包络、互相关、自适应波形反演（AWI）及两种基……

t: OWL uses up to 16th-order staggered and fully staggered finite-difference schemes with curvilinear near-surface refined meshes and ADE-CFS-MPML for forward modeling, paired with boundary-saving adjoint-state gradients and GDTW-based misfits for FWI.
采用最高16阶交错/全交错网格有限差分、近地表加密曲线网格和ADE-CFS-MPML正演，结合边界存储伴随梯度与GDTW…

Validated using eight analytic/adjoint unit tests, SPECFEM2D/3D benchmarks (including a 3D Valles Caldera model), 2D/3D synthetic FWI models (Marmousi-II, Mountain, 3D faulted), the Chevron 2014 marine benchmark, and Yilmaz near-surface field data.
使用8项解析/伴随单元测试、SPECFEM基准模型、Marmousi-II等合成模型、Chevron海洋数据及Yilma…

Unit tests pass with <0.64% elastic wholespace error and <1.76% adjoint gradient deviation. In 3D faulted FWI, GWI-2 achieves a lower relative model misfit (0.738) than AWI (0.853) and accurately resolves elastic/anisotropic structures.
弹性全空间误差<0.64%，伴随梯度偏差<1.76%；3D断层模型FWI中GWI-2相对模型误差（0.738）低于AWI…

OWL neglects Earth curvature and cannot handle vertical/overhanging topography, attenuative or poroelastic media, coupled acoustic-elastic interfaces, source wavelet/location inversion, or GPU acceleration.
忽略地球曲率，不支持垂直陡崖、衰减/孔隙弹性、声弹耦合、震源反演及GPU加速。

Unifies high-order SSG/FSG finite-difference modeling, near-surface refined curvilinear topography, stable anisotropic ADE-CFS-MPML, and multi-component GDTW-based FWI misfits (GWI-1 and GWI-2) within a single open-source HPC framework.
首次在统一开源框架中集成高阶FD起伏地表、稳定各向异性MPML及多分量约束GDTW反演目标函数。

kc: Developed OWL, an open-source Fortran framework unifying 2D/3D acoustic, isotropic elastic, and general anisotropic elastic wave modeling and FWI.
Implemented curvilinear meshes with vertical near-surface grid refinement and stress-mirroring on fully staggered grids for accurate topographic elastic free-surface modeling.
Formulated systematic ADE-CFS-MPML absorbing boundary conditions with optimal damping ratios to ensure long-time stability in strongly anisotropic elastic media.

Introduced two FWI objective functions based on generalized dynamic time warping (GDTW)—phase-shift minimization (GWI-1) and warped-amplitude difference (GWI-2)—with common warping constraints for multi-component elastic data.

Implemented three-level HPC parallelization (shot-level, MPI domain decomposition, and OpenMP shared-memory) and validated the code via 8 unit tests, SPECFEM comparisons, and synthetic/field FWI benchmarks.
开发了开源Fortran框架OWL，统一了2D/3D声波、各向同性弹性波和一般各向异性弹性波正演与全波形反演。

li: Assumes Cartesian coordinates with negligible Earth curvature; not suitable for regional- or global-scale simulations or domains with vertical/reversed topographic slopes, caves, or voids.

sum: Geodetic and seismic observations prior to the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-oki earthquake revealed decadal-scale acceleration of aseismic slip along the northern Japan Trench. Rather than inverting for spatially smooth slip-rate changes, this study tests a mechanically motivated eroding-asperity model. Using a Metropolis Markov chain Monte Carlo inversion of horizontal GNSS velocity fields from 1998 and 2009, the authors constrain locked patches to historical rupture footprints surrounded by narrow process zones with negative stressing rates, while accounting for viscoelastic mantle relaxation via Visco3D. Results show locked asperities shrank on average from 66% of their rupture areas in 1998 to 37% in 2009, reducing total moment accumulation rate by 20%. Predicted slip accelerations match independent repeating-earthquake estimates, and shrinkage rates align with analytical fracture-mechanics predictions for coseismic stress drops of 0.5–3.5 MPa. This demonstrates that megathrust locking is heterogeneous and evolves substantially over decadal timescales.

sum: Monitoring frozen lake properties typically requires labor-intensive field surveys. This study investigates using wind-generated flexural waves (0.01–0.5 Hz) recorded by a 1000 m distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) cable on Lake Pääjärvi, Finland, to estimate ice thickness and water depth. The authors isolate coherent flexural waves via template matching, extract phase-velocity dispersion curves in the frequency-wavenumber domain across four cable segments, correct for wave incidence angles using cross-correlation beamforming, and invert for effective ice thickness and water depth via grid search. Estimated ice thicknesses (22–34 cm) agree well with drill-hole measurements (25–26 cm, 2%–34% difference), while water depth estimates (0.8–31.75 m) capture the deepening trend toward the lake interior despite underestimating bathymetry by 22%–60%. Notably, the study highlights that lacking low-wavenumber signals degrades deep-water resolution and that wave refraction toward shallow shores must be accounted for to prevent velocity bias.

sum: This study utilizes a dense seismic array of 500 nodes at Cape Modern, Utah, to monitor spatiotemporal velocity variations (dv/v) in the shallow subsurface using ambient-noise tomography. To address azimuthal bias from uneven station distribution, the authors implement a Voronoi tessellation-based path resampling strategy. The resulting spatial maps of dv/v reveal lateral heterogeneity in velocity evolution. The observed velocity decreases and gradual recoveries are frequency-dependent (0.5–1.2 s), indicating a shallow origin. Integrating these observations with environmental data identifies seasonal thermoelastic forcing as the primary driver, showing a 90–100-day delay consistent with thermal diffusion. Shorter periods (0.5–0.8 s) show varying recovery rates (60–130 days) that reflect local thermal conductivity differences, while longer periods (0.8–1.2 s) indicate thermal decoupling at depth. This demonstrates the utility of dense arrays for high-resolution environmental seismology.

sum: Mapping the shallow snow-firn-ice column in Antarctica is vital for assessing ice-sheet stability, but active seismic surveys are logistically demanding and ambient noise lacks high-frequency energy. This study introduces uncontacted airborne seismology, leveraging acoustic-to-seismic (A2S) coupling from overflying aircraft as a repeatable aerial seismic source. Using a 36-node linear array along the runway at Zhongshan Station during 13 airborne overflights, the authors apply seismic interferometry to airborne-only signal segments to retrieve empirical Green's functions across 8–160 Hz. They extract fundamental-mode Rayleigh waves and three P-dominated guided-wave branches (G1–G3), which are jointly inverted to build a quasi-2D model of Vp, Vs, density, and porosity in the upper 100 m. The inversion resolves the firn-ice transition (pore close-off at ~51 m depth, ~830 kg/m³) matching nearby borehole measurements, and is validated with SPECFEM2D-DG simulations, offering a scalable, noninvasive tool for polar monitoring.

sum: This study uses the 3D physics-based boundary element simulator RSQSim to generate synthetic earthquake catalogs for five major faults in the Eastern San Francisco Bay Area (Hayward, Calaveras, Rodgers Creek, Napa, and Franklin). The authors test ten models across two fault geometries (Connected vs. Disconnected) and five rate-and-state friction and coseismic weakening (fa) parameterizations. Results show that fitting the entire catalog (Mw >= 3.9) yields high Gutenberg-Richter b-values (1.38-1.83), whereas fitting Mw >= 5.0 yields b-values near ~1.0-1.2. Connected geometries and stronger weakening (lower fa) promote multi-segment ruptures and lower b-values. Non-creeping models produce 30-year time-independent (22.4-28.9% Hayward; 13.3-20.5% Calaveras) and time-dependent Mw >= 6.7 probabilities consistent with UCERF3 bounds. However, Welch's t-tests against paleoseismic records show that most models fail to reproduce the short recurrence intervals at the creeping Tyson Lagoon site, highlighting limitations of quasi-static simulators in creeping fault zones.
本研究利用三维物理地震模拟器RSQSim生成旧金山东湾五条主要断层的合成地震目录。作者测试了连通与非连通两种几何构型及五种速率-状态摩擦与同震弱化参数组合。结果表明，全目录拟合b值偏高（1.38-1.83），而仅拟合Mw≥5事件时b值降至1.0-1.2。断层连通和强弱化促进了多段破裂。非蠕滑模型的海……

sum: This study analyzes the 24 June 2026 Mw 7.6 Venezuela earthquake sequence using W-phase source inversion, InSAR surface deformation modeling, strong-motion data, and backprojection. The results reveal a complex, multifault rupture that initiated on the right-lateral Boconó fault system before propagating onto the offshore San Sebastián fault (SSF). The rupture lasted approximately 70 seconds, which is twice the duration predicted by global scaling laws. Crucially, backprojection and strong-motion data indicate that the rupture along the SSF reached supershear velocities of up to 5.5 km/s. The event successfully released strain accumulated as a slip deficit previously identified by regional GNSS data. This work provides rare observational evidence of a major multifault supershear rupture.
